legacy or unavailable source inventories remain unqualified. Each declared slot
contributes its actual constructor-dtype scalar allocation and the lazy
Broadcast/AsType/Full descriptor envelope at the actual logical rank. The strict
original binder replaces those slots before evaluation, so the full logical
weight is not an additional physical allocation, shader, or Record event. These
Graph blocks and scalar births enter the same accepted per-span recipe and remain
cumulative; source reuse or early descriptor destruction does not refill slots.
The shared host-copy recipe is incomplete until this constructor contribution has
been consumed. A standalone `ParameterPlaceholder` operation still has no native
recipe qualification. Ordinary layerwise diagnostics retain their in-span
construction trace, and no model-family branch or second execution engine is
introduced.


### Admitted speculative uniform acceptance draws

The portable numerical program has a fixed uniform acceptance phase whose only
source is a completed two-word key belonging to the same request and supplied
stream. Its metadata worker records the ordinary sequential split, both static
key views and the actual F32 `[1]` uniform operation. MLX uses the same
`RandomState::uniform_unit_interval` constructor for this phase and its ordinary
consumer; scalar sources use fallible constructors in the entered native domain.
The source-derived receipt includes all eager uniform sources, casts, binary
workers and RandomBits; the split table and views remain separately counted.

The existing numerical admission, Graph, Record, buffer and recovery owners
cover both the uniform scalar and advanced key. Direct scalar access follows
their prepared completion; the external key is replaced only after terminal
success and exact Record retirement. A failed attempt preserves the source key
and its cumulative request charge. This producer neither certifies arbitrary
sampler callbacks nor imports an unadmitted caller-owned key. Consumer wiring is
separate from the producer qualification.

The shared speculative sampler carries ordinary native PRNG values and completed
original keys in a closed sum type. Original seed creation, sequential root
splitting, position-addressed draft keys, categorical choice and acceptance
draws consume the same prepared numerical phase engine. Their consumer validates
the retained request and the selected stream before changing a key; a completed
phase publishes the new key only after its output roots settle. A raw Array key
cannot enter this path, and an original key cannot acquire an ordinary unquoted
owner through a fallback. Original controlled seed failures transfer their
already funded neutral source without another erasure allocation.

The carrier is an immutable alias for cloning purposes; this does not qualify an
independent controlled RNG snapshot. Such snapshots and split-stream key
transport still require their actual admitted copy producers. The ordinary
acceptance draw uses the same RandomState uniform worker as the numerical phase.
No public managed-speculation gate is removed by this consumer integration.


### Prepared plain speculative controller destinations

`SpeculativeSampler::prepared_controller` is separate from the immutable
standard-policy copy witness. Only the actual facade Text controller supplies
its fixed prefix/tokenizer source and paid history-copy destination; grammar,
forbidden-trigger and unknown callbacks retain the default rejection. Native
consumers must authenticate the paired filter source and lower the actual mask
before applying the returned standard policy. These borrowed declarations do
not register source storage or grant numerical allocation authority.

Prepared history copies allocate independent fixed buffers under supplied host
custody; immutable aliases cannot grow or mutate. Commitment validates the
pending choice, copies policy/controller into a paid provisional destination,
and uses the same policy-then-controller commit worker. The old source remains
unchanged on failure and is replaced only after success. Prefix completion keeps
the existing forced-history and durable-prefix checks. Ordinary Vec/controller
behavior remains in the same workers. This component does not qualify native
mask construction, native selection, public request admission or capture.


Saved media resume associates the captured completed input with its fresh funded
workspace before the first decoder/key copy span. The source projection and
registered selection move into the existing media quote worker; later spans keep
that selection on the same cumulative metadata account. Copied decoder/key
outputs remain new destinations. Starting another span cannot reopen selection
or reset the metadata budget.

Post-commit continuation retains a separate publication witness borrowed from the
saved decoder's exact immutable cache. This account-only witness authenticates the
same prepared-input materialization and pool during normal model publication. It
contains no tensor roots, source credit, media ingress plan or old generation
request, and preserves the existing exact cache-account comparison. The quote and
its work owners retain that closed account alias through publication and failure;
ordinary cache identities supply no original witness.


### Composite prepared layerwise source handoff

Cold physical destination projection now uses the architecture dispatcher's
existing replicated and composite routes. Both visit the same actual static
modules and each selected execution-unit ordinal through one shared collector.
Composite media admission metadata is retained by its normal construction;
this projection does not fabricate input or execute encoders. Packed geometry
and companions remain outputs of ordinary architecture module constructors.
Addressable banks keep their separate selected materialization ownership.

The native loader's mutually exclusive visitors borrow one stack-only slot for
the already-admitted `PreparedLayerwiseManager`. The chosen architecture route
moves it into the same mechanism constructor and consumes the existing exact
declaration/store/stream validator. Composite direct, media and routed binders
therefore preserve the ready-host or foreground-disk source owner instead of
silently rebuilding an ordinary manager. The original request still requires
the authenticated cached source snapshot, finite operation windows and complete
native receipts; neither this handoff nor a successful cold projection relaxes
those gates. Ordinary construction without a prepared manager delegates as before.


### Native speculative plain-controller ownership

The original sampler constructor and snapshot copy consume the actual prepared
plain-controller destination. A borrowed shared tokenizer filter is accepted
only after neutral core verifies its existing domain attachment and runtime
checks the canonical registry identity/capacity. Both checks allocate nothing;
they neither register/adopt the filter nor discount its bytes. The controller
retains its actual immutable filter, keeping existing custody alive. Empty
numerical filters retain their existing no-registration behavior.

Committed logit/token values pass the same native request/stream/domain checks
as immutable policy commits. The paid provisional controller replaces the old
closed sampler owner only after success; typed copy failures retain host custody.
Snapshots preserve both their own copy H and the original owner's metadata
funding for context-free fixed prefix validation. Original construction no longer
requires an unused ordinary NativeMemoryOwner; ordinary construction still does.
The exact tokenizer/forced mask now precedes the standard policy inside the
existing numerical phase. One borrowed mask worker preserves truncated-domain
validation and false padding, and fills the already-admitted Boolean destination.
Ordinary sampling consumes that same worker. The source mask remains borrowed;
its old short-mask expansion allocation is unnecessary and its previous
conservative host allowance remains unchanged.

Only successful filtered/policy values carry the private native choice marker.
It retains allocation-free aliases of the actual prepared prefix/filter and
fixed choice state, never a name/shape-only identity. Greedy, categorical and
controller commitment reject a missing or stale marker. Normalization preserves
it; stochastic correction carries the target/left marker while permitting the
draft's older durable prefix, as required by the shared per-token commit loop.
The marker retires before the numerical value/funding and does not enter native
backing custody. Unknown controller/policy callbacks, capture, enclosing public
request preparation and other unfinished producers remain gated.

The shared speculative sampling consumer now invokes the paid provisional
controller commit adapter for original processed values. Grammar-free policies
retain their existing unchanged-commit path inside that adapter. Original
prefix completion uses the fixed controller history checks and the retained
source funding; it does not bypass those checks by returning the stored grammar
completion flag. Ordinary preparation supplies its existing native owner as an
optional argument, so original preparation need not acquire an unquoted owner.
The constrained numerical mask and choice producers remain separate requirements
before public managed speculation can be admitted.


Independent original drafter execution borrows its actual immutable executable
for paired-source validation, then uses the same mutable operation owner as
ordinary drafting. The funded entry reserves its concrete retention slot,
prepared recovery/scope and one typed failure transport from the supplied
request metadata account before allocation. That account stays in both native
scope custody and typed recovery retention; recovery keeps the actual drafter
payload through unresolved work, failure and unwinding. Funded errors retain the
exact cause and account without formatting a replacement diagnostic.

The enclosing drafter scope must begin before any native phase arena. It owns
payload lifetime and poisoning only: child phases retain their exact independent
quotas, occurrence claims, observers and completion checks. Native ancestry updates
existing counters without allocating another Record for the enclosing scope.
Neither an outer poll failure nor returning from the driver supplies a numerical
completion certificate. The existing synchronous-success wait and nonblocking
failure/quarantine paths remain shared with ordinary drafting.

The originally funded target operation uses the existing SessionOperation,
SubmissionResources and move-only neutral submission lease. Its cold source loan
requires a healthy, idle, exclusively owned executable. Paired-source preparation
authenticates that actual executable; no ordinary memory lease or reconstructed
storage inventory is introduced. The funded entry reserves the concrete resource
owner, prepared Recovery/scope and typed failure transport before constructing
them. Native child phases own independent numerical admission and completion.

The enclosing scope starts outside phase arenas and retains the actual payload
through the existing failure, unwind and quarantine paths. Its metadata account
outlives every SubmissionResources field, scope and returned failure shell.
Original errors skip ordinary formatted diagnostic copies. A polling error does
not authorize release; successful completion still uses the shared finalizer.

Cold speculative request construction reads the scheduler options retained by
the actual neutral visitor. Ordinary and controlled visitors expose the same
policy they pass to the shared scheduler. The existing validated independent
schedule constructor is available before native executables are mutably
borrowed; it creates no native resources or invocation authority. Native
source-pair binding still authenticates the exact target/draft frontiers against
that retained schedule. Custom visitors with no declared fixed policy keep an
unknown bound rather than being assigned a different scheduler policy.

Independent original request composition now lends the actual draft selection
beside its mutable model under the existing funded guard. It builds one shared
occurrence schedule, binds actual target/draft source epochs, and moves that
schedule into the ordinary AutoregressiveExecutor. Both model guards and source
preparation retain the same cumulative metadata account; no selected-realization
clone, replacement stream, ordinary lease or alternate inference driver is used.

Closing future request issuance preserves already issued value/copy/completion
custody. This composition is one prerequisite for public managed speculation.
The original plain semantic producer described below is implemented; the public
lane frontdoor still has to consume its source preparation and the original
prompt producer before the managed-policy gate can be removed. Split transport,
structured semantic profiles and heterogeneous batch occurrence ownership remain
separate unfinished integrations.

Plain speculative semantic preparation starts from the exact `OriginalTokenizer`
and `OriginalStopSource`, with a source-bound host header admitted before facade
stop/decoder/event construction. It uses the existing fixed decoder, literal-stop,
terminal projection and isolated-copy workers. The shared speculative driver still
controls tentative forks, rollback, cache commitment, cancellation and publication.
The header retains the actual selected execution identity, original tokenizer,
admitted ceiling and cumulative account. Its private existing request-identity
owner is paid before birth; no identity alias is exported. Clones and semantic
forks retain that exact preparation. Native composition validates pool/execution,
semantic-header equality, and separately checks configuration/callback provenance.
The facade's internal preparation helper constructs a fresh EOS Vec and concrete
callback Box through that header, then consumes their closed carriers into the
existing lane and freshly paid single-lane buffer. It does not certify its older
HF decoder/parser or adopt an already allocated lane vector.

`SpeculativeSemanticOwner` closes concrete Box retirement before host funding
retires. Transaction forks clear pending events, matching the existing worker;
controlled snapshots preserve their actual queued events and independently copied
decoder/stop progress. Normal publication drains the fixed event queue in place.
`SemanticEvent::TextDelta` uses `SemanticText`: ordinary String conversion preserves
ordinary behavior and wire serialization, while originally copied text retains a
closed immutable owner through callbacks, clones and final destruction. No managed
String/Vec export exists. Typed host-capacity failures remain allocation-free;
unknown semantic callback constructors retain their rejection.

`SpeculativeConfiguration` and `SpeculativeEventCallback` preserve their exact
constructor funding and private preparation identity through all lane handoffs.
Ordinary `From` conversions have no prepared identity. Matching settings/source
names cannot authenticate another account's carrier, and a managed EOS Vec or
callback Box has no raw owning exit. The shared request worker copies borrowed
EOS rows into its existing destination while the initial owner remains alive.
The callback publisher moves the closed callback without reboxing; the raw boxed
ordinary entry remains available. The caller's prior captured payload allocations
and arbitrary application callback work remain caller-owned. Publisher controls
are a separate actual producer. The focused plain-state regression includes exact
execution/account mismatch checks and EOS/callback retirement after state/source
destruction, alongside tentative isolation, snapshot events and event alias custody.
The source-explicit facade now consumes these producers through
`generate_managed_plain_text_speculative` and
`with_controlled_managed_plain_text_speculative`, using the same shared speculative
driver. Original E is lent to the neutral backend prompt hook, which validates the
closed header/source before original I and completed B construction. The prompt
hook defaults to a fixed refusal. The initial empty plain controller retains its
actual existing shared validity and paid controls; native provisional history
copies still use their existing producer. Generic cold backend-error erasure and
all enclosing facade returns use the same header H. These methods neither route
through ordinary PreparedChat construction nor acquire an unquoted native owner.
Controlled mode borrows the original tokenizer IDs for its vocabulary extent and
uses the existing controlled scheduler, snapshot and rollback workers. Its fixed
outer failure marker preserves the actual typed error in the caller destination;
ordinary diagnostic formatting remains unchanged. Closed controlled records use the
same compact JSON serializer with a paid infallible counter, followed by the fixed
transport-limit comparison; limit refusal creates no io/serde error allocation and
leaves consumed transport bytes unchanged. Ordinary arbitrary-Serialize accounting
keeps its existing short-circuit writer. Captures/activation edits still
require their own original source producers and receive a fixed pre-preparation
rejection here. Wider batches, embedded/alternative prediction strategies and
structured semantics remain separate unfinished joins; native routing must validate
the actual supported role/occurrence/source geometry.

Original speculative numerical and model scopes bind their prepared root collector
before enabling original native controls. That collector performs the one binding
of its retained failure carrier to the exact new Scope and Graph domain. The
separate direct failure-binding route is used only by scopes without such a
collector. Rebinding the same carrier after controls are enabled remains a native
domain refusal; source identity, quotas, completion and retirement checks are
unchanged.


Original speculative numerical phases use the existing synchronous recovery
finish after their prepared root completion succeeds. A single nonblocking
record poll can still observe a healthy pending terminal publication, so it
does not decide successful advancement. Failed construction or root completion
continues through nonblocking recovery retention. Successful finish is followed
by exact-owner record retirement; pending, failed, blocked and retirement-refusal
states retain their typed cause and cannot publish a numerical value.

The MLX speculative lane adapters now pass the neutral SpeculativeBuffer through
external, embedded and independent batch setup to the shared delivery driver.
Ordinary preparation moves its existing Vec into the ordinary buffer variant;
original preparation must use that buffer's pre-admitted retained constructor.
The lane's native ordinary memory owner is optional, allowing the existing
original sampler constructor to consume actual paired-request funding without
acquiring an unrelated ordinary lease. These carrier changes do not admit an
unprepared prompt, semantic state, callback or lane by themselves.


The shared MLX random-state worker selects split-table rows through static
Slice/Reshape indexing. Both sequential splitting and positional subkeys use
the same operation described by WorkspaceSamplingRandomState. The previous
scalar-index adapter created an eager index tensor and Gather under a quote
for a static view; exact graph-constructor admission correctly rejected that
mismatch. This correction preserves split-table values and replaces neither
the original graph check nor its storage bound.


Original plain token input uses the existing full prepared-input compiler with
no encoder tables. Selection is structural: one positive `[1, N]` U32 text/token
payload without metadata or extents. Tokenizer, vocabulary and family semantics
remain in the shared preparation and model drivers. The completed text packet
retains the original I/B source and both canonical native/typed views; its
conversion into a model input creates no raw array adoption or ordinary lease.
Media supplies its same architecture-owned encoder plan to the shared compiler.

An isolated copy of this packet projects its genuine single prepared payload
into exact workspace roots and retains `OriginalPreparedWorkspaceSource`. The
closed `RegisteredPreparedWorkspaceCopy` preserves that B account separately
from registered origins and cannot enter legacy sampler/decoder copy aggregates.
Its admitted operation shares the existing copy account, completion, recovery
and publication workers, adding only the paid fixed source-pin pair. No native
registry row or source credit is inferred from matching dimensions, H identity,
a raw array or available capacity. Ordinary registered copies keep their source
checks and constructor behavior.


Resident equation recording accepts the shared driver's exact token-placeholder
ordinal with either signed or unsigned 32-bit token IDs. Original speculative
prefill preserves its admitted U32 source, whereas the ordinary text placeholder
is I32. The recorder still requires one zero-input Initialize output at that
ordinal and replaces it with the actual prepared span input recipe; other dtypes
and arbitrary operations remain rejected.


An original speculative equation installs a nested-completion program only when
its selected recipe contains nested evaluations. A zero-attempt plan is absent,
not a valid native nested program; the native positive-population check remains
unchanged. Successful span completion finishes the existing recovery owner before
retiring its exact records. Construction failures retain the established recovery
Drop path and never use one polling result as universal completion.


The native speculative lane adapter moves closed configuration, semantic,
callback and lane-buffer owners through the shared driver. An originally admitted
independent request authenticates its closed semantic preparation against the
actual pool and target execution, then reuses that header's cumulative account
and capacity. Publisher construction reserves its own controls before retaining
the same account; callbacks move directly without an additional closure box.
The header grants no native operation or source-copy permission. Public request
admission still requires matching input/controller/semantic preparation.


Source-explicit managed speculative lanes route before ordinary native-domain
acquisition. The adapter authenticates their actual semantic preparation,
configuration and callback identity against the selected session, derives the
request extent through shared speculative geometry, and lends the original
configuration while constructing the schedule. It does not duplicate the EOS
buffer to satisfy a borrow. One independent target/drafter lane then uses the
same funded source pair, cache construction and ordinary shared driver. Wider
batching and embedded/external prediction sources remain unfinished original
producers, exposed as typed unknown bounds rather than architecture limitations.


The MLX public error adapter moves an existing StorageSource neutral envelope
directly, preserving its original source and custody. Like OriginalControl and
saved-copy failures, this path creates no second erasure box at the facade
boundary. Unretained cold failures continue to use ordinary translation.


Original speculative RNG snapshots use the shared isolated-array-copy program. A
completed numerical key retains the exact native buffer budget from its successful
phase, alongside its closed numerical request provenance. The snapshot adapter
authenticates the full backing identity and capacity against that budget before
projecting the source. A selected two-word key can retain an entire split table;
its logical shape does not replace that backing proof. No existing array is
retroactively registered or adopted as an original source.

The distinct neutral `OriginalNumericalWorkspaceCopy` binds the actual sealed
copy trace and original numerical account. It uses the same copy capacity
comparison, locked source-health validation and account commit as registered
copies. Its sole work scope retains account-only source custody plus the accepted
host preparation. The native contiguous/deep-copy worker, recovery and canonical
destination publication remain shared. Successful synchronous copies finish the
existing recovery worker before publishing; errors do not certify completion.
A copied key keeps its independent published backing and copy account; later
snapshots use that existing registered source. Numerical request charges and
controlled copy counters do not rewind on snapshot, failure or restoration.

The immutable sampler owner retains copy prerequisites and a closed request
identity (schedule, issuance account and pool), without retaining a request list
or native graph. Shared metadata funding is not request identity. Target and
draft keys are copied separately; each escaping key retains snapshot host custody
through its array and shared-shell destruction. Unknown sampler copies, ordinary
keys supplied to an original snapshot and foreign request keys still refuse before
copy execution. Ordinary sampler and RNG cloning remains unchanged.


Original speculative plain input authenticates the exact encoded-token source
against its retained tokenizer/header and the idle selected executable before
constructing I or B. The MLX adapter borrows those IDs into the existing
`PreparedHostInputPlan` and full text-input compiler. Host caller/error controls
use the header's existing cumulative funding; immutable I and full native B keep
their own existing source accounts and the same domain ceiling. No ordinary
array is adopted and no second semantic metadata account is opened.

When a concrete B construction fails, the neutral materialization-error owner
can consume its native prefix through that mechanism's existing retirement and
preserve the exact compiler/accounting cause, I source and accounting-only B
retention. This conversion allocates no shell and supplies no completion or
retry authority. Deferred native aliases retain their own original custody;
the public error erasure contains no thread-bound native arena. The adapter
pays its source-erasure controls before construction and retains the header
funding after the actual failure fields.

The portable facade now directly depends on eredu-nn for the neutral WorkspaceMetadataFunding contract retained by original speculative preparation and its failures. This promotes the previous development dependency; the facade still invokes numerical work through backend contracts, and eredu-nn introduces no concrete-backend feature.


Original speculative Mirostat V2 uses the same prepared cutoff and categorical
programs as ordinary Mirostat. Its immutable native sampler owner now consumes a
closed runtime adaptive-commit plan. The plan borrows the actual current policy,
prices its complete history copy and the existing doubling growth before either
allocation, and preserves tau, eta and mu. The runtime's ordinary probability
predicate and mu/history update are shared with the prepared worker; unknown
callbacks do not acquire this witness.

The native commit first authenticates the completed processed logit and supplied
request/stream, then obtains `softmax(processed)[token]` through the existing
admitted normalization and scalar-selection phases. Each phase retains its own
cumulative request charge and source-derived Graph, Record and physical storage
plan through successful completion or failure. Only then does a paid provisional
host copy update mu and history. The immutable owner is replaced on success, so
an earlier sampler snapshot preserves its independent history and adaptive state.
The already-qualified independent RNG copy remains unchanged.

Plain prospective-token controllers compose this same adaptive worker with their
existing prepared copy and policy-before-controller commit order. A forced choice
still takes the ordinary categorical draw, and Mirostat observes its normalized
probability; failure discards the provisional policy and controller together.
Zero-temperature Mirostat and optimistic promotion retain their existing semantic
restrictions. This does not qualify arbitrary grammar or sampler callbacks.

Focused coverage accompanies the producer: neutral copy/growth, invalid-probability
and forced-controller rollback cases, plus an ignored native case using two real
admitted executables and a genuinely prepared original prompt. That case compares
three nonzero Mirostat processing/choice/commit steps, history penalties, saved mu
and history, RNG advancement and final retirement with ordinary execution. It must
be run on native hardware before reporting end-to-end adaptive validation.


Original speculative state copies use the same completed-allocation source contract
as numerical RNG snapshots. After a model span's exact root completion, successful
Recovery settlement and observer retirement, the MLX independent-state owner
retains each surviving role allocation's generation identity, full backing capacity,
actual native budget and account-only role custody. It visits copied operands and
retained state roots. An unchanged root keeps its actual earlier budget; a foreign
or ordinary root gains no role credit. The next copy re-observes the native budget,
identity and whole capacity. Other roots must pass the existing registered-source
pin validator. No raw allocation is adopted into the registry.

The portable completed-source binding joins these exact accounted roots with any
existing registered roots through the shared storage-selection worker. Numerical
snapshots retain their existing public adapter, which delegates to the same copy
admission. Model source vectors, closed shared account groups and pin constructors
are paid before their destinations are created. Their account-only custody contains
no native arrays, state or request backedge, and their storage retires before host
funding. Native copying, destination publication, quarantine and budget comparison
remain in the existing isolated-copy worker. Successful copied checkpoints have
registered destination backing; source facts move with the independent state and
are refreshed only after another successful terminal model span. This closes the
second bounded-prefill checkpoint source handoff without reusing a previous role's
execution authority or refunding cumulative request charges.


Original independent-state snapshots retain the same immutable
`OriginalSpeculativeSourceIdentity` used by RNG snapshots: selected schedule,
actual request account and working-memory pool. Restoring a snapshot authenticates
that exact issuance and executable origin before charging the snapshot's metadata
account or entering native copy. A second request sharing the schedule, source
models and host metadata funding is still foreign and receives the fixed typed
identity refusal. The existing checkpoint/copy/publication and completion machinery
is unchanged; same-request restore remains independently admitted. The focused
native categorical fixture checks this boundary using its real two-span state,
including unchanged accounting on foreign refusal and subsequent valid restore.

#### Original speculative controlled continuations

Controlled restore and branch exchange keep the original request, source pair,
observation ledger and cumulative copy budget. Restoring a canonical snapshot now
prepares a fresh finite set of remaining decoder occurrences before copying any
mutable state. The core passes both the saved committed length and lifecycle to
the same executor: a live committed boundary adds remaining proposal,
verification and commit attempts; a terminal snapshot, including early EOS, adds
none. Pending prefill, unresolved proposals and cancelled states do not acquire a
continuation from their token count.

The portable independent executor retains its existing schedule identity and
monotonic pass/global ordinals. The same original request replaces its actual
role-slot destination only after the source-pair metadata account pays the full
replacement buffer and controls. Existing role accounts move into that closed
buffer; failed admission leaves them installed, and accepted work never refunds
old metadata, copying or observations. Each later model invocation still requires
its own exact source-derived P/Graph/Record/H admission and completion. The
ordinary executor uses the unchanged default hook.

The native public fixture
`managed_plain::speculative::native_original_stochastic_speculation_restores_forks_and_preserves_limits`
compares positive-temperature output with an actual ordinary independent
speculative baseline, then exercises committed-state replay, child/parent
isolation and cumulative copy/trace refusal in fresh processes. The portable
`restored_occurrences_extend_paid_storage_without_recycling_spent_roles` check
covers exhaustion, terminal/invalid lifecycle handling, duplicate-extension
refusal and final role custody. These are focused checks; native execution results
must be recorded from the parent integration run.

### Original capture checkpoints and continuation destinations

`FundedCaptureSession::prepare_checkpoint` shares the ordinary drained-boundary
predicate and copies only a fixed frontier/usage record plus the actual immutable
`SharedCapturePlan` alias under the saved-generation host provider's admitted H.
The checkpoint has no native handles, mutable ledger, claim cursor, or cloned
semantic declarations. Source registration and native completion remain the
backend transaction's obligations; host custody alone cannot prove either.

A funded checkpoint prices a fresh remaining interval through the existing
`CaptureRunHostPlan` frame/tensor constructors. Claims keep absolute prediction
coordinates and the new bank must match the actual shared source and saved
frontier. Its sole continuation constructor inherits cumulative usage with the
existing `CaptureLedger::with_inherited_usage` worker. It does not reset source
claims or replace a live ledger. Ordinary same-run restoration still rewinds
only schedule state; independently admitted children inherit the saved usage.
The native saved-components source, observed continuation quote and installed
destination now consume these producers through the existing resume transaction.


Original live raw activation capture consumes the existing selected equation and
capture claim. The funded observer obtains its current MLX observer from the
retained ModelExecution owner or the same request's registered prefill-role bank;
TLS only checks that identity. Each accepted whole tensor (including an empty
selection), and each nonempty physical prefill fragment, performs the shared
source settlement and selected-output settlement through two finite nested
completion slots. The same selected Slice/Preview/AsType worker then reads the
completed output directly. It creates no evaluation scope or alternative
observation scheduler. Future floating metadata still retains the possible
half-to-F32 conversion obligation; shape/output/retention metadata uses the
participating WorkspaceContext.

The actual accepted observer count extends its own recorded span's Graph/Record
frontiers and original publication attempts. A one-row original collector uses
the already accepted control custody, publishes the actual settled backing using
the existing native publication bank, and stays local through the scheduled
source pin and host transfer. Successful pure-native publication attaches its
registration to that backing; failed prefixes stay in the same Work's native
recovery list. This does not consume either final model-publication inventory,
certify the full work, or refund any capture/native count. The selected controls
include the closed clone/metadata/readout/error populations before their births;
unknown original role or capacity evidence refuses rather than choosing the
ordinary worker. Ordinary capture continues to use its existing evaluation and
publication route. Saved native capture-ledger snapshots remain a separate
integration obligation.

#### Source-explicit managed plain capture delivery

`LoadedModel::start_observed_managed_plain_text` and
`generate_observed_managed_plain_text` consume the caller's existing
`SharedCapturePlan` alongside the original tokenizer source. Managed admission
starts at that supplied semantic plan; discovery and plan construction remain
separate caller operations. The shared plain startup passes the exact source
through core `TextPreparationOptions`. The selected backend validates its actual
request/discovery identity and uses the existing original source publication,
collector bank and native transform/completion producers. The facade neither
copies a plan nor falls back to ordinary observed-chat preparation.

The returned owner is the existing `ManagedPlainTextSession`. Its `advance` and
`run` use the same retained text cursor and `BackendGenerationTokenSource`
delivery path. A caller-borrowed observer receives the optional token, the actual
`CapturedStepDelivery`, and active step duration before text events. Completed
cancellation or failed execution can deliver a frame without a token; the
existing execution error retains precedence if draining also fails. Shared
frames move with their original custody and may outlive the session without a
raw DTO copy. No JSON transport buffer or additional trace policy is implied.

`ManagedPlainTextSession::with_capture_observer` changes only the borrowed
callback and can attach a fresh observer after a separately admitted restore.
It does not install capture, grant new capture/copy limits or snapshot callback
state. The original startup's concrete consumer envelope includes the options
transport. Native source, collector and escaped frame/error lifetimes remain
owned by the existing core/runtime/backend contracts.

Original speculative categorical sampling retains the authenticated RNG input's
prepared numerical stream on the completed advanced key. The logits input may
retain a model stream, which does not supply the numerical key-copy source
witness. Both input streams and request identities are checked before execution;
the returned key retains the actual completed numerical allocation budget and
continues through the existing independent snapshot-copy admission. No stream
or funding account is created by this owner selection.

Funded capture checkpoints also retain a closed cumulative-usage source. Before
each same-lineage capture operation the existing ledger worker inherits the
current totals; after observer cleanup, including errors and unwind, its totals
are recorded without refund. A fixed busy marker excludes simultaneous spending;
no mutex is held across backend callbacks. The closed source owns only fixed
counters and the original account-only H which paid them. Its Arc allocation
retires before that H, with no session, bank, native storage or source backedge.

`FundedCaptureCheckpoint::into_restoration` preserves this live source, including
spending after the snapshot. Explicit `into_continuation` remains independent
fork semantics with saved usage and a newly admitted owner. Neither constructor
reuses a spent physical claim bank. Native saved-capture routing passes explicit
restore/fork intent and consumes the exact observed continuation.

Original controlled speculative token forcing uses the same pending-choice,
canonical-domain and filter validation order as ordinary forcing. Its known
plain-controller adapter copies the actual policy and history under the source's
existing metadata account, stages the prospective choice in that isolated copy,
and replaces the closed sampler only after success. The RNG, committed prefix
and model state do not advance during force or clear. Snapshot aliases retain
the preceding immutable controller. Clearing uses an additive fallible callback
so a refused destination reservation reaches the public neutral control error
instead of being reported as an absent choice; ordinary callbacks keep their
existing behavior. Every escaping copied-controller failure retains its paying
host custody, and failed attempts do not refund prior constructor spending.


Original capture completion extends a recorded equation through the same nested
frontier constructor used by its native execution bank and Graph/Record queries.
When the accepted callback needs more root slots than the original final root
list, that constructor adds the difference to both reachable descriptors and
Synchronizer input edges while preserving every primitive edge. It keeps the
final submission cardinality unchanged. This also covers a one-operation row
whose capture is the first nested completion; native traversal validation stays
mandatory and missing dispatch evidence remains unknown.

Original text snapshots now pass the complete generation state to the shared
saved-component constructor. MLX derives a drained `FundedCaptureCheckpoint`
from the actual installed collector, checks its immutable plan identity against
the source quote and its absolute frontier against the sampler, and includes the
fixed checkpoint/Rc destination in pre-grant H and logical snapshot accounting.
The existing native decoder/sampler/input copy carries a closed checkpoint alias
in its source provenance; subsequent independent data copies retain that alias.
Its final Rc shell retires before checkpoint sources and H, with no model/native
backedge. Sampling-only copies still reject a source containing capture. This
qualifies immutable snapshot capture, not fresh observed resume: the saved-origin
trace, restored-versus-independent ledger intent, and fresh original claim-bank
installation remain required and the resume quote explicitly rejects meanwhile.


Independent speculative equation inspection now lends the actual selected
ready-host or foreground-disk parameter inventory through the same architecture
workspace worker used for resident sources. The source getter shares the prepared
manager snapshot and validates its immutable selection under the existing source
lock; the counted entry refuses before legacy snapshot construction. Its caller
pays the concrete inspection/result frames from the current request's metadata
account before borrowing the source. The retained layerwise owner moves with the
quoted invocation and, for prefill, the closed program through exact completion;
it retires before the funding owner. Source identities remain descriptive and
do not grant new storage or native submission authority.

The independent native residency bank remains a separate required producer.
Moving the existing parameter source into a quote does not reclassify the
speculative occurrence as a text-generation step or grant text-control custody.
Ready-host/foreground transfer, materialization, pinning and group-submission
slots must still be bound to the actual accepted speculative role before those
selected routes can execute.

Native capture during original prefill borrows the observer retained by the
active input transaction's prepared construction bank. A private weak projection
connects that root owner to the prefill bank; it introduces no new scope, account,
or strong root lifetime. Every role transition clears the previous projection,
and completed or dropped construction banks cannot authorize capture. Failed or
blocked native owners also refuse; error/unwind seals the existing Recovery
scope, removing its current-role authority even if its payload remains retained.
The consumer clones the already retained observer and checks the current native
scope for equality after releasing all Rust bank loans. Optional unit-operation
registration continues to authenticate unit work independently; its absence in
a resident strategy no longer hides the actual admitted prefill role. New weak
projection/control layouts are included in the existing root and bank queries.


Native operation slots now use the neutral `OriginalOperationMetadataCustody`
carrier for both accepted text operations and independent speculative roles. Its
closed alternatives retain only the existing raw text-control account or the
existing speculative budget account. It contains no native payload, equation
plan, source graph, reservation conversion, or permission to allocate. Read-only
metadata/source checks use the actual account's pool; role comparison uses the
exact speculative account, never geometry or equal capacity.

Both selected neural banks call the same finite slot factory and preparation
error worker. The outer bank still validates its existing exact request or role,
stream, active Scope and once-only claim before constructing slots. Native
completion and poison/retirement behavior remain shared. Escaping reserve/clone
errors retain the same metadata account through partial-slot cleanup. The actual
slot, callback, result and retained-error layouts are priced by the same queries
for both callers. This shared custody carrier is also the required lifetime
interface for extending the existing host/foreground residency slots; it does
not itself qualify those still-unjoined operation banks.


The existing retained residency name catalogs, canonical value cells, closure
ID buffers and controller-attempt buffers now retain the same account-only
operation metadata carrier used by neural slots. Their constructors still consume
the actual manager's immutable source and exact closure/window populations;
canonical aliases keep the original cell's custody. The existing outer operation
bank retains and authenticates the exact text request or independent role
separately. A matching metadata domain is never accepted as a substitute for that
source/occurrence check. Construction, mutable controller validation and partial
failure behavior remain the same workers, with actual owner and projection
layouts included in their existing control queries.

Saved prompt construction validates physical readout against the same retained
selection helper used by quotation. A capture source that requires full-sequence
logits therefore keeps that demand through restoration, including a shortened
output allowance; ordinary saved text continues to require the last position.
The comparison remains exact and supplies no new source or native authority.

Saved capture quotation retains the actual installed path/readout companion and
source witness in the checkpoint's priced closed host owner. Fresh resume reuses
those immutable source handles without rebuilding a registration inventory. The
same saved-copy quote seals the remaining absolute capture schedule, new host
claim bank, native Graph/Record program and source publication. Existing source
storage receives no new credit; the shared C publisher reserves its exact
capacity conservatively and keeps both source and new publication custody.

Core's original resume hook carries explicit restoration or branch intent through
the existing saved-generation preparation. Sampling constructs the new collector
inside that transaction: restoration shares current live cumulative usage,
including spending after the snapshot; an independently admitted branch inherits
snapshot usage. Native installation, readiness, rollback, delivery and snapshot
copy budgets remain the same workers. The generation machine retains its actual
installed capture source instead of silently becoming unobserved.

A saved post-commit token is one physical prefill span at an absolute logical
decode coordinate. A borrowed view of the original span authenticates source,
path companion, coordinate, geometry and request before the existing prefill
gateway. Both MLX tensor/array observer adapters forward this same borrowed
continuation contract, so erasure preserves its source and admission identity.
The same funded observer claims the decode frame and native completion
authenticates the physical prefill owner. Later decoding retains the absolute
coordinate. Full-sequence readout and actual raw capture completion/publication
counts remain in the shared equation recipe. This implementation still needs
joined native restore/fork validation. An initial-prompt snapshot uses the same
prefill row companion and fragment worker with an explicitly shortened output
allowance. Its sealed checkpoint still authenticates the original source and
prompt axes; ordinary selection binding remains exact. Other capture profiles
keep their existing gates.

### Native graph construction lookup

A short active-generation profile of the measured 3,000-token managed Qwen run
found 504 of 973 sampled main-thread stacks in GraphConstruction::take.
The closed construction bank now indexes its ten existing recipe size classes.
Each lookup preserves smallest-fitting extent and first-slot tie order while
visiting at most ten classes; returned blocks remain consumed after physical
retirement. The index lives in the original Graph header and is included in
the existing native layout query before admission. No extra allocator, budget
credit, fallback or execution authority is introduced. The focused best-fit,
spent-slot, fragmented rollback and CPU completion cases pass. An older Metal
fixture fails stream admission before dispatch and remains unresolved; actual
prepared-stream public capture and released Qwen execution pass. The selected
managed 3,000-token Qwen run fell from 65.796 to 4.705 seconds with the same four
output IDs. Exact artifact, command and memory results are in
`validation/bounded-public-qwen-2026-09-16.json` under
`graph_construction_class_index`.


The shared unit, transfer, transfer-observation and host-materialization recovery
nodes now retain account-only operation metadata. Their deferred module/manager
resources, lease-return IDs and per-transfer named publication rows use the same
carrier after all owned payload fields. Existing exact observer authentication,
completion/poison checks, registry ownership and cleanup-node handoff remain in
their outer workers; observing an error still does not establish completion. The
actual slot factories project the accepted text account before construction and
price the changed native/deferred owner layouts. This permits the same slots to
retain an independently admitted role account without inventing a text request.
GGUF source-construction and foreground destination authorization stay separate
from this metadata lifetime projection.


### Independent speculation with retained host residency

The selected speculative invocation now lends its actual `LayerwiseWorkspace`
through native Recovery to the existing local operation-bank constructor. The
same parameter/copy reducer adds the canonical window's host transfers,
unloaded parameter constructors, Graph/Record work, and physical copy births to
each actual equation. A retained host source must match its original manager,
policy, window inventory, immutable buffers, and initialization pool.

The private bank registry distinguishes a text `InferenceRequest` from an
independent `OriginalSpeculativeRole`. Speculative installation validates the
exact retained equation plan and invocation, authenticates the current Scope,
and consumes that role's or prefill span's one-use bank claim before constructing
storage. Every actual span receives the ordinary per-forward canonical-window
population; failed/skipped work never restores its finite cursors. Pure slot,
pin, and deferred-recovery storage retains account-only metadata custody. The
outer registry, completion and error owner retain the exact role separately.
Metadata-domain equality cannot authorize an invocation or select a Scope.

The ready-host route uses the shared unit/transfer/window factories with no text
source ticket. Its sealed empty checkpoint acquisition bank rejects fallback;
GGUF/checkpoint and foreground-disk tickets still require their genuine admitted
source accounts. This change connects retained-host speculative execution;
foreground disk's source-ticket admission remains a separate unfinished join.
The ordinary text path retains its existing reservation/source-ticket checks and
uses the same construction and retirement workers.


### Original selected token-score capture

The existing `model.logits` TokenScores transform now joins the same source-bound
original capture worker as raw Full/Slice/Preview captures. Portable geometry
borrows the requested ID order from the admitted selection and binds the actual
batch-one terminal vocabulary row. It does not upload an ID tensor. TokenScores
alone preserves LastPosition demand before vocabulary projection; a coexisting
full-sequence selection preserves Sequence demand and its existing row assembly.
Only the canonical terminal prefill chunk invokes the selected-score worker.

Ordinary native capture, metadata tracing, and original native capture execute
one shared scalar program: F32 terminal scores, a complete finite-value check,
full-vocabulary maximum, 1024-value exponential sums combined with compensated
F64 host accumulation, and each requested score, strict-greater competition rank,
and highest-scoring different ID. The original path preserves the ordinary
normalization and argmax equations. Selected IDs never restrict normalization.
The shared finite-check and floating-maximum native receipts include their real
primitive ancestors, scalar seeds, optional copies and reduction temporaries.

Every accepted callback contributes one source publication and its actual
scalar completion count to the same recorded span. The existing native Graph
and Record reducers requery the combined equation and repeated frontiers. The
fixed root bank retains the source and each constructed intermediate; all new
physical populations remain conservative through final span retirement. Static
slice/update frontend controls, clone shells, scalar read iterators, completion
controls, typed error shells and the fixed ordered host destination are priced
before construction. The source uses the existing original observer and local
pure-native publication through registered-source pinning; it never creates a
replacement scope, ordinary allocation grant, or registry adoption.

The move-only host claim validates requested ID order, finite values, complete
partition consistency, rank and alternative geometry. Partial failure retains
initialized slots and the original host account; only its originating frame can
consume the receipt, and consumed attempts never refill. Escaped shared frames
retain the same accepted host custody. TopCandidates and other reductions still
need their own complete original numerical/publication joins; this change does
not certify them from their shape or from the TokenScores receipt.

Focused source tests cover canonical terminal progression, mixed readout demand,
foreign/poisoned claims and final host retirement, plus cold Graph/Record closure
at vocabulary sizes 1, 64 and 3001. A staged native facade case compares separate
ordinary-full, original-TokenScores and original-mixed processes against complete
nonzero ordinary terminal logits across prompt chunks 2/2/1 and three cached
decode deliveries. These newly staged cases have not yet been run.

Original independent speculative prerequisite refusals preserve their concrete
neutral accounting cause and name the actual source, stream, topology, or
selected recipe boundary with an inline static label. Phase attribution creates
no diagnostic allocation or authority. The selected residency control query
propagates recipe-validation errors instead of discarding them through an
optional byte count; absent producer bounds still refuse before native entry.

Original independent speculative quotation uses the same numerical/source
composition as original text and media. The ordinary-unit equation tracer
records numerical operations with the actual state and retained parameter
representation evidence. Its separately retained layerwise source is consumed
by the selected operation plan, which binds the real unloaded-slot scalar and
Graph constructors, host-copy populations and transfer boundaries before role
admission. Layerwise metadata acquisition is not replayed inside the numerical
trace: its replaced ParameterPlaceholder nodes never execute in native Eval.
This preserves the source/role checks and constructor charges without treating
an unevaluated placeholder as a supported numerical operation.

Independent draft loading receives the actual selected backend pool and borrows
its architecture-owned prepared sources before entering ordinary drafter
recovery. It invokes the same selected layerwise manager source initializer as
the target provider, then moves that manager into the existing prepared model
materializer. The initializer admits its measured host catalogs, immutable
backing, snapshot, identity and operation declarations before construction; its
existing typed failed-prefix custody survives any source refusal. The drafter
does not synthesize a snapshot from ordinary host arrays or postpone source
initialization until an inference role is active. Ordinary direct callers retain
the existing loader entry, and both entries share model construction, completion,
retirement and poisoning semantics.

Original independent speculative foreground residency consumes the same retained
source windows, immutable read/freeze/publication worker, canonical registry,
and native host-copy transfer worker as original text. The quote constructs the
actual one-forward disk declaration with its existing metadata funding and
retains it with the immutable layerwise source. Each recorded role/span borrows
that declaration; no runtime cold-plan reconstruction or replacement metadata
account is introduced.

The role admission includes the real source-construction facts for every
recorded span. A monotone one-use cursor issues each source bank only after its
exact neural-bank claim. Its closed source custody compares the actual role
account, while text keeps its actual reservation check. Source custody alone
cannot mint a bank, debit, publish a row, or authorize native work. The selected
source, parameter epochs, operation role, stream and original observer checks
remain independent requirements.

Completed immutable sources use the existing publication transaction and full
backing observation. The transaction retains only accounting custody on
canonical storage, so no plan, manager or native payload points back from that
account. Failed prefixes keep their constructed owner, attachment, registry and
custody; failure never returns an issued span or source attempt. The actual
window retirement counter bounds live source backing, while constructor and
publication controls remain cumulative. Source-account selector and optional
reservation frames are part of those measured controls. An allocation-free
source still revalidates its exact account before returning success.

The public tiny independent-speculation residency fixture selects host or
foreground disk explicitly, uses uneven prefill chunks and multiple cached
decode rounds, and compares managed and controlled output with an ordinary
speculative baseline at the same positive temperature and seed. Foreground
qualification is not claimed from this staged implementation alone; the
parent-owned native build and this new residency case establish that result.

A shortened original plain-text restore or fork applies its new remaining-token
allowance to the copied shared generation sequence as well as the backend driver.
Core owns the monotonic logical endpoint; the retained provider keeps its exact
original token capacity, decoder storage and custody. Readiness validates that
physical capacity, and subsequent copies preserve it. This prevents an extra
source request after the resumed backend has produced its admitted allowance,
without resizing storage, refunding budgets or reopening a terminal sequence.

Original source-ticket quarantine uses the private accepted-ticket ledger phase,
including cleanup after publication failure. It preserves the exact account,
phase, capacity and charge rather than accessing the native funded-account view.
Only the owning ticket can request this transition; no new scope or spending
permission follows. Repeated quarantine and poisoned cleanup retain all charges
without a secondary destructor panic.

Original speculative immutable-source publication preserves the accepted ticket's
unfunded phase. Its closed source bank already paid the real source backing and
controls; the canonical publication worker requires exact immutable prepaid
origins and zero incremental allocation. These rows retain the actual ticket
through their source receipts, registration sidecars and canonical origins. They
share normal registry owner counting and destruction, but do not enter funded
reservation registration bookkeeping. Text-source publication continues to use
its real funded scope. No phase promotion, generic account accessor, source
adoption or allocation credit is introduced.


### Original sorted candidate capture

The existing terminal `model.logits` TopCandidates worker now uses the same
original source/readout adapter as TokenScores. Its numerical program remains
the ordinary direct terminal Slice, F32 cast, finite-value check, full ArgSort,
selected tail Slice, contiguous ID view and score Gather. Returned candidates
keep the existing descending order and native sort tie behavior. The
native take consumes only the actual ArgSort result, never an uploaded or
unvalidated external ID source. No alternate inference or sampling loop is added.

The existing composite candidate physical emitter already retains the complete
sort backing, two scalar infinities, six Bool finite-check results, mask/reduction
storage, optional ID copy, score output, and multi-block sort ping-pong and
partition buffers. Its new Graph/Record lowering includes all real primitive
ancestors, nine explicit retained result handles, and the existing native
four-byte sort dispatch planner for additional merge/copy kernels. Each accepted
callback records four actual nested completions: source, finite count, IDs, and
scores. The source and nine numerical roots remain with the existing work/carrier
through each nested completion and failure. Successful decode uses the shared
validated transient-root retirement before model/state publication; prefill keeps
its existing carrier. Every root must pass the exact original completed-array
validator before any suffix is dropped. Failure restores the whole suffix to
Work recovery. Physical, Graph and Record capacities are unchanged.

The shared readout adapter accepts only the existing typed candidate/token-score
claims. It authenticates the claim and canonical segment before source completion,
then holds the original source publication through exact backing pinning and the
claim's destination callback. Original root storage cannot grow; ordinary storage
keeps its existing reserve/publication behavior. Reentrancy uses the same Activity
fence and OwnedScope restoration. Every typed failure remains under the existing
capture error custody. The shared parameter/local/closure/result census is queried
before Work construction; per-callback clones, native scalar reads, publication
and completion controls remain separately counted. Candidate controls enumerate
the distinct callback, shared-helper and outer return frames rather than applying
a generic multiplier to every allocation class.

The existing terminal-only neutral progression, bounded host candidate slots,
domain fields, Skip/Fail policy and non-refunding delivery semantics are unchanged.
TopCandidates alone keeps LastPosition before the vocabulary projection, while
coexisting full capture preserves Sequence. The original source validation and
selected native mechanism remain mandatory; CPU sorts and unrelated reduction
programs do not inherit the Metal receipt.

Staged coverage includes complete cold receipt/frontier queries at vocabulary
sizes 1, 64, 2048, 2049 and 4097 with K=1/V, plus a fresh-process facade comparison
of ordinary full logits against original candidate-only and mixed captures.
Existing ordinary CPU and Metal cases still exercise the same numerical worker,
including half casts, equal scores, full sort backing and nonfinite failure
prefixes. These successor tests have not yet been run.

The shared selective state-space scan recurrence supplies its Metal workspace
and original recipe through the same primitive worker sequence. A neutral fixed
geometry validates the seven projected inputs, optional recurrent state and
chunk/floor policy before constructors run. The ordinary MLX adapter and a
stack-only cold adapter both consume that geometry and recurrence; no model
family chooses a native branch. Checked chunk endpoints preserve a caller cap
larger than the remaining sequence without overflowing an i32 cursor.

For positive tensor dimensions, the physical facts count every possible F32
cast, scalar seed, pointwise result, indexed reshape, reduction compaction and
partial, and final concatenation/cast against actual Metal allocation facts.
The separate descriptor census exposes no physical capacity. Its exact call
population supplies Graph/Record traversal, safe native handles, the finite
Rust output vector, inline index controls, rank-four strided copy/concat workers
and closed failure transports to the existing original recipe.
WorkspaceDtype::Float32 is the existing four-byte floating envelope;
F16/BF16 source facts remain in WorkspaceRepresentation. State stays F32;
output preserves the actual input floating representation. There is no new
kernel source, intermediate completion, source adoption or inference engine.
Both returned roots use the existing enclosing completion and publication.
The new native component fixture checks nonzero state and output against the
existing host recurrence and ordinary MLX for uneven prefill, reduced-precision
input and cached single-token execution, and checks escaped-output retirement.
This operation producer does not by itself claim complete model-family native
admission; other operations and source/residency contracts remain independently
required.

Original pooled-cache mask construction now consumes the existing neutral
PoolingMaskGeometry and the same integer MLX worker used by ordinary compressed
attention. The actual retained cache supplies pooled count and ratio; the
architecture continues to own pooling policy. Two I32 aranges, integer Divide,
fixed reshapes and Less supply the complete original Graph/Record population.
The existing physical/host emitter still counts the actual coordinate, quotient,
ratio and Bool backings without a float-coordinate conversion or mask staging.

The recipe also prices the native handle/result frames, strided-reshape workers
and exact geometry/stream-error transports. Original failures retain their scope
custody as typed neutral neural sources; ordinary diagnostics and the shared
zero-pooled/single-query no-mask behavior are preserved. No intermediate
completion, source publication or parallel attention engine is introduced.
The new prepared-domain fixture compares the actual cache worker to an i64
visibility oracle at incomplete-window boundaries and a ratio above float32's
exact integer range, then verifies escaped original output retirement through
the existing component harness. This closes the mask primitive; pooled/indexed
attention's separate numerical operations retain their own admission requirements.


Original finite Summary capture uses the same native chunked reduction worker as
ordinary capture. Core retains source-relative Summary selection and physical
prefill fragment geometry; runtime owns its once-only scalar claim, fixed result,
finite-statistics validation and the existing cross-chunk accumulator. The native
adapter consumes the scheduled claim and source pin, completes the actual source,
selection and scalar roots under the accepted model/prefill role, and records only
validated host statistics. Per-callback Workspace traces and actual branch
populations supply Graph/Record/completion and control requirements; an empty
physical prefill contribution performs no native work. Decode-only temporary
roots retire only after the existing completed-array identity check. Model/state
publication, captured frame custody, quota and controlled commitment remain with
their existing owners. Histogram qualification is separate implementation work.
The native original `GatherPooledMask` producer consumes the same fixed geometry
and ExpandDims/Broadcast/GatherAxis/ExpandDims worker as ordinary compressed
attention. The existing physical facts still account for direct strided gathering
without replicating the pooled table or index tensor. The receipt counts six
primitive candidates, seven edges, no eager seed, and the exact wrapper/error
controls; completion and publication remain with the enclosing admitted operation.
The selected native source now compiles the ordinary GatherAxis Bool and Int32
index variants, alongside its existing floating/UInt32 variants. Its original
guard accepts only those compiled variants; signed positions retain the same
negative-index normalization, with no cast, host index copy or generated shader.
Source masks preserve their actual floating representation through the gather.
Original shape/native failures retain their paying source through the neutral
error adapter, while ordinary diagnostic text and worker order stay unchanged.
A prepared-domain component case checks query-specific Bool/F32/F16/BF16 masks,
strided source/index views and signed positions against an independent host
selection and the ordinary worker, including escaped-output retirement. This
closes the mask-selection primitive; pooled-score selection and attention still
require their own complete native producers.

The original tensor-bound `clip` producer shares the native Maximum-then-Minimum
sequence with ordinary execution. It consumes the three actual input/bound tensors
and keeps their broadcast and precision-promotion order, including reversed bounds;
no scalar bound or host staging is constructed. The existing six-buffer physical
fact is paired with ten primitive candidates, twelve edges, two returned handles,
and the actual fixed wrapper/error controls. Native failures retain source custody
through the neutral tensor error adapter. A prepared-domain component checks scalar
and per-row/per-column bounds, strided inputs, reduced precision and widening,
broadcast-growing shapes and reversed limits against both the former native clip
entry and a scalar oracle. This is the reusable tensor operation consumed by the
Gemma4 vision clipped projections, without any family-specific native dispatch.

Immutable original intervention declarations now use the capture source compiler's
closed account and the same exact String/Vec count-and-copy worker. The core
`SharedInterventionPlan` releases its Arc shell before copied payload and host
custody; it cannot adopt a caller's existing buffers. Controlled discovery checks
reuse the canonical admission digest with an allocation-free borrowed comparison,
rather than cloning and readmitting the declaration. The context-bearing sampler
hook preserves ordinary dispatch and allows the native implementation to consume
actual request funding without an unquoted owner.

For evidence `None`, the existing speculative numerical capture plan can bind one
actual `OriginalInterventionSource`. Admission checks its pool and physical source
identity. Its extra outcome claims extend the same frame row; they do not create
another role counter or ledger. Fixed record strings and bounded diagnostics are
paid before construction and flow through the existing shared frame/abort owner.
The ordinary and prepaid paths share attribution and schedule construction;
logical metadata uses the existing cumulative ledger. Missing or failed edits
cannot seal successful delivery, while aborted evidence preserves attribution and
spending. Successful receipts still require the actual native edit/completion
producer. The public static-edit gate remains until the existing `apply_activation`
worker has complete Workspace/native input, region, mask and replacement lowering.
Preview/Summary evidence requires source-owned companion selections and their
claimed destinations as subsequent integration; neither is a model limitation.

The same scalar Summary producer now serves speculative sampler-input capture.
Its fixed claim authenticates the exact numerical occurrence; completion accepts
only that occurrence's paid payload and retains custody on validation failure.
The adapter reuses the selected/flattened Summary program, with source custody
already retained by numerical Recovery. Its population omits only the completed
source frontier; selected flatten and every scalar read retain their own exact
completion allowance. Source aliases and all temporary outputs stay with the
existing phase roots and recovery owner. No second source publication, schedule,
ledger or sampling driver is constructed. Summary remains a full selected-row
observation before policy processing, with ordinary target/draft attribution.


Original pooled-position selection shares one fixed native worker with ordinary
execution. The existing two-input `bhld,bpd->bhlp` einsum path is expressed with
its exact operand order, batch broadcasts, transpose/reshape sequence and Matmul;
score clamping/scaling, head weighting, reduction, masking and ArgPartition remain
unchanged. No host einsum parser or indexing plan is constructed in the admitted
worker. Shared geometry validates the source/output shapes and checked flattened
query extent before the original receipt is issued.

The existing physical fact retains all F32 casts, reshape copies, reduction and
multi-block sort storage. The selected U32 tail retains the complete pooled-width
index allocation; its next GatherPooledMask consumer therefore sees the actual
backing, without copying or registering a synthetic source. The recipe includes
all primitive candidates and seeds, actual native handles, rank-four reshape
workers, sort-width-dependent extra kernels and typed scope-retaining errors.
Sort kernels cover all rows in one grid, using the qualified standard native
source and selector controls. Existing completion and publication remain with the
enclosing admitted operation.

A prepared-domain component compares nonzero ordinary and original outputs to the
former einsum worker and an independent host head-weighted ranking oracle. It
covers multiple batches/queries, masked strided BF16 sources and a 2,051-position
pooled bank that exercises multi-block sorting; the real gather consumes the
selected indices and escaped output retirement is checked. IndexedAttention's
separate four-contraction producer remains an independent admission requirement.


Original IndexedAttention uses the same native worker as ordinary indexed
local/pooled attention. Neutral IndexedAttentionGeometry and its fixed validation
error are the single source for semantic input checks; ordinary diagnostics keep
their existing shape/scale/sink text, and original failures retain their existing
operation scope through the neutral neural error carrier. Geometry grants no
source, device or submission authority.

The worker preserves all four two-input einsum operand/axis orders using fixed
broadcasts, transposes, reshapes and the existing Matmul. Selected keys and values
use the qualified strided GatherAxis directly; score masks preserve Bool finite
minimum and additive casting semantics. A two/three-element stack container
joins local, selected and optional sink logits before the same precise native
softmax. Fixed slices exclude the sink's zero-valued contribution while keeping
it in the common denominator. Selected arrays and their full source backings
remain in the ordinary lazy graph through the enclosing completion/publication.

The existing physical emitter prices these gathers, four contractions, masks,
softmax and addition. The matching recipe counts actual primitives, eager seeds,
handles, fixed controls and twelve contraction reshapes plus the optional sink
reshape/concatenation. Empty local windows retain the two native zero-scalar
Matmul fill branches, including their source descriptors and physical facts.
Original source/kernel qualification and enclosing completion remain mandatory.
A prepared-domain fixture compares the fixed worker to the former native einsums
and an independent host softmax oracle for distinct key/value widths, multiple
heads/batches, signed positions, strided BF16 sources, Bool/additive masks, sinks
and a cached query with no local bank, including escaped-output retirement.


Original model.logits Histogram capture uses the existing neutral fixed-edge
selection, canonical prefill fragments and logical quota. Its typed host claim
prepares fixed edges/count vectors under the accepted original host account;
previous chunks and the current fragment coexist, and both allocations are
priced. The existing atomic histogram validator/merger is shared with ordinary
capture. Native static selection, F32 conversion and chunked comparison/mask/sum
reads use one program for ordinary execution, cold Workspace tracing and original
execution. Actual source completion/publication/pinning and per-read completions
remain in the same admitted Graph/Record work; prefill roots retire under their
existing chunk ticket, and decode temporaries use the completed transient suffix
boundary. Finite increasing edges, half-open bins and the inclusive last upper
edge retain their existing semantics. This does not qualify arbitrary callbacks
or bypass the independent speculative phase qualification below.


Static activation execution shares the portable runtime validation and seven-action
recipe across ordinary native execution, fixed metadata population counting, and
original numerical execution. A checked caller-retained source shape avoids host
shape copies; the backend compares actual borrowed metadata before primitives run.
The new neutral `StaticSliceUpdate` describes positive-stride, exact-rank updates
separately from general indexing. MLX supplies its direct native cast/broadcast/update
receipt and full destination-copy bound. Every selected/replacement/update result
stays in the existing numerical Recovery until final settlement; construction does
not establish completion. Prepared primitives support F32, F16 and BF16 through
that same worker. Fixed counting retains exact scalar precision, separate from the
four-byte logical workspace envelope. Reusable neutral `CastFloating` and
`InitializeFloating` descriptions name real conversion/typed constructors; MLX
provides AsType allocation-or-alias, Graph, host and exact output precision facts.
Known source representation must match the prepared dtype, and execution checks
the actual native dtype. Payloads borrow their exact typed bits; scale/fill
scalars round to the activation type before arithmetic. Nonfinite replacement
payloads remain rejected. This primitive qualification does not by itself widen
an original caller's source, evidence or completion authority. Compact masks include their exact-width temporary host buffer in the phase
population before execution.

The immutable capture/intervention compiler account is opaque at its private
`SourceAccount` boundary. Its existing `Arc<AccountNode>` unsizes without another
allocation; fixed validation still checks the exact pool through the same locked
allowance. Consuming dynamic retirement recovers the concrete Arc and frees its
