Shared embedded verification and target replay now carry the existing immutable tensor packet for token inputs, using the actual numerical token/range producers on original execution. The target output retains that same packet instead of making an ordinary native clone before phase entry. Its closing output visitor reports scores and capture only: input tokens already have their own completed source and are not a new closing equation root. Ordinary mechanisms keep their existing tensor construction and clone semantics through default packet hooks. Lexical input evidence may be extended only while preserving the previous reference prefix; the native adapter pays the exact joined reference destination and validates all sources before the callback. This closes token handoff, while captured prefill/seed capture view integration remains the next shared-driver join.

Original internal speculative observation has an array-free source owner distinct from the model-role collector. It retains the compiled C source, exact architecture scopes, logical origin and pre-admitted queue backing. Borrowed observer bridges forward that descriptor; only the actual native model phase can replace it with the funded collector and deliver a SharedCapturedStep after retirement. Each escaping envelope's identity is priced with its model role and retained by that frame, while the outer queue backing retains its own H. Internal edits and logical-window aggregates/sequence slices remain explicit producer joins; the source-only owner never runs them through the ordinary capture backend.


Originally admitted internal speculative capture revalidates the actual retained
`PreparedModelDiscovery` catalog, selected `SpeculativeActivationExecution` scopes,
phase hooks, collector capabilities, and already-resolved artifact/execution/
overlay/session identity before constructing its immutable source. Architecture
scope traversal and runtime hook support share the ordinary discovery workers;
core capability checks share initial admission and ordinary revalidation. This
borrowed validation allocates no replacement discovery, catalog map, diagnostic
String, or native resource. Its fixed control query is charged by the enclosing
source constructor. It grants no invocation, actual geometry, transform quotation,
or completion authority. The original internal-edit producer remains explicitly
`UnqualifiedIntervention`; ordinary static logits interventions retain their
existing mechanism. Partition producers still require their separate exact
projection, rather than treating a local catalog as partition authority.

Original managed speculative activation requests reach the existing controlled
configuration hook. The loaded backend declaration retains actual sealed
prediction execution facts plus a paid session/overlay identity and delegates
point/scope validation to PreparedModelDiscovery. Only then does the ordinary
capture-source copy worker create C, and the source-only observer receives that
exact source, scopes and identity. Each native phase still separately quotes,
admits and settles its collector. The facade owns request composition and does
not reconstruct source declarations or allocate a native observer.


Captured embedded seed views and concatenation keep immutable tensor packets
through carry, proposal, verification replay and saved-state transport. Their
lexical evidence names each actual completed input; target-output evidence is
retained on the verification result and never inferred from a newer cache state.
The native numerical compiler has one fixed two-input capture concatenation cut:
rank-three batch-one inputs, equal floating representation and hidden width,
positive sequence lengths, and the existing axis-one Concatenate primitive.
It uses the same exact source pins, recipe reducer, native scope, completion and
publication as other numerical cuts. Two source packets occupy fixed slots in
the existing immutable owner; no source collection or alternate engine is born.
Native-local evidence retains native operation budgets before their accounts,
while host preparation custody remains account-only. Immutable snapshot seeds
share this checked completed owner; mutable target and prediction caches still
use their existing separately admitted copy providers. Original raw tensor-view
entry points reject before native allocation when source custody is absent.

Embedded target source projection uses retained text residency when selecting
native materialization workspace. Fully resident execution borrows the selected
parameter representation and current state without requesting a host/disk plan.
Ready-host and foreground-disk execution retain their actual prepared layerwise
source. This matches ordinary executable workspace selection and preserves the
native source checks; it neither reselects execution nor adds a family branch.


Original embedded fresh-branch startup accepts a populated target only through
its actual idle, completed resident-copy source. The existing independent copy
worker pins canonical source registrations and publishes independent target
backing; a one-use `OriginalPredictionTarget` retains that copy's Q/H until the
shared cache-preparation agreement consumes it. Startup never labels ordinary
text state as completed speculative Model storage. The target's absolute cached
frontier participates in cached+input+output scheduling, while the architecture's
fresh prediction frontier and prefill alignment remain independent. The same
shared target-copy, seed and continuation drivers remain responsible for actual
state layout, completed native work and subsequent branch copies. Unregistered
or unsettled sources still fail their existing checks; a fresh branch does not
claim to restore historical prediction-lane state.


Original embedded target and prediction phases lend the same execution closure
an invocation-local funded capture observer after quoting its exact C source,
scope mask, actual physical shape and current cumulative usage on the same
workspace context. The model role pays the collector, native transform roots,
identity envelope and error owners before construction. Direct tensor, summary,
histogram, candidate and token-score transforms reuse the existing selected
native workers; no callback runs on the source-only outer observer. Capture
roots join final native completion and remain in the existing recovery payload.
The host collector alone survives payload retirement to deliver the shared frame;
completed model-source publication contains surviving state/output roots, not
already downloaded capture temporaries. Physical prefill preparation keeps its
existing source lifecycle, and the local collector uses the existing model
observation transaction. Scope-filtered readout uses the same actual invocation
mask in cold quotation and funded execution. Generated reconstruction and logical
cross-window aggregation still require their own exact source producers; this
consumer does not certify those by executing an ordinary fallback.

The replicated embedded-prediction target constructor retains the same prepared
source loan used by ordinary replicated construction. Its existing store
validator, selected configuration publication and capability publication populate
the exact source-owned semantic slots during initial construction. Later bounded
target equation quotes consume those immutable validated facts through the shared
construction helpers; they neither repeat allocating source validation nor infer
source authority from equivalent checkpoint metadata. Standalone architecture
callers retain their ordinary construction behavior.


Retained generated model capture now uses the existing block-FP8 reconstruction
factory under the same original equation role. Native preflight checks the spent
claim, actual prototype, compact U8/F32 operands and selected program; its two
sources and seven emitted arrays are retained through the enclosing recovery
payload with paid inspection-clone handles. Each accepted selection retains its
own capture transform, while repeated selections share one reconstruction per
hook. Cold population follows the actual policy decision, including zero native
work for an empty slice or a quota skip, and includes generated inputs/outputs in
the same final traversal. This does not introduce another reconstruction equation,
source registry, completion owner or logical-window aggregation producer.


### Original Embedded controlled replay

The architecture-erased Embedded executor forwards host buffers, sampler metadata,
logical identity and sequence copying to the existing source-funded speculative
mechanisms. The initial and saved sequences use the same retained provider for
External and Embedded requests; the native common-source binding does not change
either schedule or role identity. Context-bearing checkpoint capture is an
additive shared-driver hook whose ordinary default calls the existing checkpoint
worker. Erased target, proposal, verification and saved-checkpoint Box destinations
are paid before construction and retire before their retained host authority.

Controlled Embedded restore and branch exchange extend the existing authenticated
occurrence cursor and request slot bank before copying. They preserve spent
attempts, prior roles and cumulative copy/observation/transport authority outside
all snapshots. Mutable target and prediction caches keep their exact prepared copy
providers and per-state completion evidence; immutable capture packets share their
existing paid owner. Native logical snapshot estimates use borrowed descriptors
and source visitors, with the same conservative policy as ordinary snapshots;
these estimates do not grant native copy permission. Each actual copied cache
still completes through its independently admitted existing source-copy worker.

The public Qwen replay fixture exercises the first committed boundary, later
mutation, restore, fork/exchange, deterministic RNG/text replay and nonrefundable
copy spending. Its native result must be recorded separately before support is
claimed. This path stays within one active controlled request; importing saved
state into a fresh request is a separate source-authentication contract.


Routed Embedded construction retains the same sealed prepared-source loan through
initial target pairing and later workspace entry. The V3, V4, Qwen hybrid and
Nemotron target models accept the same immutable ConfigOwner used by replicated
construction; ordinary public constructors delegate with their original owned
configuration. Initial source/store validation, effective config publication and
capability publication use the existing exact-source helpers. The source stores
an alias of the configuration actually held by the model, never a post-hoc copy.
Typed metadata failures remain typed through routed preparation and dispatch.

The successful initial routed contract now retains its actual selected bank table,
canonical addressable targets, filtered materialization source, and separate target
and source-format parameter descriptions in the existing prepared source owner.
Checked reconstruction authenticates the same immutable selected source and bank
identity before lending those descriptions and tasks to the same contract worker.
The neutral parameter-description hook borrows the retained validated declaration;
legacy implementations keep their existing owning producer. This does not grant
source readiness, native submission authority, or a new parameter topology.

SequentialPredictionGroups uses the same physical namespace worker for appended,
zero-based and patterned groups with paid names, rows and graph construction.
V4 cache geometry, ordered capture-policy validation, and cache identity now share
ordinary and counted destinations. Its pooled, pending and overlap states retain
their original residency and lifetime semantics. Model static declarations and
configuration/identity diagnostics use the existing metadata destinations.

V3 and V4 target construction now retains the actual initial block declarations
with that same completed source. Selected-format target declarations consume the
exact retained bank's per-unit expert specifications; pre-transform source modules
retain their original configuration declarations separately. Checked construction
selects the exact typed unit/index and calls the existing paid instantiation worker.
The V3 dense/routed target and prediction construction paths share one block source
and instantiation worker, while forward equations are unchanged. No native arrays
or module objects are copied into the immutable source inventory.

Changing a model's explicit expert realization invalidates its retained unit and
parameter-description loans. Ordinary callers can rebuild through the existing
constructor; checked execution must obtain a new qualified source. Independent
public native routed Embedded qualification is still required before support is
claimed; source construction alone is not completion or execution authority.


Originally admitted Embedded model-role host banks can retain an independently
compiled static intervention source and an exact per-invocation scope mask.
The same fixed frame/claim/receipt producer preserves physical sequence geometry,
actual model-account identity, source identity, and cumulative capture spending.
Different architecture hooks execute in graph order; operations sharing one hook
retain declaration order. A consumed or failed claim cannot be issued again.
These host contracts supply no native operation or completion authority. The
original loaded internal-edit entry remains gated until its source validator,
actual cold edit trace and native role consumer are connected; ordinary logits
intervention behavior is unchanged. Preview/Summary companions for this new
model-role entry remain a separate producer obligation.

Replicated target equation reconstruction uses the existing ModuleMetadata
destination for Qwen hybrid block and recurrent-attention parameter names,
linear formats, normalization declarations and temporary specification owners.
The attention constructor normalizes the same borrowed RoPE scalar map instead
of cloning it. The ordinary and funded constructors share the same module
instantiation and equations; paid metadata does not grant native source authority.

The generic fixed/compressed replicated parameter-description worker now sends
its graph, layout, groups and owner names through the same funded metadata
constructors used by the shared decoder. It consumes emitted parameter groups
with the existing ownership validator, avoiding a deep duplicate expected-group
collection. Exact selected parameter binding and native completion remain
independent requirements. Other family unit constructors must provide their own
qualified metadata before their complete managed path can be claimed.

Independent capture windows resolve physical slice coordinates through the same
fixed geometry worker as canonical prompt fragments. The neutral geometry retains
globally anchored strides and validates both admitted logical and actual physical
extents; native tensor selection consumes those resolved local coordinates.
Tensor, Summary and Histogram retain distinct typed geometry and claim paths.
The window geometry itself grants no source, quota, native construction or
completion authority. Original Embedded window host plans, no-overlap record
delivery and cumulative reduction assembly must join their existing funded
workers before the corresponding source gates can open.

Successful ordinary text-contract validation can retain its exact filtered
materialization tasks, declared addressable parameters and complete companion
exclusions in PreparedContractMaterialization. The closed owner also retains
the actual selected realization. Checked reconstruction authenticates that
selection and the complete declared exclusion set before architecture work, then
revalidates the actual architecture and companion population against the same
authoritative full task sequence. It reuses the already validated filtered task
source without cloning recipe, provenance or lowering metadata. Equal task names
from another selection cannot substitute for the retained owner.

The shared parameter validator accepts the architecture's ordinary owned
description or a borrowed description retained by its actual completed
construction. Its companion index continues to refer to that exact description;
geometry, parameter shapes, formats and companion ownership checks still run.
These neutral retained metadata contracts confer no payload readiness, native
materialization or execution authority.

The original Embedded observer's physical-window bank now carries the shared
scheduler row placement through the same cold policy, fixed host frame and
single-use transform claims. Both quota ledgers reserve ordinary invocation and
fragment metadata before source validation or native construction. A no-overlap
window records its actual source and NotInvoked outcome without a selected shape,
payload or generated factory call. Global slices are resolved once by neutral
geometry; surviving host frames retain their existing account custody. Logical
Summary/Histogram/Preview assembly remains a separate shared producer and its
source gate stays closed until that request-ledger join is complete.

Logical prefill reduction delivery uses the same closed shared payload retirement
mechanism as physical capture frames. The runtime may preallocate the final
aggregate owner before execution, then move its already constructed report into
that destination. Clones share aggregate records, Preview/Histogram storage and
retained host custody; the last owner releases all payload before custody. The
wire format remains the ordinary report, and deserialization creates only an
ordinary delivery. This storage bridge grants no capture quota, source identity
or completion. Original aggregate assembly still requires its paid shared
constructor and the request's cumulative ledger before the first cold quote.


Original Embedded static activation edits retain the loaded intervention source
and its architecture-supplied phase mask beside the original capture source.
Architecture validation borrows the retained declaration catalog and the same
runtime mechanism/status projection used by ordinary discovery. The backend
supplies its actual static mechanism facts; a matching identifier alone does not
qualify an edit. Capture-only callers retain their existing typed refusal for an
edit-bearing plan without those facts.

The cold observer records actual reached hook shapes, exact declared floating
dtypes, slices and logical costs in an H-funded immutable plan. It traces the
existing static activation worker and adds its real roots, controls and internal
completions to the same model recipe. The funded observer consumes a model-role
claim from the original source, rechecks source identity, operation/phase/index,
physical shape, dtype and charged usage, then executes that same worker. Edit
outputs remain in the enclosing native root collector; provisional receipts do
not authorize successful delivery before final completion. Failure retains the
existing aborted frame and original role custody, without refunding logical or
physical spending. Target and prediction equations use this same handoff.

This increment qualifies dense static activation actions with no evidence
companions. Split-prefill edits with global sequence slices or per-sequence host
mask/replacement/addition payloads still require the existing logical-window
lowering to join this original path and return typed attribution refusal until
then. Routed edits and internal Preview/Summary companions remain separate
unimplemented producers, not architectural restrictions. Ordinary static logits
editing and ordinary intervention execution are unchanged. This packet adds a
focused retained declaration/facts refusal case; native public parity remains a
separate integration check, not implied by cold quotation or source validation.

Original Embedded capture may initialize its exact cumulative ledger at source
preparation through the existing request account constructor. That closed owner
contains no model scope or numerical permission; it retains its own fixed host
account after all ledger storage. Cold quote, host bank and funded envelope
compare the actual same ledger and immutable source. Later model roles reuse
that owner without charging a second ledger birth, while cumulative spending
stays outside snapshots and is never reset by a repeated source loan.


The retained routed target-unit source also covers Qwen's hybrid blocks. Its
initial source stores the selected expert, full-attention, feed-forward and norm
declarations; checked reconstruction invokes the same block instantiation and the
existing paid recurrent-attention constructor using the actual immutable local
configuration. The source retains no model/configuration owner backedge. Explicit
expert-plan replacement invalidates both declaration loans before reconstruction.
This closes the target constructor producer; native Embedded public qualification
continues through the shared execution and observation paths.


Prepared window consumers may resolve a borrowed physical invocation into an
already paid logical-shape destination and project a normalized global slice
into already paid local/destination slices. These fixed-result core helpers share
the ordinary window/contiguous-partition validation and stride arithmetic. They
provide geometry only: actual source, frame/role, payload copying, reservation
and native completion remain separate consumer obligations. A nonintersecting
window writes no fragment and authorizes no empty native update.


Exact registered and completed workspace source layouts expose an unselected
binding constructor for multi-source quotes. It runs the same existing-only pin,
root uniqueness, capacity and source-domain validation and retains every account;
it omits only context selection. The consumer installs one finite union of the
actual borrowed roots before tracing and keeps each binding through admission.
Existing constructors still select immediately. The context continues to reject
late selection and every second installation; no new registration, native source
permission or budget credit follows from constructing the metadata union.


Nemotron's retained routed target inventory now covers its actual Mamba,
attention, dense ReLU-squared and selected sparse ReLU-squared unit declarations.
The ordinary block and retained unit builder share those sources. Mamba's source
and the existing attention/dense source builders accept the same paid metadata
destination, which also closes the fixed non-routed target constructor. Parameter
names, encoded companions, local head/group widths, convolution layout and
residual order remain supplied by those architecture-owned constructors. Expert
plan mutation invalidates the model's retained construction loans. Native public
Embedded qualification remains a separate requirement.

Embedded target and prediction source binding now precedes the shared equation
trace. Each actual registered or completed inventory passes the same existing
pin, capacity and account checks without installing a partial selection. One
finite union of those exact metadata roots is selected before tracing starts;
all contributing source owners survive native execution and completion. Neither
late selection nor a second selection is permitted. Prediction obtains its
actual lane inventory through the architecture-owned state-source callback,
before materializing and executing its existing equations.

Logical capture aggregation now shares its actual record, shape, Histogram and
Preview constructors between ordinary and funded metadata destinations. Window
and Preview validation expose fixed error values; ordinary callers retain their
existing CaptureError formatting adapters. These host constructors do not grant
source identity, native transformations or quota, and original cumulative
assembly still uses its request-owned lineage and actual physical records.

The neutral prepared intervention-window payload owner shares the ordinary
row-major projection worker for Mask, Replace and Add. It copies only selected
values, preserves F32/F16/BF16 payload representation, and keeps its real metadata
account behind both returned storage and partial-construction errors. Source C,
physical/logical geometry, operation/role identity, logical ledger reservation
and enclosing native completion remain separate mandatory consumer checks.

Original Embedded logical-window capture decisions carry a paid, capture-only
skip-reason sidecar beside the physical selection mask. The cold equation sees
the inactive mask before tracing; the same funded frame retains the exact logical
limit reason, while schedule skips retain precedence. An attached reason cannot
enable a claim. Owned reason storage retires with the existing host run and does
not alter intervention scope, native authority, or cumulative quota spending.

Original model-role static edits now retain the actual frame window alongside
their immutable source and physical shape. The shared global-slice/contiguous
projection and payload workers supply local edits; ordinary projection metadata
and encoded-record costs are reserved separately, in order, before native usage.
A window with no selected rows acknowledges the same operation without creating
a tensor, root or completion. Both source precision and exact role/window/source
identity remain checked, and all emitted roots stay in enclosing model recovery
until terminal completion. Compact component masks whose component axis is also
the split row axis still require their paid ID-localization producer; internal
Preview/Summary evidence companions remain a separate unfinished integration.

The admitted chat-template evaluator now executes plain `replace(from, to)` for
literal or borrowed text atoms with exactly two positional text arguments. The
ordinary MiniJinja filter and counted evaluator share the same non-overlapping
UTF-8 match/segment writer, including empty patterns, Unicode boundaries, and
embedded NULs. The existing generated-text destination pays and retains actual
bytes plus inline trim/length metadata; no intermediate String, scratch vector,
or second evaluator is introduced. Original source/context borrows end before
retained output escapes, and partial buffer failures keep their existing host
custody. Arbitrary object coercion, generated replacement inputs/arguments, and
other argument profiles remain explicit unqualified operations rather than
borrowing this profile's reservation.

Original Embedded logical aggregate preparation preserves ordinary quota order:
physical invocation, capture/edit record metadata, and the delivery envelope
precede logical aggregate reservation. A closed source/occurrence prefix resumes
the exact step and cumulative totals in cold and funded collectors. The real
single-use frame and native completion remain mandatory. Later hook projection,
value, transfer and evidence charges remain at their actual producers.

Original intervention evidence aggregates use the same logical-window lane and
payload algebra as ordinary execution. Their constructor borrows the immutable
source-owned Before/After companions and uses the actual metadata destination
for lane, record, shape, payload and string storage. Fixed continuity/source/
encoding failures avoid constructing ordinary diagnostics inside original work.
Logical skip reasons remain source-bound inputs to physical evidence claims;
these host helpers confer no native source or readout authority.

The original Embedded outer observer now drives the same online logical-window
aggregate constructor, validation, merge, and terminal publication as ordinary
speculation. Its exact request lineage reserves the physical metadata prefix and
logical aggregate before cold quotation; an unwind guard retains every accepted
reservation. The last real physical envelope receives the prepared immutable
shared report after the existing prefill settlement boundary. Report storage and
its account-only custody may outlive the observer, source, and loaded request.
Capture and Before/After evidence skip decisions retain separate paid sidecars;
logical evidence decisions never disable the intervention itself. Native evidence
collector qualification remains with the corresponding physical producer.

Original Embedded target phases bind the shared session's completion callback to
an invocation-local nested collector. Target prefill, verification, and replay
retain their existing session transaction ordering; they do not construct an
ordinary graphless collector while the original Graph is active. The same paid
nested-root/event worker also serves prediction-state completion. It copies only
borrowed actual state/output handles into prepared clone slots, retains accepted
arrays and the event in the enclosing Recovery payload, and submits after state
and RefCell loans end. Exact role, selected stream, and current scope are checked
before the one-use completion attempt. A failed wait does not release Recovery
or establish successful completion.

The target quote obtains its nested root census from the existing completed
architecture trace: current state plus vocabulary output, with validation roots
from the native reducer. Hidden target capture remains separately retained and
joins the outer phase completion. The same Graph/Record reducer combines this
explicit root list with selected module/group boundaries. An inactive weak
session projection grants no work; its separately retained host authority covers
its header until replacement or session teardown. The activation guard disables
that projection on success, error, and unwind without requiring a new inspector
entry into a possibly fenced session. Native public-path qualification is tracked
separately from this producer implementation.


Original Embedded intervention evidence uses the same fixed Preview and Summary
child constructors as numerical evidence. Each child retains its immutable
operation/side declaration, exact model-role custody, physical invocation, and
optional source window. The source-owned logical skip pair is copied into the
paid model capture bank and revalidated at the outer envelope handoff. Consuming
a skipped Before side still precedes After; it cannot enable another capture.
Window projection metadata uses the existing ordinary capture ledger policy
before source readout, including metadata-only no-overlap outcomes. Physical
child payloads and partial failures retain the same original account and remain
provisional until enclosing completion. This host contract alone does not
qualify a native evidence producer; its cold trace and actual shared readout
worker must be admitted separately before the original source gate opens.


### Retained prediction construction stack frames

The portable retained prediction factory validates the same prepared selection
and immutable source graph before dispatch. Each family constructor now executes
in its own cold function frame, retaining the existing unit equations, allocation
funding and placement owners. Unselected families no longer contribute their
temporary models to one combined stack frame. No native family selection, extra
heap ownership, or change to invocation authority is introduced.


Original Embedded internal-capture checkpoints use the same controlled saved-authority
carrier and prepared restore transaction as ordinary capture. The original variant
retains the exact C source, collector identity, immutable edit source/scopes and
source H. It keeps the existing live request ledger; it never saves or rewinds
physical invocation IDs, capture spending, delivery queues, aggregates or native
state. Save/restore require a successful boundary after every physical envelope
and logical prefill report is drained. Restore allocates replacement identity and
masks before the controller copies native target/prediction state; dropping the
preparation leaves authority unchanged. Native cache copy remains in the existing
controlled driver. Readmission of a new edit plan still requires the separately
authenticated loaded declaration and prepared invocation preflight.


Original Embedded static internal interventions admit source-owned Preview and
Summary evidence through the same physical model capture bank. The loaded
architecture declaration still validates the exact scope, phase, hook geometry,
precision and static action facts; evidence does not widen edit applicability.
The cold model-hook worker borrows the immutable companions and records the
actual selected Before/action/After graph in ordinary ledger order, retaining
logical skips and metadata-only non-overlap states. The native adapter checks
that exact source, side, invocation/window and Model custody before invoking the
existing Preview or Summary readout. Their selected-output/flatten frontiers
settle lazy post-edit ancestry under the existing original observer; scalar
frontiers, control storage and retained roots come from the shared worker's
population. Source/readout/edit roots remain in the enclosing Q/Recovery union
through success, error or teardown. No separate source publication or memory
account is introduced. Frames remain provisional until the enclosing model
completion, and failed evidence stays aborted without refunding logical quota.
This qualifies the internal static evidence producer; routed edit programs and
other unimplemented action/source equations retain their typed rejections.


The selected background-prefetch Rust storage producer now separates its immutable
unit domain, fixed FIFO/terminal slots, and shutdown retirement destination from
thread creation and native source reads. `PreparedPrefetchStorage` reserves those
actual constructors through neutral metadata funding. Closed shared aliases free
their payload/header before the final host account; cancellation prepares its
terminal destination before taking the lifecycle mutex, and a returned selected
failure retains its actual source ID without copying a string. Ordinary and
prepared storage execute the same prefetch lifecycle and worker loop. This storage
receipt does not qualify `std::thread`/PAL allocations, native host reads, or an
original background model invocation; those remain separate producer joins.


### Prediction source selection precedes retained unit construction

Retained prediction construction validates the actual prepared selection and
borrows its immutable local state declaration before constructing workspace
units. The existing caller projects its actual state and installs the exact
borrowed-source union at that boundary. Unit construction and equation tracing
then consume that selection. The declaration comes from the same closed retained
factory as the later state construction; no backend branch reconstructs geometry
and no source-selection guard is weakened.


Original Embedded internal-edit readmission keeps the shared controlled driver,
ordinary logical readmission storage charge and atomic saved-authority commit.
The driver now delegates its mandatory loaded validation to the executor: the
ordinary default retains discovery re-admission, while the original observer
borrows its exact retained catalog/origin and H-paid session/overlay projection.
This projection owns no native tensor, stream, callback or model session. C
identity and scope remain fixed. Replacement I uses the existing copied-source
compiler; the same static activation estimator and fixed rank destinations check
one worst independently shaped invocation against current settled lineage. The
ordinary invocation budget reducer is shared with that prepared preflight. All
accepted authority-copy and capture spending remains spent if a later preparation
fails or a prepared replacement is dropped. Restore keeps its existing distinct
authority-only behavior and does not reprice work or rewind usage.

Original internal readmission reads current usage through the drained collector's
exact request-minted capture lineage. Its loaded declaration adapter retains no
request issuance owner. The atomic authority preparation rechecks the same live
ledger before charging; host authority replacement cannot reopen a closed request,
refund usage, or grant a model occurrence.

The MLX crate permits compiler recursion depth 256 for composed retained-error
`Send`/`Sync` proofs. These traverse existing prepared pin groups and the deliberate
quarantine accounting cycle (pool funding ledger, quarantined borrowed source pin,
completed numerical account, pool). Captured checkpoint/source custody adds proof
nesting but no new native or request-owner backedge. This compiler setting preserves
all concrete ownership, compiler-checked auto traits and runtime memory ceilings;
it neither enlarges runtime stacks nor marks unsettled native work complete.

### Stable per-request speculative execution assignments

The existing neutral speculative table selects a request execution context from
its stable insertion ID before request history, identity, configuration or prefill
construction, and before candidate inspection and each selected action. Global
table storage and rank coordination retain the outer batch context. The selector
is an allocation-free projection of already retained source ownership; it neither
mints admission nor changes the fair scheduler. Ordinary executors keep their
existing assignment through the default implementation. Autoregressive and
Embedded composition forward the same selector to their existing mechanisms.
Native batch sources must validate the exact request-to-source mapping and retain
its owners for the complete borrowed context lifetime.


The dense background host-read handoff reuses the retained foreground disk source
and the same canonical per-window read banks. It moves prepared source jobs into
the existing bounded prefetch worker and moves successful immutable host batches
back through a closed, prepaid result mailbox. The mailbox retains source and
host metadata custody through queued, active, cancelled and escaped-result
lifetimes; no manager, device tensor, native budget or scope observer enters the
worker. Source live-capacity permits remain in the actual immutable buffers.
Caller-thread native copies use the same source, role, destination and completion
checks for deferred and already completed reads. Host-window protection consumes
a prepared transition naming a real finite ledger group and runs the same neutral
protection worker without ordinary manager reaping. These producers do not select
lookahead, claim thread/PAL admission, publish host residency, or enable the
original background dense entry; those consuming boundaries remain explicit.

Managed plain speculative batch preparation shares its per-lane source worker
with single-request generation. Each lane owns an independently authenticated
semantic/controller/configuration/callback source and prompt preparation; the
application request list is never relabelled as framework-owned retained storage.
Finite host and lane buffers are admitted before allocation and retain the first
actual lane's batch-control funding through prefix failure. The entire host batch
joins Request agreement before any prompt preparation, and the entire prompt batch
joins Prompt agreement before shared backend dispatch. Existing scheduler IDs
select the matching native request/source context; equal tokenizer or geometry
alone cannot merge lane authority. Empty batches allocate no request destination.


The paged-cache source boundary now exposes a closed lexical loan over the actual
cache manager, canonical block records and layer-local tail. The same portable
block-selection predicate serves ordinary scans and source inspection. The loan
preserves session, generation, finite pool, global layer, rank, window/prefix,
key-only sentinel and canonical tail accounting. It refuses contention or pending
worker ownership without waiting, polling, tier movement or shard reopening.
Device, immutable-host and retained disk backing are borrowed under that same
manager guard; returned geometry is separately paid metadata and retains its host
construction owner. Fixed inline source failures preserve their typed cause and
an independent host-funding alias through error retirement. Geometry alone grants
no copy, materialization or invocation
authority. Original paged execution remains gated pending the consumer's exact
lease/transfer, block-scan equation, completion and rollback admission; this source
producer does not represent paged history as resident concatenation storage.

Original Embedded batches retain one exact occurrence/numerical request and one
one-use target/prediction cache preparation per lane. A paid immutable context
table is constructed after all source owners have stable storage; duplicate
request owners and mismatched execution origin, stream or pool are rejected.
The existing insertion-order request ID selects its prevalidated context without
allocation or native work. Selected contexts carry their own ID and no table
backedge, and reject a different request ID. Global table/coordination storage
uses the first source's batch-control funding, while model roles, sampling,
sequence, copies and cumulative capture spending use each actual lane source.

Single and multi-lane Embedded execution share source preparation, cache workers,
concrete executor and the existing fair visitor. Every prepared request closes
future issuance after execution or failure; completed and unresolved native
values retain their existing independent custody. External multi-lane execution
still requires selection of its existing portable AR occurrence cursor, which is
currently owned singly by AutoregressiveExecutor; the established external single
path remains unchanged and wider external original requests remain typed-gated
until that connected cursor producer is integrated.


The independent-draft executor can retain a finite, paid table of its existing
monotonic occurrence cursors. The shared request table's insertion ID selects
one cursor through the already authenticated native request context; an
unselected outer context cannot spend a lane occurrence. Cache creation,
prefill/decode claims, and controlled continuation all use that same selection.
The cursors remain outside cache snapshots, and native source-pair validation
still authenticates each claim's exact schedule before model work. This table
adds no scheduler, request account, or native execution authority.


Paged source projection can now pin an exact selected catalog through the same
neutral `CacheBlockLifecycle` lease counter, without recording demand access or
changing LRU history. The native pin retains its actual manager, generation,
selection, IDs and host metadata owner; failed preparation releases only its
accepted pin prefix. Pin retirement runs no reaping or tier transition.

Completed device block/tail projection uses one existing native alias collector,
with paid final metadata and descriptor handles. Both successful inventories and
failure prefixes retain their canonical pins outside the manager guard, and
native handles retire before the pins and host funding. The projection rechecks
actual source manager, generation, current local frontier and retained physical
backings; descriptive geometry does not grant native role authority. Host/disk
blocks require separately admitted promotion, and paged equation, transaction
and original execution gates remain unchanged until those consumers are joined.

The selected background host-read worker can now accept a separate, source-qualified
standard-thread startup account before constructing its name, std entry/Thread/Packet
owners, its fresh child TLS destructor vector, and private queue synchronization. The qualification is the existing pinned
stable Rust/libstd build, with the actual Darwin PAL selector; unstable ambient spawn
hooks are not a producer reachable by this closed stable worker. The selected worker
sets the existing 2 MiB stack default explicitly, avoiding a request-time environment
lookup. OS-private stacks/TLS, ambient calling-thread TLS state, and libdispatch internals retain the existing
runtime boundary; no inferred process-wide reserve is introduced.

This startup account is host-only and crosses no native tensor or device-budget
boundary. `BackgroundPrefetchWorker::finish` observes the real standard-thread join
before retiring it. Nonjoining Drop preserves asynchronous shutdown and quarantines
an unobserved startup account through the existing unresolved-account policy; callback
return is not treated as proof that libstd Packet/current-thread cleanup has completed.
The source read service consumes that same admitted worker and joins explicitly on its
normal finish path. Host-window scheduling, canonical host publication and device
promotion still require their own exact source/operation handoff before the managed
background entry may be opened.

The host-result mailbox likewise initializes its exact paid mutex while still privately owned, before any worker or caller can race its first use.


Original independent-draft batches now construct one actual source pair and
schedule for each paid facade lane, then bind the existing immutable request
context table. The same ordinary executor owns the corresponding monotonic
cursor table and executes all lanes through the existing fair scheduler. Shared
host/source authentication and lane/cache preparation are reused with Embedded
batches and controlled single-request execution. Each lane retains its own
semantic source, occurrence/account identity, capture ledger, native caches and
failure custody; the first lane funds only finite outer bookkeeping. Every
created request closes future issuance after execution, including a later-lane
failure, without retiring escaped values or refunding spent work. Current native
stream/topology applicability checks are unchanged.


Prepared Embedded composite target construction now consumes the exact
`PreparedModelSources` requirements and completed immutable configuration owner.
Ordinary and prediction visitors share the same typed composite constructors and
direct/routed handoff; prediction pairing occurs only after that handoff. The
workspace Route no longer reconstructs ordinary requirements or format maps.
Qwen Hybrid reuses the actual completed source/target configuration and capability
without deep cloning. Checked reconstruction requires a completed configuration
producer before any ordinary map copy. Inkling uses the same completed-source
handoff with its actual effective configuration and unit declarations.

The same typed routed callback consumes the retained parameter-bank/materialization
source before checked construction. Missing completed sources retain their portable
metadata rejection before ordinary requirement or target-set allocation.


Cold binding projection now carries exact prediction module destinations through
the ordinary architecture materializer and physical module visitor. The portable
total constructor has a private binding-inspection purpose: it validates the same
selection and source roles without publishing executable prediction placement.
Native preparation consumes the emitted slots, physical ordinals, selected tasks,
layout and shared-owner roles to build supplementary residency declarations.
Resident prediction and host-layerwise prediction use the same source-funded
manager constructor; its real retained host sources and initial device owners
remain included in admission. This is metadata/source construction, not request
permission, and it does not certify unsupported transformation or transport work.


Distributed native construction now retains the exact neutral communication
realization after setup consensus. Its immutable source owns the original
manifest, checked group/route world-wave proofs and setup transcript identity;
clones alias that source instead of reconstructing it from equal metadata.
Actual native groups and routes retain the same source through moves into the
portable partition runtime. A funded native source binding validates the actual
selected manifest, setup identity, native world, group contracts and directed
route endpoints, and lends their finite ordered inventory without allocating a
communicator or entering a collective. Its availability query is read-only and
refuses borrowed, terminal or unresolved owners without reaping native work.

The source's exact Rust host-capacity census is distinct from communicator
internals, transport buffers, collective scratch, native completion and quarantine
storage. It grants no existing-storage credit or original execution authority.
Those producer populations and the current rank-local layout/operation join are
still required before removing distributed original-admission guards; the guards
remain in place in this change.

The background host source now hands completed immutable buffers to the same original
residency acquisition transaction. Exact canonical and alias name rows are prepared
from its retained `ForegroundDiskWindowPlan`; the host branch validates the same
manager/source/custody before reservation, binds every canonical owner before aliases,
and uses the existing controller publication and rollback. The ordinary branch keeps
its reader and error order and shares the canonical alias lookup. The completed read
returns its already-observed allocation capacity with the successful buffer; no second
native observation, checkpoint read or inferred capacity substitutes for that fact.
The final `ResidentHostOwner` retains the actual metadata funding for publication names
and alias rows independently of the temporary read service. Device promotion continues
to consume those same immutable host owners through the existing HostToDevice worker.
The request bank must lend the actual read service and once-only publication destination;
this producer does not yet open the background scheduling entry.


Inkling composite construction now retains the actual effective configuration and
static declarations from the successful initial constructor. Text embeddings,
normalizations, output, optional MTP depths/shared norm, dMel static tower and hMLP
static normalization reconstruct through the same neutral spec-copy workers under
construction metadata. Admission borrows the closed configuration owner; completed
source publication binds the exact source/target transform presence and selection.
Checked reconstruction never regenerates checkpoint format maps or MTP declarations.
This constructor source boundary supplies declarations rather than native execution
permission; the original native source and role binders remain mandatory.


The composite routed handoff now shares the existing routed source publication:
actual parameter descriptions, selected bank identity, addressable targets, and
completed contract materialization are retained after initial construction.
PreparedCompositeArchitecture lends its immutable description for metadata
validation and invalidates that loan when mutable inner access is requested.
This publication is descriptive; the checked composite routed constructor validates
its actual completed unit and graph source before consuming the routed contract.
Ordinary composite construction uses the same contract/addressable-target worker.

The admitted background read service permits one physical source read per unit
in a source generation. Taking a completed batch does not reopen that unit:
manager publication, device promotion, rollback errors and escaped owners may
still retain the backing. A lock-free failure fence closes the whole generation
on read/publication failure or unwind, and cancellation closes it before waiting
for the worker. The source has no reset method. Successful scheduling must reuse
an existing published host owner; a new generation requires separately admitted
source capacity and an explicit drained boundary. Queue cleanup alone never
proves physical source retirement.

The same thread startup producer can accept against a retained original host
source. Its private origin projection supplies the actual execution, pool and
account ceiling; source validation and the independent startup commitment share
one usage-lock transaction. Neither a copied identity nor a caller-invented
capacity replaces the retained source. Worker startup remains host accounting
only and does not spend or recreate a native submission allowance.


Cold host-copy snapshots borrow the original manager's exact retained prepared
host owner when a resident unit has published only a Device-tier row. The source
backing is independently retained and paid by original construction; this loan
does not allocate a second payload, install Host residency, or supply transfer
authority. Snapshot validation compares the same immutable owners and geometry.
Actual transfer acquisition and pinning still validate the ledger's current tier
and readiness. Ordinary managers without a prepared host source retain their
existing snapshot requirements.


Distributed completion host preparation now uses the retained communication
source for finite array-handle, count-buffer, group, route, and stream
containers. Population is supplied by the selected communication worker and
confers no native allocation credit. Group and route insertion compares the
actual retained source, declared contract, and native handle. The existing
`NativeResources` and `PreparedRecovery` receive moved values; preparation never
clones a native resource or treats a prepared recovery as completed work.

The weak resource registry and both existing orphan quarantines share a linked
one-use destination. Ordinary callers allocate that destination under their
existing contract; prepared callers supply the node paid before submission.
Removal unboxes the node before dropping its contents and source funding. Every
strong native resource alias independently retains account-only custody after
its native `Rc`; unresolved work still uses the existing recovery quarantine and
terminal-status rules. A failed observation, timeout, or TLS exit is not a
completion witness.

These constructors qualify host retention only. Exact native communicator and
transport census, event submission, child host-resolution/wait allocations, and
housekeeping callback registration still require their own source-funded
producers. Original distributed execution guards remain closed until those
producers and their actual caller joins are complete.

Prepared background windows publish completed worker-owned host batches on the
calling thread, using an independently prepared Host acquisition before the
existing Device acquisition. Host and Device controller/closure cursors are never
reused. Source lookahead submits only exact currently missing host rows; hits
retain the already published backing. One failure fence spans protection, queue
submission, host publication, promotion and rollback. The request coordinator
must additionally span unit population and completed forward progression.

The per-forward background source is the exact canonical union of the retained
selected windows. Its existing read banks have one attempt per unit; foreground
source banks preserve their existing two-attempt policy. Native source capacity
remains the existing shared retirement counter, including failed/escaped buffers.

An original dense manager with selected background host lookahead retains two
separate exact window declarations: the Device-depth source and the Host-depth
source. Both are constructed by the same source-owned geometry/canonical-row
worker under the manager's accepted load account. The second constructor's full
metadata population is counted before load; it starts no worker and reads no
weight payload. Request preparation borrows the retained Host source by exact
layout, IDs and depth, rather than extending overlapping Device windows or
rebuilding a selection. Original dense controller construction therefore covers
both declarations, while worker/copy execution still requires its request bank.


Conditional Qwen now compiles its actual target and prediction unit specs during
initial composite construction and retains them beside the immutable effective
configuration, local geometry, and selected expert realization. Checked unit
construction validates those exact owners and invokes the existing TargetBlockSpec
and PredictionUnitSpec workers; vision keeps its existing paid constructor.
Changed expert realization invalidates the source; reinstalling the same declared
realization preserves it. Completed source publication carries both source/target
unit owners, enabling the shared checked routed contract only for that completed
constructor. These neutral declarations do not supply native tensor, account, or execution
permission; the existing backend source/role binders remain mandatory.



Inkling retains the initial constructor's graph, parameter description, transport
roles, target/prediction state layouts, and total logical state count beside the
exact configuration and local geometry owners. Vision and dense/sparse target
units reuse the ordinary unit-spec worker, preserving routed and shared expert
indices and quantization companions. Metadata construction borrows the retained
catalog and copies only demanded state/spec destinations through their funded
workers. Replacing the expert realization invalidates the source unless all actual
per-layer bank declarations match; equal configuration values from another owner
do not establish a source. Missing sources still refuse before ordinary graph or
format reconstruction. Successful initial composite construction publishes this
complete owner for both direct and routed reconstruction.

The native original-operation preparation boundary carries the existing quote
`WorkspaceMetadataFunding` through recipe quotation and final bank construction.
The report metadata adapter exposes only an alias of that supplied host account;
account-only operation custody does not manufacture new host spending authority.
The shared replicated/composite adapters forward it without changing source or
execution selection. Background constructor consumers retain the alias after
all their declared storage.

The background forward coordinator consumes one prepared generation per actual
forward and one exact window per ordinal. A stack guard covers the same caller's
acquisition/population closure, making errors and unwind permanently close the
request. Normal advancement joins the real worker after every window has been
consumed and the operation bank has verified its actual pending leases drained.
Cancellation never resets source slots. The coordinator has one paid failure
destination; repeated calls after terminal failure return a fixed refusal, so
an escaped error cannot cause repeated failure allocations or physical reads.


Original inline communication event submission consumes the existing retained
communication source and finite completion destinations. Its native submission
uses the current original role's Graph and Record owners through the same
`OperationEvent` prepared-root/Eval worker; it does not create an independent
Scope or derive native quota from a host population descriptor. The prepared
recovery borrows that exact role, and a prepaid housekeeping registration stays
with the actual native resource owner through unresolved recovery and quarantine.
An event may complete while the surrounding model role is active; event readiness
and permission to release that role's resources remain distinct. Busy or failed
observation never supplies retirement evidence.

The original event constructor exposes a closed completion wrapper, so ordinary
allocating flag, word, header and consumer-wait builders cannot be attached to it.
Prepared F32 finished-flag and I32 failure-agreement destinations now attach
through the same scalar resolver. They submit their owned scalar as the exact
sole event root, then borrow completed backing through that event's retained
original observer; no second evaluation or child Scope occurs. The agreement
count comes from the actual retained group's declared membership. Each result
alias keeps its paid cell allocation before account custody, so the boolean can
escape native completion without retaining native arrays or a mutable observer.
Signed word and individual in-band header adapters also use that same resolver.
Their actual owned output supplies dtype and host population; destination vectors
and copied immutable expectations are paid before event submission. Original
polling fills existing storage, and extracted word vectors retain account custody
until the data is dropped. Header custody outlives both its row elements and the
outer row-vector allocation. Same-role stream dependencies consume source-paid,
once-only slots in the existing observed operation bank. Each stream must match
a handle already retained by the actual completion, and each child keeps that
resource owner through safe role retirement. The native wait uses the existing
WaitRecord producer in the same admitted Record arena; its exact requests remain
part of the caller's native role quote, separate from host slot storage. Fixed
refusals spend their slot without inventing a native failure, and primary event
readiness does not imply child/role retirement. The actual native communicator
allocation census and cross-role source handoff remain explicit prerequisites
where those distributed paths require them; no admission guard is opened by
these completion producers. Ordinary distributed completion continues through its existing Event and
Recovery; both paths share resource status, bounded-wait and quarantine workers.

Background request planning retains the selected manager's separate Host-depth
windows and ordinary dense options. Host acquisition uses the actual intersection
of Host lookahead and Device demand; Device rows outside that intersection use
the existing direct reader. A canonical unit receives exactly one prepared read
slot per actual Host-window occurrence, while direct reads retain their existing
two-attempt allowance. Warm omissions spend neither another unit's cursor nor a
source backing. All forwards share the same actual native retirement counter.

Before each new window the bank requires its pending native lease queue to be
empty after unit wait, transfer synchronization and payload release. The source
service then waits for the real worker callback boundary and destroys completed
results outside the next canonical Host set. Only that transition may rearm a
successfully consumed occurrence. Source read, publication, promotion, retirement,
or cancellation failure permanently closes later admission, including when its
partially filled backing escapes through an error. Thread startup still retires
only after the real thread join, independently of callback completion.

The source peak is the smaller of the complete finite occurrence population and
Host budget plus the largest exact ready Host window plus the largest direct
window's real attempt population. Shared Host acquisition already pins external
canonical alias owners in the Host ledger; an alias row with no new physical
backing cannot permit its owner to be evicted. These pins and drained native
leases justify the Host term. The native retirement counter remains charged
until each backing's last actual alias dies, independently of ledger eviction,
callback return, or publication. Host-only source, queue and window metadata use
the supplied cumulative preparation account; native tensors and budgets stay on
the calling thread. This joins the bounded consumer; public selection must also
consume the same prepared manager, startup and source contract before admitting
the background route.

Paged key/value append now shares one portable ordered traversal between native
execution and workspace metadata. The actual block size, tail extent and absolute
frontier determine slices, partial-tail concatenations and seal boundaries; native
tail accounting, sealing, completion and rollback remain the existing manager
operations. The workspace keeps separate ordered blocks and a partial tail, and
restores its prior local state after a partial failure without refunding accepted
trace or construction spending. Source-projected blocks retain their actual native
roots, canonical pins and paid metadata owner beside the symbolic state, including
on rejected policy/geometry handoff. These declarations grant no native permission.
This append producer does not open the managed paged entry: scan arithmetic
(Fused/InputScores, softcap and relative bias), source promotion, original manager
transactions/completion and state copy/resume/reset still require their exact shared
consumers. Existing original policy guards remain in place.

Prediction source-copy recipes now distinguish fresh unit construction from
rebinding actual retained modules. The existing prediction visitor supplies each
physical module's retained replacement/restore handle population; the ordered
invocation trace counts repeated shared calls independently. The same source
recipe validates the exact immutable parameter inventory and accounts those C
handle shells in Graph, while the existing source-copy recipe continues to own
lease binding, transfers and completion. Retained modules add no scalar seeds or
Full constructors. An unbound recipe still fails qualification, and the ordinary
fresh-unit constructor continues to account its actual seeds and lazy nodes.

The native blockwise backend consumes the same typed score options and explicit
value-pass/bias entry points through its existing accumulator. Paged native startup
uses that descriptor's pass count; no alternative attention implementation is
introduced. Metadata stage completion remains descriptive and never substitutes
for the native per-block ownership boundary. Exact MLX BlockwiseAttention fact and
recipe lowering, source-qualified block/promotion scheduling and original paged
manager/completion admission remain required before opening the managed route.

A qualified resident source may publish only Device residency while retaining its
paid immutable host backup. Source pinning now revalidates that exact backup and
pins the actual ready published tier: Host when present, otherwise the qualified
ready Device copy. The pin owner retains the immutable snapshot until its leases
retire. It neither creates a Host ledger row nor gives an ordinary checkpoint
fallback original-source authority. Failure unwinds the exact pinned tier for
each successful prefix, outside recursive manager/native lock acquisition.

Paged block discard now uses the same whole-block prefix boundary for native
manager retirement and workspace append/scan state. If the retained prefix ends
inside a sealed block, that block remains live; its suffix does not authorize
discard of the prefix. Existing lease, imported-source and history pins remain
additional independent retention conditions.

Paged attention now uses one portable ordered pass/block/tail traversal for the
ordinary native cache and its exact projected workspace state. The native
adapter retains actual manager prefetch cursors and block leases, submits each
sealed block before releasing its lease, consumes the independent tail, and
settles the final output before shared window discard and telemetry. The
workspace adapter consumes the actual ordered projected block arrays and tail
through the same blockwise descriptors, preserving selected score arithmetic,
softcap, complete-context mask, sink values and caller-produced per-block bias.
It validates exact retained frontier/window/prefix geometry and keeps history
unchanged after a failed scan without refunding accepted trace work.

This shared scan does not itself authorize original native execution. The
complete native blockwise recipe/fact lowering, paged manager mutation and
promotion authority, aggregate state consumers and copy/resume/reset remain
required joins. The original Device-only state/copy gates and causal blockwise
receipt refusal remain in place until those actual consumers are qualified.


The selected dense source initializer now accepts configured background Host
windows through the same original manager constructor and its exact controller
facts. Payload transforms and sampled-memory instrumentation retain their source
qualification checks before admission; no unsuccessful admitted constructor falls
back. Requests still require their actual read, queue, thread-startup and native
operation bank before selecting original background execution.

An ordinary call on the same source-prepared manager owns the existing ordinary
background worker in its transfer window. It uses the same scheduling, Host
publication and Device transfer paths, and cancels the worker during the same
window cleanup. This avoids a manager/controller/worker ownership cycle. Original
requests instead use the paid host-only coordinator, with native tensors and
budget handles remaining on the caller. Both publish disjoint completed worker
counters into the existing neutral telemetry mutex; cumulative counters saturate
and queue capacities/peaks take maxima. Reports are observations only and never
replace actual worker join or backing-retirement evidence.

Paged aggregate state projection uses an owning destination for native arrays
borrowed only during a manager source loan. Borrowed resident projection and
this destination share the exact sorted physical-identity/capacity/root insertion
worker and prepared inspection clone worker. The owning destination is installed
outside the loan before imports; successfully retained native rows survive a
later refusal and are deduplicated across subsequent layer loans. Per-source
shape/dtype/completed-backing validation remains unchanged. This does not create
cache source permission: the complete state producer retains actual canonical
manager pins beside its native witnesses through storage binding and admission.

The shared original numerical consumer preserves its native source error with
the selected equation cut and input side. These static labels add no formatting
allocation to admission; the existing exact Cause/Failure layout queries price
the enlarged error carrier before native entry. They identify a failed source
completion handoff without changing traversal admission or granting a new role.

The shared workspace state sum now has a distinct paged key/value layer instead
of treating paged source arrays as concatenated resident history. This layer
uses the existing block append/scan workers and the same fixed-role import and
shape validation as ordinary state. Immutable metadata checkpoints share block
handles; mutation copies the metadata container under the cumulative context,
and reset leaves saved metadata intact. These metadata operations do not grant
native manager history retention, checkpoint/copy or reset authority. Complete
native source/pin collection and those manager consumers remain required before
original paged admission. The relative-profile bias producer is also still an
explicit workspace gap; supplied relative profiles are never discarded.

Every prepared native projection storage destination now retains an independent
alias of its actual WorkspaceMetadataFunding after its native rows. This covers
accepted-prefix failures from transient manager loans after the constructing
Context is dropped. Raw WorkspaceTensor/ExistingStorage values retain only
trace identity; their enclosing state/result continues to own funding. The
storage owner does not create a new allowance, source grant or refund.

The original dense background reader allocates each final host destination on
its caller before submitting the existing checkpoint job. A safemlx-only
`PreparedHostTransferWriter` admits no array handles and exposes only an
exclusive byte slice on the I/O worker. That worker runs the same grouped
`read_many_into` operation; registration, immutable publication and promotion
resume on the creating thread after actual callback completion. A wrong-thread
return preserves the writer, and a worker failure, panic or detached teardown
moves its preallocated owner into the existing allocation-retirement queue.
No native buffer destructor runs on that I/O path. The source receipt and live
retirement counter remain with the real buffer until ordinary host reclamation
actually releases it; queue completion alone refunds no backing. The safe
handoff uses the existing safemlx unsafe boundary and adds no portable unsafe
code or native budget on a worker. Foreground reads compose the same three
allocation/read/publication workers synchronously.

The shared prefill span lifecycle declares final score ownership explicitly:
ordinary spans request the session's final causal row, while a source-bound
consumer may retain the completed selected-position axes. This does not change
output demand, vocabulary projection, chunk scheduling or cancellation. Embedded
MLX selects the latter only with its retained original numerical context; the
architecture forwards that mechanism contract. Its existing original logits-row
consumer then creates, funds and completes the final view from the actual target
source. The former unconditional post-phase ordinary index could create a new
descriptor outside the target's completion/source publication. No model-family
branch or second prefill driver is introduced; default and ordinary paths retain
their existing finalization.

The separate original background Host acquisition bank prepares its lease-ID
destinations with the actual Host tier. Existing Device banks retain Device
selection. The shared transfer and lease workers compare the requested tier to
that retained declaration before taking IDs or pinning ledger rows; accepting a
Host producer does not allow a Device destination to cross tiers.


The complete key/value workspace projector now consumes mixed actual paged and
exact-concatenation layers through one physical allocation identity collector.
Each paged layer contributes its canonical manager selection, generation, pool,
rank, block intervals and tail geometry under the existing non-demand source
loan. The same source-to-append geometry worker constructs a distinct paged
workspace layer; it does not concatenate historical blocks into a resident
stand-in. The final native inventory retains all array witnesses first, then
its paid source geometries and canonical pins, then host funding. Aliases share
one storage identity across dense and paged layers.

Projection reserves its source and native-row destinations before borrowing a
manager. A successful pin enters the external destination before any subsequent
fallible array import. The owning native failure retains a partially accepted
prefix after every loan closes. Existing pre-submission error adapters may
explicitly retire that unsubmitted prefix outside the locks; the original typed
cause and host funding survive the teardown. Neither source facts nor a metadata
checkpoint grant native execution, promotion, copy, reset or continuation
permission. Host/disk block promotion, hybrid/pooling paged state joins, relative
bias projection and complete paged native recipe/completion consumers remain
separate producers; the original Device-policy gates are unchanged.


The MLX distributed retained-source adapter now lends a paid, immutable inventory
from the actual native Group implementation. Requested backend names and rank-one
fallbacks do not identify the implementation: EmptyGroup is explicit. Ring reports
its actual socket/vector/buffer and worker populations without reading live queues.
MPI, JACCL and NCCL report only their known inline implementation owner and leave
their backend storage unresolved. Shared controls, associative nodes, worker and
socket runtime storage, submission tasks and inherited owners are separate unresolved
domains. These partial source facts grant no native capacity and do not open the
original distributed admission gate. Exact Group implementation comparison detects
aliases across different C/Rust wrappers while both immutable owners remain borrowed.


Ring socket requests now use the existing native TaskNode/TaskOwner and an
allocator-qualified promise state, with their exact invocation Graph loan passed
explicitly into nested workers. The existing socket worker and mutex still own
acceptance and progress. Each accepted receipt joins before its raw buffer borrow
can unwind; its promise retains the allocation source after queue retirement.
Pool siblings are all joined before the first task error is rethrown. No new Scope,
completion engine or worker TLS authority is created. ThreadPool callable ownership,
remaining plan/packet producers and communicator platform storage remain separately
unqualified, so these socket layouts alone do not open original distributed admission.

Ring captures the exact GraphQuotaRef before enqueueing each outer scheduler
callback. Callback-local TLS is not source evidence: a Graph-only native task can
retain Graph without installing an OriginalBuffer worker binding. Direct, routed
and nested pool socket operations receive only this explicit retained caller loan.


The native ThreadPool now queues the same concrete TaskNode/TaskOwner used by the
scheduler, with callable and promise held together before FIFO acceptance. Its
ordinary enqueue delegates to the same worker with the ordinary allocator; Ring
passes its retained caller Graph explicitly. The shared promise helper reports the
actual qualified void/value/reference state layout. Unaccepted prefixes drop their
future before the promise, and workers retain the exact source through callable,
node and result retirement. Remaining Ring plan/packet storage and native
communicator/platform resources still require their own bounds and source joins.


Ring's shared reduction worker now constructs its two index plans through one
checked geometry/count producer and fixed Graph-vector reservations before any
socket submission. The quote layout and native constructor use the same packet,
segment and step calculation. Half-open spans preserve the ordinary scatter/gather
order with overflow-safe clipping. Both partial destinations retain and retire the
same caller source on success or reserve failure. Variable routed all-to-all
payloads still need a qualified global count/source contract; received headers do
not constitute an allocation bound.


Hybrid state now joins actual paged key/value storage and fixed component values
to the same complete source projection worker as ordinary key/value state.
Fixed dtype/role validation and resident compressed capacity/layout projection
are shared with the ordinary native adapters through borrowed value callbacks.
The paged append source is selected and pinned before fixed values are imported;
all physical aliases share the enclosing inventory, including aliases between a
paged block, fixed component and resident storage. A native fixed-value refusal
retains the accepted source prefix through the same owning failure/ordered
teardown path. Counted construction uses the same typed DeviceState constructor
and exact callback/control layouts, not an independent admission allowance.
Paged compressed attention and pooling local caches still require their own
block representations and consumers. Their gates, and original paged native
execution/copy/promotion gates, are not relaxed by this hybrid source join.


The retained Ring worker-storage query borrows the actual native group and input
