array. Gather, reduce and direct-neighbor transport share their checked partitions
and concrete worker callable types with execution. The query consumes the exact
pool task, socket task/promise, reduction-plan and future-vector layout producers;
its counts include immediate empty socket results and the padded small-reduction
path. Source-bound backend loans retain the selected communication source and H
through query-result retirement. EmptyGroup, unknown implementations, unsupported
operations and unqualified standard-library layouts refuse instead of returning
zero storage. No input evaluation, stream setup, task submission or completion
poll occurs during inspection.

These are worker destinations only. Outer CPU encoder/primitive/event storage,
persistent communicator controls, OS workers and private transport resources
still require their own producers before distributed original admission opens.
Variable all-to-all forwarding additionally needs an actual negotiated global
payload source; local counts do not bound third-party routed packets. Received
headers are not adopted as allocation authority. The isolated native fixture
covers shared nonzero partitions, exact task/plan extents and explicit refusal;
actual multi-rank Ring numerical validation remains required for public support.


Paged local-cache visibility uses one portable ordered worker for both native
lease traversal and workspace metadata. The worker slices each actual selected
block under its lease, releases that lease, then slices the independent tail and
constructs only the transient requested window. Local update assembles prior
visible tokens plus all submitted input before the existing shared append may
discard expired blocks. The stored state remains paged. This source/metadata
contract does not admit native original manager promotion, copy, or execution.

Ordinary prediction invocations bind retained parameter values through the same
module binding worker with ordinary native handle cloning. Initial admitted
source construction retains its finite prepared aliases, and original admitted
invocations retain their separate prepared binding path. Repeated ordinary
rounds and independent lanes therefore cannot consume the source constructor's
finite alias population. The existing native-scope guard prevents the ordinary
prediction entry from substituting this path for an admitted operation.


Ring's outer CPU dispatch now uses named Gather, Reduce, Send and Receive
callables around the same worker bodies. Each retains the creator's exact Graph
reference before enqueue. CommandEncoder exposes the concrete std::bind payload
and existing scheduler TaskNode layout; both counted and uncounted enqueue use
that same node. A separate borrowed Group/input dispatch query supplies this
contribution, and the backend derives its paid loan from the already authenticated
worker source. It grants no worker TLS, submission role, fallback allocation or
communicator admission. Primitive construction, Eval cleanup, data/backing and
event producers remain separate. The native fixture exercises the exact bound
node with signed nonzero data on a thread without Graph TLS, verifies creator
source retirement and rejects an undersized arena and actual singleton source.


Complete pooling-state projection consumes the same owned cross-layer native
identity collector as key/value and hybrid state. The actual pager supplies its
physical layer and rank; a pooling table index does not replace that identity.
Local blocks and tail, pending/pooled/overlap arrays, and source pins retain their
original native backing together. Both local mechanisms use the same declared
pooling stream count, ratio, frontier, component presence, dtype and geometry
validator. An accepted native prefix outlives any rejected later component;
legacy callers retire that prefix only outside all manager loans.

Workspace pooling keeps a distinct paged local member and uses the shared
visible-window/append worker. It returns prior visible tokens plus every new
token, while stored history stays paged and metadata checkpoints use paid COW.
This completes the cold source/metadata consumer, not native original execution.
Remaining producers are exact native causal/Fused/capped/sink/relative blockwise
recipes and completion roots; original manager lease/prefetch/promotion and
source-owned transfers; prepared append/seal/catalog/rollback/discard/reset
destinations; and source-qualified paged copy/snapshot/fork/resume. Relative
attention still needs its actual architecture-selected bias source/geometry in
the metadata producer. Existing Device-only/source/policy gates stay in place
until those consumers authenticate their real resources.


Managed plain-text warm-up on a loaded embedded-prediction model uses the same
architecture-owned target equation constructor as embedded target quotation.
The exact retained prediction/source tuple is still authenticated; plain target
work does not construct or invoke that extension or publish its placement.
Native admission retains the complete idle inventory, including prediction
modules, immutable prototypes, source stores, overrides and shared manager
backing. Missing inventory, source ownership, completion or state-frontier facts
keep their existing refusals. This permits a subsequent fresh embedded lane to
consume the independently completed and registered target state through the
existing populated-target copy path; the warm output lends no source authority.

Target equation quotation configures retained prediction capture before binding
observation paths to the actual resident or layerwise runtime. Captured spans
then use that immutable configuration; they do not invalidate the prepared path
generation through mutable architecture access between spans. Plain and media
equation construction keep capture disabled unless their explicit quote requests
it. The existing binding-identity validation remains mandatory.

Fixed replicated target capture is shared across mixed, attention-only,
fixed-component and stateless state profiles. Selecting a narrower cache
representation changes state access, not the architecture's requested final
hidden output. All profiles retain the same explicit capture flag and context
owner; ordinary requests leave it disabled. This includes attention-only
Nemotron target quotation selected from its actual layer schedule.


Resident routed providers expose a neutral equation-parity fact through the
existing replicated execution strategy. The selected `PlannedResidentBank`
variants validate their retained per-unit specification and invoke the same
resident grouped operators on the supplied bank, input and routes. Bank-id
routing preserves this fact only when its provider type declares it. This lets
embedded target projection consume the existing retained routed selection and
its target equation quote. The fact grants no storage, execution or completion
authority: actual source inventory, metadata, observation and native operation
banks remain independently checked. Addressable/custom providers and separate
partition strategies retain their existing qualification requirements.


The ordinary page mask now uses exact I32 query/key coordinates for
representable source ranges, preserving causal, prefix and sliding-window
behavior without a host boolean vector. Wide-coordinate ordinary requests
retain their existing worker; the original profile requires exact represented
coordinates. Floating workspace layouts continue to use their existing
conservative four-byte representation, including narrower native scalars.
General original paged admission remains closed until per-stage recipes and
manager/source completion consumers join this numerical producer.


The native distributed lazy constructor now has a separate source-derived
Graph recipe for the actual retained Ring or EmptyGroup implementation and
input. It reserves the existing descriptor, primitive, input-reference,
shape/stride and C-handle destinations, invokes the ordinary distributed
constructor, and retires the bank before evaluation. Singleton identities
mint only the result handle. Exact CPU stream validation precedes construction;
unknown implementations and overflowing geometry remain typed refusals. The
backend output owner retains source metadata funding after the lazy array.
This recipe supplies no Data/backing, communication worker, completion event,
or persistent communicator fit; original distributed admission remains closed
until those real owners are joined. Native multi-rank validation remains pending.


The source-bound chat evaluator lowers `<`, `<=`, `>` and `>=` into the same
storage-parametric VM dispatcher used by ordinary MiniJinja. Its closed storage
adapter uses the existing scalar comparison/coercion kernel, ordinary value-kind
ordering, and borrowed UTF-8 string comparison. This includes numeric results of
`length`/`count`, as used by the retained Nanbeige and Kimi K2 template sources;
it does not claim the remaining operations in those whole templates. Ordinary
undefined validation and recursive Value comparison remain in ordinary storage.
The checked adapter accepts only scalar/undefined values and available string
atoms; recursive container comparison, generated-string comparison and chained
comparison programs still require their own finite traversal contracts.

Comparison creates a boolean in the existing paid operand destination. Source
instruction/continuation geometry and render controls include the new operation
and the shared scalar worker's concrete controls. Measurement and filling execute
the same dispatcher; neither allocates a comparison result or falls back to an
ordinary renderer. Existing source, partial render failure, and completed output
owners retain their actual funding independently of borrowed caller inputs.


The resident-provider equation fact is a sized static method rather than an
associated constant on `RoutedExpertProvider`, preserving existing dynamic
tensor-parallel providers. The retained execution strategy exposes the
descriptive query used by native target and erased-session source
inspection. Its default preserves the pre-existing ordinary constant; routed
execution forwards only its selected provider type's closed fact. No bank scan,
allocation, residency change or new distributed qualification is introduced.


Native blockwise facts and recipe lowering consume one exact stage decoder
for query preparation, ordered page accumulation and final normalization.
The decoder validates real operand/output geometry, mask coverage, grouped
heads, value width, prior recurrence state, bias/sink placement, arithmetic and
absolute page coordinates. Existing contiguous input-score and paged paths
share the recurrence buffer formulas and constructor census. A page records
one nested completion: three roots for normalization/fused accumulation or
one for the rounded value pass. No total-history scratch approximation is
substituted for these page bounds. Original causal execution is still gated
until actual source-qualified manager calls, append/seal publication and
promotion/copy lifecycle consumers supply their distinct admission.


The shared CPU General-copy dispatch used by distributed contiguity now has a
source-derived native storage query. It names the same concrete FIFO callable,
its two actual weak descriptor/Data wrappers and bounded worker metadata,
including higher-rank iterators. The existing single-stride collapse equation
prepares its fresh vector destinations before mutation and moves the result;
ordinary copy and iterator consumers use this same implementation. These are
copy-dispatch facts, not destination backing, parent Eval/cleanup or persistent
communicator admission. No distributed support gate is opened by this query.


The checked chat evaluator now dispatches `in` and `not in` through the same
ordinary membership instruction, with negation remaining the existing shared
`not` operation. Borrowed source/context strings use the shared ordinary UTF-8
substring search. Borrowed JSON sequences scan once with the same short-circuit
loop and scalar equality kernel, retaining indices in the existing operand
registers; map membership uses the actual borrowed key lookup, including keys
whose value is null. The exact two-field text-message representation exposes
those same keys. Empty/undefined containers retain ordinary lenient behavior.
No implicit value-to-string formatting, generated-string search, recursive
container equality or nonempty literal-container construction is newly admitted.

The membership result occupies the existing paid boolean operand. Source/action
geometry, search/scan controls and the scalar equality worker are included in
the existing compilation/render census. Scanning creates no dynamic Value,
container copy or iterator heap; measurement and filling borrow the same finite
immutable inputs. Escaped render output and partial failure retain their existing
source/funding owners. The retained Nanbeige closing-think substring and Kimi
schema-key conditions exercise this operation without claiming whole-template
coverage from these clauses alone.

Prepared routed target quoting forwards the exact `PreparedModelSources` owner
through the existing gated, ReLU-squared and pooling visitors. The visitor lends
its target inspection for family selection and retains the completed config,
unit, store and materialization sources for reconstruction. Existing standalone
inspection callers use the same worker; an inspection alone does not establish
a checked constructor source. Preparation failures retain their typed metadata
cause rather than allocating a replacement diagnostic string.


Paged-cache canonical catalog storage can now be prepared as a finite paid
inventory. The portable `CacheRecordTable` keeps the same identity-ordered
records and supports the existing ordinary growing map. Preparing moves those
records into an explicitly bounded sorted allocation without copying payloads
or changing canonical lease, access, prefix, or tail state. Checked insertion
and lifecycle replacement validate capacity before ticking the clock or
mutating any destination; allocator overcapacity is not usable credit. The
native manager's physical table and source iterator consume this same store.

Old empty inventories and their host accounts are returned from installation
so backend callers can retire them after releasing manager loans. Ordinary
growth retains any prior host account until the table itself retires or its
empty predecessor is returned. Preparation and scalar capacity facts confer
no native source or execution authority. Source-bound manager installation,
original append/seal/promotion and controlled copy/resume/reset remain required
before the original paged execution gate can open; the gate is unchanged here.

The native capture recipe includes retained capture aliases in the final
completion root bound, ordered Synchronizer edges, and selected worker storage.
The transform equations and tensor allocations are already in the architecture
trace and are not duplicated. The exact same enriched recipe drives Graph,
Record, native root allocation and final completion. This closes the mismatch
where Embedded capture retained arrays beyond the equation-only root collector.
Unknown prerequisite recipes stay unknown; no runtime growth is permitted.


Accepted Ring pool/socket tasks now carry a private allocation-only Graph loan
at the existing queue progress boundary. Its source is the accepted native
Task's retained Graph, including through callback and node destruction. Explicit
allocations validate that exact Graph even when no host constructor is active;
they cannot consume a concurrent host bank or a closed source's prepared input
blocks. Queue task/Socket layouts include the loan and validation controls.
The loan supplies neither default allocator selection nor Scope, Record, event,
or backing authority. Native submission/constructor controls explicitly refuse
inside it, just as for the existing allocation-only buffer worker. Ordinary
Graph-null jobs and synchronous empty socket completion keep their existing
path. This closes the accepted-worker allocation source; it does not qualify
unresolved communicator owners or the whole CPU distributed Eval population.

Inkling workspace input admission now uses the existing complete-input identity
comparison and part inspection destinations. Ordinary and metadata-funded calls
share one text/projected/image/audio semantic worker; only descriptor/vector and
diagnostic construction differs. Checked calls pay those actual destinations
and preserve the source error. This input admission does not grant native media
execution or qualify a tensor-inspection method that the backend does not supply.


Accepted original text recipe candidates retain their actual canonical paged
source pins separately from temporary native projection handles. The shared
resident and prepared-input recipe workers move the already constructed source
inventory through candidate selection and accepted installation; rejected
candidates retire their inventory before the planning account. The inventory
contains actual manager pins and paid geometry, and its vector retires before
its independent host owner. No auxiliary Array clone is retained in the quote.
This is a source handoff for the pending original manager bank, not an execution
grant. Saved paged continuation still needs its own completed manager-copy
producer; the existing original paged policy gate remains unchanged.


The shared native blockwise accumulator records completion only after its exact
current recurrence roots have successfully crossed the existing nested or
ordinary recovery boundary. Its subsequent `submit` call reuses that completed
state instead of issuing another ordinary asynchronous submission. Any attempted
accumulation clears the marker first, including early failure. This private
readiness state neither authorizes source use nor opens the original causal
paged gate; incomplete/error work retains the existing recovery behavior.

The bounded chat compiler accepts borrowed mapping `.get(key[, default])` through
the same method-call VM dispatcher as ordinary rendering. Ordinary dispatch
retains the installed compatibility callback; bounded lookup uses the existing
message/JSON map worker and fixed operand slots. Explicit null is preserved,
missing keys use the supplied value (implicit or undefined defaults become None),
and every default expression executes before method selection. No generated key
bytes, general method call, namespace, macro or full-template capability is
inferred from this operation. Source/output and partial-failure custody are the
existing paid owners.

Borrowed chat strings also accept `startswith` and `endswith` through that same
method-call path. Both paths invoke the standard string edge comparison used by
the installed compatibility callback; borrowed JSON sequences preserve its
first-match short circuit and string-element validation order. No normalization,
implicit formatting, slicing or generated-byte materialization is added.


The bounded chat VM represents unlimited string splits as borrowed source/input
views, with a source-owned literal separator or the ordinary whitespace rule.
Ordinary split filters and these views use one iterator worker; checked length,
negative indexing, membership, type predicates and join consume the view without
creating a substring vector. `strip`, `lstrip` and `rstrip` keep UTF-8 ranges and
use the existing Unicode character-set trim semantics. Operand/control layouts
and generated output remain charged through the existing source/render owners;
selected JSON string views move with their paid operand register. Dynamic split
separators, max-split arguments, split-sequence formatting/loops and operations
on generated concatenations remain outside this finite profile. The released
Nanbeige reasoning/content expressions are covered directly; its full template
still requires macros, assignments/namespace state, reverse slices, literal
containers and tool serialization. These method joins do not establish full
Nanbeige template support.

Typed prediction operations explicitly declare whether they preserve target
geometry, parameter topology and observation declarations, including on failure.
The default invalidates prepared runtime bindings. Closed architecture-owned
prediction operations preserve those declarations while executing supplied
prediction units and mutable lane state; they use the same typed resident or
layerwise entry in native, partitioned and workspace execution. Arbitrary
architecture_mut access continues to invalidate bindings. This avoids rebinding
or allocating a new observation identity between Embedded prediction rounds,
without granting unknown operations permission to retain stale declarations.


The native CPU distributed Eval source is now derived from the actual accepted
AllReduce (sum/min/max), AllGather, Send or Recv primitive, its exact Ring group,
peer, dtype and immutable input/output geometry. A source-funded descriptor
borrows the constructed output and retains its original communication source
and H. Unrelated/subclass primitives, EmptyGroup identities and unknown native
implementations do not gain this source. Accepted evaluation does not recheck
the canonical new-submission terminal fence.

The existing FixedEval prologue now installs the same GraphConstruction bank
around those ordinary CPU primitive and cleanup workers. Its ten closed size
classes account for cleanup, invocation vectors, possible contiguous copies,
weak Data wrappers, native buffer-birth routing, the actual outer CPU task and
temporary retention. It quotes both permitted contiguity/donation paths from
immutable geometry and never treats lazy flags as a guarantee. Ring task/plan
and copy worker scratch extents remain separately reported. Logical backing
sizes require conversion through the selected native allocation facts; they
are not a physical budget. Persistent communicator/OS owners and the complete
managed distributed admission remain explicitly unqualified. Native multi-rank
constructor/Eval execution is still a validation gap; the new refusal case
checks exact source recognition without inventing a communicator.


The native distributed conformance now includes a two-process localhost Ring
fixture (`mlx-distributed-original-ring-test`, launched by `tests/run_local_ring.py`).
Both ranks use actual strict Ring initialization and the same ordinary numerical
oracle. Contiguous and transposed signed inputs exercise reduction and gather
through retained constructor/Eval/worker source queries, source-bound original
Graph/Data allocations, prepared traversal, completion, and final owner retirement.
The final accepted graph completes after the communicator is fenced for new
submissions. This fixture is staged coverage; a recorded successful native run is
required before reporting multi-rank validation or complete managed admission.


Retained cold construction keeps mutually exclusive ordinary-family and
resident/layerwise constructor temporaries in separate non-inlined workers.
The same selected source, validation, unit construction and observation binding
are used, and the caller prices the selected helper controls before entry.
This avoids carrying inactive target/MTP/vision declarations through a nested
workspace quote; it adds neither a heap substitute nor a thread-stack policy.


Paged catalog preparation consumes the accepted candidate's actual retained
manager/page inventory and the same immutable equation span plan. The shared
generation subset excludes the conservative unsent final decode; the existing
paged append partition derives each physical layer's sealed-block growth from
its real block size and partial tail. One manager loan revalidates its selected
pins, pool/generation, block descriptors and canonical tail accounting, then
prepares finite physical and neutral lifecycle destinations. Repeated managers
and physical layer aliases do not create independent catalogs. Both native
recipe entry routes retain these destinations beside the canonical source pins.

Catalog installation is a metadata operation, not original execution permission.
It rechecks the actual quiescent manager/generation/populations before moving
the canonical records, and retires empty predecessor storage after unlocking.
A refused install retains its paid destinations and original typed cause. The
paged native policy gate remains closed until the role-bound append/seal/scan
bank consumes this exact source and quoted operation order, covers actual
per-record payload construction and pool transitions, and retains all sources
through completion and recovery. Copy/resume/reset and unavailable tiers keep
their existing producer requirements.


A distinct retained-communicator source now accounts for the actual C++ shared
owner (including implementation), immutable socket and scratch vectors, real
libc++ hash-node/bucket allocations, and C++ worker thread runtime objects.
The native Ring factory is the authority for these layouts; inputs cannot
provide a count or implementation tag to manufacture a source. The existing
loaded thread-runtime qualifier supplies its retained library object sizes,
and its fixed control query is now shared by scheduler and communicator sources.
A borrowed safe/native source retains exact implementation identity; the backend
pays the known retained bytes before lending it through the original neutral
communication source. Every failure-producing query prepays its retained error.
Live operation queues and plans remain in their existing per-operation source.
OS-private thread/socket memory and inherited terminal roots remain explicit
obligations. No total managed distributed gate is opened by the known C++ subtotal.
The real two-process Ring fixture also checks these persistent owners and aliases.


Ordinary composite requirements use the existing paid immutable shared owner;
prepared requirements continue to retain their exact PreparedModelSources alias.
The context-bearing ordinary constructor prices the shared shell before birth
and keeps H through shell retirement. This removes an inactive inline ordinary
requirements payload from every prepared composite handoff without reconstructing
selection, configuration, source readiness or declaration identity. The original
source validation and completion gates remain in the shared construction driver.


The actual Ring persistent-source census now follows the same managed-runtime
boundary as the existing qualified CPU/background workers: OS-private stacks,
TLS, kernel socket state and allocator internals are not missing C++ producers.
Its exact shared owner, map, vectors, communication buffer, inline synchronization
and loaded-qualified C++ thread runtime complete this retained managed domain.
Unsupported implementation/ABI/runtime qualification and inherited managed owners
still refuse or remain explicit. Per-operation Graph, backing, event, failure and
retirement producers remain separate obligations; this correction supplies no
whole-operation fit or distributed execution admission by itself.


The CPU distributed operation census is available before lazy graph construction
from the actual retained Group/input and the existing checked constructor source.
It shares the same private Eval/cleanup/copy/communication worker as the accepted
native-primitive adapter. No proxy array, parameter-only source or second Eval
engine is constructed. The original entry rejects tracing and fenced fresh
sources, while the accepted-primitive entry preserves already accepted work.

The closed safe source combines constructor and Eval/copy/Ring-worker Graph
extents while keeping logical backing, event traversal and physical reservation
separate. Backend native-rank loans retain the same declaration, persistent
managed owner H and native input through preparation, and their result keeps the
same account through the ordinary constructor. Logical subgroups, world-wave and
routed transport do not become native full-world operations through this source;
their existing multi-step driver still needs its own connected finite producer.

The real two-process fixture compares every cold class/backing/worker population
with the later actual accepted primitive, including noncontiguous input, then
checks a fenced fresh query refuses without changing its destination while the
already accepted graph completes. Public distributed execution guards remain
until physical backing, completion and selected rank/source binding are joined.


### Internal capture transaction and retained readmission authority

Internal Embedded capture uses the same observation-transaction disposition as
ordinary model hooks: successful sealed work is Committed and failed work is
Aborted. This describes the model transaction, not token commitment; the separate
speculative phase and origin still distinguish tentative proposal and verification.
Sampler-input captures preserve their existing Untracked logical disposition.

Controlled edit readmission always invokes the selected executor's validator.
An ordinary observer requires the controller's loaded discovery; an original
observer authenticates its retained declaration/source and candidate under the
existing paid control owner. The discovery reference is optional so the controller
does not construct a second unpriced discovery report merely to reach that source
validator. Default validators reject missing discovery; no absent-source bypass
is introduced.

Logical prefill aggregate records attribute the sum of their physical contributors'
charges. The report-level charged field contains only additional aggregation
storage and encoding costs; physical transformations are not charged again.

The Inkling ordinary decoder-unit worker retains the same final target activation
as its routed and parallel workers. This context value is captured before readout
selection, including state-only prefill chunks, so the target-only workspace quote
and the selected execution consume the same prediction handoff.


Original distributed backing quotation now calls the same retained allocator's
single-request physical-capacity worker used by allocation. CPU's zero-byte
header and Metal's empty/page-rounded allocation remain distinct. The existing
aggregate Metal query is unchanged. The cold operation supplies its actual
copy/output sizes: reductions select one equal-sized birth, gather retains both,
send may copy, and receive owns only the output. Every query/failure transport is
paid before inspection and exact operation/runtime loans keep source H alive.

The positive real Ring fixture now allocates its original buffer budget from
these physical source facts and compares completed output capacity with the
same selected allocator. Overflow leaves the query destination unchanged. Graph,
Record, completion and native rank admission remain separately source-qualified;
logical payload size is never used directly as physical capacity.

The resident router recipe consumes the existing dense unpartitioned selector
worker for F32 sigmoid or square-root-softplus scoring, supplied IDs, and selected
coefficient normalization. Supplied IDs omit ranking and partition work. Sigmoid
and row-sum calls retain their independently qualified immutable source families
and pay each fixed invocation; CPU crossing-tie partitions retain their existing
stream/source recipe. Input transforms, learned scales and intervention programs
remain separate producers, with no inference from matching tensor shapes.

Pooled attention retains the existing fused SDPA lowering for its actual joined
local/pooled key bank. Its outer recipe adds the two head-axis views, bank and
optional mask concatenations, each actual mask conversion or missing scalar,
and their fixed copy-worker destinations. The same pooled-mask shape validator
is used by execution and inspection. Empty individual banks remain valid when
the joined extent is positive; overflowing or incompatible extents refuse.


The paged manager's prepared catalog source also owns finite current-report,
historical activity, and final report destinations. Installation moves the same
canonical rows under the original manager generation and returns retired empty
storage for teardown after unlocking. Ordinary and prepared publication share
one tally and recent-block counting worker; prepared publication validates the
whole actual layer population before mutation and preserves typed aggregate-pool
failures. Report selection retains the existing 128-identity policy and exact
overflow totals. Descriptor-derived control queries include the actual bounded
selection array and iterator frames; storage capacity grants no cache mutation,
promotion, or execution authority. Original paged execution remains gated until
the role-bound append, seal, scan, and completion consumers are connected.

#### Selected communication retention before original completion

Original completion preparation now selects the actual control world, group, or
route from its authenticated communication source and prepays every nested host
copy before insertion into the existing completion destinations. The portable
validated requirement/route values expose fallible retention copies preserving
operation order, exact dtype/limit declarations, and UTF-8 role/schema contracts;
they do not rebuild validation sets or mint another selected source. The backend
copies logical membership and route vectors while aliasing the same native group
and transport-stream owners. Each attempted selection pays its error controls,
and invalid source orders or exhausted destinations leave prior entries intact.

The same `NativeResources`, recovery, housekeeping, and quarantine owners retain
these copied values and their H account until settled retirement. There is no
native array copy, collective, or completion claim in this host-only step. Logical
world-wave and route equation admission still requires its actual operation
producers; retaining an exact logical group does not authorize replacing its
shared driver with a native whole-world collective.

Bounded mapping views use the same method/filter VM dispatcher as ordinary
rendering. Keys, values and item pairs borrow the exact immutable JSON map; a
key is a borrowed text register, and a pair retains its map register and ordinal.
The selected ValueMap ordering is preserved with and without preserve_order.
The iterable retains ordinary length/truth/type behavior and the shared Value
indexed-access fallback, including negative indices. List conversion exposes
the same immutable values with sequence kind and no per-element allocation. Joining keys or scalar values uses the shared
ordinary formatting/separator worker and the existing measured text destination.

Nested mapping and sequence loops now use the same VM PushLoop/Iterate/StoreLocal/
PopLoopFrame dispatcher, with UnpackList also routed through the ordinary shared
adapter. The closed compiler derives operand depth, maximum active frames and
lexical locals from the actual source. Separate borrowed registers retain each
active iterator and local, including outer values hidden by an inner binding.
Each frame advances monotonically through its actual immutable input length;
only that advance replenishes its source-sized instruction allowance. Structured
nested frames therefore need no guessed iteration multiplier or growing runtime
container. Flat assignment targets may unpack their exact input arity.

The pure render-prefix query describes the real operand/frame/local/reference
scratch. Original exact-output measurement temporarily admits this prefix through
the same host owner before allocation, then retires the scratch before admitting
final output storage. Measurement failures retain the paid error shell and exact
source owners. Both execution passes allocate from the same source-derived layout;
input references retire before either completed output or a partial-output error
escapes. Existing exact-output required-bytes queries now perform this temporary
funded measurement; the separate prefix query remains allocation-free.

This does not certify full Nanbeige/Muse templates: macros, set/namespace state,
serialization, filtered/recursive loops, loop else blocks, nested assignment
patterns and generated-string list conversion remain separate operations. Compact
message values do not retain arbitrary source-map keys or tool history, so these
mapping views and argument loops consume actual borrowed JSON objects. No model
name changes the compiler, dispatcher or source admission.

The native resident recorder retains the first missing lowering's actual operation
description through the existing quote metadata funding. Embedded target admission
moves that diagnostic into its retained failure and preserves neutral UnknownBound
as the source. This does not change admission or manufacture a source fact; it
makes an incomplete native recipe attributable without running an accepted graph.

#### Actual Ring operation and single-stream completion source

The cold CPU Ring operation now has an additive completed-operation source. It
requires the actual input to be a detached settled leaf and composes the existing
constructor, CPU Eval, copy, Ring task/plan, exact root, Synchronizer, Record and
Event-dispatch producers. The quote includes the Synchronizer's separate CPU
cleanup bank and one-element output vector, plus its final CPU Event signal task.
It derives captures from the selected native Record minimum and actual per-step
Data population. Receive has no input edge; the other constructors retain their
single completed input. Checked Graph/Record extent sums use their respective
owning allocators' fresh-capacity rules.

The closed source retains the same native group/input/operation, revalidates the
leaf before construction, and prepares the existing `ReadyCompletionResources`
with the exact selected world or group and the same finite traversal. The native
constructor and completion submission remain separate calls under the caller's
actual admitted role. Physical backing, runtime startup, persistent communicator
custody, and rank/session authority remain independent retained prerequisites.
There is no generic scalar-capacity constructor or logical-subgroup substitution.
The two-process Ring fixture consumes this source's capacities for its nonzero
contiguous/strided reduce and gather cases; an unexecuted lazy predecessor is
refused without changing the output query destination.


The accepted paged source inventory is now a paid shared native owner. Its exact
manager/catalog generation and complete pinned source are revalidated before
installing the canonical destinations, using the actual consumed prefill set and
accepted equation plan. The existing original-operation registration authenticates
only the actual prefill InputTransaction and cached ModelExecution scopes. Their
existing Recovery payload retains a page-source alias after native roots; pending,
failed, and early-drop paths never refund the consumed occurrence. The alias has
no session or quote backedge and no new inference or memory ledger. This closes
source-to-role retention. The append consumer below builds on that same owner;
the scan consumer below and paged saved-state admission remain separate from
opening original request gates.

The MLX cold execution-stream constructor prepares the existing shared router CPU
source after admitted runtime initialization and before module materialization can
enter an accepted scope. Ordinary selector construction retains the same fallback
preparation. Cold quotation stays side-effect-free and still requires the retained
source owner; this does not promote an ordinary worker or relax unknown bounds.

Relative-profile attention now supplies the resident native construction recipe
from the same validated descriptor as its physical workspace facts. It includes
both actual integer-coordinate graphs, profile clipping/gathering, optional window
and logarithmic scaling, repeated-K/V reshape copies, both matrix products and
precise softmax. High-rank reshape workers have their own source extents; no family
branch or extra numerical implementation is introduced.

The shared joint-selection native worker retains its existing raw-logit gather,
corrected sigmoid ranking and shared log-sigmoid/softmax coefficient equations.
Its fixed validated geometry now also drives the resident construction recipe,
including actual sort, copy and matrix-product sources. The ordinary worker and
its control census live together; the backend adapter only invokes that worker.


The grouped native recipe now derives a borrowed bank description for both packed
gated products and Relu2. The actual two projections, sorted selection plan and
weighted Sum share one reducer. Relu2 contributes its existing Maximum/Square
activation and scalar zero, with no gate/up slices, outer safe-ID constructor or
chunk-output container. Its Whole and Units/Finish phases keep the same actual
four retained unit/selection arrays and common observer controls. Dense projection
compactions, possible BF16 validation workers, sort storage and native source
requirements remain explicit; no non-dense, partition or bias source is inferred.
Relu2 adapter failures use the existing original error transport, so partial native
work retains the same role/account custody while ordinary execution preserves its
existing errors. This closes the dense Relu2 recipe, not unqualified packed formats.


Portable workspace traces now name value-completion boundaries separately from
numeric operators and output storage. Paged sealing records its two actual
key/value roots; scan finalization records its one returned root before history
can retire. The MLX recipe counts one nested completion per such event, with the
existing fixed traversal supporting the actual one/two-root workers. Their
ordinary native path keeps the same eval; original work uses the current admitted
nested traversal and preserves its typed failure. This descriptor is neither a
source witness nor independent execution authority, and it does not erase the
remaining original paged mutation/promotion/copy admission requirements.

The existing centroid-selected readout now supplies native construction and copy
recipes alongside its physical workspace facts, using one fixed geometry validator.
The source counts complete partition backing, actual gathered weight replicas for
every selected position, matrix products, per-position minima and final dense
scatter. Empty batch/sequence keeps the existing explicit zeros branch. The native
equation and transport census are colocated; output-demand policy is unchanged.

Target/prediction session completion uses the existing synchronous nested graph
worker with its paid dynamic root destination. The host bank remains suspended
until all admitted GPU and router CPU callbacks settle; only then is it restored.
Asynchronous grouped submission retains its single-GPU restriction. Neither path
reinterprets polling failure as completion, and unresolved records remain under
the enclosing original scope's recovery ownership.

The Embedded prediction quote and native bank preparation use separate fixed
call frames. The exact source-loaned quote returns before the existing native
bank/recovery constructor is entered; its source owners then move unchanged to
the prepared payload. Inkling's source construction likewise returns its actual
architecture, optional source, capability and identities before invoking the
typed continuation. Both boundaries charge their concrete argument/result
destinations through the same construction funding before entry. They add no
heap indirection or native authority, and preserve the existing success, failure,
completion and host-capture delivery workers. This keeps completed construction
temporaries off deeper quote stacks without changing the thread stack limit.


Paged publication preparation consumes the same checked append-step iterator as ordinary native and metadata execution. The retained source keeps the architecture-derived batch/head/width geometry even for an empty cache; actual generation records produce exact physical manager/layer/rank block IDs, sealed intervals and prefix status. F32 publication metadata is paid before role execution and revalidated against the actual native arrays; descriptive workspace Float32 alone does not authorize another native dtype. Metadata and physical arrays retire before the record's host account, including a record escaping failed publication. The same ordinary record constructor is reused. The exact append consumer below spends these programs. The scan consumer below uses the same publication identity; original paged
request gates still require the remaining saved-state consumers.


Original paged append now checks out the one-use publication program from the
actual accepted model-role source bank. The current-scope lookup is weak and
compares the exact native observer; it cannot construct a source or execution
grant. The source RefCell loan ends before the same ordinary append traversal
runs native Slice/Concat callbacks. Every sliced and joined key/value root enters
the existing model completion owner immediately, including identity joins, before
a later fallible operation can release it. An unexpected append-to-root failure
keeps the actual array in the same Q-owned source program; it drops before source
pins and host custody. No additional completion owner is introduced.

The manager accepts only the next exact tail size/frontier and sealed block ID
of that program. Actual F32 arrays settle through the shared nested-completion
worker before the same canonical logical/physical insertion routine publishes
them. This first consumer requires current device backing and no sliding-window
removal; tier promotion and window removal remain explicit missing producers.
Its budget check uses the same actual local/process-pool comparison as ordinary
rebalance. Over-budget candidates restore the prior tail/report or remove the
new record; arrays retire after the mutex is released. A failed append removes
only its exact committed program IDs, restores the saved local tail/frontier,
and preserves both primary and rollback errors without refunding the role. The
source bank fences reuse on failure or unwind. Existing final model completion
also checks that every append of the exact current occurrence has completed.

The cold source inventory pays native callback/claim frames, exact manager
publication/report frames, and the single bounded abort path before admission.
The shared metadata append records the same two extra publication handles kept
by native sealing for rollback. Canonical report/table storage remains the
existing installed manager's responsibility. This implements the append/seal
consumer, not a claim of completed original paged inference. The scan consumer
below builds on its exact publications; manager promotion and copy/resume/reset
still need their real consumers before the public gate can open.


Original paged scanning now consumes the same accepted source/occurrence as its
completed append. The finite inventory contains exact initial canonical block
IDs plus the actual preceding/current publication IDs. Each source pair has two
paid final handle slots; preparation itself creates no descriptor or source.
The exact manager/generation/scope loan binds completed Device F32 block arrays,
and the actual append callback fills the final lazy partial-tail pair directly.
No pending tail is relabelled as an already-completed model source.

The canonical block pin and per-pass demand lease reuse the existing lifecycle
acquire/release and device-hit telemetry. A pin alone exposes no native value or
execution authority. The private scan claim supplies the actual immutable arrays
to the existing PagedScanPlan and BlockwiseAttentionAccumulator; only that closed
source can select the original causal/Fused branch. Actual options preserve
InputScores' second pass, score caps, masks and sinks. Relative-bias construction,
window removal and host/disk promotion remain explicit missing producers.

Source aliases are filled once per occurrence and reused across its actual
passes. The active lease and accumulator stay in the existing Q-owned source
program on error. A lease releases only after the shared recurrence has completed;
borrowed finalization retains the accumulator until the final output settles.
That output enters the existing transient model-root union before completion or
reporting can fail. Partial native handle fills retain their canonical pins, and
all arrays retire before source pins and host funding. Failure fences occurrence
reuse without refunding admission or telemetry.

Cold construction pays the exact source rows, native clone handles, iterator and
callback controls, one reusable active lease slot, and the manager's actual
source/report workers. The ordinary readout shares the same borrowed output
equation, canonical acquisition receipt and report update; no second attention
engine, map, ledger or completion owner is introduced. The focused source test
checks nonzero canonical backing, foreign-ID refusal, demand telemetry and an
escaped final lease retaining H. It does not claim public managed paged parity;
request gates remain closed until the remaining concrete consumers are joined.


Captured speculative sequence views preserve both feature and stream axes.
The neutral numerical program admits rank-three and rank-four capture range and
concatenation geometry, while probability programs retain their rank-two/rank-three
contract. The MLX metadata and native slices preserve all trailing axes and account
for the actual four-index transport. Right-hand concatenation validates every
trailing extent, so stream geometry cannot be silently flattened or substituted.

Bounded chat assignment uses the ordinary shared VM's StoreLocal and UnpackList
instructions. The packed compiler derives root and loop-local capacity from the
actual assignment targets in the source, including both conditional branches;
there is no fixed local ceiling or growing environment map during rendering.
Top-level variables persist through the render, conditional assignments share
the enclosing scope, and each successful loop advance clears only that loop's
locals through the same iteration boundary as the ordinary Context. Assignments
retain borrowed scalar/sequence/mapping/text inputs in the already paid reference
slots; generated text stays in the measured output workspace. Flat unpacking
requires the actual input arity. Namespace mutation, nested targets, captured
set blocks, macros and general serialization remain separately unsupported by
this bounded profile; scoped set support alone does not qualify a full released
template using those constructs.


The shared paged append trace records each actual sliced pair and joined candidate pair as transient completion roots. ValueRetention creates no tensor storage or numerical work and performs no completion; its exact input count extends the existing native recipe root union and therefore the same original PrefillRoots capacity. The native consumer receives only a weak append-only view from its authenticated model root owner. This keeps disconnected/error-path candidate roots under the existing Q, without a second completion carrier or a source-descriptor grant.


Prediction equation admission accepts both ordinary hidden sequences and sequences
with a retained stream axis. It checks exact invocation positions, positive trailing
extents, common workspace identity and floating representation before dispatch.
Family equations retain responsibility for their concrete width/stream geometry;
the quote does not flatten or reshape the actual input to satisfy admission.


Encoded checkpoint recipes may project admitted full-source ranges into reordered
final destinations for byte-aligned joins and bounded row selections. The neutral
checkpoint compiler reuses the existing selection-range worker, including packed
alignment checks; file identity and per-read validation remain with the same
admitted batch. It creates no payload staging or native equation. Detached source
construction and read scratch count the actual projected spans, including repeated
selected rows, while output allocations use the exact inferred destination size.
Source tensor metadata continues to describe the original complete encodings and
is not substituted for the selected physical byte count. Scalar conversion and
nontrivial transpose remain outside this encoded-byte path; selected destination
shape, dtype and companion validation still precede native residency admission.


The external assistant materializer retains its actual typed checkpoint handoff,
source configuration, selected tasks, exact bindings, and populated native values.
These existing construction values are moved into the assistant owner; later
managed projection need not reopen the artifact or synthesize a second module
source. This retention alone grants no original-memory fit or execution role.
The same funded drafter recovery guard can lend either a selected independent
model or the architecture-typed external assistant, preserving poisoned-state,
unresolved-work, and payload retirement behavior. External equation admission,
source-aware target captures, numerical values, and same/split-device transfer
must still be connected before the managed external entry can be opened.


#### Accepted communication completion after source fencing

A successful completed-operation constructor can now mint a private accepted
source that owns its actual output graph, exact original observer and traversal,
borrowed execution stream, and source/H custody. No raw array, matching scalar
geometry, or shared latest-source slot can create this handoff. New constructors
still check the retained source's current availability; terminal fencing remains
monotone.

The accepted source enters the same `ReadyCompletionResources` submission body
as the fresh-source path. The destination checks exact source and traversal, then
the shared native worker checks the current original Scope and actual stream.
It does not reclassify an already constructed graph as a new source submission.
Event failure, pending work and retirement use the existing recovery/quarantine;
the original scope/lease and nonrefundable accounts remain unchanged.

The explicit two-rank backend test
`accepted_ring_operation_completes_after_source_fence_and_retires_custody` reuses
the existing local Ring subprocess harness. It quotes actual native capacities,
constructs a noncontiguous F32 reduction, fences the communicator, observes new
source refusal, drops the original source owners, and submits/completes the exact
accepted output against an ordinary numerical oracle. Its final assertion checks
that both accepted completion and escaped refusal release their H custody.

The bounded chat message view now lends each original JSON object to the same
structured operand worker used by other caller bindings. Reasoning fields, tool
calls, missing/null content and structured media content remain exact immutable
caller values; message selection creates no merged map or copied payload. Typed
role/content inputs keep their compact representation. Existing source-derived
operand, local and iterator borrow registers bound these temporary loans and
clear them before returned render/error storage can escape. This supplies input
representation parity; macro and namespace language support remain separate.


A selected external-assistant visitor now borrows the original realization and
architecture capture declaration beside its typed materialized assistant. This
loan is made by the neutral construction owner and ends with the visitor; native
request setup does not clone or re-pair the selection. Its fixed transport query
is paid by the same funded drafter guard before the callback. This is a source
handoff, not an invocation grant or a replacement speculative driver.

Prediction completion quotation now selects the synchronous nested-root mechanism
explicitly. It accepts its fully qualified CPU/GPU equation because the actual
worker retains the native host bank until every callback completes. The existing
mixed-stream graph and record populations still account for every frontier;
there is no early-retirement credit or bound bypass. Asynchronous neural groups
retain the single-GPU/no-CPU requirement, and a prediction boundary cannot supply
asynchronous consumer waits or match an asynchronous group's source plan.

Selected original rank collectives now consume the same allocation-free group membership,
operation, dtype, and tensor-limit checks used by the ordinary partition driver.
The actual native input and exact retained group order then supply the existing
CPU constructor/Eval/Ring worker/backing/completion quotation and one-use accepted
handoff. Sum and axis-zero equal gather preserve the actual selected equation;
output metadata is checked before event submission. This layer is a concrete rank
consumer, not a model-session admission grant: the model's current Stream-only
collective context still requires a typed source-bearing binding and exact input
completion ownership. Logical subgroup/world-wave packing, routing, and unpacking
remain explicitly unqualified until their ordinary producers are included. No
logical group is replaced with an unqualified full-world native operation.

Synchronous routed prediction also composes completed host-copy descriptors with
its actual CPU/GPU equation. Copy and aggregate workers remain separately priced
single-GPU producers. The later equation keeps its exact dispatch population and
recomputes the expanded array/rank frontier with the shared router worker query,
including its control storage and kernel attempts. Asynchronous consumers retain
their previous stream restriction. Parameter sources and physical bytes are
unchanged; the extra descriptors receive no early-retirement credit.

The prediction module-bank caller now uses that same synchronous nested-root
worker before retiring its actual unit lease. Previously it submitted the graph
asynchronously and immediately waited, despite quotation selecting synchronous
mixed-stream completion. The source-owned callback borrows the retained unit
and observer; its failure keeps the existing recovery node armed. Success still
uses common terminal observation, transfer settlement and unlocked payload/pin
retirement. No extra event, completion owner or inference engine is introduced.

The managed speculative facade retires original tokenizer, semantic and lane
preparation temporaries before entering the shared ordinary or controlled driver.
The returned batch and its fallible transfer destination are charged to the same
retained host source; backend workspace construction no longer runs beneath the
completed host-preparation frame. This changes neither the selected strategy nor
the request, cancellation, output, state or native completion protocols.

The neutral speculative request table publishes terminal and successfully
prefilled requests through one existing paid destination. First-token RNG
progress and lifecycle/accounting updates are retained before that handoff;
cancelled or failed prefill keeps its existing coordinated rollback. Removing
the duplicate by-value request construction also reduces the active frame
beneath architecture workspace construction without changing state ownership.


The external assistant operation boundary keeps the selected family equation in
`eredu-architectures`. Its typed operation lends the real current arguments to a
backend phase and runs the same ordinary worker for native execution and cold
tracing. Gemma's sequential proposal uses this boundary, including its actual
hidden-state mutation and shared target K/V. Cold projection builds a finite,
source-sized vector of those K/V entries through the participating metadata
context; the attention worker accepts the same borrowed store interface used by
its ordinary map. It does not create a second unpriced hash table.

The assistant module constructor borrows the retained selected configuration and

The external assistant request retains its actual selected architecture contract

The complete semantic capture stays in the outer completion union while the ordinary inner target completion retains state and scores. state never owns or rewinds the control cursor.

The original paged saved-resume installer binds the source bank only after the
shared prompt copier has completed, exchanged and published its independent
manager. The saved-source inventory remains in its original copy account. The
installer uses the retained cumulative workspace metadata account and the same
complete native collector to compare actual destination page intervals, physical
layer/rank roles, shapes and manager sharing, and checks disjoint native backing
identities. Temporary array witnesses retire before the destination pins. The
existing catalog constructor consumes the exact resumed recipe; its role bank
still requires the accepted request and original scope. This private handoff does
not authorize host/disk promotion or change the original public paged gate.


### Explicit original parallel-control occurrence binding

The native request control owner retains the shared session's monotonic cursor
outside saved model state. A source can create that owner once. Each actual
failure-agreement event consumes one claim before source inspection or native
preparation, then derives its capacity from both immutable status leaves through
the existing communication operation compiler. This is one branch union for one
vote; it grants no capacity for guessed future phases.

An already admitted request control role lends its observer and stream to a
one-use temporary Group. The shared partition agreement callback verifies the
actual event, selected communicator, source account and stream, then the existing
failure-agreement method consumes that binding. Accepted submission and scalar
resolution use the same ReadyCompletionResources and BoolResult worker as the
ordinary completion path. Group clones hold only weak occurrence loans plus paid
metadata custody. Closing construction on error or unwind never closes the native
observer or releases Q; the enclosing recovery retains native sources until
independent completion or quarantine.

This binding does not manufacture a native scope or relabel model-forward
allowances. The early-phase request control-role accounting/installation and
shared policy selection remain explicit joins before public admission can open.
Barrier-only local phases must not issue a fictitious agreement claim.

The partition strategy consumes a prepared control resource by explicit borrow
through the existing phase agreement, poisoned-session recovery agreement, and
final commit workers. The communication manifest and table remain the selected
owners; no replacement table or implicit current-resource slot is installed.
The backend validates the request's event/context/funding before lending a
resource, and unavailable prepared binding is a typed failure before ordinary
submission. The same workers retain completion deadlines, poison authority and
decision semantics. Barrier-only phase policy performs no synthetic collective.

The fused external assistant now lends its actual raw and encoded context through
three typed operations: raw assembly, committed-context update, and fused proposal.
Each operation runs the same family worker during cold quotation and native
execution. The native invocation supplies the quote's metadata destination for
context containers, mask payloads and failure controls; this destination grants no
native allocation authority. Committed encoded K/V is frozen in the existing shared
value owner with its exact completed source. Verification inputs and projected
logits retain source-aware tensor packets, and controlled copies use the existing
isolated copy worker plus current-root receipts. Ordinary mechanism defaults keep
the same equations and delivery semantics. Split-device transport remains a
separate required integration, not an architectural exemption.

The explicit `MlxBackendFactory::with_state_residency` owner forwards its actual
portable cache policy into the same target inspection/selection and prepared
stream realization; default factory copy semantics and drafting workers remain
shared. Original plain text admission now selects the completed F32 paged
KeyValue/NoState, full-attention, Device-page worker. Host transfer, live-disk,
process-sampling, relative/sliding and mixed-state copy producers remain outside
this selected scope. Actual source catalogs independently check native tail/page
representation before preparing accepted invocation programs. Saved resume uses
the copied-manager source bank after settled publication, never the saved
manager's authority. Public behavior still requires the focused end-to-end
validation; availability of a primitive alone is not recorded as passed support.


### Original parallel control scopes and the selected native partition

Each reached control occurrence uses the existing PreparedRecovery scope and
accepted request-wide OriginalNativeStorageBank. The native source's actual
status program contributes its backing peak to the cold selected native storage
plan beside all retained model roots. Controls borrow that exact installed budget
through OriginalTextControlGuard; a byte count or model-forward scope cannot
replace it. Graph/Record arenas, the failure carrier, recovery and housekeeping
nodes are paid on the retained source account before their corresponding native
construction. Their native callbacks retain accounting-only custody.

The shared partition policy remains responsible for bounded waiting and result
resolution. The native control scope verifies terminal state, retires its own
completed records, and finishes the same Recovery before releasing Q. Failure
keeps accepted work under the existing quarantine and fences the request control
owner; it neither returns an occurrence nor invents released physical capacity.
This role implementation still requires its lexical session installation before
the managed distributed admission guards may be opened.

The original prefill-input loan accepts either the retained Embedded or External
model schedule after validating the same numerical environment and the actual
completed B source's request identity. It still refuses anonymous contexts, a
second outstanding prefill loan and an active Embedded numerical invocation.
Schedule selection grants no input source or completion authority.

Original registered/saved paged copies now retain each actual F32, F16 or BF16
source declaration through the common publication-metadata worker. Its shared
control query prices the actual dtype-name buffers and scalar widths, including
two-byte block occupancy; page and local-tail copies continue through the same
source-qualified isolated-copy worker without conversion. This closes the copy
representation producer, not the remaining first-append dtype binding or
Host/disk promotion. Paged request eligibility stays scoped until those actual
consumers are connected; quantized checkpoint format is independent of KV dtype.

Gemma external prefill lends hidden rows and selected scores to the same
source-aware observation hook as captured K/V. This preserves the actual
completed source through the receiver; the original native adapter must qualify
any active tensor observer before invoking it. Empty observation uses the
existing paid descriptor alias, and ordinary observation keeps its callback.


### Lexical native installation of original parallel control

The accepted TextExecutionQuote owns the exact request control cursor, source,
controls and installed native storage bank. Each actual text submission creates a
paid activation and lends its projection through the native session mechanism.
The shared session calls that mechanism only when its selected policy declares an
actual control collective. Replicated and composite adapters use the same generic
mechanism; no model-family branch or second scheduler is introduced.

Callback exit closes the activation independently of completion or quarantine.
The source owner can remain alive for later controlled steps without making an
old projection usable by an unrelated operation. Ordinary entries clear the
installation. An installation failure closes its provisional local guard before
returning, while already accepted native work retains its own recovery owners.
A conflicting slot borrow refuses before borrowing any original source using the
existing fixed request-Busy diagnostic; all source-owned phase failures keep their
paid original causes. The remaining distributed source/idle/transport gates are
unchanged until those concrete producers are qualified.

Internal partition-wave agreements borrow the same explicitly installed model
parallel Group context. Its separate weak request-control projection is matched
to the exact immutable model source and funding before the executor loan. Every
reached agreement uses the same monotonic request cursor and source-funded native
role worker as outer phase/commit agreement. No wave count, latest-group lookup,
or ordinary submission fallback is inferred. Group copies retain only account
custody and the submission activation; closing activation prevents later use
without retiring accepted model/control completion owners.

Pipeline-only request control has a distinct native source owning the actual
initialized agreement communicator table and completed immutable status inputs.
It neither selects nor fabricates an AllReduce/model tensor source. A private
closed Model/Control carrier feeds the same control cursor, native admission,
submission and recovery worker. The separate request context loans a paid
agreement Group to the partition runtime without turning on an optional neural
tensor-parallel context. Logical subgroup equations and point-to-point transport
still require their own exact source producers before public admission.

The original external entry consumes both sealed architecture invocation shapes:
sequential assistant steps and fused raw/update/proposal operations. Their actual
retained schedule supplies occurrence populations; every reached operation still
requires its own exact input inventory, recipe, model role and terminal native
completion. The old sequential-only entry refusal is removed after joining the
fused consumers. Split placement and unqualified tensor observers remain separate
explicit refusals. Cold recurrence validation is not a native Muse execution claim.

The original paged append source prepays a finite floating metadata destination
for each actual sealed page. It measures the shared dtype formatter and retains
its shape/text buffers under construction funding; only the actual source-bound
F32/F16/BF16 output pair can produce a publishable record. Empty geometry and the
conservative Float32 workspace extent class do not select a native dtype. The
shared append worker now validates native tail occupancy from the actual prior
and produced arrays, including concatenation promotion, and retains the same
canonical begin/seal/rollback and completion order. This producer does not widen
public paged admission: half-precision scan recipe/source qualification and
Host/disk promotion remain separate implementation joins.

The original paged scan source accepts the actual finite native F32/F16/BF16
pair and keeps the query output dtype separately from workspace byte geometry.
The unchanged accumulator casts Q/K/V to F32, applies its existing selected
score/probability rounding, and casts the final output back to the query dtype;
the source validates that exact dtype and shape before delivery. Boolean or
floating masks and floating learned sinks retain their original semantics.
The admitted two-/four-byte state class is therefore only an early eligibility
check; actual retained pages, produced tails, sealed metadata, and scan outputs
still supply precise native dtype witnesses. Quantized model weights introduce
no cache-format branch. This expands the implemented Device/full-attention
floating path; native public half-precision validation remains pending. Host/
disk promotion, sliding/discard, and other state profiles remain unfinished
producer joins rather than architectural exclusions.

Internal pipeline execution, source-completion and source-readiness agreements
borrow the executor's actual current context and its explicitly attached request
control funding. They use the same prepared group callback and agreement worker
as the outer session lifecycle. Source reconstruction from ranks, default groups
and an implicit current native request is not permitted. Optional tensor-parallel
contexts keep their architectural None/Some meaning during reversible exchange;
a pure pipeline execution still needs a separately admitted control context.

The partition runtime has a separate, scoped optional request-control context.
The shared session lends it around the existing model-context/forward callback
and restores it with the same unwind-safe exchange worker. Inner pipeline votes
prefer this explicit slot; the architecture's neural parallel context is
unchanged. This permits pure pipeline control ownership without selecting tensor
parallel equations. The native source, actual request admission and transport
must still be bound before that entry path is qualified.

Retained text equation inspection validates the actual projected state against
selected component placement instead of rejecting every paged policy before
tracing. The neutral validator compares the complete layout, metadata context,
actual paged member (including a pooling local member), block size and discard
retention with the retained selection. It does not manufacture a paged state
from a device state. The existing native complete collector supplies the state,
all backing identities and pinned managers; original request planning keeps
that owner through the same paged append/scan recipe and source bank. Native
promotion and execution authority remain independent of this descriptive check.

Gemma external-target prefill retains the actual normalized model configuration
through the existing closed `SharedCompositeConfig` owner. Each paid admission
aliases that owner and validates the actual prepared tensor identity with the
same token/projected-embedding policy as ordinary admission; no schedule or
format map is deep-cloned by the span constructor. Cold target quotation uses
that same counted admission hook. Raw image/audio ingress still requires its
separate host-read and ingress-source producers and is not admitted by this
text-prefill join.

Completed numerical outputs own a stream wrapper funded by their current
invocation. Reusing an input's stream wrapper can accidentally retain the entire
input invocation after independent result storage completes. Stream identity
validation still precedes construction; array views separately retain the actual
backing and graph custody they need. Native completion and deferred destruction,
not the creation of a new wrapper, determine when those source owners retire.

Actual retained Ring scratch participates in the existing native payload
inventory. The native communicator implementation mints a checked monotonic
identity during ordinary initialization; wrapper and logical aliases preserve
it without a pointer-reuse key or global owner registry. The sealed safe source
retains that implementation and its actual fixed communication-buffer capacity.
Initial setup captures the source; cold original/snapshot inventories borrow
that descriptor and use their existing counted destinations. Missing persistent
census coverage stays unknown. Physical publication registers each buffer once
and retains its native owner before releasing its registration. No tensor shape
or mutable scratch access is exposed, and no completion is inferred from source
inspection. Distributed public guards remain until operation/source/control and
transport obligations for the actual selected path are all connected.

Gemma's initial completed composite construction now retains its exact effective
configuration, parameter graph, state layout, group transports, and cache
fingerprint. The existing source handoff publishes those immutable declarations
only after successful contract preparation. Cold external-target quotation
borrows them through the same metadata-aware architecture contracts; it does
not rebuild format maps or reinterpret a native source from equal geometry.
The serial text static factory uses the shared paid module destinations, and
unit range validation no longer allocates a discarded path. Configured media
static constructors still refuse checked reconstruction until their own native
source/metadata join is supplied; ordinary media execution remains unchanged.


Speculative target and prediction quotation receives the caller's exact phase
metadata funding explicitly, including the shared current-target projection and
external target quote. Contexts and successful quote parts retain this account
through the existing source binding and native role consumers. A fixed borrowed diagnostic source and the existing
fallible quote/bank/consumption boundaries retain construction or execution
failures with that same phase account, using the existing planning-error owner.
They add no enclosing generic execution callback or extra model-result frame. Request-wide source metadata and cumulative
occurrence/copy/capture counters keep their existing owners and semantics; this
change does not assert that an entire speculative replay fits its budget.

Original distributed communicator buffer retention uses the actual initialized
Ring buffer identity and capacity already present in the retained storage
inventory. Before an owned communication table becomes a model or control
source, its complete nonzero buffer population enters the existing-only pin
worker. Missing registrations or contradictory capacities refuse before source
construction. A paid payload-free host authority carries that pin on aliases of
the same neutral communication source, preserving its original identity. Native
outputs and retained failures therefore keep the pin after table/source owners
retire; the source does not own native work or create a completion backedge.
Only the closed matching table proof excludes those exact scratch bytes from
the native persistent host census. Standalone bindings still pay the full
census, and all other native control, transport, subgroup, and completion
obligations remain independently required.


Resident native recipe assembly accepts zero output storage only for the shared
nonempty-input `ValueRetention` and `ValueCompletion` operations, whose exact
fact/trace output populations must still agree. These operations retain the
existing root union and nested completion census; they do not synthesize an
output tensor or gain numerical allocation permission. This connects paged
append/seal/scan traces to the same final recipe assembler.


The paged host-promotion source owns the actual canonical host buffer pair,
manager generation and block pin. A fixed no-housekeeping native descriptor
uses the existing host shape getter without allocating a shape vector; its
facts carry no source or submission authority. The paid destination holds both
output arrays, completion events and publication aliases before a native call.
