Only the existing active paged scan proof can invoke the same original host
copy worker. It revalidates the exact source, admits Device and transfer
occupancy, completes both transfers, and uses the shared canonical
`promote_host`/`restore_host` transition and promotion telemetry.

Replacement publication transfers removed Host occupancy into the same pool
reservation while moving the admitted Device occupancy to the actual manager.
Both backings remain charged until their corresponding owners retire, including
failed copy/publication prefixes; no new pool or byte-equivalent identity is
introduced. Arrays/events retire before host buffers, pins, reservation and
metadata funding. Cold host-page source projection, native recipe/scan-row
selection and outer completion integration still need to select this producer;
this source unit does not enable the original public Host or disk pager gate.

Original text readiness consensus has an explicit backend-associated source
separate from the later model preparation. The shared startup asks for it from
the genuine sequence claim before model admission, retains it through failed
admission and native prompt/sampler construction, then moves it into the same
ordinary/controlled machine. Prediction, decision, commitment, instrumentation
and facade delivery lend that same source through the backend agreement hook.
Detached branches clone only the backend source owner; saved resume requests
prepare a fresh source through the current runtime. The backend authenticates
the actual loaded session/table and owns all native stage admission, completion,
quarantine and nonrefunding protocol usage. Source-construction failure cannot
fall back to ordinary transport. A runtime that requires explicit original
transport refuses its absence, including before model admission. Default
non-distributed implementations keep their existing local agreement behavior.


Complete native projection can retain immutable Host witnesses and completed
Array witnesses in the same sorted physical-identity table. Repeated imports
share one portable storage root; if a real allocation is reached through both
native forms, the row retains both witnesses and counts its capacity once.
Host imports use the fixed no-housekeeping descriptor and paid metadata
constructors. They create no Array and grant no transfer or equation execution;
a paged Host block still requires its explicit source-bound promotion operation.


Paged append and scan authenticate each accepted prefill/decode role through its
existing original model completion owner. The closed weak root projection checks
the prepared graph observer, current scope, and retained failure before the pager
can consume its exact request occurrence. A sequential resident model may have
zero unit-boundary submissions and therefore no parameter-operation registry.
That absence does not create another scope: the model owner remains authoritative.
Where a unit registry exists, its request and active observer must agree with the
same model owner; an expired or retired registry still refuses. Root, native
control, catalog and request custody retain their existing completion boundaries.

The phase diagnostic loan prepays the existing exact backend-error and
role-admission-error constructors before quotation. The one-use receipts own
funding, contain no model callback or result payload, and use the same typed
planning-failure owner. A role budget refusal consumes its receipt without
another debit. Source-chain checks recognize only that exact owner/account,
preventing duplicate wrapping of the same phase failure; a distinct additional
error still requires its own admission.


Original text preparation consensus uses the existing bounded coordinator and
rank-frame validator. Its transport may lend a completed word destination to the
validator, keeping native source and paid host custody alive for the whole loan;
the ordinary transport retains its Vec-based adapter. Native signed and unsigned
word readout share one destination and completed-result worker. An accepted
collective can consume a destination priced from its retained constructor's exact
output dtype and population before submission, without re-querying availability
after work was accepted. This does not authorize a model invocation or remove any
unqualified distributed execution gate.


The original preparation frame producer borrows the actual fixed U32 readiness
frame from the shared coordinator. It shares the existing initialized-leaf worker
with status agreements, preserving failed-prefix source/arena/custody order. The
world gather is quoted from that completed leaf and actual retained control world;
constructor, CPU evaluation, backing, worker, event, and unsigned host destination
remain separate exact sources. No guessed frame capacity or model tensor grant
enters this source-only producer.


Gemma's counted text/projected-embedding ingress consumes the exact metadata
loan already carried by PreparedCompositeInput. Its ordinary decoder-part,
embedding, and ordered-input workers use counted destinations under that loan;
the returned ingress and forward owners retain the same context after all
host containers and tensor handles. The shared runtime receives the existing
LayeredForwardMetadata loan and a direct retained-root visitor, avoiding an
unpriced owning retention iterator. Typed escaped construction errors retain
the same funding through the existing neutral paid source producer.

Pass-local shared K/V still uses the same SharedAttentionStore publication
contract. Ordinary forwards retain their existing HashMap. A counted forward
prepares exactly the distinct publisher policies from the actual normalized
Gemma schedule, with one mutable optional pair per declared policy. Publication
replaces an existing pair without growing the destination; unknown policies
refuse. Capture visits only actual populated pairs. This qualifies the existing
single-placement text ingress/forward owner; raw media ingress and distributed
forward construction keep their separate unjoined metadata producers and are
not inferred from a successful text quote.


Paged cold scan state distinguishes retained host blocks from device arrays.
The first selected visit records the existing immutable-host copy worker for
both actual floating representations and retains both independent outputs in
the enclosing model root union. Later passes and invocations use those promoted
values. A later attention failure retains completed promotion state and spent
trace work. Host-to-device facts use the native original-copy layout, including
its direct output shell and nested completion; they do not grant source access.
The native scan must still consume the exact prepared promotion owner and keep
its submitted prefix and original host accounting through retirement. Host
saved-state copying remains unqualified until that separate consumer is joined.


The complete paged collector now imports stable Host rows from their real
immutable buffer handles, in the same cross-layer allocation identity table as
Array rows. Its source owns finite prepared promotion slots before any native
role begins; a later projection failure retains those slots outside the manager
loan. First selected scan access checks out the matching original source slot,
uses the existing copy-to-array worker, retains every submitted output in the
actual Model completion union, then commits the existing manager Host-to-Device
transition. A later pass or invocation binds the same canonical promoted page.
Native arrays/events retire before host pins and transfer occupancy. Appends
may preserve such authenticated current-layer Host rows, while foreign or
unprepared current-layer rows remain a typed refusal. Disk sources, eviction
selection/demotion, and public Host policy admission remain separate required
consumers; this join does not relax those gates.


The Gemma composite constructor returns its actual constructed model/source and
identities before invoking the shared prepared visitor. Initial declaration
construction and retained-source construction occupy separate cold frames;
neither reconstructs the selected source during quotation. V4/DSpark retained
prediction construction selects its concrete unit constructor before reserving
that branch's module temporaries, then uses the same expert-bank binding worker.
All added source/result loans are charged through the existing metadata context.
This reduces simultaneous constructor stack storage without moving model-family
selection into the backend or increasing native thread stacks.

Prepaid phase diagnostics prepare with the fixed `WorkspaceMetadataFundingError`
return type that their constructor can actually produce. The concrete native
error and request-admission error owners remain separately prepaid and are built
only on a real failure. Phase quote funding, native role/source ownership, and
nonrefunding request counters retain their existing lifetimes.


Readiness-frame native storage has its own source-bound preparation admission.
It reuses the cold source ledger and raw account handoff, while keeping a distinct
communication custody type: neither prepared-input B nor a later model request
can stand in for it. Each actual immutable frame/submitted gather is priced by
its retained native producer before native storage is created. Returned output,
failed prefixes, native aliases and quarantine retain this independent account;
the existing readiness coordinator alone owns protocol attempts and decisions.
Host workspace planning remains a separate allocation hold and grants no native
backing or submission authority.


Original direct tensor-parallel text readiness now carries an explicit backend
source from the shared original request preparation into automatic and controlled
advancement. Each fixed prepare/confirm frame uses independent native storage
admission, then the existing accepted world Gather and completion/Recovery. The
same coordinator owns attempts, confirmation, peer validation and poison state;
completed host words remain borrowed under paid source custody. Startup has no
model-grant dependency and host planning is not promoted to native permission.

The old blanket distributed text refusal is replaced only by the retained
session/world/selection tuple and the existing exact direct-parallel recipe
compiler. Prefill control facts require that recipe's actual parallel source.
This does not admit logical-subgroup, pipeline transport, arbitrary collective,
internal capture or completed-media paths whose remaining producer is unknown.
All ordinary APIs retain their previous readiness and numerical workers.

The low-level native `prepared_distributed_backend` entry retains those same
backend-owned prepared execution/source streams alongside the caller's actual
world. It uses the existing stream factory and retains its typed failure; it
never adopts ordinary stream aliases or treats topology as native authority.
The public `LoadedModel::load` path consumes this backend with the same neutral
parallel load request and ordinary model construction driver.


The original paged Host store uses an exclusive destination created by the
existing `PreparedHostTransferPlan`, with its actual page-rounded backing and
source-arena controls paid before construction. The ordinary and original
GPU-to-Host paths share `copy_to_host_into` and `CopyToHostTransfer`; the latter
reuses the prepared buffer and returns a root for the enclosing Model completion.
The Rust destination permits one attempt and publishes immutable Host storage
only after that attempt's completion succeeds. Failed prefixes retain the output,
event and source owner in that order. This producer alone does not admit Host
paging: exact eviction selection, role-bound manager publication and the complete
cold transfer trace remain required before the public Host gate can change.

The Gemma layered unit dispatcher selects the actual vision, audio or text group
before entering its concrete constructor frame. Each child preserves the existing
family module worker and exact metadata destination; a text quote therefore does
not retain construction temporaries for the two unselected media groups. Sparse
router and expert preparation likewise returns before dense attention/MLP module
construction. This separates host construction lifetimes without changing layer
order, parameter binding, residency selection or native admission.


Paged cache source pins now retain immutable logical identity separately from
active Device-demand leases. Both prevent removal, content replacement and
reset. The prepared tier mover may exclude only active demand after validating its
exact source-pin ownership and retained replacement occupancy; ordinary eviction
continues to exclude every source pin. Both use the same borrowed eviction worker,
including exact LRU/LFU ties, prefix and recent protection. Host/backing removal
continues to exclude all source owners. A completed Host publication uses the
shared physical transition and returns its actual Device owner for rollback or
retirement; no synthetic asynchronous ticket supplies completion authority.
Prepared scan aliases and demand/source pins retire at their enclosing observed
Model completion while their spent program metadata remains cumulative. This
keeps earlier role payloads from being retained by future request slots.

Embedded target prefill, verification and the shared captured-prefill lifecycle
prepare their concrete session-error conversion before exchanging mutable target
state or starting fallible work. The native adapter debits the existing typed
shared error owner and conversion controls at that point; failure consumes the
move-only receipt without another metadata request. The callback owns no model,
success result or execution authority. Ordinary implementations retain their
existing conversion policy. Other compatibility validation hooks remain separate
from this operation transport; the receipt grants no admission or completion.

The admitted chat renderer lowers keyword `namespace(...)` creation and attribute
assignment through MiniJinja's shared VM dispatcher. Its ordinary adapter still
calls the existing built-in/object implementation. The closed storage adapter
uses source-sized identity/field destinations and dedicated borrowed registers;
loop-local cleanup preserves outer mutable namespace aliases, and new instances
cannot reuse a slot with a live stack/local alias. These are rendering storage,
not backend or accounting policy. Exact released DeepSeek V3 system-scan syntax,
Unicode accumulation, fresh loop aliases and failed destination custody have
focused ordinary-parity fixtures. Positional/splatted namespace initialization,
namespace objects stored inside namespace fields, arbitrary callbacks, macros
and generated container producers remain typed implementation boundaries; none
is described as an architectural model limitation.

External Gemma and Muse scheduler adapters forward the exact retained host row
buffer through their neutral mechanism hooks to the existing native coordination
worker. The buffer keeps its original owner through request selection and any
configured partition agreement. Legacy mechanism defaults still reject retained
buffers unless explicitly implemented; this handoff adds no tensor, transport or
split-placement admission.


The replicated and composite idle/snapshot inventories include an actual
partition sampling group's retained native setup-buffer source. They deduplicate
it with the enclosing communicator inventory by physical source identity. A
missing buffer or attached model/control invocation remains incomplete. The
neutral communication authority is fixed control metadata (selected completion
policy, terminal bit, and poison record), without tensor payload or arbitrary
callbacks; its presence alone no longer prevents initial loading authority from
retiring. Unknown prediction observers retain their independent inventory gate.
This publication join does not authorize distributed execution or copy: each
later operation still consumes its selected source, admission, and completion.


The prepared paged Host-store consumer uses the existing
`OriginalHostSourceBank::begin/finish` transaction. Its native constructor places
the accepted `OriginalHostSourceReceipt` in the final destination arena before
allocation. Only the actual completed `CopyToHostTransfer` destination can enter
immutable source publication; its native allocation receives the existing
`NativeStorageRegistration`, so later source inspection can recognize that exact
Host backing. Metadata funding alone is not storage or submission authority.

The selected original scan moves a store into its actual row before native
submission, authenticates the current model/source account, canonical generation,
physical allocation identities and complete owned source-pin count, and extends
the existing Model completion roots after each actual copy. Active demand or a
foreign canonical source pin refuses mutation. The shared completed demotion and
pool replacement workers commit the Host row only after both copies complete;
failed publication restores the same Device owner. Replaced Device backing and
its pool token currently remain together through source-bank teardown, including
failed or escaped owners; observing completion alone does not refund them.

This consumer is not yet the original Host paging admission boundary. The cold
shared eviction itinerary, its accepted source-bank population, Host-store
workspace effect, repeated promotion of newly stored pages and exact retired
Device attachment must be joined before that gate can open. Existing Device-only
public admission remains unchanged, and no Host execution parity is claimed by
this component.

Speculative verification retains a prepared host diagnostic destination from
before submission through completion and checkpoint restoration. If both the
operation and restoration fail, the shared driver retains both concrete causes,
with the original operation as the primary source, instead of replacing it with
the cleanup refusal. Embedded prefill and commit use the same two-cause contract
and the existing native prepared diagnostic worker. Error conversion cannot
request a second metadata grant after failure, and neither failure establishes
successful rollback, completion, or reusable state. Copy admission and cumulative
attempt/copy accounting remain unchanged.

The external target phase enters its native bank/recovery continuation only after
the exact cold equation quote returns, matching the embedded prediction phase.
The same move-only occurrence, borrowed phase diagnostic source, and owned quote
funding cross that call boundary. Its concrete argument and return controls are
prepaid before quotation; no heap relocation, enlarged thread stack or native
admission change is needed to keep later bank temporaries off the cold stack.


Original chat macro storage reuses the vendored parser, capture analysis,
argument binder and VM instruction dispatcher. Root-scope macro declarations
retain the same shared capture membership and late root assignments as ordinary
MiniJinja; calls keep separate locals, default/keyword arguments, recursive
frames and text results. Source-derived registers cover simultaneous frames at
the existing chat environment recursion limit. The actual source/input runs
measure concatenation prefixes and Unicode output before render destinations
are reserved. Borrowed inputs retire before output or a paid partial failure
escapes. No ordinary `Value` closure graph, environment map or unqualified
callback is created by this path. Nested declarations and call-block closure
graphs still require their own exact retained producer; they remain typed
refusals, not a model-family applicability claim. Macro results support the
existing admitted text operations, and arbitrary callback results remain
unqualified.


The portable paged planner represents a completed store with an opaque
`WorkspaceStoredHostValue`, not a zero-capacity Tensor or an alias of its former
Device allocation. The store effect returns no portable Tensor; its native
copy-completion Array remains an internal Model root. Later loads carry the exact
same stored-value identity and produce independent Device tensor storage. The
Host source constructor and its original receipt separately account and
register the actual Host allocation. An opaque metadata handle cannot supply
native source or execution authority.

Paged state and pooling-local storage visitors skip a stored-Host page's former
Device tensor metadata. Their shared scan promotion worker handles both original
retained Host inputs and newly stored values; a failed later attention operation
retains completed promotions and all accepted trace spending. Source-context
identity is checked before recording either effect. Host-store recipe facts,
source-bank population and the common native/cold eviction itinerary remain
required before original Host paging admission opens.


Rollback error transport is entered only after the operation fails. The shared
Embedded executor and request driver keep restoration results and the owned
operation/restoration pair in out-of-line failure workers, so successful cold
model quotation does not retain those large error temporaries on its stack.
The existing pre-operation destination reserves each worker's argument/result
controls; restoration still runs under its actual copy admission and retains
both causes when it also fails. This changes neither stack limits nor budget
refund/rollback policy.


Native imported workspace state now retains the actual descriptor's floating
scalar type independently of conservative logical F32 sizing. This descriptive
field gives no contiguous-layout or storage-ownership credit. The same native
rotary and attention workers propagate their actual output scalar rules into
parallel workspace facts, so a row collective can bind its real input type
after cache views, rotary application and SDPA. Missing source representation
continues to refuse; no checkpoint-format or family inference supplies it.

The stored-Host trace uses the same native transfer recipes. A store has zero
portable tensor outputs, at most one Device compaction, one nested completion,
and one internal native root in the existing Model completion union. Its Host
allocation and registration remain in the independently accepted source bank.
A matching stored-value load uses the ordinary Host-to-Device worker and creates
one independent Device output. Both descriptors retain exact native scalar type
separately from the conservative floating extent class. These facts alone grant
neither cache policy mutation nor Host materialization; the exact manager/source
itinerary and accepted source constructor are still required before admission.


Explicit external-drafter device placement uses the same backend factory worker
as the selected target. The drafter materializes against that backend's own
execution and weight-source streams. Its loading recovery retains the complete
backend before model construction, then moves it into the ordinary drafter
payload; model/stream aliases retire before the placement owner. Later source
inspection can borrow that exact admitted environment, and cannot promote an
ordinary stream fallback or equal device identity into original authority.

This ownership join does not open managed external split execution. That path
still needs an independently retained per-side environment through mutable
assistant visitation, source-authenticated event/copy handoff in both directions,
and per-side numerical/model context selection. The current admitted execution
stream producer covers Metal GPU0; CPU and other-device original producers remain
concrete implementation gaps rather than architecture inapplicability.

For a selected Host pager, the shared workspace append/scan state retains a
paid per-source conditional transfer inventory. Each actual initial or appended
page has one immutable Host source declaration; each selected normalization or
value-pass visit has an optional independent Device load. The native manager
still selects real victims using its existing eviction predicate. The cold
trace follows the maximal finite transfer path rather than reproducing native
policy or deriving an allocation identity from equal bytes. Absolute page and
query frontiers, store occurrences, scalar types and actual shapes accompany
the inventory. Hot native pages may skip transfers only after source checks.
Source-bank construction, dynamic canonical publication, and final Host public
admission still require their actual native consumer; metadata alone grants none.


Original chat nested declarations and call blocks now use one paid closure row
per live ordinary lexical frame. A macro call has its own locals and closure;
a loop reuses its closure across iterations, matching MiniJinja's ordinary
scope semantics. Captured loop values retain their actual frame index rather
than resolving the callee's current loop. The existing shared capture walker,
argument binder and VM dispatcher handle inline caller macros and their text
outputs. Frame retirement clears its borrowed capture registers before reuse.
Mutable namespace fields still reject macro objects, so this producer does not
claim an escaped, dynamically growing closure graph; that requires a separate
retained graph census. The restriction is typed and concerns storage ownership,
not model-family applicability.

The closed chat producer now lowers scalar subtraction, multiplication, true and
floor division, remainder, and powers through the same storage-parametric VM
dispatch as ordinary evaluation. Its actual borrowed scalar operands enter the
existing checked integer/IEEE floating helpers and paid result/error controls.
The released Mistral/Ministral role-alternation block's modulo therefore follows
ordinary namespace updates. Ordinary dynamic repetition stays in its existing
operator worker and needs its own retained output producer before admission;
scalar support does not grant bytes for a repeated string or iterable.

Cold parameter representation inspection follows the actual selected executor's
read-only architecture/policy source loan, including a partitioned executor whose
policy type differs from the direct resident strategy parameter. The shared
strategy/source visitor cannot retain a unit borrow, and native policy keeps its
validated idle layout/address owner through the callback. Only complete strict
static and unit visitation installs a descriptive table. Dtype remains exact
when a native parameter descriptor has unsettled stride flags; false contiguity
claims no layout property. Missing/remapped/unavailable sources still refuse
qualification, and no parameter mutation, load, completion or storage grant is
introduced by this loan.

The native Host program binds each conditional store to either a retained
canonical ID or an exact future publication from the already prepared append
program. Future shapes/scalar types come from that same cold equation trace;
source loans authenticate the original manager, generation and inventory before
preparing destinations. Native arrays are checked against the current canonical
row again at actual transfer and publication, including exact allocation identity.
Host destination payload is created only after consuming the accepted source
component; every constructor receipt stays in its real immutable publication
owner. The per-page C+B census and real scan occurrence list are retained by the
existing paged source bank. This constructor/source binding does not yet open
the Host admission gate: actual policy mutation/promotion must consume it.


### Active cold constructor transports

The shared resident constructor assembles its owning runtime in a separate
function after all unit constructors return. Composite direct and routed
construction likewise finish the existing selected-source handoff and
publication before invoking a visitor that may start another workspace quote.
Both policies preserve the same by-value source, architecture, graph and unit
owners; they neither box a native resource nor introduce new execution authority.
Checked construction prices the concrete additional argument/result transports
before the selected work. This separates temporaries whose work has completed
from the active nested quote without changing thread stack limits or equations.

The original chat string filter shares the installed VM filter dispatch and
default scalar-formatting worker. Existing text keeps its paid borrowed or
generated storage; scalar/undefined results consume the exact measured generated
text destination, including UTF-8 bytes, character counts and trim edges. The
actual LFM/Nanbeige text/scalar expressions can therefore retain these strings
through namespace aliases and macro arguments without reconstituting dynamic
Value objects. Structured-object formatting remains a separate producer, and
this filter grants no arbitrary formatter callback or object serialization.


The speculative request table likewise performs final row assembly and insertion
in an out-of-line helper reached only after prefill and first-token commitment.
Its concrete generic arguments, row and result controls are admitted through
the selected request's existing coordinated Delivery preparation. That local
authority survives the helper; the same fixed request buffer retains the stored
row. Cancellation, rollback, sampling, publication and request numbering still
use the existing shared driver and ordering.


Resident unit construction passes the actual build Result directly to a shared
post-build insertion helper. Result extraction and the moved Vec argument exist
only after the recursive unit constructor has returned. The helper preserves
ordinary build-before-growth ordering, checked preallocated group destinations,
and prefix retirement on failure. Its exact generic argument/value/result
transports are counted by the same workspace unit-storage control query.

The paged Host itinerary prepares a distinct native promotion destination for
each declared selected pass. Destination preparation retains paid array-handle
slots and a finite reservation-table population; it grants neither occupancy
nor execution. Actual binding rechecks the same manager generation, exact
canonical Host buffers, declared dtype/layout, active original role, and source
account before reserving the real Device and transfer occupancy. Completed
GPU-to-Host publication supplies a closed immutable source for later reloads;
it does not reconstruct source authority from block geometry. The original
shared promotion worker still performs transfer, settlement and canonical
publication. Initial standalone Host projection keeps its existing worker;
when the finite itinerary is present it owns these per-pass destinations.

Canonical manager Device occupancy and aggregate physical cache-pool custody
are separate bounds. A replaced Device backing or completed reload retained by
the Model completion union remains physically charged even after its canonical
row becomes Host-resident. The itinerary does not refund that live storage.
Host admission remains closed pending its native policy/occurrence handoff;
completed-root retirement within a role remains a separate required producer
for policies whose useful physical limit depends on that earlier retirement.


An independently retained copy environment uses the same prepared-stream-copy
constructor previously embedded in the prediction cache-copy context. The shared
backend owner retains the exact stream wrapper, source comparison plan, pool and
allocator identity, with constructor metadata last. Each later loan revalidates
those identities and charges its actual controls; no registration, native role
or copy allowance is created by lending it. Prediction cache copies consume this
same constructor. External split placement can prepare the owner before mutable
assistant visitation without borrowing the drafter for the whole operation.


The external state-copy worker validates its input against the retained source
side and completes the existing isolated copy on the independently authenticated
destination side. Both loans belong to the same request and actual memory pool;
a completed-source marker is never relabelled to the destination stream. The
output proof is constructed only from the real completed copy. Existing same-side
state copies use this shared worker with equal placements. Per-side context loans
provide no native scope or transfer authority.

This physical-copy prefix does not open split external admission. The ordinary
same-device event/alias path, all sampler/model consumers, and the selected entry
still need their complete source-aware joins; unsupported CPU/other-device
original stream producers remain explicit implementation gaps.


Original distributed phase agreements reached inside a model prefill scope use
an explicit native child scope with the actual active original observer. The
existing event source independently pays its finite Graph/Record arenas before
entry. Default nested scope construction still rejects foreign arenas; the
explicit control entry additionally refuses stale observers and active Record,
capture, or worker loans. It preserves ordinary durable parent ancestry,
quarantine, and TLS restoration, and inherits the same immutable native backing
origin. The shared agreement, completion, and Recovery drivers are unchanged.
An inner polling/native failure does not release either parent or child custody.

The original paged Host consumer now checks out the complete finite itinerary
while native append/scan work runs, releasing source and manager loans before
any transfer. Tail growth and sealed-page publication ask the actual manager's
shared borrowed eviction predicate for a victim; ordinary recent protection
remains strict for mutation and may yield for an attention demand. The native
move authenticates every source pin, exact current backing, generation and
active Model role. Initial stores use the registered Host-copy producer; later
demotions reuse that immutable Host backing through the same completed
canonical-publication worker. Reuse records a demotion without claiming another
physical transfer. A selected scan pass consumes its exact paid load slot even
when the canonical page is already on Device. Reads and demand leases borrow
the actual current initial or reloaded owner. Failed checkouts preserve all
submitted prefixes, and real replaced Device charges remain live. Host public
admission awaits the accepted source-component handoff into this consumer;
there is no fallback to ordinary manager acquisition or simulated occupancy.

The original chat range producer uses the same checked integer progression
definition as the ordinary builtin, including its pre-existing 100,000-element
limit and zero-step rejection. The closed value retains that exact descriptor
in paid operand/local/loop storage; each reached member uses the shared iterator
and numeric value rules. Listing changes the enumerable kind without inventing
input elements, and no mutable native owner or arbitrary callback is admitted.
The shared progression calculation now avoids machine-word overflow for valid
wide signed ranges; endpoint differences and indexed arithmetic are checked.
Released Gemma lookahead ranges retain ordinary nested-loop/capture behavior.

External equation inputs are a selection from retained tensor evidence. Every
retained registered witness first authenticates its original request and stream;
only allocations present in the current equation projection participate in its
backing comparison. An unused predecessor witness does not force an unrelated
input into the equation. The complete source binder still acquires exact
registered or completed authority for every actual input, and mismatched bytes,
source accounts, requests and completion origins continue to refuse.

Paged Host generation now joins its exact source-construction facts to the
original prefill comparison. Before any native role is issued, the neutral
move-only scope set extracts the actual accepted SourceBank from its matching
HostDestinationBank. It validates the same request/control account and whole
selected source component, then leaves only the remaining operation destination
facts. This does not refund funding, change native role populations, or create
a new source identity. The pager constructs its registered Host destinations
from that bank; existing resident/bounded parameter workers keep their exact
remaining-component comparisons. Source and operation roles share the original
control guard. A separately selected parameter source-construction component
still requires a disjoint two-publisher partition producer before it can be
combined with the pager; its retained peak is never overwritten.

The selected full-attention key/value generation path can now admit Host
paging with F32/F16/BF16 source representation and live Disk disabled, subject
to its actual finite manager and pool limits. Host saved-state copy/resume/reset,
sliding discard, relative-bias scan, and other state families still require
their remaining producers. Their existing typed gates remain; these are
implementation gaps rather than architectural exclusions.

The feature-gated MLX facade extension exposes the existing neutral
`CacheResidencyReport` as `LoadedModel::cache_residency_telemetry`, translating
native failures through `BackendFailure`. It forwards the existing selected
session report and owns no cache policy. The public Host paging fixture uses
that report to require actual demotion and promotion, alongside a distinct
shared-pool physical high-water mark. Its small canonical Device budget is not
a claim that every completed backing retires within the current Model role.


External tensor aliases authenticate their actual completed input stream before
sharing the existing evidence. The validator accepts the other side only for an
already bound external same-device assignment, with the same retained request
and managed pool; it still checks the actual native backing and its account.
The alias preserves the original completion marker and does not publish a new
one for its consumer. Cross-device inputs continue to require a completed copy
on the destination. The per-side entry, numerical, and model consumers remain
separate prerequisites before split-placement admission can be enabled.


The original external assistant equation now selects its admitted Draft
copy environment. The existing combined source binder consumes authenticated
predecessor accounts, including completed inputs borrowed from the other side
of a same-device assignment. It checks selected registered backing against the
actual input projection after authenticating every retained declaration. The
same native scope executes and completes the equation; only then may its new
model inventory name the Draft stream. The shared evidence publication worker
retains actual registered predecessor markers and current roots with the phase
metadata owner. Entry, target and numerical transfer consumers remain required
before the public split-placement gate can open.


Managed tensor-parallel model equations retain their resident lazy-constructor
bank while invoking the shared source-bound distributed constructor. That
constructor now borrows only the actual resident association in the same active
Scope and Graph. Its exact group/input recipe reserves separate blocks already
counted by the parallel source; resident slots and nested completion attempts are
unchanged. A lexical native guard restores the association after the child bank
retires, including capacity refusal and exceptions. Strict standalone constructor
entry and pointwise/worker/foreign bank refusals remain intact. This loan neither
submits work nor grants Eval, backing, communicator or completion authority.


External static axis views use the same numerical worker with an explicit
selected-side context. It accepts an input stream different from the destination
only when the value is already completed, belongs to the same request, and its
owned stream matches the other admitted side of a SameDeviceSplit assignment.
The worker retains the input's native/account owner throughout recovery and
publishes its result on the actual destination stream. Registered view evidence
keeps the copy's original completion marker alongside the new view budget.
Range publication projects only the new completed packet, then retains the old
input evidence independently through the shared phase-aware publication worker.
Other numerical sampling, target consumers and request entry still need their
selected-side joins before public split-placement admission opens.


External logits import and row selection now consume the same selected-side
numerical source path. Rank-two import keeps the actual source stream; row
selection completes the existing LogitsRow equation on its selected destination.
Registered-copy and prior numerical-view evidence stays in the existing readout
source owner, rather than being reclassified as a model account or discarded
when the temporary tensor wrapper drops. Source shape/dtype checks remain the
existing positive rank-two/rank-three F32 logits contract. Original strict model
readout entry points remain available to their existing callers.


The existing speculative sampler now forwards selected placement through its
prepared logits policy, controller mask, capture/intervention phase, greedy
choice, and probability/correction numerical workers. The same source/request
validation and native numerical worker remain in use; complete peer inputs are
accepted only by the closed same-device context path. Compatibility helpers
retain their existing Target default. RNG handoff, verification transport,
selected commitment and target/state inputs remain explicit consumers to join
before public split-placement admission opens.


Original Host-paged reset reuses the same source-bound empty manager and paid
reset publication worker as Device paging. Stable Host pages supply their actual
manager configuration and catalog capacity; reset reads no page payload and
performs no promotion or numerical copy. The old namespace and its physical
owners remain intact until the existing reset retirement boundary. Source plan
identity, idle storage validation, finite host construction and original pool
publication remain required. The independent copied-state reservation still
rejects Host pages: enabling empty reset does not authorize Host snapshots or
restore/fork, whose selected load-and-copy producer remains unfinished.


Paged blockwise metadata retains the selected original query scalar separately
from its F32 recurrence values. The existing native representation adapter now
reports the real Begin/accumulation F32 storage and Finish's cast back to that
original type for both fused and rounded-score passes. Missing source evidence
stays missing; it is never replaced by the logical Float32 extent class. This
keeps later-layer cache pages eligible for their exact Host store description.

External assistant loading now publishes actual completed parameter backing and
retained checkpoint source storage into its selected backend working-memory
pool through the ordinary retained-storage registration. The typed source owner
keeps that registration after its module, arrays and checkpoint aliases; native
retirement releases the physical inventory before the shared charge. Managed
assistant equations continue to pin existing exact roots, with no registration
or source-capacity synthesis during cold quotation.


Original RNG root splitting still runs on Target in the same order. Draft
position-key selection and categorical sampling now run on the selected side
through the same numerical worker, and state replacement still follows actual
completion. Same-device verification retains authenticated already-completed
numerical values with their original markers; cross-device verification remains
pending its actual copy consumer. The sampler snapshot context retains both
actual per-side scalar copy prerequisites and selects a matching loan from the
key's owned native stream. It does not own a second stream or rewind any copy or
attempt spending. The existing isolated key-copy mechanism remains unchanged.


The originally admitted chat worker binds the text environment's registered
Python-compatible `tojson` filter. Ordinary rendering and the bounded VM use one
iterative formatter for escaping, numeric spelling, separators, indentation and
key order. Input JSON trees and messages remain borrowed; no cloned Value tree
or recursive formatting stack is created in original execution. The source
compiler preserves positional/keyword evaluation order and uses fixed operand
slots for the four registered options, including a literal separators pair.

A measurement attempt owns exact container-continuation and sorted-entry slots.
An already ordered object uses its direct iterator; other sorted objects use
actual object-length borrowed entries and an iterative in-place heap sort.
Encountering a larger live population returns its next required capacity before
writing those slots. Runtime retires and settles that attempt, then admits the
larger destination before retrying the same immutable source/input. There is no
unpriced recursive input census or guessed maximum depth. Final rendering gets
its own exact peak admission and temporary input loans retire before output or
error publication. Generated bytes and escaped failures retain the existing J/C/H
owners. Custom callbacks and unsupported dynamic operand representations retain
typed refusal; no arbitrary callback is certified by this built-in producer.


Original sampler commitment now consumes the caller's selected Target or Draft
placement. The shared completed-input validator authenticates a same-device
peer value at its actual origin without changing its source marker. Existing
no-mutation, controller and adaptive policy workers retain their exact token,
history and policy checks; adaptive normalization and accepted-token probability
execute on the selected side. Provisional host policy replacement still occurs
only after those observations and the same commit worker succeed. The bounded
path retains actual source/output/error custody and never refunds copy or attempt
counters. This consumer does not open the external split-placement entry gate.

The existing source-owned Metal indexed kernels now include one-index Gather
with index rank one, two or three, plus overwrite ScatterAxis with either Int32
or UInt32 indices. The same generic native kernels handle strides, signed index
semantics and both location widths; no operation is replaced by a cast or extra
tensor copy. Native admission accepts only variants present in the precompiled
library. This supplies the already-quoted ordered-readout rank-three Gather and
signed scatter without runtime shader compilation or another capacity grant.


External target quotation now authenticates immutable input evidence at its
actual completed Target or Draft origin before binding the same exact account
union. Mutable target state still requires Target completion. The registered
input selector shares its existing projection worker and keeps strict behavior
for the earlier unselected entry. After the actual target completion, publication
names Target only for that new completed inventory; surviving registered input
witnesses keep their origin and native custody. The selected publication and its
finite prior table use the current phase metadata owner. This adds no numerical
operation or completion and does not open split admission.


External state source joins now take an explicit consuming placement through the
same neutral mechanism: Gemma target selection and control copies use Target,
Muse context control copies use Draft. The native join preserves the common
completed origin of the immutable roots and each registered witness's own
origin; it does not manufacture completion on the consuming side. Incompatible
completed source mixtures still refuse before projection. Gemma's transferred
state retains each actual transfer result proof in paid finite storage and joins
those current roots, so a future completed destination copy is not replaced by
the old target proof. Ordinary transfer equations and state ordering are shared.
Split entry and cross-device copy qualification are unchanged.


External token packets and state transfers now consume their selected side
through the shared source-aware worker. Same-device transfer authenticates an
already completed input and retains its original marker and custody. A raw
tensor uses the paid handle-alias worker; an immutable packet shares its existing
owner. Cross-device transfer delegates the existing isolated copy worker and
publishes only its completed destination proof, still subject to that worker's
actual device and source qualification. Verification token prefixes use the
same selected range worker. This joins consumers without opening the public
split entry or qualifying any missing device factory.


The original external request driver now consumes the retained same-device
placement after source-aware model, numerical, sampler, state and transfer
consumers are connected. It prepares an owned copy of the selected drafter's
actual stream and scalar prerequisites before mutable visitation, retaining
their native/host custody. Paid stream snapshots validate the declared topology
without constructing a new device or reopening selection. Each request's shared
context receives both exact environments; controlled and uninterrupted execution
use the same driver. Cross-device request entry still refuses until its RNG,
verification copy and device-factory producers are qualified. Same-device
integration requires native public validation; source integration alone is not
a parity claim.


Saved-state source projection distinguishes borrowed Array operands from actual
immutable Host-transfer buffers under the same paged manager loan. The existing
sorted storage collector retains both source kinds with their native identity,
canonical pins and admitted host owner. Count/construct use the same typed
selection; array-only copy producers continue to reject Host operands until
their real transfer/copy population is joined. This source projection neither
promotes a page nor grants a model or copy role.


The shared isolated-copy native census can describe an actual immutable Host
load before each selected eager-copy leaf. Fixed source descriptors supply
scalar type, rank, transfer policy, native direct extents and logical bytes;
Host loads add their own output birth, root and completion to the same original
Graph/Record/physical account. Array-only programs retain their previous zero
Host population. These counts grant no source or execution authority: the
snapshot source owner and destination residency consumer remain required.


External draft RNG transfer and verification logits now use the existing
independent-copy worker when the selected context crosses devices. A shared
registered-value receiver validates the actual completed destination shape,
dtype and allocation before retaining its request association and paid stream.
The original key/logit meaning and controller choice remain unchanged; failed
copies cannot replace caller state or unfinished distribution entries. Key
snapshots borrow either numerical or registered-copy stream custody through the
same exact environment validator. Cross-device public entry stays gated pending
actual per-device stream and equation/copy worker qualification; these consumers
do not certify a missing native runtime.

Paged Host transfer source construction selects stores and loads from the same retained generation span records used by native append/scan programs. The complete cold equation trace still includes its conservative final decode and keeps that diagnostic bound; an occurrence is omitted from the native transfer inventory only when it matches an actual record excluded by `generation_records()`. Unknown coordinates or missing submitted programs remain fixed source-identity failures. Original trace entry indices are preserved through filtering, and accepted source storage is constructed only for submitted occurrences.


A selected CPU:0 backend in the managed Metal runtime now retains actual
execution-stream and CPU-worker registrations through the same source constructors
used for checkpoint materialization. A separately admitted enclosing owner pays
only its call/control storage; stream and worker native prefixes retain their own
existing accounts. The same factory finishing worker supplies the weights stream.
Original environment loans validate both exact registrations and the allocator
origin. This is stream/worker construction qualification only: CPU numerical/model
recipes and CPU physical-copy population remain separate missing consumers, and
cross-device request admission remains closed. Ordinary fallback remains where
the existing initialized runtime cannot provide a qualified stream.


Shared template slicing uses one ordinary/source-bound dispatch and checked
coordinate normalizer. Borrowed sequence slices retain their actual input loan
with a fixed affine view; nested slices compose coordinates without allocating
lists. Unicode text slices read the actual source or generated prefix. When
measurement reaches generated text, it requests an exact finite temporary
atom/byte buffer; the runtime retires and settles that attempt before admitting
the next. Rendering retains the same measured output destinations. This supports
reversed message histories, skipped system messages and sliced JSON tool output
without template-family branches or destination growth during an admitted pass.


Original direct tensor-parallel output publication is part of the retained model
invocation. The architecture supplies the selected publication owner and group;
the cold equation trace records the ordinary non-owner zero contribution and its
Broadcast/Sum occurrence. The shared session lends that same invocation after
forward, and the shared partition publisher authenticates its prepared group
against the selected stored resource. The loan does not reopen model construction
or install a replacement native source.

The MLX publication worker appends and settles its actual contribution through
the existing original root collector, then binds the completed leaf to the exact
prequoted CPU layout and uses the existing accepted constructor and prepared
communication completion. The quote includes contribution storage, a retained
completion root, and the two reached nested completion attempts. The invocation,
observer, source and actual roots stay under the enclosing recovery owner on
failure; publication never releases them or refunds an occurrence. The temporary
weak root view closes on every callback exit, so a retained recipe cannot prolong
the root control allocation after its own host account retires. The final
shared model completion remains required. Prepared publication metadata uses
borrowed native dimensions and the ordinary tensor contract validator; its error
destination retains the concrete cause and funded host account without an extra
formatted diagnostic allocation. Ordinary publication still uses the same
selected owner, broadcast equations, bounded wait and poison policy. Logical
subgroup and PP transport producer requirements remain explicit; this direct TP
join does not qualify them by geometry alone.


The cold composite equation visitor keeps media-only module extraction in its
selected media helper. Text-only quotes continue through the existing text
visitor without retaining the unused media branch's by-value transports on their
active unit-construction stack. The resident equation runtime similarly extracts
and wraps the shared resident constructor's result only after recursive unit
construction returns. Both helpers price their concrete control transports before
entry; no module/source owner, constructor equation, error, stack limit or native
admission policy changes.


The CPU isolated-copy prerequisite uses the existing native Contiguous worker
and private completion primitive. Their fixed Eval bank is selected from exact
native type, device and input/output geometry, then installed under the same
accepted Record and Graph. The ordinary copy branch, weak views, FIFO dispatch,
cleanup and completion equations are unchanged. Pure queries expose the bank,
higher-rank worker scratch and one possible backing birth separately; they do
not admit an allocator, stream, source or model equation. Cross-device external
admission still requires the complete per-side copy and neural consumers.

Saved paged Host destinations use finite declarations in the existing original isolated-copy plan. The same HostStore lowering supplies optional Device compaction, copy, and completion populations. Host backing is a distinct component of the accepted copy's physical bound; it is not added to the Device allocator budget. Every declared destination is consumed before construction and before original scope entry, and failed preparation cannot restore it. The existing prepared Host destination worker accepts only completed arrays born under that exact copy's native buffer budget and retains its native output/event before completed immutable Host storage and copy custody. Its completed witness compares the original buffer budget, so a Model allocation or another copy cannot authorize terminal snapshot publication. The source-row binding, terminal Host publication, manager policy/occupancy, and saved resume handoff still must consume this witness before the Host snapshot gate can be enabled.


The isolated-copy planner now selects that exact CPU Eval source for array-only
programs on a retained CPU stream. It shares the ordinary Contiguous/eager-copy
constructor, nested completion, recovery and final publication mechanisms with
the existing GPU path. Every completion includes the actual CPU signal task.
The existing retained Metal allocator still supplies physical rounding in this
managed Metal runtime, regardless of which stream computes the copy; no CPU
header rule is inferred from a device label. Host transfer programs and pending
cast/reshape tails retain their existing separately qualified selection.
Distributed CPU completion now quotes the same extended Synchronizer bank while
preserving its existing event signal, source and Record populations. General
CPU numerical/model recipes and cross-device request admission remain pending.

Completed Host-store Array roots use a borrowed, fixed-status Host-transfer alias
witness in the same native publication worker. The witness preserves the native
Host allocation namespace and full backing capacity; publication requires an
already registered prepaid immutable source in the same pool. It cannot create
a Model birth, ordinary storage credit, or source account. Attachment repeats
completed backing identity/capacity validation under one runtime loan and uses
the existing prepared Host-allocation sidecar; failures retain the original
attachment owner. The actual Host buffer and source custody remain live until
the final native alias retires. Descriptor, witness and attachment frames are
part of the existing paid publication control census.

The shared chat JSON string formatter also streams immutable generated-text
prefixes and concatenation segments through the same scalar escaping worker.
The bounded consumer separates its read-only prefix from its finite destination,
requests reached atom/byte capacity before reading, and retires failed attempts
before resizing. Nested JSON, Unicode slicing, and trimmed concatenations require
no temporary ordinary String or new family-specific rendering path.

The shared VM dispatcher now also owns string-concatenation operand order.
Ordinary storage preserves its existing undefined checks and Value formatting;
bounded storage uses the same scalar spelling and its existing admitted text
atom storage. Text identity and conversion are shared with the string filter.


The original partitioned output publisher settles its actual root/zero
contribution through the existing paid nested-completion worker. It retains
that value in the enclosing model root owner, then retires only the model host
constructor bank before the independently sourced CPU collective. The enclosing
`PrefillRoots` remains a one-shot collector: only the final shared session
completion consumes it, after publication has supplied the actual output. A
nested refusal retains the original bank and unresolved work in the same Q;
no completion attempt, occurrence or budget is reset.

Saved Host destinations publish through the same independently admitted
WorkspaceCopyPublicationPlan as Array and slot destinations. A finite paid list
accepts only positively completed PreparedSavedHostCopy outputs from that exact
copy budget; the terminal inventory must contain those same immutable Host
objects with their actual generation and full backing capacity. The existing B
publisher and prepared Host-allocation attachment retain the copy account through
all aliases and failures. This adds no original Text/Model source origin or
prepaid Host-source credit. Manager destination/state and copied-source consumers
must complete before the public Host snapshot/resume gate can open.

The source-qualified CPU unary Eval path consumes the existing named ordinary
unary, floating-unary and real-unary task instantiations. Its descriptive query
selects the actual function and supported dtype, then accounts for the two weak
array owners, one possible output backing, task node, output/tracer containers,
cleanup, and the shared strided iterator's rank-derived metadata. Native Eval
checks exact primitive type, dtype, shape and source cardinality before opening
the same Graph bank and worker loan used by the CPU copy path. Copy and unary
share the single-output destination constructor; unsupported primitives acquire
no permission from that reusable constructor. Backing allocator, source account,
Record, stream/event and completed output custody remain separate. These native
sources do not qualify an entire CPU assistant model or open CrossDevice managed
admission; the selected numerical/model recipe must consume every reached source
before that entry can be admitted.

Generated chat lists use immutable indexed value storage under the same shared
BuildList dispatcher. The reached constructor reports its exact required slots;
runtime retires and settles each unsuccessful fixed measurement before admitting
the next. Borrowed values receive distinct temporary source registers, while
nested generated values retain immutable indices. Concatenation prices its actual
copied value population, including prior retained list versions. No ordinary
Value graph or mutable caller container enters the retained rendering.

Paged Host quotation retains each stored value's exact original workspace
source and redeclares its conditional store in later invocations. Native cache
policy may defer a page's first Host copy until a later eviction; that later
Model role therefore pays the actual copy/compaction, traversal and completion
work. Repeated declarations share the same store identity and physical Host
destination. The native mover remains one-use, actual victim selection stays in
the shared manager policy, and hot/completed paths may omit the already-paid
conditional work. Failed quote prefixes retain their spending.

Original numerical token input can consume an authenticated CPU execution
factory through the same request role, eager U32 source, NumericalProducer,
scoped recovery and completed output receiver used on GPU. The zero-equation
trace retains its generic constructor/traversal facts; its CPU Graph plan uses
only the actual private CPU completion bank and signal source, with zero kernel
attempts. Eager backing, metadata and output stream ownership keep their existing
independent sources. Other CPU numerical programs remain refused until their
entire selected equation has source-qualified dispatch populations; this input
join does not open the external CrossDevice entry.


Logical pair transport now shares one borrowed native group plan between the
ordinary direct/rotation exchange and its original source. That plan retains the
actual ordered endpoint membership and requires the existing consensus-proven
world wave for opposite-rank rotation. The original route loan resolves the
exact selected route and endpoint, then derives each send/receive peer from
that plan. Native full-group operations still cannot substitute for a logical
subgroup or packed-world transport equation.

One original exchange round constructs both actual CPU operations before a
single two-root completion. The exact native source includes both constructor,
Eval, Ring worker and backing populations, plus one Synchronizer/Event/Record
population. Its preallocated completion retains the actual selected route. A
constructor-minted pair carries observer/source custody into the existing
completion and recovery worker, including after fresh submissions are fenced.
This is the route-round producer, not whole PP admission: framed headers,
packing/decoding arithmetic, model-forward route loans and non-pair world
transport remain required before their existing managed gates can open.

Generated list concatenation preserves the ordinary lazy-iterable type and its
shared sized-chain materialization threshold, even though bounded storage prices
the actual materialized values. A list conversion resets the observable chain
kind. Indexed storage does not make an ordinary iterable claim to be a sequence.

Generated chat mappings use the shared BuildMap instruction and the same
immutable value arena as generated lists. The constructor preserves key order,
replaces duplicate values before exposing the result, and retains borrowed
source members in distinct paid registers. Keys/values/items views, attribute
lookup and membership consume the completed indexed mapping without allocating
an ordinary Value or materializing a second input tree.

The same CPU Eval destination mechanism also consumes exact arithmetic and
comparison task sources with two inputs. The ordinary task body, dtype switch,
broadcast classification, donation and strided arithmetic remain shared. The
source counts three weak owners and validates both input shapes/dtypes, the
comparison Bool output where applicable, and the existing worker's int-sized
loop extent before native entry. Copy, unary and binary storage queries use one
source-derived `ContiguousIterator` constructor bound for copied prefix metadata,
collapse destinations and positions. Its Graph loan follows the existing task
through worker return. NaN-equality and other unqualified workers remain separate;
these finite sources neither widen Copy's one-input declaration nor authorize a
complete CPU model or external CrossDevice request.

The CPU `AsType` source now uses the same original copy Eval bank and ordinary
conversion task as `Contiguous`. Its pure query validates actual source/output
dtypes and checked element extents; native Eval additionally validates the exact
primitive, arity, shape and data span. Allocation, donation, conversion, cleanup
and escaped backing ownership remain shared with ordinary CPU execution. This
qualifies that producer only; it does not admit an incomplete CPU model or open
external CrossDevice placement.


Stable Host cache rows now use the same finite saved-copy manager worker as Device
rows. The actual source loan retains Host buffers, source pins, generation and
pool identity; an independent manager reserves the copied rows in their real
canonical tiers. After copy admission, typed initialized slots consume exact
Host destination plans before the original scope opens. Each Host leaf uses the
existing Host load, isolated array copy and completed Host store, then validates
its actual representation before canonical insertion. Failed rows retain their
native prefix, source pins, destination manager and copy budget in that order.
The optional completed-Host callback lets the existing copy publisher authenticate
its destination without introducing another completion carrier. Public saved
Host execution remains pending the composition publication and source-provenance
handoff; cold source facts alone do not grant execution.


Saved Host cache copying now carries physical source kinds through the existing
finite preparation and native copy driver. Array sources retain their ordinary
handles; immutable Host sources retain the same pinned source inventory and
are loaded by the shared Host transfer worker before isolated copying. Exact
Host destination declarations add their real storage, constructor populations
and completion roots to the same copy admission. Initialized state slots consume
those declarations before opening the native scope. Completed Host outputs join
the existing SnapshotWork publisher under their actual copy budget; both the
Host owner and any native completion alias receive the same Copy provenance.
No Host source is relabelled as Model or immutable load authority. Copied-Host
resume still requires the corresponding exact source-provenance consumer before
its public admission can be claimed complete.


Dense saved-state source inspection preserves Host/Array distinctions under the
same paged manager loan. Logical snapshot sizing consumes each actual source's
logical byte count and rank while native page-rounded allocation remains in the
separate physical admission. This source view does not authorize materialization
or relax the pending copied-Host resume producer.


The original TP output-publication handoff validates its actual contribution
with the existing scoped leaf validator after nested completion. Waiting for
an event and retiring its Record do not themselves detach the root's completed
event. This final owner-side validation checks the same original observer,
rejects lazy, pending or foreign work, and marks only that completed root
available before the pure distributed source query. It uses the shared native
observation control bound and keeps the existing outer root collector, source
custody and one-shot publication occurrence; it adds no evaluation or grant.


Prepared PP boundary transport borrows the exact selected route/account from
its explicit execution or control context. The shared partition driver keeps
that source through schema validation, local dependency completion, canonical
header construction, native transfer and output validation. A separate PP
control context remains separate from optional neural TP. Both ordinary and
prepared header construction use the same checked RoleExactV1 writer; the
prepared path funds ordered role/shape/header destinations and carries source
custody through output and fixed error owners.

The local dependency and framed-transfer backend hooks require their own
model-scope and native storage producers. A prepared caller never enters the
ordinary completion or frame constructor when one is unavailable. This source
and host-framing join does not grant native byte-view/concatenate/upload/decode
storage or complete PP capability; the native framed consumer and whole-model
boundary quote must supply those existing operators before the current gates
can be removed. Failure-agreement waves preserve their existing rule: local
readiness failure is first reported to the shared agreement without prematurely
poisoning the collective used to carry that failure.


Generated chat containers use the ordinary iterative JSON formatter through a
read-only typed value projection. Borrowed JSON nodes retain their input loans;
generated lists/maps and views retain indexed immutable value-arena handles.
The formatter's continuation and sorted-key banks are sized for the actual
handle type before a fixed attempt. Overflow or reached capacity retires the
attempt before larger destinations are admitted. No intermediate ordinary JSON
tree, recursive traversal stack or implicit scratch growth is introduced.

The existing CPU numerical token/tensor range invocation now composes a checked
nonempty unit-step Slice at rank two through four with the same numerical role,
source witness, constructor recipe and private completion. Native Slice validates
actual normalized bounds and positive-stride backing geometry before the ordinary
alias worker runs. The complete input backing remains owned independently from
the new view's role and completion. The CPU dispatch bank counts its real cleanup
and output aliases; it consumes no GPU worker allowance. Other numerical/model
programs and external CrossDevice admission remain separately qualified work.


The bounded float filter uses the ordinary scalar conversion and text parser.
Its instruction preserves the existing VM filter dispatch and lenient undefined
policy; scalar results stay in fixed operand storage.


Fresh resumed paged state distinguishes immutable sealed Host backing from
mutable Device/tail values. The shared metadata and canonical row traversals
retain the exact Host source owner into an independent manager while the existing
isolated-copy worker copies Device and tail values. Native Host reads remain
subject to the fresh selected role and the preserved source account; retaining
a buffer creates no Model birth or new B grant. Active Host-store traces remain
unqualified as immutable resume sources. Canonical per-manager occupancy stays
separate from shared physical pool custody; source aliases retain their original
charge until their last actual owner retires. Composition source registration
and native recipe selection must consume this exact distinction before public
Host resume is complete.

CPU numerical normalization now selects the actual F32 source and shared precise
last-axis Softmax worker. Its optional ordinary contiguous-copy branch, temporary
descriptor, copy task and raw-pointer numerical task have separate fixed bank
slots, while one actual output backing covers either branch. The numerical loop
is unchanged. The same original source receiver accepts released row/sequence
logit shapes from completed registered copies. Query limits follow the real int
loop bounds, and escaped output owns its new account independently of its input.
This adds only Normalize; complete CPU model execution and CrossDevice admission
still require the remaining selected producers.


The original PP boundary header source consumes the shared writer's closed frame
packet, authenticates its exact native route and request allocator loan, and uses
the existing immutable U8 host-copy worker. The expected bytes remain with the
logical payload; no extra host header copy or separate protocol is introduced.
The source arena and its actual backing are funded before copy, and each completed
header retains the source account through its native allocation. Partial failures
retire already-created headers before their source custody. This source does not
qualify payload bitcasts, concatenate/slice equations, transport, or completion;
those producers must independently join the same prepared route.


Generated list join and JSON escaping share the immutable text-segment visitor.
Both read an admitted completed prefix while writing only to the separate output
tail. Join uses the ordinary separator/format loop and retains indexed list
members without building a second sequence.


The copied-Host resume handoff now selects only actual Array operands for its
isolated-copy program and recovery census. The complete saved-source owner still
pins and authenticates immutable Host buffers. Metadata projection copies
Device/tail storage and retains Host roots exactly; native manager assembly uses
the corresponding shared row worker. Post-copy agreement requires a distinct
manager, independent Device allocation identities, and pointer-identical retained
Host owners with matching real capacities. The check rejects unrelated equal-size
Host storage. No Host buffer is relabelled as a fresh P/Model birth, and no new
copy grant is created. Public saved Host lifecycle remains to be validated on the
joined consumer.


Original saved paged-state admission now includes stable Host sources through
the closed Host copy destinations and exact retained-resume source handoff.
Snapshots make independent Host copies under B; restored/forked managers retain
those sealed immutable B owners and independently copy mutable Device/tail
values. Source generation, phase, dtype, completion and finite destination checks
remain mandatory. Disk paging and unsupported relative/window producers retain
their existing explicit gate. Public Host drain parity is validated; the new
Host snapshot/restore/fork/reset fixture remains pending joined execution.


Sampling synchronization's rank/order coordination is a shared neutral runtime
driver. Architecture-selected group/rank inputs determine the sole local sampler;
other ranks do not advance RNG or sampler history. Token contribution, Broadcast,
wire conversion, stop contribution and stop Broadcast preserve their existing
order, and a failed producer prevents later collectives. Ordinary MLX supplies its
same native workers. Original adapters must supply actual retained input,
communication and scalar-result sources; the shared driver grants no native
submission or storage authority and does not itself widen original support.

The CPU greedy numerical consumer now uses the actual F32 ArgReduce and Squeeze
branch of the shared known-policy sampler. Its finite source validates the real
axis, singleton result, fixed rank and checked loop counts. The reducer and tie
comparison body remain unchanged; its weak input/output owners and the alias
cleanup retire under the same original graph/record. Completion performs the
existing U32 readout, with no second sampling engine. A one-entry vocabulary
selects the separate ordinary fill path and remains explicitly unqualified in
this CPU recipe. Full CPU model and CrossDevice qualification remain pending.


Limited string splitting retains the ordinary named whitespace iterator and
standard separator iterator through one shared split worker. Fixed views carry
the exact part limit; indexing, slicing, join and JSON consume that same view.

The CPU probability readout consumes the same static index worker as ordinary
execution: a checked Slice followed by its scalar Reshape. Its Reshape source
validates the exact declared output and requires the actual row-contiguous
input branch, so the existing shared-buffer worker creates an alias without a
copy allocation. The same CPU completion and F32 scalar readout apply. Reshapes
that require compaction still need their own source; this does not qualify CPU
model equations, private BLAS workspace, or the CrossDevice entry.

The same CPU static-index recipe also consumes a selected logits row from an
actual `[1, positions, vocabulary]` source. Its Slice/Reshape result preserves
the existing retained parent-source owner, then enters the shared greedy or
normalization worker. Selection validates the actual rank-two output; neither
this row view nor its cold facts grant CPU model or cross-device execution.


Live paged-cache file publication now returns a neutral immutable file owner.
Native manager records, asynchronous read/write tasks and their results retain
that exact owner; stale/discard/reset paths release their reference instead of
unlinking a borrowed path. The final source owner removes the uniquely published
