ephemeral file. Persistent prompt-cache files remain externally owned. This
closes disk source retirement, including queued work outliving its manager; it
does not qualify the existing worker registry/channel, serialization buffers or
Host read destinations for managed Disk execution. Those finite producers remain
required before its admission gate can change.


The shared cache I/O worker can now install paid finite operation and completion
registries under its exact worker identity while idle. Both ordinary and finite
stores use the same coalescing, queue admission, cancellation and retirement
state machine. New keys at the explicit retained-operation limit fail before
registry mutation; existing-key joins remain valid, and retired slots can be
reused. Installation preserves queue history and returns unchanged paid storage
on a foreign/busy worker. Escaped tickets retain the installed registry funding.
This accounts for registry storage only: per-task completion/payload allocations,
queue transport, thread startup and actual disk serialization/read destinations
remain independently required before managed disk execution is admitted.

CPU explicit PRNG key creation uses the existing eager high/low U32[2] source,
physical allocation and retained seed-constructor bank. The shared numerical
role composes that unchanged source with its actual CPU completion; it creates
no random evaluation worker. CPU key splitting, uniform and categorical draws
still require their separate exact sources. No model or CrossDevice gate changes.

Original distributed sampling uses the same neutral rank/order driver as ordinary
sampling. The architecture's actual sampling group, authority, and canonical rank
are bound against the retained native request table. A single step source moves
through its prediction scope set into the SamplingEvent context; it does not use
the model invocation's closed weak group loan. Only the selected rank calls the
existing sampler and advances history/RNG. Other ranks complete their selected
sampling role with a paid immutable zero and the unchanged optional key.

Each reached token or stop Broadcast consumes the request's monotone control
cursor before source inspection and admission. Its real completed F32 contribution
selects the existing CPU Sum constructor, persistent communicator, physical backing
and accepted completion workers. The original control role worker now accepts
that closed owned invocation as well as agreements, retaining input, request and
native bank through completion or quarantine. The selected communication authority
still performs bounded waits and poisoning. Scalar reads occur only after actual
completion; the final U32 token is produced by the existing initialized-source
copy worker and retains its source/H. No second sampler, tensor source relabel,
ordinary collective fallback, or snapshot-refunded occurrence is introduced.


Original direct route completion preserves public `[send, receive]` values but
selects complementary native submission order from the actual directed route.
MLX reverses its BFS tape: the source endpoint submits `[receive, send]`, while
the destination submits `[send, receive]`. Thus one endpoint's blocking Send can
progress against the other's blocking Receive even beyond socket buffering.
The closed source retains this order with the same two-root capacity and accepted
completion; no array aliases, native tasks, or collective engine are added.
Multi-round Ring forwarding still requires actual intermediate-rank wave source
owners and remains a typed `LogicalWorldTransport` refusal at this route boundary.
The focused pair fixture now uses a 16 MiB strided payload in each direction and
fixed progress markers, while retaining the source-fence and escaped-H checks.

CPU explicit-key splitting uses the same RandomBits numerical body and Threefry
worker as ordinary execution. Its source counts the actual raw-pointer task,
one output backing and fixed captured key geometry; encoder cleanup retains the
original input/output while the task has no fabricated weak-array captures. The
shared single-output layout now distinguishes those actual task captures while
preserving the copy/unary/binary wrappers. Split-N and the existing static row
workers compose one or two completion roots in the same numerical role. Counts,
key geometry, declared output and source strides are checked before dispatch.
Uniform/categorical programs and model/BLAS consumers remain separately gated.


Cache disk work now travels through one explicit finite FIFO shared by ordinary
and prepared execution, replacing per-message channel allocation while keeping
the same admission and receive/execute/retire worker. The physical backing has
exact queue capacity plus one orderly-shutdown slot. Paid replacement is allowed
only on its exact idle worker; queued payloads and detached receivers retain the
backing account until actual retirement. Shutdown and cancellation drop backend
payloads outside queue/execution locks, and infrastructure failures are fixed
typed causes rather than newly formatted worker strings. This closes physical
queue storage; task/completion shells, typed native disk results and actual
read/write destinations remain independently required before managed Disk use.

### Generated string edge consumers

The portable template worker admits a generated receiver and generated prefix or
suffix through the existing paid contiguous-text materializer before calling the
same installed string-edge operation. Generated sequence candidates retain their
immutable value-arena sources and preserve first-match short circuiting, including
unread invalid later candidates. Their iteration/descriptor frames are counted.
Full released LFM tool argument construction exercises macro output, namespace
concatenation, generated joins and reasoning-content checks through the shared
public automatic/controlled chat driver.

The closed CPU Matmul source additionally describes the existing plain BF16 row
worker, whose FP32 reduction body is unchanged. It validates positive fixed-rank
matrix geometry, actual compact/transposed interiors, batch strides and the
signed `elem_to_loc` domain before installing the same Eval bank. The census
includes the raw two-input task, output backing and the ordinary temporary-batch
header even when its vector is empty. No BLAS/BNNS workspace is inferred from
this source, and this partial operation fact does not open CPU model or external
cross-device admission. F32's default BLAS path remains a separate mechanism.


The existing initialized native U32/I32/F32 source producer accepts scalar shape
`[]` only with exactly one source element. The empty shape product is one; a
nonempty shape still requires its actual dimensions, and zero dimensions, count
mismatches, invalid dtype, allocator/domain mismatch and capacity failures retain
their existing checks. This supplies the actual scalar F32 stop word used by the
shared sampling Broadcast, without relabeling it as `[1]` or creating a lazy
reshape. Scalar leaves use the same closed metadata/backing construction and
source custody as non-scalar leaves, with no runtime initialization or submission.

Saved Host-paged decoder inventory uses the same lexical physical operand visitor as its copy plan: Device/tail arrays and immutable Host allocations retain their actual identities and capacities in the existing `RetainedStorage` collector. Nonpaged states continue to inventory their full retained-array population. This closes the saved-source collector handoff without turning Host metadata into Array permission; resume source pins, transfer destinations and completion remain independently validated.

### Shared assistant generation-block normalization

The text crate now owns one cloneable byte-stream normalization used by ordinary
chat and by the admitted source compiler. Transformers generation/endgeneration
tags become the existing transparent if-true/endif spelling, preserving ordinary
whitespace controls, Unicode trimming, raw tag scanning and unterminated-source
behavior. Managed compilation feeds normalized bytes into its existing exact
decoded-source destination; it creates no intermediate String or syntax tree.
The fixed scanner/lookahead/UTF-8 controls are included in source requirements,
and source selection continues to retain the original config and its provenance.

The shared cache I/O worker can prepare exact-worker task boxes and completion shells under a retained metadata account. Prepared admission requires the existing finite queue and registry, rejects foreign workers and ordinary unqualified completion joins, and otherwise uses the same exact-key coalescing and physical worker. Refusal retains the unchanged task/source; joined unused tasks remain available for the backend's ordinary rollback-disarm handoff. Completion aliases retire their actual shared allocation before the funding alias. A borrowed result callback avoids cloning an output or ordinary error string. These shell/control producers do not qualify backend payload construction, thread startup, disk source access, serialization, read/write destinations or transfer capacity; original Disk paging remains closed until those actual consumers join.

### Shared ordered selection filters

The existing ordinary select/reject loop now drives both ordinary vector storage
and bounded immutable value-arena storage. Bounded truth and equality predicates,
including dotted attribute/index paths, preserve order and error precedence.
Input, comparison value, path, and current candidate have distinct paid registers;
selected borrowed results retain independent registers before iteration advances.
The returned value has the ordinary materialized sequence kind. Actual input
length bounds the finite result bank; no worker grows an unaccounted vector.
The full Llama tool/history integration exercises builtin tool exclusion,
custom schemas, builtin and custom calls, Unicode and both tool-placement modes.

### Generated filter-expression admission

The portable emitter now accepts expression inputs and separators for replacement
and join, whose existing paid contiguous-text consumers already handle those
values. Removed atom-only syntax gates had incorrectly rejected nested released
LFM escaping chains before those consumers could run. Runtime type/capacity
checks stay in the existing workers. Successful source-construction assertions
compare the exact normalized byte stream while retaining the original source
document, rather than equating transformed syntax with its unnormalized input.

### Original template identity across normalization

Prepared chat templates retain a fixed SHA-256/decoded-length identity of their
original selected source alongside normalized compiler data. Configuration checks
compare that original identity and selected name, so an equivalent if-true source
cannot impersonate a generation-block source. Hashing consumes the actual finite
source-byte view through a fixed buffer; its hash/buffer/cursor/output controls
are included in source construction requirements. No second source allocation or
ordinary named-template selection object is introduced. Invalid Unicode tag
whitespace remains a parser rejection even though normalization preserves it.

### Generated text comparison and membership

Generated string equality, ordering and membership now materialize their actual
UTF-8 view through the existing paid text consumer before invoking the ordinary
comparison/search kernels. Cross-type comparisons keep the ordinary kind ordering.
Generated mapping keys and sequence candidates use the same retained value/loan
paths. A zero-atom empty macro is a valid empty source view; empty owned slices
require no backing bytes and still reject nonempty or out-of-range geometry.
No recursive container equality is inferred from iterable length.

CPU F32 Matmul can now be explicitly selected from the bundled fixed-tile SIMD
implementation through a backend-neutral cold declaration of tile edge,
reduction lanes and index limits. Selection changes only a private scalar
StreamCopyPlan; its existing paid realization owns a new immutable context
wrapper over the same queue/device. Native Stream equality continues to identify
that queue, while exact stream-copy authentication and Matmul/AddMM primitive
equivalence include the numerical choice. No process-global or Scope-dependent
kernel switch is used. Default contexts keep their existing BLAS behavior.

The selected worker reuses the unchanged `simd_gemm` block/load/arithmetic body,
now with a shared batch wrapper for F32 and existing F16/BF16 non-Accelerate
wrappers. F32 accumulates SIMD partial sums into fixed 16x16 FP32 tiles; its
rounding may differ from platform BLAS, so ordinary and managed comparisons must
use the same retained choice. The direct source covers positive normalized
ranks 2..4, actual compact/transposed interiors and complete batch/stride spans;
all signed products and the tile-ceiling addition are checked. The original
source describes plain Matmul only; AddMM, required operand compaction and the
remaining CPU model operators need their own complete consumers before family
or cross-device admission can open. The selection itself conveys no source,
working-memory or submission authority.

Automatic CPU backend construction now consumes the explicit fixed-F32 matrix
choice when its compiled cold facts are present. Ordinary and managed requests
use that same chosen context; direct/default factories remain unchanged. The
context wrapper is produced by the existing prepared materialization stream
initializer from the exact source plan, and the CPU execution owner retains
both its copied context account and original stream/worker registrations. Pool
validation follows both owners. F32 selection affects only F32 products: other
dtypes retain ordinary dispatch, including the already source-visible BF16 row
worker. This completes context selection ownership, not CPU model admission;
remaining operator/recipe and external transport consumers stay independently
required.

The CPU source registry also qualifies the existing common nonempty Transpose
and Broadcast alias workers at ranks zero through four. Their immutable axes or
shape declarations are borrowed directly; evaluation validates exact permutation,
broadcast compatibility, canonical F32/F16/BF16/U32 representation, nonnegative
source strides and checked backing span. The same source check extends the existing
row-contiguous Reshape alias to F16/BF16. These workers retain the original buffer
and price inline stride/cleanup metadata; they create no backing or arithmetic task.
BroadcastAxes, empty allocation branches and noncontiguous reshape copies still
need their own source producers. These facts alone do not open CPU model or
cross-device admission.


Selected PP boundary dependencies borrow the actual model completion source
through the shared forward's existing separate control context. The context owns
only a paid, lexically closed weak root view; it does not enable the optional
neural TP policy. The native dependency callback authenticates the retained route,
source, funding and source endpoint, and uses the existing PreparedNestedRoots
producer and completion/Recovery publisher. The neutral driver's same bounded
wait remains authoritative. The root count must fit the enclosing model recipe
and an actually remaining native nested-completion attempt; this bridge creates
no Graph, Record, physical-backing or missing PP quotation credit. Context aliases
close at forward exit while unresolved native events remain in existing recovery.
The boundary frame and whole PP/combined quote producers remain required before
the managed path can be advertised.


PP boundary byte framing now has one shared encode/decode equation worker for
ordinary native arrays and the pure workspace trace. Encoding reinterprets the
actual scalar representation as U8, flattens, then concatenates the canonical
neutral header. Decoding slices the same header width, performs the existing
zero-add alignment copy when its byte offset is not element-aligned, reinterprets
and restores the logical tensor shape. No protocol bytes or family policy move
into the backend. Exact floating dtype evidence is required for byte widths.
The shared View/reshape/concatenation lowering prices fresh and growing high-rank
Shape/Strides destinations through the native copy-layout query and recognizes
the actual View primitive in the resident constructor bank. This source producer
supplies no route, completion or PP model admission by itself; the selected
boundary source/context and complete transport consumer remain required.

Live disk-cache publication now has a counted metadata destination sharing the ordinary filename formatter and hard-link/remove transition. Ordinary Disk manager initialization retains the existing process naming source. Prepared construction pays the concrete basename, staging/destination path buffers and shared file-owner allocation before construction; its failure keeps unchanged paths and custody, and an unpublished owner cannot delete a colliding destination. Actual staged payload writing/sync, SafeTensors serializer maps/buffers, OS I/O and disk transfer accounting remain separate producers. This component does not open original Disk paging admission.

CPU dense cold facts and the resident recipe reducer now consume one checked
operation plan for the explicitly selected F32 tile or existing BF16 row worker.
The plan uses actual represented, row-contiguous same-type sources and rank-two retained weights; rank-two
through rank-four inputs follow the ordinary flatten/Matmul/unflatten path.
Constructed dense projections also include weight Transpose and optional bias
Broadcast/Add. Its exact CPU Eval banks, physical births and final CPU completion
are separate from GPU, router and collective populations. Missing operations or
representations keep the trace incomplete. Biased Tensor::linear (AddMM), F16/mixed
model projections, packed formats, and complete external CPU family quotation
remain separate consumers; no CrossDevice/model admission gate is opened here.

The checkpoint artifact reader exposes an immutable `ArtifactFileVersion` captured
from an actual regular-file handle. Rebinding an opened handle compares the same
observable identity, extent and timestamps as the existing positional reader;
the actual read still checks before and after transfer and retains its handle
on failure. This descriptor grants neither file lifetime, payload storage nor
I/O admission. Cache publication/source owners must supply those independently;
this component does not open managed Disk paging.

Live-cache publication now retains the actual staging file handle across atomic
hard-link publication and captures its completed observable version. Both ordinary
and prepaid publication use this source contract. A subsequent prepared read
checks an opened handle against that retained version and consumes the existing
checkpoint positional reader; a same-sized or equal-content replacement is not
the original source. Runtime read controls and actual file/publication custody
remain live through failed reads. File opening, byte destinations, serializer and
native transfer admission are separate producers; managed Disk paging remains
closed until their actual consumer is joined.

The CPU dense plan also accepts exact row-contiguous BF16 input, weight and bias
representations. It selects the already-existing BF16 row Matmul and preserves
its F32 accumulation followed by BF16 result, then the ordinary BF16 bias-add
rounding. Transpose and reshape remain aliases. The physical workspace retains
the existing conservative F32 envelope; actual native backing dtype is checked
by each CPU source. F16 and mixed-dtype projections remain unqualified until
their separate selected worker/cast populations are provided.


### Original pipeline boundary frame execution

The explicit prepared pipeline route callback consumes the shared canonical
header packet under the current model/control context. Actual source dependencies
and the receiver placeholder needed by the existing logical pair exchange settle
through that model's already admitted nested completion bank. Each encoding,
route exchange and decoding attempt consumes the same request's monotone control
cursor; the cursor and accounting remain outside saved model state. The neural
parallel option remains distinct from the control-only context.

Frame encoding and reconstruction use the ordinary byte-view, reshape,
concatenate, slice and alignment materialization equations. Their finite
workspace reports select existing native graph, backing and pipeline-cache
producers. Logical transport consumes the retained endpoint plan and its real
send/receive sources; completion keeps complementary submission ordering and
actual accepted roots. The existing bounded wait may return its successful
completion owner for the outer shared driver; errors and deadlines preserve
its original quarantine behavior. Destination payload and received canonical
header share that exact event, and its existing resolver checks in-band bytes
before success. There is no synthesized header or completion receipt.

This consumer alone does not qualify unquoted PP model work. Actual cold
partition quotation must include model/placeholder nested completion attempts
and coexisting frame/transport backing before an original managed PP request is
admitted. Non-neighbor world forwarding still requires its real intermediate
rank participation source. No TP/PP support claim follows from this staged
consumer or from isolated route primitive results.

The same CPU operation plan and recorder now consume existing Add/Subtract/
Multiply/Divide and Square/Tanh sources for represented F32 or BF16 inputs.
Same-type compact operands use the ordinary broadcast aliases and unchanged
CPU arithmetic workers; the exact source banks and physical births accumulate
through residual/pointwise chains. Mixed types, generated scalar constructors
and other arithmetic operators remain absent until their own producers join.

The CPU original unary/binary source also refuses a contiguous input whose
inherited data_size exceeds the logical output size. Those ordinary branches
allocate or donate the inherited span, so row-contiguous flags alone cannot
justify a smaller logical envelope. This is checked before allocation and does
not change the ordinary numeric worker or claim a bound for the larger source.

The ordinary and bounded uppercase filters share one Unicode scalar traversal.
The ordinary filter preserves its existing safe-string policy; bounded rendering
writes each expanded UTF-8 character into the admitted generated-text destination
and retains that destination with the rendered prompt. Input materialization,
Unicode iterator/write frames and output expansion are accounted separately.

Filter mapping uses one ordered traversal in ordinary and bounded rendering.
The bounded adapter retains the input iterator and one destination register per
actual result, then invokes the admitted uppercase worker with its existing text
materialization and formatting controls. Unknown filter names remain an explicit
profile refusal until their actual consumers join this adapter.


The source-visible CPU Gather producer reuses the ordinary indexed-copy body
and its negative-index behavior for nonempty, one-index full-axis selection
(the geometry produced by `take`). It checks actual axes, slice/output geometry,
F32/BF16 storage with I32/U32 indices, nonnegative source/index strides and actual
backing spans. Ranks sum to at most four and checked products respect the worker's
integer loops. The descriptive layout is not evidence that index values are
valid: ordinary index/token validation and actual retained source binding still
apply. Multi-index, partial-slice and other dtype branches stay unqualified.
The same queued task owns the index vector and three weak descriptors; unchanged
cleanup retains their backing. Its existing iterator vector now uses the shared
Graph allocator, with both iterator construction and the vector destination
priced under that exact queued task's Graph loan through task destruction.
Floating `take` uses the same Squeeze alias worker and source geometry checks;
no fresh backing is attributed to that alias. These producer facts do not open
CPU model or cross-device request admission by themselves.

The checkpoint layer supplies a borrowed SafeTensors header plan for actual
ordered tensor declarations. It delegates dtype/shape/offset JSON encoding to
SafeTensors' public TensorInfo schema and the same compact serde_json serializer;
counting and writing share one immutable source. The plan validates canonical
dtype/name ordering, duplicate/reserved names, contiguous offsets, exact bit
extents and the existing header limit. It allocates neither an index map nor
payloads. Cache writers must independently fund declaration/header storage and
consume this same plan in ordinary and prepared paths before Disk admission.

Live-cache shard writes now share a neutral source/header worker in ordinary
and prepared construction. Actual stored tensor metadata is funded before its
shape vectors; the completed immutable source supplies the second-stage exact
header/Arc census. Both paths encode through the checkpoint header plan and
write the same canonical dtype/name order into the existing unique publication
staging path. The actual published source retains that header/layout. Its own
reads validate the captured file version plus exact header/extent and lend the
recorded payload spans, avoiding a new metadata index/parser. Persistent external
shards retain the existing strict parser. These components qualify no native
transfer or queue execution; the managed Disk consumer remains unfinished.
The version-bound positional live-read worker remains Unix-qualified; ordinary
non-Unix disk reads preserve their existing reader and gain only retained-header
validation, not original read admission.


Pipeline boundary destinations use the metadata context lent by the existing
model invocation. Runtime boundary schema validation and symbolic-dimension
resolution share their ordinary workers with counted role/shape destinations;
the dense no-auxiliary schema supplies the corresponding typed encode/decode
producer. Pipeline execution moves existing payloads and uses borrowed visits to
collect exact state/context completion roots under that same account. Unit names
remain architecture-owned and have an additive metadata destination hook. These
contracts do not grant native communication or completion authority, and do not
change the separate neural TP versus control-only PP selection. Other schema
producers must qualify their finite callbacks before original execution; the
completed public PP path still requires retained schedule quotation and native
frame/backing admission.

Default dictionary sorting now uses one stable ordinal-decorated heap traversal
for ordinary and bounded rendering. The worker has constant control depth and
no hidden scratch allocation; ties retain original pair order. The bounded
adapter pays one source, one ordinal and result per pair, and a comparison loan.
ASCII case-insensitive comparison shares an allocation-free byte iterator and
preserves non-ASCII bytes exactly, matching the selected MiniJinja configuration.
Optional Unicode folding and nondefault sort options remain separate profiles.


CPU boolean all/any and F32 last-axis row sums use the same named ordinary
Reduce task and unchanged numerical bodies. Their physical source checks the
actual normalized axes, exact output shape/dtype and backing spans. Boolean
all/any selects only the contiguous whole-tensor branch; F32 sums select only the
existing row-contiguous four-level cascade, preserving its reduction order.
Rank and product checks keep integer loops representable. The source prices both
weak array descriptors, the real output birth, cleanup, task and fixed SIMD or
cascade locals. Neither accepted branch reaches general strided reduction's
callbacks or temporary vectors. Boolean LogicalNot and shape aliases reuse their
existing workers with canonical bool storage. This qualifies the real validation
and normalization producers; it does not admit an incomplete embedding/model
recipe or the other Reduce branches.

Block assignment captures now use the same BeginCapture/EndCapture dispatcher as
ordinary evaluation. A bounded capture retains its parent, active macro depth
and accumulated text in three admitted value registers. It shares the existing
macro text writer without creating a lexical scope; nested captures, calls and
loops preserve assignment visibility and output destination. Generated map keys
use the same paid text materializer before ordinary key equality and retention.


An original partitioned model source now distinguishes its architecture-selected
neural TP group from its required output-publication group. Pure PP prepares the
actual publication resource and retains the same initialized allocator, group
inventory, stream, agreement inputs and request owner; it does not require a
fictitious neural Sum declaration. The shared model loan still binds and retains
the original observer, but lends no neural context in that case. Sum/Gather
quotation on such a source refuses, and publication continues to authenticate
its exact selected group/root. This does not enable PP admission before its
retained architecture schedule and full boundary recipe are quoted.


The original live-cache Disk writer now has a closed Host-source preparation
producer. It selects the actual manager generation and stable Host block under
the existing lexical loan, reuses the ordinary stored-scalar and shard-header
workers, and prepares the unique publication destination before queuing work.
The existing finite cache I/O worker executes that one-use task; a preallocated
shared typed outcome retains success or the exact filesystem/native failure
without formatting an ordinary error string. Host buffers retire before their
source pin and transfer reservation. Successful publication moves the actual
file-length Disk reservation into the existing shared live-file owner, so every
file alias retains the charge until final file deletion. Equal byte counts do
not substitute for the reservation or source owner.

This producer does not yet perform the canonical HostWriting-to-HostBacked
transition, install the manager's finite queue/registry, or admit public original
Disk paging. Those consumer joins and the prepared read destinations remain
required; no model-family or cache-policy gate is widened by this unit.


The CPU strict dense-embedding recipe now composes its actual normalization,
repeated token-bound comparisons, retained not/any validation root, safe-index
zeros/where, Gather and Squeeze producers. It retains five eager scalar sources
and the full validation producer population through completion, using the same
shared constructor/role mechanism. Physical scratch comes from selected index,
mask and scalar outputs, never a whole-table materialization. The floating
output uses the existing conservative F32 physical envelope while retaining the
actual F32/BF16 representation. Native Full accepts its existing scalar-copy
branch; Select accepts the existing compact contiguous ternary branch and prices
four weak wrappers. Their immutable physical sources validate actual shape,
dtype and backing before Eval. Unsupported partial/general/sentinel/packed paths
remain distinct until their actual consumers are qualified; this increment does
not open a full CPU model or cross-device request gate.


Disk task metadata installation uses the actual loaded manager and its existing
physical worker. It replaces that worker's idle registry/queue destinations and
the same canonical write-reservation table with finite paid storage. Generation,
worker identity, and idle checks remain mandatory. A partially installed failure
retains remaining destinations and prior empty storage; it starts no I/O and
changes no cache tier. The next producer must still authenticate and reconcile
actual completed writes before public original Disk admission.


Canonical Disk locations and queued read/write results now share one immutable
native descriptor owner. Ordinary construction retains its existing path/name
semantics, while an original producer prepays those exact strings, verification
cell and descriptor before I/O. Binding consumes only the unique prepared slot
and an actual versioned writer source with the matching retained layout. Clones
retain the same owner and file custody without copying paths or rebuilding
format metadata; descriptive fields still confer no read or execution authority.

Bounded chat measurement grows immutable scratch layouts geometrically between
completed attempts. The runtime admits the selected layout before allocation and
settles each attempt before retrying; if spare capacity cannot fit, it retries the
minimum actually reached by the interpreter. Final render destinations retain
their exact measured sizes. Generated text producers finish independently of
the VM operand stack, allowing object-key normalization at full stack capacity.


The selected CPU recipe also describes the existing learned F32/BF16 RMS
fallback and weightless F32 RMS. It reuses the native cascade row sum, divides
once by the actual width scalar, adds epsilon, applies reciprocal square root,
and preserves the cast before the learned gain. The unused BF16 custom-kernel
probe is included in constructor custody. Both scalar sources, full/row/vector
intermediates, the exact named fallback frame, and the unchanged CPU completion
population are counted. Native source validation remains authoritative for each
actual primitive. Empty or higher-rank inputs, mixed/unknown representations,
BF16 weightless reduction, grouped and offset scales remain unqualified by this
increment. These facts do not open general CPU model or CrossDevice admission.


CPU activation recipes now follow the existing SiLU and sigmoid layers: BF16 is
widened before the shared F32 negative/exp/add/divide or sigmoid worker, then cast
only at output. The actual CPU-declined pointwise probe has its own small control
census; no GPU kernel population is used to qualify it. SiLU's scalar one,
intermediate and result backing, shared aliases/worker sources and completion
remain owned by the same recipe. Direct exp/log also use their existing CPU unary
sources. These partial model facts do not open CrossDevice or general CPU model
admission; F16, unknown representation and unsupported activation policies remain
separate source obligations.


The original logical route worker now obtains its paired Send/Receive completion
source from the actual retained Group and immutable frame layout before binding
the real input. The C wrapper shares the same two-source validation and
Synchronizer/Event/Record tail with the existing settled-input query. The native
route retains both persistent communicator loans, exact peers, complementary
submission order and original source/H through binding and failure. Binding
recomputes both operation sources and the full paired completion; equal layout
values or independently wrapped groups cannot replace the original source.
This descriptive cold source creates no proxy Array, permission or completion
claim. The complete PP model quote still requires its architecture-selected
boundary occurrences, frame backing and retained partition-driver consumer.


Ordinary unbounded SiLU gated products compose the same CPU activation and
pointwise multiplication plans over borrowed source layouts. The activated gate
remains an intermediate with its complete backing and scalar custody; the final
product has its own output population. Dtype equality and equal gate/up geometry
are required by the existing plans. Scaled, clipped and offset policy branches
remain separate source obligations. This composition adds no native equation or
CPU-model/CrossDevice admission.


CPU row-contiguous Reshape, ExpandDims and Squeeze now emit the existing
`AliasInput` memory fact. Their outputs retain source storage, consume native
constructor/completion metadata and create no physical backing birth. ExpandDims
uses the ordinary common alias worker with exact checked inserted axes, dtype,
source span and output geometry. Allocation plans retain their prior semantics.
Transpose/broadcast and arbitrary-stride consumers are not inferred from this
row-view qualification; full CPU-model/CrossDevice admission remains separate.

Original saved Host copies settle their actual transfer completion and run the
same retained-observer completed-array transition used by copied Device leaves
before handing the Host alias to cold storage publication. This transition
submits no work and accepts only the same completed role event; it detaches the
completed descriptor event so certified Host allocation identity/capacity can be
observed. The destination and recovery roots retain failures, and the source
inventory continues to reject unknown backing instead of inferring capacity
from tensor geometry. The copy census includes the observer validation frames.

Filtered chat loops use shared begin/append/end collection instructions in the
ordinary and bounded VMs. Filtering retains accepted values before body iteration,
so loop length, last-item checks and outer loop bindings retain ordinary semantics.
The bounded collector reserves its input-length arena before iteration, keeps
borrowed values in their admitted registers and never grows the operand stack.
Its nested continuation metadata and unused reserved slots remain accounted for
until the render attempt retires.


The next CPU model source is tied to the Gemma DraftStep entrance: concatenate
its target embedding and previous hidden state. The existing two-input native
worker now uses the shared inline/Graph-owned Shape for its prefix sizes and
keeps the same GeneralGeneral copy calls. Its exact bank counts one output birth,
two destination slice descriptors, four weak task aliases and both queued jobs,
including their worker scratch and retirement. Cold facts authenticate the
joined geometry and actual equal F32/BF16 representation; two possible promotion
casts stay funded. This closes one reached producer, not whole-model admission.

The original Disk write operation now consumes the actual installed finite
worker and source-owned task. It revalidates the manager, generation, exact Host
buffer pointers and sole owned source pin before the shared `begin_write`
transition, then enqueues through the existing worker. The same task completion
is borrowed and matched by identity before `finish_write` publishes its paid
immutable location. The published file owns its exact Disk reservation; the
transfer reservation absorbs the actual removed Host charge while the task still
holds those buffers. Canonical reports and physical pool custody stay distinct.
Cancellation removes only the matching canonical row before source-pin teardown;
failed completion and publication retain their real file/Host prefixes.

Local Disk policy uses one shared logical inventory tally for ordinary and
prepared writes. Physical file bytes, including the actual SafeTensors header,
remain separately charged by the file owner. New prepared source facts still do
not authorize tensor materialization or a public Disk inference path. The
remaining original Disk join is the version-bound read into a paid Host
destination, its shared promotion/policy-bank itinerary, and the resulting
public request/resume validation.


Original synchronized text sampling retains its immutable U32 output through a
separate source-construction component sealed by the shared text controls before
acceptance. The component uses the existing `OriginalHostSourceBank` transaction:
the actual completed prepared-input leaf publishes and attaches its canonical
immutable registration before the model inventory or a pending-token snapshot
can observe it. Its source receipt remains with the native arena through final
retirement. Host cache/paged source banks remain independently owned; neither
model rollback nor a failed token construction refunds source bytes or attempts.
The shared sampling rank driver and wire conversions are unchanged.

The original external-assistant phase now reads the immutable device and CPU
matrix implementation from its actual retained Draft stream. Its one shared
parameter/input projection, constructor, equation trace and completion recipe
use CPU facts/recording only for that CPU source; GPU sources keep their existing
Metal facts. This is a scalar source inspection with paid controls, not a new
stream or a selection override. Platform-default CPU F32 still has no asserted
BLAS bound. Missing CPU operators leave the complete equation unqualified, and
this change does not open cross-device public admission.

Filled immutable Host sources share one native destination/observation/attachment
transaction. Dense foreground reads pass their unchanged exact one-use peak
retirement permit through a typed adapter; cumulative source-bank constructors
cannot satisfy that peak permit. The exclusive writer may cross only the I/O
worker boundary, while freeze and canonical registration still require the
creating thread after actual byte initialization. This shared worker creates no
file selection, read completion, materialization or new public paging authority.

The concrete Gemma CPU DraftStep source now includes its unit-axis transpose
pairs and exact F32 GELU. Transpose retains the existing native alias worker and
original storage; shape-only descriptors qualify a row layout only when nonunit
extents are distinct and stay in order. Equal nonunit-axis permutations remain
unqualified without a richer physical descriptor. GELU uses the unchanged
`x * (1 + erf(x / sqrt(2))) / 2` worker order, three actual scalar sources, and
separate cast/broadcast/Erf/binary populations. It does not substitute a tanh
approximation or combine the two divisions. Both additions feed the same CPU
recorder; rotary and attention still require their actual sources before this
assistant invocation can be admitted.

Structural chat equality uses one iterative short-circuit driver. The ordinary
storage adapter retains its actual object iterators, custom comparison and
unknown-length map behavior. The bounded adapter stores container pairs,
parent/index continuations and borrowed child loans in the admitted value arena.
Both retain scalar coercion and object identity semantics; no recursive Rust
input walk or unpriced container conversion is introduced.

The saved paged Host projection may retain its exact source-owned future Host
itinerary while that itinerary is empty. Resume copies validate the same metadata
context, no recorded entries/loads and no stored or selected block effect before
sharing it with the copied state. A started itinerary remains a typed refusal;
this does not replay stores, authorize native transfers or replace source pins.
The ordinary complete-source projection still owns the itinerary used by the
subsequent equation quote and native source binding.

Saved Host resume quotes source-construction facts from the exact retained
itinerary and the same final Host-store layout producer. It does not reserve a
successor manager by using the saved manager as authority. After actual copy,
publication and independent backing/grouping checks, the new manager inherits
only the quoted metadata itinerary, prepares the existing Host program and
compares its constructor facts with those admitted by the saved quote. Fresh
manager pins, cache-pool reservations and native source-role banks remain the
actual execution owners; source mismatches refuse before the run is exposed.


Distributed framed-boundary quotation derives physical backing from the same
allocator worker as accepted CPU operations. The cold pair uses its retained
Send/Receive layout and group source without a placeholder Array; the framed
control consumer reads that requirement before role construction. Actual input
rebinding, constructor acceptance and independent completion/backing authority
remain mandatory. This source completes the frame requirement without widening
pipeline model admission before its shared architecture quote is connected.

The Gemma CPU DraftStep rotary source now follows the existing default,
nontraditional, full-width F32 RoPE fallback. Its F32 Arange producer uses the
unchanged sequential-addition body in a named task; the exact zero-input Eval
bank retains output backing through cleanup and task completion. The source
checks finite primitive start/stop/step against actual rank-one output length,
and rejects count overflow before any fixed destination is published. Sine,
cosine, frequency products, half slices and concatenation reuse their ordinary
workers, with every native birth bounded by the actual input extent and three
separately counted scalar seeds. Named fallback callbacks share the ordinary
body and expose their fixed controls. No fused rotary kernel or alternate
position equation is introduced. Partial-width, explicit-frequency, alternate
rounding and grouped-query attention sources are not claimed by this increment.

Original live-cache Disk reads select the manager's actual immutable publication
and retained writer layout, bind an opened handle to its exact file version,
and prepay the full byte destination plus final Host writers. The existing disk
worker only reads and fills those exclusive destinations. Creator-thread
completion reuses the dense filled-Host registration worker; no native calls or
new source grants run on the I/O thread. Success and failed partial reads retain
file/layout, native prefixes, canonical pins, cache-pool reservation and H until
their actual owners retire. Canonical DiskReading publication and native
promotion remain separate consumers; these source facts alone do not open the
managed Disk policy or the external/persistent shard parser path.

The concrete Gemma DraftStep CPU attention source preserves the existing
mask-free F32 SDPA fallback, including its actual grouped-query rank-five
unflatten/broadcast shapes. The retained F32 SIMD mechanism now reports that
rank; native alias/row-reshape/softmax sources use the same fixed workers and
require the compiled Shape/Strides inline capacity to cover five axes. No
higher-rank heap population is assumed. The native source still validates
actual matrix interiors, strides, source backing, output extents, and selected
kernel before installing an Eval bank. Matmul's two ignored broadcast axes now
reach the same existing AxisView worker directly, avoiding a temporary ordinary
vector; multiplication and reduction order are unchanged.

The CPU recorder prices both score and value matmuls, precise row softmax,
actual repeated-head geometry, scale scalar, all source aliases/casts and final
flatten. Named SDPA callback controls share the ordinary fallback body. The
one-layer Gemma trace now requires every actual operation to have a source;
this is not a public admission claim or a replacement for a native complete
assistant invocation. Masks, sinks and alternate arithmetic remain separate
source requirements.

The chat facade observes one local timestamp during request-context preparation.
The immutable scalar facts survive every measurement retry and both prompt
variants. The shared text formatter uses Chrono's original local-date parser and
direct writer; generated bytes and formatter controls are part of the existing
render admission. It allocates no intermediate date String and never rereads the
clock during bounded rendering. Host clock/timezone acquisition remains an
environmental observation at context preparation, separate from render storage.
The local-only source rejects offset-bearing format requests instead of supplying
fabricated offset facts; ordinary formatting retains its full offset behavior.

The original Disk read consumer uses the same exact-key worker admission and
DiskReady/Reading/HostBacked state transitions. Its pending row shares the actual
Host reservation; canonical telemetry includes that capacity while physical pool
publication excludes a duplicate charge. Only completed creator-thread source
registration permits Host publication. Failure restores the same file/ticket
state and retains completed or partial buffers. Native source arenas also retain
the Host reservation across deferred worker-side destruction; I/O-transfer
occupancy is a distinct real token. Final success moves Host charge into the
actual manager through the existing replacement publication, without a refund
or a synthetic backing identity. Cancellation removes only this consumer's row
and never claims I/O completion.

The CPU assistant validation now includes the existing complete Gemma `DraftStep`
with nonzero parameters, token embedding, hidden state and shared target K/V.
The native fixture projects those completed sources into the family operation,
reduces its actual CPU trace, derives Graph/Record/physical capacities with the
same source queries, and invokes the same module under original native controls.
It compares ordinary logits and updated hidden state, checks the real offset
advance, and holds each escaped output until its native ownership retires. This
is a complete native equation check; neutral request admission and the remaining
ordered-readout/cross-device public consumers are separate requirements.

Original saved-text resume installs the same retained executable parameter
representation inventory used by initial and completed-media quotation before
reconstructing the resumed equations. The existing source visitor pays its
metadata on the resumed context and retains the source/epoch validation contract.
New paged K/V values therefore carry their actual scalar representation into the
shared conditional Host-store itinerary; no cache dtype is inferred from logical
extent, and this descriptive handoff grants no allocation or transfer authority.

The CPU greedy consumer now admits the existing logit-policy metadata trace
through its completed-source validation. Only a genuinely empty trace returns
the existing immutable source alias; nonempty CPU policy operations still need
a complete native recipe. The common commitment check accepts authenticated
completed F32 CPU logits and preserves the same token-domain and request checks.
This closes the host policy handoff after the already qualified CPU argmax; it
does not grant a cross-device request or a new numerical operation.

Original cache-file reads can prepare the existing Host-to-Device promotion
worker only after the exact read has completed and published HostBacked storage.
The new closed witness retains those immutable buffers, the completed task/file
version and source pin, physical occupancy, and accepted source account. Binding
checks the same manager generation, canonical file and buffer identities, current
scan role, and exact retained selected block geometry. The shared transfer,
completion-root union, Device publication and return-to-Host mechanisms then use
that witness; a raw path, matching shape or read completion alone grants nothing.
This producer currently binds retained rows. Future append-row Disk declarations,
finite request read/write itinerary integration, and cold Disk projection remain
required before managed Disk admission opens.

Bounded chat neighbor lookup borrows the existing immutable loop source at the
previous or next selected index, preserving filtered order and undefined edges.
The same frame owns the input loan through nested calls; operand/local registers
retain selected neighbors without a prefetched heap list. Source admission fixes
plain-text autoescape, so the safe filter uses the existing string-conversion
instruction; HTML escaping and safety introspection remain outside that profile.

The original Disk writer now accepts the finite request bank's exact lexical
source-pin inventory. The shared standalone writer still requires no preexisting
owners. Both entries use the same source/file/task producer and demand-lease
checks; the request entry first compares the actual bank-owned pins under the
same manager loan, then retains its additional write pin. Pending and final
publication require that exact total, so foreign pins or changed ownership cannot
be hidden by an arbitrary count. Real old Host resources remain charged through
their owners. This closes the pin-aware write producer; finite Disk itinerary
storage and source/destination admission remain required before public selection.

The CPU ordered-readout partition source shares the ordinary ArgPartition task
and the existing eight-class Graph bank. Its finite source query covers F32
rank-one through rank-three last-axis partitions; the actual native consumer
checks positive extents, kth, output dtype/shape, checked strides and physical
source span before installing that bank. Rank-three leaves at most rank-two
iterator geometry within the bundled native inline containers. Equal-key and
NaN ordering remains the existing nth_element/sort behavior. This producer does
not by itself admit the remaining ordered Gather/Scatter/Min/Full composite.

The CPU one-index Gather source also admits I32/U32 tables and a combined
source/index rank of five. This is the existing ordered-readout selection of
centroid rows by a rank-three index, followed by the shared Squeeze alias.
The same queued GatherTask, signed-index rule, complete-slice geometry checks,
checked extent products, and task-owned iterator Graph loan are used. The
source and index remain exact borrowed native inputs; integer token order is
copied without conversion or sorting. This source increment does not qualify
the complete ordered output composite or widen public placement admission.

The paged Disk itinerary prepares each possible writer's exact immutable shard
header, publication path, output shell and reservation-table destinations from
the selected page declaration before any Host value exists. At the actual policy
step, one-use binding checks that same declaration against canonical immutable
Host buffers and the closed source-pin claim, then reserves actual Disk/transfer
occupancy and enters the existing writer. Ordinary stable-source preparation now
uses that same destination and binding worker. The destination contains no
placeholder tensor and cannot submit I/O until a real source binds; public Disk
admission still awaits the complete read/write policy itinerary and source bank.

CPU ordered-output masking uses the existing F32 last-axis SIMD minimum and
Full's copy from the completed per-row broadcast. The minimum source proves
a single contiguous reduction row (or the existing all-contiguous case), so
the selected worker uses neither the general recursive callback nor scratch
vectors. Singleton minima remain ordinary aliases. Full validates the exact
stored row count and broadcast strides before admitting the existing General,
Vector, or scalar copy worker. Checked output/source extents and native task
custody remain required; no ordered-family or public placement gate opens from
these partial sources.


The prepared dense pipeline path retains the architecture's original execution
plan, unit addresses and selected communication declarations. Its cold quote
uses the ordinary partition scheduler and boundary contract writer through a
metadata-only communication adapter in `eredu-runtime`. A separate control
context carries that source; it does not populate the optional neural tensor
parallel context for a pure pipeline partition.

MLX lowers each recorded boundary through its shared byte encoder, retained
logical Send/Receive pair, and decoder. The quote owns the exact native
constructor, evaluation, backing and completion sources. At execution, a
monotone invocation cursor authenticates the canonical frame and actual tensor
against that source before the existing workers bind it. The lexical model loan
retains the parent invocation; child recovery retains only the array-free
boundary recipe and source custody. Child allocations share the request's
physical allocator census, while each child has its own funded Graph/Record
role and completion. No child primitive is counted as a parent GPU operation.
The initial vertical consumer covers resident pure PP; combined TP/PP requires
its matching neural subgroup source in addition to these same route sources.

The source-qualified CPU ScatterAxis overwrite path retains one three-input
Eval cleanup across both ordinary jobs: the initial source-to-output copy and
the existing indexed overwrite worker. Its immutable query counts five weak
array descriptors, the real output birth, both queued task owners, both worker
loans, and the normal input cleanup. Native admission authenticates exact F32
source/update shapes, I32/U32 indices, final-axis geometry, and checked logical
and physical spans. Duplicate and negative indices keep the ordinary worker's
order and semantics. Donation may reduce work but never reduces the declared
source bound. This completes only the scatter producer; complete composite
quotation and public ordered assistant parity remain independent obligations.

The original Disk write destination also owns its exact worker/key task box and
completion before source binding. The neutral cache worker exposes a one-use
empty payload slot; binding moves the actual backend task into that same storage
without allocation or changing its key. Ordinary `prepare_task` uses this same
slot worker. The native write destination prepays operation/report controls and
later authenticates the same metadata account, manager, generation and worker.
No file or cache source authority is granted by an empty task slot.

Ordered CPU indexing uses the same Squeeze alias through rank five and the
existing row-contiguous Reshape for signed I32 token IDs. Both preserve the
source's storage identity; the actual rank, dimensions, canonical element width
and backing span remain checked. No copies or numerical conversions are added.
The pending integer Gather/take case exercises these exact alias consumers.

The original paged Host itinerary now owns one finite installed disk queue and
registry per actual manager, sized by its selected write/read occurrences. Host
pressure selects the same portable LRU/LFU tier-move predicate with required,
prefix and demand protection, and consumes the selected page's prepared durable
writer. The driver retains the operation before enqueue, awaits that exact task,
and commits the existing canonical write transition before claiming Host space.
Source pins permit a tier move only after the native writer authenticates the
whole bank-owned population. Completed writes, old Host backings and physical
occupancy remain in their actual owners. Disk read/reload and backed-tier release
remain required before the public Disk admission gate can open.

A completed original Host-to-Device promotion retains the exact durable backing
alongside its native outputs. When the same cache policy selects that Device row
again, it uses the existing backed Device-to-Disk storage transition. The native
consumer verifies the file owner, completed array allocations, manager generation
and full source-pin population before publication. Replaced native arrays remain
inside the same promotion/completion owner; its existing reservation receives
removed canonical occupancy, without a physical refund. Failed pool publication
restores the exact backed Device state before unlocking.


Original framed PP transport can retain every forwarding round of an actual
logical Ring route. The source first authenticates the unchanged retained
world-participation proof and matching canonical role schemas across the
selected submission wave. Each cold round retains its own exact native
constructor/Eval/Graph/Record/backing source. At execution it binds the actual
completed output of the previous round, spends a new control occurrence, and
uses a separate child role through the existing accepted pair and completion
worker. No terminal child scope is reopened and no arbitrary round count is
accepted. Legacy single-round source callers retain their existing refusal.
This supplies the route half of combined TP/PP; logical TP subgroup numerical
sources remain independently required before the combined model gate opens.


### Managed text chat permission parity

The facade uses the ordinary text-chat eligibility predicate before bounded
rendering. When that predicate excludes actual tools, a parallel-tool permission
and permission for raw reasoning do not themselves add renderer bindings or
semantic parsing. Managed automatic and controlled text chat therefore accept
those passive permissions without a separate policy gate. Explicit thinking and
reasoning-effort mapping still need the selected facade format policy and remain
typed unfinished integrations; this does not claim semantic tool parsing.


The original pipeline cold quote compares the actual session state with the
same retained constructor's owned global unit slice. `ArchitectureParameters`
continues to expose the complete tensor-local layout used by the shared
partition driver. The existing metadata-funded state slice worker performs the
local comparison; rank geometry is not reconstructed and no full-model state
is allocated or substituted for the rank's mutable state.


The shared cache residency pool detaches an empty manager or reservation table
when its final actual member retires. The table allocation and its retained
preparation funding are dropped after the pool mutex is released. An externally
retained empty pool therefore does not retain the latest copied provider's
snapshot or branch lease through unused table capacity. Occupied tables and
individual reservations retain their actual owners; aggregate peaks and
cumulative copy spending are unchanged. A subsequent original insertion still
requires its own paid destination table.


Original multi-round pipeline frame validation uses the neutral manifest's
metadata-funded route-wave producer. It reserves exact route-range and endpoint
populations before the same canonical ordinary wave validator runs. A retained
world-wave proof remains distinct from equal frame contracts and exact native
round sources; none of these descriptions grants submission authority.


The original Disk itinerary prepares each selected read's exclusive Host fill
destinations, complete shard byte buffer, task payload slot, completion slots,
and real pool reservations from the exact retained writer layout. Those
containers are paid before publication. The accepted source constructor binds
the same filled-Host worker; later selection authenticates the actual published
file/version, canonical manager/generation and shared writer-layout owner before
pinning it. Opening and task handoff occur outside the manager loan. A failed
construction retains its actual native prefix in the finite itinerary. Existing
stable-file preparation uses this same destination worker. These destinations
alone do not authorize a read, Device promotion, or public Disk execution.


Each original paged Disk load now consumes its finite prepared read destination,
authenticates and opens the writer's actual published file outside the manager
loan, and retains the task/completion before starting the shared I/O worker.
Only a positively completed, canonical Host publication can fill that load's
prepaid Device-promotion slots. Both retained and future-declared pages use the
same existing promotion, scan, pin and backed-Device return workers. The source
bank counts each real completed-read pin alongside writer/promotion pins.
Successful task-resource waits follow exact-key registry retirement so a later
load occurrence receives its own completion and payload; older output tickets
retain their own sources. These joins preserve the separate public Disk gate
until initial Disk-only state projection and saved-state copy also have sources.


Original combined TP/PP model execution retains logical tensor subgroups as
logical groups over the exact prepared Ring world. An adjacent two-member
subgroup uses the ordinary direct pair equation; it is never relabelled as a
native whole-world Sum/Gather or as a pipeline route. The common paired native
producer retains an explicit group-or-route selection through its accepted
constructor and matching completion resource entry. Explicit routed collective
plans and non-adjacent tensor groups retain a typed refusal until their own
ordinary consumers have complete original producers.

The model quote retains the actual pair census plus separate dependency and
final reduction/gather numerical recipes. Runtime settles the real lazy partial
through its explicit parent-model root loan, then separately admits the pair,
`received + sent * zero`, and result stages with the request's monotonic event
cursor. Children own actual arrays and array-free source recipes; they never
retain the parent model State or its Q. Failure preserves the accepted owners
and spending. The architecture chooses the neural TP slot from its retained
selected group while the world-control slot remains independent; pure PP keeps
its neural slot absent. The public combined fixture uses four real local Ring
ranks, nonzero Qwen parameters, chunked prefill and cached decode, comparing
ordinary, managed and controlled output against serial execution.


Portable paged metadata distinguishes actual tensor-backed state from opaque
read-source geometry. A declared read handle contains only its trace identity,
shape and scalar representation; it creates no Tensor, storage identity or
Host-store effect. Both passes of the existing paged scan use the same Host-load
worker as stored values. Native adapters must bind the exact retained file,
manager, version and accepted source custody before materializing a load. State
storage visitors omit opaque reads, and active transfer traces remain ineligible
for saved-source relabeling. Tensor-origin inspection now explicitly returns
`None` for a read that has not produced a Tensor.

The CPU row-contiguous Reshape source validates the native primitive's requested
shape against the resolved output. One `-1` is accepted only when every other
extent agrees and the checked complete input/output products match. This is the
existing shared-buffer Reshape worker; no copy branch, new backing, task, or
native admission authority is added. Source controls include the inference flag.

A native Muse fused-source fixture uses the released assistant geometry and its
actual cached BF16 checkpoint, selected and registered by the shared external
materializer. Target compatibility consumes only the released target config.
Nonzero ordered taps first traverse the ordinary RawContext/UpdateContext
workers; their completed encoded/K/V values then feed the same FusedProposal in
ordinary and original native execution. The fixture quotes actual parameter and
input descriptors, derives Graph/Record/Buffer capacities from that trace, and
checks that escaped output retains its native account until destruction. This
is an assistant equation/source check; it does not assert full target or public
request parity. The ignored native case requires explicit artifact paths and
has not yet been executed.


Complete paged projection retains each actual own-writer file owner beside its
manager pins, including file/version/layout identity and physical Disk charge.
An initial Disk-only row supplies opaque read geometry to the shared paged scan;
it contributes no invented Tensor or native allocation to the storage census.
The finite read itinerary reuses that file's exact immutable writer layout and
pays real Host and Device destinations before execution. External/persistent
shards still require their separate parser/source producer. Backed hot-row
retirement and saved Disk-state copying remain separate execution joins; this
projection does not open public admission.


An initially hot paged row with an existing immutable Disk backing retains both
its real tensor roots and an opaque read source. Its maximal transfer itinerary
contains reloads without a redundant Host-store or file publication. Returning
it to Disk uses the same canonical Device-to-Disk worker as completed read
promotions: exact source/ID/pins and backing are checked, rollback restores the
same row, and removed Device arrays stay beside their real pool reservation
until native retirement. The return does not refund physical storage merely
because canonical Device occupancy decreased.

### Retained parallel sources for saved text continuation

Original saved-text quotation uses the saved local decoder and populated sampler with the same retained partition constructor as initial generation. A fresh planning account prepares the exact current model communicator table and feeds the existing native parallel fact/recipe worker; it neither projects the later live decoder nor copies request control authority from the snapshot. The shared partition equation visitor accepts configured or borrowed sampling inputs through one implementation.

The admitted resumed request owns its own monotone control cursor and lends a weak, scoped communicator projection to the existing all-rank control-state exchange. Completed copy sources and nonrefundable snapshot/copy spending remain under their existing owners; the projection closes on success, failure, and unwind. The focused public two-rank lifecycle fixture uses the shared snapshot/restore/fork checker, including cancellation, a refused one-byte restore, independent continuation, and final custody retirement. Native validation is pending the staged build.

The MLX paged saved-state copy retains exact own-writer Disk locations and file
reservations in an independent canonical namespace. Disk-only rows have no
numerical copy operands; Device and Host rows use their existing copy worker and
retain their immutable backing alongside the new payload. The actual installed
I/O worker is shared, with no new thread or task grant. Cold metadata checks compare
the retained layout, scalar representation, shape, path, names, byte extent and
physical Disk reservation before copying or pinning. Logical snapshot estimates
conservatively include shared file bytes; physical Disk occupancy remains owned
once by the real publication source. Persistent/external cache files still require
their separate parser/source admission. This copy producer does not open the
original Disk execution gate; the invocation and resume source/role joins must
also complete.

### Global partition addresses and local resident policy slots

The cold pipeline adapter constructs units from the exact retained partition address sequence, using the same addressed-unit worker as ordinary native partition preparation. Architecture constructors continue to receive global group/unit addresses; the resident policy receives only those completed units, in matching local-slot order. A full-graph resident constructor is not an intermediate step for a local partition. Both workspace destination vectors and the shared build/result frames are counted before use; partial construction retains the enclosing source account through retirement.


### Retained rounds for nonadjacent logical TP pairs

The native logical pair consumer now traverses the same borrowed exchange plan and round fold as ordinary execution. Each actual round has a retained native layout, exact source/group identity, ordered send/receive roots and completion capacity. The request cursor spends a fresh claim for each reached exchange and arithmetic stage; snapshots do not restore those claims. Opposite pairs require the existing consensus-proven world participation wave in both the logical group and retained declaration. Actual native endpoint order breaks blocking send cycles while public pair outputs remain send then receive. Adjacent pairs remain one-round instances of this same worker. Larger or other selected groups still retain typed refusal until their separately selected packed-world producer and consumer are joined.

Original paged full-attention admission now includes configured live Disk storage.
The option predicate supplies eligibility only: each request still constructs the
same source-derived finite writer/read destinations, task queue/registry slots,
version-bound file source, filled-Host publication, promotion and scan role bank.
Saved state retains immutable own-writer files in independent namespaces while
copying actual hot payloads; reset uses the same empty-manager constructor.
Canonical tier occupancy is separate from the physical pool, whose old roots,
read destinations, writes and copied owners remain charged until real retirement.
The public Disk parity/lifecycle companion is staged for central native validation;
this admission change itself is not a successful native execution claim.

The external placement binder can describe the concrete Metal-target /
Float32Tiles-CPU-draft pair only from their actual retained stream sources and
shared pool. The shared external batch entry passes all three declared topology
forms to this mandatory binder, including CrossDeviceSplit; unknown forms and
autoregressive drafts still refuse that external entry. Every model, numerical
and independent-copy operation still needs its exact source and admitted recipe;
the placement description grants none.
The public CPU assistant case uses the existing unordered Gemma fixture with
nonzero weights, three prefill windows and four generated tokens, comparing
ordinary, managed and controlled execution with identical unfiltered greedy
settings. Ordered CPU readout, nonempty CPU sampling policies, and the reverse
CPU-target placement remain separate implementation requirements.


The selected CPU ordered-vocabulary recipe composes the existing centroid
partition, integer ordering gather, selected weight gather, F32 tiled product,
row minimum, stored broadcast fill and final overwrite scatter. It counts every
actual parameter/result shell, frontend cast/broadcast candidate, native Eval
job and selected weight replica from the request geometry. Minimum and indexed
overwrite keep their ordinary numeric workers and ordering. The fill can retain
compact row-broadcast backing; Scatter's real copy supplies the final dense
output. This source qualification does not itself open external public placement
admission or assert completion of the whole assistant invocation.

The GPU-target/selected-CPU assistant continuation fixture uses the same native
artifact, placement and unfiltered greedy mechanism as its uninterrupted case.
It calls the existing controlled continuation driver for snapshot, restore,
fork/exchange, forced-token isolation, and calibrated cumulative copy/trace
refusals. Target state copies use the retained target environment; key snapshots
lend the exact stream's retained target or draft environment and independently
completed copy source. Releasing saved objects never refunds cumulative limits.
The case is staged, not yet validated; other device directions or CPU mechanisms
remain subject to their explicit source admission.


The facade's forbidden tool-trigger controller now shares one borrowed byte
matcher with ordinary automatic activation. Its pending state is a length into
its immutable trigger; checking a candidate or advancing this state constructs
no token-sized scratch or activation buffer. Automatic grammar activation still
uses its existing materialization/llguidance worker and remains separately
unqualified. `ConstraintController::prepare_forbidden_source` copies the exact
packed token vocabulary, trigger and durable history into paid fixed buffers,
retaining the original tokenizer-validity owner and the host account through
source and failure retirement. The packed offset reader and forbidden predicate
are shared with ordinary controller execution. This source is descriptive: it
neither authenticates another source nor grants model execution, filter output
storage, continuation copying or semantic event publication. Public prepared
semantic/controller managed-capacity guards remain until those actual consumers
and prepared-input attribution are joined. Full llguidance Matcher/fork storage
is still a distinct missing producer for automatic and required tool calls.


### Cold single-operation distributed completion source

The immutable layout and actual settled-input distributed sources now enter the same native single-operation completion worker. It derives the same constructor/Eval, root, CPU Synchronizer, Event, Graph and Record populations; layout quotation creates no tensor or grant. A retained Rust completion source owns the exact native group incarnation and paid shape, and rebinding accepts only the selected actual group and a detached completed input whose original source populations and complete traversal still match. The existing accepted constructor and completion remain the executable path. This is a prerequisite for larger logical TP packed-world stages, not permission to substitute a native world operation for a logical collective.


### Partition parameter identities and resident storage slots

The native parameter representation visitor uses the retained global-to-local
partition address map to borrow each actual resident unit. It validates the
source layout against the local slot and preserves the module's global parameter
identifiers. A nonzero PP start no longer discards the complete dtype table merely
because global unit indices differ from local storage indices. Numerical scalar
facts still come from the actual native descriptors; no representation is
inferred from a logical shape or from the rank.

A later original paged append accepts a stable DiskReady row only when its actual
canonical file is the identical retained file from the current source bank or a
successfully committed write in that bank. A phase flag, path, or finished-but-
rolled-back writer is insufficient. This validation runs under the existing
manager loan without opening or promoting the file. Public I/O checks settle
completed worker publications through the ordinary report/reap entry and test
actual retained backing files separately from canonical Disk-only row counts.

The original chat renderer accepts a borrowed scalar overlay for facade-produced
request controls. It applies the same last-insertion precedence as ordinary
keyword merging, above caller/default maps and below template-local assignment.
Boolean/text bindings remain lexical source indices through measurement and the
existing paid render worker; no merged map, arbitrary object or callback is
introduced. Protocol recognition and validation remain facade-owned: this scalar
carrier alone does not enable or identify a chat profile.


Resident target, prediction and external-assistant quotation now share the
actual retained-stream mechanism source in backend nn/workspace. The target
projection carries that immutable CPU/Metal choice to its recorder, so a CPU
stream cannot be projected with Metal operation facts. CPU Float32Tiles and
platform-default behavior remain the existing cold factory choices; this handoff
selects neither a kernel nor a stream. It preserves all exact parameter, cache,
input, completion and source-binding checks. Every CPU operation still needs its
source-visible recipe. Reverse CPU-target/GPU-draft public admission remains
closed pending a complete target trace and the corresponding Target-side
numerical consumers; this context/recorder join supplies no total-fit claim.
