Facade chat request controls are resolved by one allocation-free worker from the
actual recognized format profile. Ordinary preparation applies its fixed borrowed
bindings to the existing owned keyword map; the original renderer can borrow the
same scalar entries. Effort restrictions, thinking-disable conflicts, and Muse's
explicit strength precedence share validation and preserve ordinary diagnostics.
This worker consumes profile facts; it does not infer a protocol from model names
or authorize unbounded recognition in an admitted request. Managed explicit
controls still require the separate paid behavioral profile source.


### Selected packed-world logical TP stages

Larger and nonopposite logical tensor groups use the existing ordinary packed-world branch only when the actual logical group and retained declaration carry their consensus-proven world participation wave. The shared pack/extract worker keeps the same zero-filled world tensor, representative slot for Sum, rank slot for Gather and selected member order. Both ordinary and workspace adapters use the existing Reshape, static SliceUpdate, Index and Take primitives; there is no topology-specific arithmetic engine. A paid immutable I32 member input is constructed from the exact retained source before quotation.

Cold quotation retains the full native-world constructor/Eval/completion source and separately derives pack/extraction recipes. The actual model occurrence completes its lazy partial, then executes pack, native Sum and extraction under separate reached request claims, the existing child scopes and the accepted completion worker. Each failure retains the same source and H; no source identity is reconstructed and no cursor is snapshotted or refunded. Sum returns a view into the packed world, so its full physical backing remains in the logical output population. Explicit routed-value plans remain a separate typed applicability boundary until their existing route iteration is wired; they cannot enter packed-world admission.


The CPU numerical compiler now has a source for the existing sequential
UniformUnitInterval acceptance draw. It composes split-two RandomBits, two
Slice/Reshape key views, scalar F32 range subtraction, the draw RandomBits and
U32-to-F32 conversion, four scalar broadcasts and the existing Divide/Minimum/
Multiply/Add workers. The two completed roots are the draw and advanced key;
the caller replaces its key only after ordinary completion succeeds. CPU Eval
and completion controls come from their actual CPU layout queries, while the
shared constructor/physical recipe retains all eager scalar and attempted
buffer births. This grants no categorical, difference, or complete reverse
CPU-target placement support. The focused native fixture compares three seeded
draws and key states against ordinary CPU execution, failed-state preservation
and final escaped-key retirement; it is staged for central validation.

Completed original Disk reads use the same Host-to-Device promotion worker and
ordinary demand telemetry. Its closed completed-read witness now supplies the
existing disk-origin flag at the successful canonical Device publication. Host
reloads remain Host promotions; a retained file alone is not a Disk read, failed
publication creates no successful promotion, and one-use execution prevents
double counting. The public Disk check continues to require actual writes,
reloads and retained files rather than accepting only canonical tier movement.

The facade's Inkling behavioral recognition now uses one closed probe decision
worker for both storage modes. Its ordinary adapter consumes the same rich
history, effort and mapping/string tool JSON recipes; profile assembly and
recognizer ordering are unchanged. Structural token validation lives in text
and borrows a caller-owned exact result prefix while checking added membership,
forward/reverse identity, atomic encoding and duplicate IDs in ordinary order.
Encoding failures retain their actual payload. Original tokenizer sources expose
only immutable added-token identity; that fact authorizes no profile or encoding.
The shared probe/control worker does not itself admit JSON or rendering storage.
Managed explicit reasoning still requires the paid probe owner and original
render/encode adapter before its request gate can open.

Resident KV-only snapshot and restored-state construction now lend the accepted
host preparation to their actual empty fixed-role child tables. Each child uses
the existing dense host-slot worker, receives an independent prepared identity,
and retains the same host authority through metadata aliases. The exact source
plan prices every child constructor and its escaping typed error before copying.
The saved publication still authenticates prepared destination metadata; source
tables and ordinary unprepared identities are never promoted into that domain.


The CPU numerical correction consumer executes the same neutral two-cut program
as ordinary sampling: precise F32 normalization of both inputs, subtraction,
maximum with the actual zero scalar, and the ordinary all-axis total. Both roots
complete before the unchanged mass predicate decides whether to run Log. The
all-axis source authenticates the real contiguous full backing and complete axis
set, retaining the existing SIMD SumReduce order; it does not substitute the
separate last-axis cascade. Existing Softmax, binary, Broadcast, Squeeze and Log
source queries price the remaining CPU jobs. Each cut keeps its own actual graph,
completion and escaped-output custody under the same numerical request. The
source currently covers positive rank-two/three F32 inputs with more than one
element. Reverse CPU-target placement and Categorical remain separate consumers.


The CPU numerical categorical consumer composes the same source-derived
split-two/uniform population with the ordinary Gumbel Log/Negative sequence,
addition to the actual score row and final ArgReduce/Squeeze. F32 rank-two/three
rows with vocabulary wider than one use the same retained known-policy choice
and explicit key as ordinary sampling. Both selected token and advanced key
complete under the original numerical role; failure preserves the caller key.
Uniform and categorical share the shape-derived random population worker.
This adds no nonempty logit-policy source or reverse-placement admission.

Prepared profile probes have an additive readonly record declaration in the text
renderer dependency. It borrows explicit scalar/container fields and shares
ordinary map replacement order without creating serde maps, object callbacks,
VM state or allocation grants. Each producer must retain and price its actual
record/text storage through the lexical operation. This declaration alone is
not yet a render-source adapter or behavioral-profile admission; the existing
JSON input and explicit managed reasoning gate remain unchanged until their
shared worker consumer joins.

The record-source consumer now runs through the same structured registers,
lookup/iteration/equality/filter workers and iterative JSON formatter as borrowed
serde inputs. Effective object order follows ordinary map insertion/replacement;
key sorting uses the existing paid key bank. Only temporary lexical registers
retain input loans, and completed output copies its bytes before those loans end.
Record traversal uses the existing recursion ceiling, including cyclic static
records. Input descriptors supply no callback, allocation or profile authority;
actual request-level profile admission still needs its source-owned record
producer and the original render/encoding handoff.


The completed direct partition source retains the exact local
`SelectedStateRealization` produced by the same `for_partitioned_geometry`
worker that the ordinary session uses. TP and PP cold quotes borrow that result
and call the shared workspace-state validator before tracing equations. This
preserves the architecture's local component shapes, placements and paged
geometry without cloning the selected layout on each request. The local
selection is created only during initial model construction and belongs to its
existing immutable prepared source; each quote funds its new loan and result
frames and the validator's existing metadata worker.

This permits exact paged state projections for fully resident parallel weights.
The native page source, cache catalog, Host/Disk program, operation roles and
admission checks remain required. Host/Disk layerwise parallel weights still
need the checked parameter-source policy in the parallel quote; ordinary
partition construction already selects those policies, so this is an unfinished
managed consumer rather than a model-family limitation. Internal parallel
capture likewise requires its own prepared observer source.


The shared native parallel role keeps the selected completion deadline across
its callback and final scope observation. A completed event may precede the
worker's final accepted-record frontier. The role therefore observes healthy
pending or temporarily busy native status until that existing deadline, rather
than treating one pending poll as terminal failure. It retires records only
after exact successful scope completion. A native failure, unavailable/funded
progress requirement, or deadline preserves the recovery's native resources
and neutral lease. This changes neither the selected timeout nor its native
completion criteria; the additional fixed clock/observation frames are funded.

Behavioral chat-profile preparation now has a narrow original backend handoff:
the adapter validates actual J/C pool identity and lends its selected execution
to the existing cumulative host-metadata account. The neutral closed preparation
retains both original sources; facade producers reserve their concrete record,
validation and error controls before birth. Any escaped host owner retains that
same account after its source payload. This is host preparation only: it grants
no protocol identity, render, encoding, native role or inference permission.
Ordinary profile policy stays in the facade and actual rendering/tokenization
must still consume their existing original operations separately.


Checked Hybrid decoder copying selects the existing parent/child table group
for every actual layer, including an empty fixed-role child. Empty children
still own metadata identities. The shared group plan counts their host
construction and gives each saved child its original protected hold; resume
uses the same dense group worker to attach each child before publishing the
outer table and finishing the single prompt claim. This prevents later native
publication from encountering a newly copied but unregistered empty child.
It does not relax inventory validation, omit zero-byte identities, or change
ordinary KV numerical copying. The source-selected group controls and table
counts feed the existing snapshot and resume admission calculations.

The closed behavioral probe recipe now constructs lexical immutable record
frames for the actual history, effort and tool arguments. Ordinary preparation
converts that same recipe into its existing JSON renderer input; original
preparation can borrow the descriptors directly after paying their concrete
frame population. Probe argument forms are explicit borrowed mapping/string
variants used by the existing recognition calls. No source family inference,
serialized JSON parser, new object engine or default-request profile cache is
introduced. Template rendering and structural atomic encoding remain separate
original operations with their own real owners.

The original behavioral-probe adapter now borrows actual J/C and loaded defaults
under the source-qualified profile preparation. It pays the exact lexical record
and validation controls, invokes the same probe recognizer, and uses existing
original H rendering and E token encoding for every behavioral/atomic check.
Completed H verifies exact J/C and consumer identity; failures keep native-free
render/encoding custody ahead of the probe host owner. Negative recognition
retires completed temporary outputs without refunding cumulative controls.
This concrete adapter does not yet choose a public profile: ordinary precedence
across IFM/Muse/Gemma/Inkling and request validation must join before explicit
managed controls can replace the current gate.

External assistant lexical input loans authenticate completed witnesses against
both retained request environments. This inventory step grants no execution or
cross-device alias: each model, numerical and copy consumer still validates the
actual array source at its selected placement. Gemma's DraftStep declares Draft
for its completed logits conversion through the neutral source-aware method;
target prefill keeps Target. Both use the existing numerical row/import workers,
with their actual source and host custody. CPU/GPU copies remain mandatory when
physical placement changes.

Muse/ATEM's actual structural, historical-channel, four-strength and tool-output
recognition now uses the same operations seam and lexical source recipe as
Inkling. Ordinary profile construction and request-validation order are
unchanged. The original adapter can execute these same decisions with paid
records and original H/E owners; selection still requires preserving the earlier
IFM and later Gemma ordering rather than choosing from model metadata.

Gemma channel/history, both thinking toggles, optional stop-token validation and
mapping/string tool probes now use the shared source operations and exact
record recipe. The ordinary wrapper still assembles its same recognized profile
and structural/stop lists in declaration order. The largest actual structural
probe is seven tokens; both ordinary and original adapters use that finite
result population, independent of tokenizer vocabulary extent. Original IFM
precedence and final request mapping remain the outstanding selection join.

The selected CPU source now includes the existing nonnegative, positive-length
I32 unit-step Arange worker used by exact causal-mask coordinates. The immutable
source validates integral endpoints, the declared output length and the final
loop increment within I32; the ordinary loop and its promoted step arithmetic
are shared. CausalMask quotation consumes those real range sources plus the
existing reshape/cast/broadcast/comparison and optional subtraction/LogicalAnd
workers. It retains each possible backing through completion and reports Bool
output without a fabricated floating representation. Empty masks remain outside
this producer. Masked target attention and reverse external placement still
require their own complete consumer join; this source alone opens neither.


The IFM behavioral profile worker now shares its three initial effort probes,
request-control precedence, disable check, and exact tool-history predicates
between ordinary and original chat operations. A separate request-probe method
preserves ordinary error propagation after protocol recognition. Original probes
borrow the actual caller map and fixed explicit replacements over the actual
loaded defaults, using the same paid record renderer; they never clone caller
JSON or infer a profile from a model name. Its fixed result describes behavior
only. Actual dialect structural-token/history validation and final profile
selection remain prerequisites to public managed request-control admission.


The checked layerwise workspace acquire consumes the retained
`WorkspaceParameterSourceLoan` through its existing count/fill worker and the
same `bind_prepared_workspace_parameters` traversal used for fixed borrowed
bindings. The projection owns paid row/name/shape/window destinations and
prospective roots: invocation roots are fresh at each acquire, while explicitly
trace-lived canonical aliases survive later units. Escaped workspace values
retain their roots and cumulative metadata custody. Exact floating precision is
carried by each actual source row; conservative Float32 geometry does not infer
native F16/BF16/F32 representation or positive contiguity.

A partition's retained global execution addresses can be projected over its
unchanged local storage/window layout. Both layers validate that mapping; native
Host/Disk sources retain the original policy's immutable address pairs, and
module ParameterIds remain the global IDs built by the architecture. This
source/acquire producer alone grants no native materialization, collective,
role, or whole-request admission. Those existing checks remain required at the
parallel model consumer.


Native nested completion and retained-event submission share one prepared Eval
worker. The single-GPU profile keeps asynchronous submission. A mixed-stream
profile uses the existing event wait and exact accepted-record observation while
its resident graph bank remains suspended, then returns the completed event to
the ordinary communication authority. Queued CPU primitive/prologue callbacks
therefore finish before that bank can be reused. Every root, source, scope and
attempt check remains in the shared worker; failure retains unresolved native
records and request custody. The added fixed mode/pointer frames join its
existing native control-layout query.


The remaining chat protocol selector shares one fixed observation record per
actual mapping/string tool-history render. Ordinary and original callers run the
same ordered selector, including the existing first-successful-render rule for
DeepSeek/Mistral variants and Qwen's separate effort/history probes. The private
original inspection callback returns only paid fixed facts after validating the
completed render's exact J/C and consumer. Render storage retires before the
probe account; no source-string or caller-object references escape. Selection
still requires actual complete dialect token validation before public admission.


Borrowed dialect profile metadata now comes from the same validated declaration
used by ordinary profile construction. Declarative specification and tool-name
validation have fixed typed failure forms; ordinary callers format those same
causes with their unchanged diagnostics. Harmony/LFM expose their actual typed
parameter and static token sources through the same narrow profile accessor.
This accessor owns no parser, grammar, device, or request policy. Its explicit
control census permits original profile selection to validate the complete
source declaration before borrowing the exact tokenizer's token witness.


Parallel layerwise quotation now lends that same source into the original
architecture-owned partition driver. Direct TP derives paid graph/unit geometry
before selecting its policy; PP compares the retained global addresses with the
source's local layout, then runs the same executor, boundary schedule and output
publisher. Resident and layerwise policies share their forward body. Static
module precision comes from the actual module visitor; acquired unit precision
comes from its counted source rows. Missing unit facts do not become inferred
scalar types.

Configured requests pass the already retained layerwise workspace into native
parallel planning. Saved-state planning creates its existing paid source once,
returns that owner with the quote, and binds the same native neural/copy recipe
workers. The ordinary Host/Disk role, transfer, registration, source identity and
completion checks still decide native applicability; cold geometry or parameter
facts alone do not remove them. In particular a Disk source without its complete
existing native producer still refuses at that producer.


Original behavioral probes distinguish a reached absent callable from an
unsupported worker or resource failure. The ordinary builtin-global declaration
also supplies a pure membership query; local macros and actual context values
are resolved first, and the text profile's registered dict/clock functions remain
explicitly qualified. The fixed render location records UnknownFunction without
allocating diagnostics. Only that semantic failure may become a negative initial
profile probe; request-specific IFM render failures still propagate. Any owned
partial render retires normally before its paid probe/source allowance, with no
budget refund or blanket geometry suppression.

The CPU F32 Select source also describes the existing broadcast worker through
rank five, as used by GQA mask expansion. Its same accepted task retains the
Graph loan for four borrowed stride rows, their collapse destinations and three
prefix iterators. Native source inspection checks scalar type, nonnegative
readable strides, exact shape and backing span before enqueue; unknown or larger
donation backing is refused. This source adds no masked-attention or reverse
external-placement admission by itself.


Tagged tool-history validation shares a nonallocating source-indexed worker
between ordinary request policy and original profile selection. It preserves
message/call/parameter traversal and name/delimiter checks. Ordinary diagnostics
read the same immutable rejected entry to retain their exact text; original
errors keep fixed indices and no borrowed caller strings or cloned JSON.


Ordinary and original chat preparation now share the complete ordered profile
selector. It consumes the same IFM/Muse/Gemma/Inkling/remainder behavioral probes
and validates every selected declarative/custom profile's complete structural
token list against the actual tokenizer. The fixed token destination is derived
from the largest existing closed declaration (IFM), not a caller-supplied limit.
IFM tagged history is validated at its original point before returning the
selection. Ordinary owned profile construction receives those accepted facts;
the original path retains only fixed selection facts under its actual J/C-bound
probe owner. A selection alone does not authorize a semantic parser or tool
controller and cannot bypass public request-policy validation.


The fixed request policy is now produced from the shared accepted profile
selection and also supplies ordinary owned profile controls. Original preparation
retains a closed PolicyOwner with the exact J/C source and paid probe account;
only its lexical scalar bindings borrow caller text. Effort, Qwen tagged-history,
and strength validation run in ordinary order. Generation-prompt resolution
uses the selected declaration, including Muse's required prompt behavior. This
owner supplies no semantic parser/controller authority; its public managed
render/startup handoff remains a separate consumer join.

The CPU SDPA source consumes an explicit Boolean mask using the same ordinary
frontend and named mask worker. The recipe counts the real mask broadcast,
GQA head unflatten, condition/value casts, Select scratch, and second scalar
seed before execution. Q/K/V retain the current exact F32 contiguous source
requirement; arbitrary input strides, implicit causal mode, additive masks,
sinks, softcaps and reverse external placement are not granted by this join.


Managed plain-chat requests with explicit thinking/effort/strength/IFM format
controls now select their policy through the paid actual-source probe owner,
borrow its scalar replacements into the original renderer, and retain that owner
through rendering/startup failures. Startup resolves generation-prompt behavior
from the same selection. Requests without explicit profile controls retain the
existing direct-render path; general no-control profile policy is a remaining
consumer extension. Raw thinking still requires explicit unparsed-output
permission, and tool/parser/controller work keeps its existing separate boundary.

Parallel bounded quotation keeps static and unit parameter evidence separate.
If a retained strategy cannot lend complete resident units, its exact static
module source can still supply embedding/output scalar facts. The installer
discards partial resident rows before this narrower visit, propagates actual
native/metadata failures, and leaves unit facts to the checked layerwise source
binder at acquire. Static evidence supplies no residency or native permission.


Tensor-only pipeline execution retains architecture-derived entry, per-unit sum
and selective-readout participation waves. A native group reports whether its
selected packed-world mechanism requires every rank; the architecture executor
then drives matching inactive-stage work through the existing communication
contracts and completion boundaries. This keeps semantic ordering out of native
group code and preserves state-only chunks without an output gather. The new
ordinary integration still requires validation; managed zero-work source quoting
and custody must be joined before this path is considered complete.

The forbidden-trigger controller has a separate neutral prepared source and decision contract. Its immutable input owner copies the exact packed vocabulary and trigger into paid buffers; it shares the byte matcher and packed decoder with ordinary facade constraints. Provisional history evaluation preserves token-by-token error order. Prepared commitment validates and computes a prefix first, appends only to a unique bounded history, and publishes the prefix only after that append succeeds. Identity aliases retain real input/history custody and never grant native sampling authority. The plain-controller source continues to describe only the tokenizer-validity semantics; native forbidden mask production and public semantic admission remain separate consumer joins.

The shared partition-capture receipt protocol supplies opaque reached frame
sources (coordination, preparation, payload and delivery) to its transport. The
ordinary bounded gather remains the default worker. Original adapters receive
an explicit request control owner, validate the same native world and authority,
consume the live request cursor, and use the existing accepted U32 Gather,
readout and authenticated child recovery scope. Word and byte destinations
retain their cumulative metadata funding through validation and decoding; they
cannot expose an independently owned Vec. These frame sources describe actual
protocol populations and grant no native storage. Model capture admission still
requires the full funded placement/observer and native transport quote join;
this transport implementation alone does not widen that gate.


The tensor-only pipeline participation schedule is retained once by the completed
architecture constructor. Native binding seals its exact mechanism requirement;
workspace quotation borrows that same sealed fact and schedule through the
prepared source. Quotation never guesses a packed-world mechanism from rank
counts. Rebinding to a conflicting fact refuses, and a quote before binding
refuses. Active execution and inactive zero-work now traverse the same executor
for both native realization and neutral tracing; native source/completion
validation remains required before the larger managed path is reported complete.

The facade now constructs a distinct prepared forbidden runtime from that exact paid input owner. Its explicit source/copy/mutation hooks preserve immutable vocabulary identity and independently copy bounded durable history. Ordinary filter and speculative-history callbacks consume the same trigger worker; original consumers use the typed hooks without formatting errors or allocating a filter. Ordinary snapshot cloning cannot masquerade as an independently mutable prepared history: these controllers require the explicit prepared copy hook. Native forbidden mask quotation, its source authentication, and sampler/controlled snapshot dispatch remain required before public semantic admission.

Prepared forbidden decisions also pass through the existing token-choice transition helpers. Provisional suffix validation precedes forcing; forced commitment checks precede the atomic history/prefix worker; independent copies preserve pending position and immutable input identity. The pre-forcing observation domain remains the actual forbidden predicate rather than being reduced to tokenizer validity. The native mask producer and sampler dispatch must consume this distinct decision before any public semantic gate opens.

The original CPU speculative logit-policy consumer uses the shared CPU equation
recorder for every nonempty ProcessLogits trace. It borrows the completed input's
actual floating dtype and row/last-axis layout after the existing request and
stream authentication. The ordinary immutable policy constructs the same mask,
penalty/filter and temperature operations; each operation must supply its exact
CPU source. The zero-operation policy still returns its existing source alias.

The qualified F32 temperature suffix uses the existing eager reciprocal scalar,
two same-type cast sources, two broadcast aliases and Multiply worker. It composes
with the existing Bool mask upload, negative-infinity seed and cast/broadcast/Select
population without a separate recipe per policy option. The recorder prices the
actual combined graph, physical storage, host mask and CPU completion, with one
final output and no invented capture roots or nested reads. Returned logits and
failures retain the same request, phase, completed inputs and explicit stream.
Unsupported policy operations or floating representations keep their exact source
refusal; this source join does not claim half-precision or multilane validation.


The selected Host/parallel neural quote uses that same retained-event nested
worker. Its source must describe one GPU stream and, when present, the actual
CPU stream, plus complete graph, mutable-storage and operator-owner populations.
Each reached group keeps the full enclosing traversal/record ceiling and its
existing consumer waits; synchronous mixed-stream settlement gives no budget
refund. Host-copy descriptors retain their exact expanded traversal and the
parallel worker extents. This qualification does not admit CPU-only neural
submission or an unqualified CPU model copy producer.


Inactive tensor participation charges its fixed invocation, iterator, placeholder
and error frames to the same checked workspace account used by its ordinary
executor trace. Errors preserve that account. Tensor allocation and communication
continue to use their existing per-operation source producers.

The selected CPU target prefix also qualifies F32 embedding scaling through the
same scalar Multiply worker used by ordinary Tensor execution. Its eager F32
seed, cast/broadcast frontends and CPU binary source enter the actual recipe;
only the completed dense F32 result receives a contiguous representation. Other
scalar promotion combinations and unqualified strided inputs remain explicit
source gaps. This prefix alone does not admit reverse external placement.

The original forbidden mask uses the existing TokenMaskPlan expansion through a closed predicate arm, preserving vocabulary padding/truncation and forced-token behavior. CPU and GPU continue to consume the same pre-sized Boolean destination and existing Select operation. CaptureTokenDomain also carries that closed pre-forcing predicate, so candidate/domain observation can distinguish semantic exclusions without substituting tokenizer validity or the final forced mask. No user callback or arbitrary object becomes executable source authority through these descriptive contracts.

Single-input concatenation now reaches the same existing MLX alias fast path
through the shared fallible C handle clone before an input vector is built. It
preserves native singleton axis behavior, integer dtype and actual strided
representation. The CPU recipe pays that handle while claiming no primitive,
worker, or new storage. Multiple-input concatenation keeps its existing worker.

ConstrainedSampler now dispatches the finite Plain/Forbidden contracts through its existing copy, forced-choice, policy-then-controller commit, adaptive commit, and processed-value identity worker. Both error causes remain typed, including allocation custody. The numerical policy consumer selects the actual decision's TokenMaskPlan instead of deriving a plain mask from tokenizer validity. Legacy shared-filter authentication still refuses the additional forbidden byte inputs until their exact original source witness is attached and authenticated; this is an explicit remaining source integration requirement, not a model limitation or a public support claim.

CPU attention-head transpose retains the existing checked native alias source
and actual axis/readable-stride validation. Neutral shape facts admit its
permutation without marking the output contiguous: only an unchanged order of
distinct nonunit dimensions preserves that claim. Consequently downstream RMS
and matrix consumers must qualify their real strided inputs independently; the
transpose source does not widen those gates or reverse-placement admission.


Partition receipt serialization now borrows the exact completed capture records
and retained context. The ordinary owning DTO and scheduled-record adapters use
the same core wire-field serializer, including protected tensor/nonfinite policy.
The runtime no longer clones receipt identities or builds an intermediate owned
fragment vector merely to encode it. Output allocation, received-record admission,
expected placement and native completion remain independent requirements.

The fixed completed-record receipt writer reuses capture's accepting JSON counter
and the same core serializer, then fills one exact counted byte destination.
Known encoded-size refusals do not allocate a JSON diagnostic; cumulative metadata
and output custody survive refused retries. The writer input is descriptive only:
actual producer placement and completed native ownership must come from the
enclosing scheduled observer, and received records still require their original
claim destinations and all-rank delivery agreement.

Forbidden vocabulary/trigger admission now uses the same neutral original immutable-source compiler account as capture and intervention declarations. A borrowed, validated input-copy plan fixes all byte destinations before the pool admits them; the shared copy worker constructs fresh buffers under that account. The closed OriginalForbiddenSource validates its real pool and copied-input owner, retaining partial failures and successful aliases through actual retirement. Backends forward source compilation and authenticate that closed witness; they do not select tool policy, decode tokenizer configuration, or accept a caller-supplied host token as source evidence.


Packed native-world subgroup extraction consumes the exact retained, ordered
host membership through the same static-slice/stack worker in ordinary execution,
cold quotation and source-funded execution. It does not rebuild membership as a
device index tensor or create a dynamic validation graph for already selected
ranks. Checked member destinations, native aliases and operation controls remain
funded before construction; selected group/source identity and terminal world
completion are unchanged.

The facade's original forbidden constructor now retains that closed compiler witness alongside its actual immutable inputs and independently funded history. Copies preserve the witness; the existing native sampler copy and numerical-mask paths call one exact validator for pool, copied-input identity and tokenizer-validity source. Validation controls are paid before those checks. The original consumer then uses the same mask expansion/Select/completion worker, including CPU support, while public request/profile/parser selection remains a separate facade integration step.


A partition tensor receipt can fill its original scheduled claim directly. The
shared serde deserializer receives source-sized scratch and emits lexical events
to a fixed receipt visitor; it does not allocate an ordinary Value, CaptureRecord
or second tensor. The visitor checks the retained context, sender, selection,
precision, exact source/selected/output shapes, charge and complete wire fields.
Failure spends the claim and retains original host and metadata custody. This
concrete consumer covers complete-global-producer floating tensor receipts;
other claim kinds and explicit invocation geometry remain separate work, and
neither parsed bytes nor this host decoder certify native/all-rank completion.

The facade's prepared-chat speculative constraint forwards the separate forbidden
source, independent-copy, and atomic mutation contracts to its retained
controller. The wrapper adds its actual copy-result frames to the destination
bound; it neither converts the controller to plain text nor creates source
authority. Original semantic request startup still requires its own qualified
controller, parser, and event producers before this forwarding can be used by a
public admitted semantic request.


Workspace transpose descriptions retain the already-paid normalized axis vector
and expose a borrowed permutation to native facts. CPU views derive final-axis
contiguity from that exact permutation, including equal-size axes; a false
row-contiguous flag alone still grants no stride fact. The optional final-axis
fact describes unit stride only, never dense backing, source authority or a
storage allowance. Generic GPU consumers retain the same transpose alias and
native primitive. This describes the next CPU row-reduction prerequisite;
reverse external placement remains closed until its complete consumer qualifies.


The CPU RMS source also covers a proved contiguous final-axis row in a
non-row-major tensor. The shared reduction planner constructs the same
one-axis GeneralContiguousReduce plan directly; its existing SIMD SumReduce
order is preserved, separately from the row-major cascade. Fixed inline
shape/stride and row-iteration controls are charged by the same native source
query. Unknown final strides, general singleton plans and unqualified gains
remain refused. Two-source cached concatenation reuses its already-priced
General-copy worker for the same explicit row fact. Strided-value SDPA and
head-joining reshape still require their actual copy sources before reverse
CPU-target public admission can open.

Lexical token-byte conversion is an eredu-text mechanism shared by ordinary
facade TokTrie construction and the immutable tokenizer's borrowed packed-source
planner. The worker retains ByteFallback precedence, exact byte syntax, sparse
canonical IDs, special-token spelling and the ordinary leading-marker removal.
It inspects borrowed decoder fields without serde or a tokenizer/trie rebuild,
and writes only caller-sized slices. Its geometry/control report grants no
runtime source authority; original forbidden-source compilation must still pay
the fresh destination and retain its actual tokenizer/source/account custody.
Streaming decode remains a separate worker because its prefix and UTF-8 repair
semantics differ from lexical constraint bytes.

Original forbidden input compilation can borrow the actual OriginalTokenizer
and facade-selected trigger directly. The same lexical packing worker fills a
paid temporary, and the existing immutable source-copy worker creates the closed
inputs. Both populations and their overlap are admitted before either birth;
partial packing stays in typed error custody, and escaped copied inputs retain
the real compiler account. The backend forwards only its exact pool and session
validation. This source producer does not establish semantic parser admission
or promote Auto/Active grammar states to the forbidden-controller contract.

Neural group-frontier refusal preserves the retained equation row and the exact missing producer prerequisite. A previously funded operation diagnostic moves into the existing planning error owner without cloning its string or inspecting native payloads. Retained-event and synchronous-prediction workers keep their separate completion modes and unchanged Graph, Record, backing, and kernel-source qualification.


Selected Float32Tiles CPU Matmul also accounts its ordinary matrix-interior
General-copy fallback. The native source checks both actual operands and adds
zero, one or two copy jobs, destination descriptors, Data/births and worker
scratch under the same Eval. A single two-entry temporary vector is retained by
the existing TemporaryBatch through callback completion; no extra Eval or
cleanup occurrence is invented. The pure copy query remains separate from
source authority and the opaque platform/BF16 matrix paths are unchanged.
CPU attention admits the reached strided-value case only with explicit
final-axis evidence and charges its possible replicated value copy. Query/key
row-major requirements and reverse public admission remain unchanged pending
the head-joining reshape source.

The eager F32 scalar multiply prefix retains the two AsType producers already
present in its recipe: three possible backing births including the result.
Its scratch includes a full input cast, scalar cast and actual scalar seed;
identity optimization cannot silently delete those quoted producers.

Original partition capture distinguishes a remote prefill target from local scalar coverage. The shared chunk-progress worker still consumes each canonical chunk and reserves the logical target once. After all chunks commit, one final receipt claim can allocate the original whole-run host destination; failed or dropped claims cannot retry. Local producers may seal for receipt encoding while remote targets remain explicitly missing. Final frame delivery still requires every remote receipt and the enclosing native completion/commit decision.

Ordinary and original semantic controller startup share one borrowed branch and
trigger selector. The forbidden branch compiles the actual historical tokenizer
object retained inside its prepared recipe, so later loaded-tokenizer mutation
cannot replace that vocabulary. Ordinary recipe construction seals the raw-object
range using borrowed serde RawValue; original startup reads the closed range and
uses the existing original tokenizer/compiler and lexical source worker. No
ordinary TokEnv or matcher is reconstructed under original admission. The new
constructor funds independent history and keeps the actual original input proof;
Auto/Active still require their own qualified grammar producers. Semantic parser,
event and public request admission remain a separate unfinished integration.


Tensor-wave participation passes the same retained model context as active
equations to runtime's existing validated Sum/Gather and local dependency
drivers. Neutral backend hooks may complete that exact occurrence synchronously;
invalid retained contexts cannot fall back to ordinary allocation. MLX validates
the selected opaque group against the original source, reuses model Sum and the
shared arbitrary-axis gather worker, and completes the real roots through the
existing nested completion primitive. Cold execution records those same
value-completion boundaries so their traversal and native resources are prepaid.
No dummy completion or topology-derived permission is introduced.

ReasoningDelta uses the same SemanticText payload as TextDelta. Ordinary String
inputs preserve independent ordinary cloning; original prepared publication can
use the existing fresh retained UTF-8 copy worker. An escaped reasoning event
therefore keeps its own actual account after the parser, event queue, or callback
retires. JSON representation remains a string, and logical snapshot accounting
copies ordinary payload bytes while sharing already-retained immutable owners.
No parser or tool-call source authority is created by this payload contract.

Declarative text/reasoning transitions use one nonallocating worker over the
actual static dialect descriptor and borrowed pending bytes. Ordinary parsing
immediately consumes the same transition descriptors, including delimiter tie
order, UTF-8 partial retention, prefilled reasoning, and the exact handoff into
its existing tool-payload states. The worker replaces per-step delimiter Vecs
with the finite three-entry population. It owns neither output bytes nor an
account; prepared consumers still require paid pending/event destinations and
an exact selected parser source before invoking it.


CPU target head joining carries the exact dense axis order from an already
qualified transpose, as a fixed scalar physical fact beside logical geometry.
The neutral declaration supplies no source identity, backing capacity or native
permission. Unknown stride order remains unqualified. The CPU quote reconstructs
only those proved strides and calls the same fixed-rank reshape planner used by
native execution. Its positive extents and products are checked, and its collapse
and divisibility decisions match the existing general planner. A compatible
strided reshape keeps its alias and remains non-row-major; an actual copy prices
the existing General-copy task, weak descriptors, output Data, worker scratch and
one backing birth before publishing row-major output. The fixed planner owns only
inline metadata through rank five; unsupported ordinary geometry retains the
existing general path. The admitted CPU workspace view remains through rank four.
This qualifies the concrete head-join boundary, not a whole CPU model or reverse
external placement admission.

The prepared scheduled partition-tensor delivery uses the ordinary receipt exchange's preparation, padded payload, and final all-rank decision. Its closed decoder fills original scheduled claims, including the final remote prefill target, instead of allocating a second raw capture record. Producer encoding borrows the finished SharedTensor record; received local bytes are compared with the sent source. Frame sealing remains outside the exchange, and any failure retains the admission, original H, and metadata account. Native placement and complete transport quotation remain independent requirements.

Contiguous partition-capture geometry has a retained constructor source which validates the same coordinate equations without allocation, reports its exact Vec populations and fixed controls, then builds those declared destinations. The ordinary contiguous constructor and original paid receipt preparation share this worker. Its source describes geometry storage only; actual architecture placement, capture H, transport, and native execution remain separately authenticated.

Prepared declarative channels now have fixed pending-byte and event destinations
consuming the same ordinary transition worker. Construction borrows the actual
selected dialect hook and compares its recipe trigger to the closed original
forbidden source. Byte/event bounds are explicit, mutable copies are independent,
and emitted text/reasoning keep their own paid immutable owners after container
retirement. A reached tool-payload state returns a typed producer gap with the
completed event prefix retained; decoder, stop, outer terminal-event and public
semantic-owner integration remain separate required work before public admission.

The literal channel transition worker lives in `eredu-text` and borrows an explicit
delimiter program. Facade dialect implementations still select and project their
actual protocol; the neutral worker performs no family/profile recognition, tool
payload parsing, allocation, event publication, or admission. Ordinary and prepared
consumers use the same UTF-8 lookbehind and tie ordering. A borrowed descriptor is
not source authority: original execution must retain its separately paid closed
program and mutable destinations.

The original complete-producer capture receipt uses the same portable receipt
validator and canonical digest writer as ordinary partition capture. Its source
is the exact shared capture admission and architecture-selected producer rank.
The runtime prepays the contiguous projection, normalized source slice, context
UTF-8 copies, digest destination, and constructor controls through the original
metadata account. This form stores its sole producer inline; ordinary arbitrary
producer sets retain their existing map. Receipt errors retain the shared source
and metadata account, and read-only delivery estimates borrow the normalized
geometry. These host receipt facts confer no native source, transform, transport,
or completion permission; those remain separately admitted backend obligations.

Original semantic channel programs are copied by the runtime's existing original
source compiler. The closed owner retains copied delimiters, structural ID/spelling
rows, the actual generation tokenizer, and the actual forbidden input owner. Atomic
rows are checked against that tokenizer; decoder and controller consumers must
authenticate those retained identities. Selection stays in the facade. Compiler
failures retain completed byte/row prefixes and their original account; neither a
borrowed program nor a structural spelling grants tool-payload execution.


The external cross-device binder describes either retained Metal/CPU direction
only when the actual CPU stream carries the cold Float32Tiles selection. The
same request authenticates both environments, their pool, and each input's real
origin; placement does not relabel completed values. The CPU target uses its
retained mechanism through the ordinary family workspace projection, actual
prefill/verification roles and shared numerical sources. Transfers and saved
copies keep distinct source and destination environments and publish only the
completed destination witness. The binder's pair check grants neither a missing
operation recipe nor a total-fit claim. Reverse public generation/replay remain
pending native validation, using the same ordinary and controlled drivers.


The CPU shifted captured-prefill join now uses the same axis-one two-input
concatenation worker as ordinary execution. Its numerical selector accepts only
that finite program without capture/intervention, authenticates both completed
input witnesses, and inspects actual F32/BF16 nonnegative source strides under a
paid descriptor loan. The selected CPU context and resident reducer provide the
existing cast candidates, two General-copy jobs, output backing and completion
controls; no Metal dispatch allowance stands in for CPU work. The completed
concatenation keeps both source owners and its own numerical account, so escaped
views/results and failures retire through the ordinary lifecycle. Unsupported
rank/type/layout, mismatched right extent and missing source facts still refuse.
This is an operation source join; it does not open an Embedded or reverse public
model admission gate.

The runtime's original channel parser consumes only its closed copied channel
source. Mutable pending bytes and event buffers are admitted before birth; cursor
state contains no self-borrowed pointers. Snapshot copies independently copy mutable
buffers under the snapshot payer and retain immutable delimiter/source owners. The
same shared literal worker chooses emissions; escaped reasoning/text events retain
their own metadata authority. Tool-payload handoff remains a typed refusal until its
producer is joined, and cannot manufacture a successful terminal event.

A checked parallel layerwise workspace trace includes the ordinary unit
constructors reached inside each forward. Before reducing that trace, the native
recorder borrows the retained LayerwiseWorkspace parameter census used by strict
binding and compares every placeholder scalar by count and dtype. Those replaced
constructor nodes are excluded from the neural Eval DAG only under that exact
source-qualified comparison. The existing native constructor producer then
rechecks the same source population and adds its scalar births, logical-rank
graph descriptors and control storage once before admission. An unbound
ParameterPlaceholder remains unqualified; scalar geometry alone never establishes
replacement before evaluation. Resume uses the same source handoff.

Original speculative semantic execution extends the existing closed decoder/stop
owner with its source-qualified channel parser. The same incremental decoder still
consumes every token. Actual structural IDs replace visible decoder suffixes and
flush literal-stop lookbehind before their selected spelling/terminal action, as
in the ordinary semantic pipeline. Normal finish flushes the parser once; cancel
discards lookbehind. Snapshot copies share immutable program/source custody and
independently copy decoder, stop, pending and event destinations under the snapshot
payer. Native admission checks actual tokenizer and forbidden-controller input
identities; a facade callback or borrowed channel descriptor cannot substitute for
this closed owner. The public semantic entry remains gated until its complete
request/source handoff and tool-payload applicability are joined.

Original partition capture coordination now has a paid, move-only host owner
that retains the same shared capture admission, actual forward context and
metadata account. It accepts each scheduled receipt in canonical order and
compares the exact receipt identity, floating transform declaration and final
logical ledger. The existing ordinary coordination frame writer and all-rank
comparison worker are shared; the source context is serialized directly into
the digest without allocating a JSON payload. Every include attempt reserves
its own controls, and a consumed vote retains native failure custody through
the returned error. The enclosing shared observer must prepare all local work
and pass its ordinary admission agreement before invoking this vote. Native
transport sources, observation placement and publication remain separate.

Managed text chat always invokes the existing source-bound behavioral profile
selector, including requests without explicit reasoning or tool-format controls.
The selected default generation policy and tagged-history checks therefore match
ordinary preparation. Probe/render controls remain admitted before construction.
Once rendering completes, policies which merely honor the caller's generation
toggle release their completed probe account; a generation override retains its
actual template/tokenizer source owner through startup. Failure retains the
unfinished render and profile sources under the same request ceiling.

Prepared semantic chat startup has a source-producing facade adapter over the same
original speculative host. It compiles the historical forbidden controller recipe,
projects actual dialect/structural rows into the closed channel source, copies
ordinary profile/caller literal-stop declarations, and constructs the existing
source-bound decoder/stop owner, EOS configuration and callback. Generation C and
historical controller C remain distinct as in ordinary prepared chat. This adapter
does not select a backend, infer a profile, or activate a public mode by itself;
prompt-source and public request handoff remain separate prerequisites.

The facade exposes source-explicit managed prepared-chat speculation alongside
managed plain text. It consumes the caller's actual `PreparedChat`, originally
encodes its rendered prompt, and hands the paid semantic host and forbidden
controller to the same speculative request/driver used by plain execution. The
controlled entry uses the same request and runtime owner. Text-only APIs keep their
text semantics. This first public source path supports the actual forbidden-trigger
controller and literal channel program; Auto/Active grammar construction and a
reached tool-payload parser state still have typed missing-producer failures.
Arbitrary pretokenized/backend-prepared prompt source entry remains follow-on work;
no ordinary input Vec or semantic Box is adopted as an original producer.

Executable loading retains the CPU or Metal equation mechanism selected by the
actual stream, including the exact CPU matmul implementation. Cold, funded, and
saved-state resident quotation dispatch both facts and recipe recording through
that retained mechanism. Common allocator/host facts remain available to native
numerical programs, whose separate source checks still bind their actual stream.
A CPU executable cannot obtain a Metal parallel equation quote from those shared
facts; CPU parallel recipe construction remains an explicit missing source until
its native collective recorder is supplied.

CPU capture conversion source now recognizes the existing `capture_cast_f32`
and explicit `CastFloating(Float32)` descriptors through the same CPU AsType
worker. Actual F32 inputs retain their source storage and layout; positive
rank-zero through rank-four row-contiguous F16/BF16 inputs price the existing
conversion copy and its independent F32 destination. Physical source precision
is mandatory; erased precision and strided half conversion remain unqualified.
This producer does not open CPU capture or intervention admission. The numerical
capture dispatcher, target observation quotation, prepared capture stream check
and CPU nested-completion populations still require their complete joins.

The original partition observer uses the same receipt-cost worker as ordinary
partition capture: transport, global delivery/evidence, and each exact producer
fragment are charged globally before a move-only local `CaptureQuota` is lent to
the transformation. The existing observation and prefill reservation methods
accept the neutral reservation contract, so this local quota cannot charge the
parent ledger again. Neither the receipt allowance nor its source/metadata
custody qualifies an unimplemented native transport or transform.

The tokenizer's ordinary and original literal `Replace` construction share the
same move-only pattern/content handoff. Literal matching uses nonoverlapping
UTF-8 spans and the existing replacement consumer; it no longer constructs a
hidden escaped regex. Regex declarations retain their ordinary matcher. This
supplies a bounded component constructor for original fallback decoding without
changing normalization, decoding order, or serialized tokenizer declarations.

Original tokenizer construction now consumes the same finite decoder-sequence
classifier as fixed-destination decoding. The existing ByteFallback/Fuse/Replace
orders, optional final ByteLevel, and one-leading-space Strip are constructed
from their actual JSON fields; the marker and replacement buffers are reserved
under the original source account before they are filled. The same ordinary
literal Replace constructor receives those exact allocations. Partial model,
sequence, and literal buffers stay in the owning failure until its source account
retires. No serde reconstruction, regex compilation, alternate decoder, or
caller-provided capacity is used in this admitted path. Other decoder configurations
remain typed construction gaps rather than inferred tokenizer-family exclusions.

Packed logical collective extraction uses the shared static indexing overload
for both ordinary and admitted execution. Each host-selected member is a Slice
followed by the existing optional Reshape, matching the retained Index recipe;
it creates no eager index tensor or dynamic Gather validation root. Member order,
values, completion/source ownership and finite graph reservations are unchanged.

Remote prefill progress consumes one private acknowledgment from the exact
complete-producer allowance. The acknowledgment records the globally charged
producer usage against the receiver's existing frame target and advances the
ordinary hook state; it neither charges the receiver a second native estimate
nor creates/refunds physical H. Source/index equality and the original target's
exclusive claim remain mandatory through receipt delivery.

Capture selection now retains exact static slice coordinates in the portable
workspace trace. The owning starts/ends/strides vectors use the existing metadata
account and borrowed operation views share those exact buffers. Ordinary native
selection still calls the same rank-preserving Slice worker. Metal records that
one constructor; the selected CPU source admits only nonempty rank-two through
rank-four, unit-stride slices of known row-major floating inputs. It retains the
entire source backing and recomputes row-contiguity from the actual rectangular
selection. General Index, strided/empty/preview slices and public CPU capture
remain unadmitted until their full source and completion consumers qualify.

A sealed runtime partition program now enters funded observation through the
existing prepare/coordinate/delivery callbacks. Preparation creates exact paid
receipt destinations and globally reserves the ordinary local allowances; the
separate vote precedes every tensor hook. Nonproducers advance real prefill
progress through their one-use remote charge, and final delivery fills the same
original H target before the shared frame seal. The native adapter must still
provide retained architecture placement, transport cold coverage and complete
partition-evidence storage before advertising managed parallel capture.

The pinned `toktrie` dependency now exposes a consuming, borrowed construction
plan around its ordinary flat-arena insertion and serialization. Original trie
construction reserves its eight actual payload/scratch destinations from the
complete token-byte and EOS source before filling them. Alphabetical sorting
uses an explicit token-ID tie break to preserve duplicate-token order without
stable-sort scratch. The same serializer uses a prepaid explicit DFS stack;
actual packed-node encoding failures retain their partial output. Ordinary trie
construction consumes that shared fill worker, and filtering consumes the same
serializer and allocation-free validation. Original grammar admission still
requires the separate slicer, grammar/lexer/parser, token-mask and copy producers;
a constructed trie alone grants none of those authorities.

The vendored token-trie workspace member inherits `unsafe_code = "forbid"`.
Trie walking uses checked node indexing under its existing end bound, and its
reserved sentinel bit uses the existing checked bit setter. The compatibility
`allow_token_unchecked` name now delegates to that safe setter. No new unsafe-code
exception or native dependency boundary is introduced.

Original grammar token-byte preparation now uses the ordinary trie-input worker,
including exact special-token markers and literal fallback bytes. The existing
forbidden-trigger vocabulary still strips the leading marker with its previous
semantics. A closed lexical view can only be returned after writing the exact
planned buffer; it borrows both that buffer and its immutable tokenizer source.
These byte and slice facts supply trie construction and do not grant grammar,
retokenization, or parser-execution authority.


The original grammar vocabulary producer now derives exact marked token bytes
from its retained original tokenizer, pays packing, borrowed-slice storage and
all ordinary TokTrie builder destinations, and executes that same constructor.
The dependency-owned geometry quote cannot construct or adopt a trie; the
constructor checks the actual source slices against it after packing. Temporary
slice storage retires before either result, while failed packed/trie prefixes,
completed trie aliases and the source tokenizer retain the complete compiler
account until their real owners retire. The facade still selects EOS and other
token metadata; account validation compares every selected metadata field and
ordered EOS alias against the actual trie. This immutable source does not admit
Auto/Active grammar execution: shared slicer, lexer, parser, mutable mask and
snapshot/copy construction still require their actual original producers.

Original partition capture provenance uses the same admitted receipt and global
capture allowance as ordinary delivery. Its context, producer list and exact
fragment regions are constructed in paid metadata destinations before forward.
The canonical decoder attaches that prepared evidence only after receiving the
expected complete producer, before the common final delivery vote. Frame-owned
metadata custody follows successful and aborted deliveries into the immutable
shared frame; independently shared tensors keep their existing custody. Failed
votes and discarded partial frames do not refund capture reservations. Native
placement, transformation and transport still require their retained sources;
this provenance handoff does not advertise managed parallel capture by itself.


The original numerical capture phase can now consume an actual CPU equation
trace for raw model-logit FullTensor and supported Slice observations. It uses
the existing CPU recorder for normalized-row views, exact static coordinates,
physical F32 conversion and the ordinary vocabulary mask. The mask contributes
its actual Bool/scalar seeds, possible cast copies, Select worker and host mask
expansion. The same closing-root helper extends model or numerical completion;
actual raw callbacks retain their own nested completion occurrences. No GPU
worker census substitutes for CPU execution.

The installed numerical recipe lends a borrowed CPU stream and current original
observer to the shared raw capture worker. This loan creates no source, scope,
buffer account or completion allowance. Existing request/source authentication,
claimed host destination, native recovery, final roots and escaped custody are
unchanged. Standalone GPU capture keeps its existing stream validation and error
order. CPU preview, reduction and intervention paths still require their own
complete transform sources; this numerical handoff does not advertise family
activation or intervention support from an isolated primitive.

Ready native Eval inputs now publish `available` when the shared input loop
removes their already-observed completion event. Both ordinary and scoped Eval
use that same completed-descriptor transition. Previously the loop could leave
an event-free `evaluated` descriptor; ordinary array inspection normalized it,
but the original cross-role leaf handoff correctly refused that missing witness.
The correction publishes the status only after actual `ready`/signaled evidence.
Unscheduled descriptors, live primitives, tracers and unfinished/foreign events
retain their existing refusal paths. No quota, source authority, queue submission
or wait policy changes, and boundary framing still moves the exact input tensor.


Constraint recipes also retain the actual prepared tokenizer environment's full
fixed trie metadata in their existing immutable registered bytes. Ordinary
reconstruction consumes those retained roles and ordered EOS aliases instead of
allowing repeated token-name recognition to replace them. The original grammar
vocabulary producer can therefore authenticate against historical prepared facts
without creating a vocabulary map or running recognition after admission. This
retention supplies source identity only; bounded parser/lexer and tokenization
operations still require their own producers.


The same ordinary grammar prefix-normalization worker now publishes its exact
result as a closed frozen tokenizer source alongside the original chat tokenizer
recipe. Constraint recipes retain that complete normalized envelope, its already
validated raw-object range and the real special-token splitting flag. Ordinary
grammar restoration consumes this recorded source directly; original grammar
construction can borrow it without cloning current tokenizer components or
reapplying prefix policy after admission. The ordinary and original source
routes therefore share policy without conflating the chat and grammar tokenizer
configurations. Newly retained bytes stay inside the existing recipe owner and
its registration charge; this does not authorize allocating grammar execution.


Original tokenizer construction now accepts the retained source's explicit HF
special-token splitting flag before allocation, in addition to serialized JSON.
The flag is installed on the actual freshly constructed added-token vocabulary
through its existing setter and is consumed by the same fixed encoder. It does
not mutate a published source or add a separate matching path. This closes the
non-serde policy input needed by the frozen grammar tokenizer source; cache,
normalizer, grammar and parser resource bounds remain independently checked.


An absent original tokenizer decoder now reaches the existing no-component
construction and ordinary space-join decoder source. Its existing fixed decode
destinations already include the exact separator bound and special-token skip
semantics. The old root-only refusal is removed; no decoder object or alternative
text algorithm is introduced. Original special-splitting and trie failure tests
exercise this actual source form through the shared construction path.


CPU numerical Preview capture now consumes the same exact positive-unit-step
Slice producer at rank one after its shared flatten operation. Both native query
and actual primitive/source validation accept ranks one through four, preserving
all extent, stride, dtype, nonempty, subclass and backing-span checks. The source
has no buffer birth or worker scratch; flatten uses its independently qualified
alias/copy source. The existing raw capture phase retains the complete source,
counts the same nested read and publishes the bounded prefix through its paid
host destination. Summary/histogram and intervention sources remain separate
missing consumers, rather than becoming admitted through this rank extension.


The facade now assembles an original grammar vocabulary directly from that
historical normalized recipe: it retains the recipe identity, carries the actual
special-splitting flag into original tokenizer construction, pays the temporary
ordered EOS source through the existing metadata funding, and invokes the same
runtime trie compiler in the tokenizer's own pool. Its immutable result preserves
both source and adapter custody after eager ordinary preparation retires. This
entry intentionally creates no TokenizerEnv callback that could allocate ordinary
encoding work inside admitted grammar execution; the subsequent shared grammar
factory must consume qualified tokenization and parser operations.

The cold partition binding-destination projection consumes the retained architecture
selection through the same typed partition constructor and global-address unit
worker as executable construction. It describes only local physical slots, task
ownership, and sharding layouts. Before native load ownership starts, MLX feeds
these exact bindings to the existing original Host/Disk manager producer and
moves that manager through the selected dense local or pipeline binder. The
ordinary binder revalidates source store, declarations, plan, and both streams
before adoption. Global parameter IDs remain distinct from local residency slots;
off-rank tasks remain excluded by the same selected task inventory. Metadata
projection itself grants no native work, and numerical transforms and other
partition routes still require their own complete source producers.


Directly declared floating parameters now pass their ParameterSpec through the
neutral Tensor unloaded-parameter hook. The default calls the existing native
placeholder constructor unchanged. WorkspaceTensor instead consults the same
exact retained parameter-representation table used by neural operator factories,
matching identity, logical shape and dtype before preserving physical facts.
Thus learned scales and other direct architecture parameters do not lose their
already supplied source representation during cold equation construction.
Anonymous placeholders and mismatched declarations remain unknown; this hook
loads no checkpoint and grants no materialization or execution authority.


The original pending-token copy producer selects CPU populations from its exact
prepared scalar or complete `[1,N]` I32/U32 source and retained stream. It reuses
the ordinary isolate, reshape and optional I32-to-U32 conversion worker. Its two
nested completion occurrences share the installed traversal ceiling, while their
native sources are counted separately: Contiguous on the first frontier and only
the actual shape-changing Reshape and signed cast on the second. A matrix already
in `[1,N]` shape keeps its returned/recovery descriptor shells and final
Synchronizer without an invented Reshape primitive. CPU source queries continue
to enforce their rank/element limits. The existing registered prepared-source
binder, separate copy account, physical allocator population, publication and
failure/escaped ownership remain mandatory. This adds no general CPU saved-state
resume, Host-transfer or new public execution admission.


The ordinary grammar slicer's filtered tries now use the same source-planned
TokTrie constructor. The plan borrows the actual immutable trie and mask backing,
reserves selected byte/node geometry, preserves original sorted-ID order and all
EOS metadata, and retains real allocation-failure prefixes. Repeated filtering
therefore consumes one shared constructor rather than an estimated arena and a
second serializer. The plan grants no grammar or source-account authority;
regex/containment, topology and mask storage remain explicit factory prerequisites.


Ordinary trie-mask allocation and mask cloning also use source-derived plans.
The fresh mask reserves the same physical sentinel bit as the existing walker;
copying preserves actual word length and logical size, including trimmed or
padded storage. Their single vector allocation is fallible with retained prefix
custody, and their geometry comes only from an actual trie or mask loan. These
are the mask destinations consumed by the existing slicer constructor, not a
new token-selection policy or independent grammar authority.

Parallel cold observation uses the shared equation/span driver at the same
pre-publication logits hook as executable inference. Only the architecture's
selected owner traces the capture transform. After ordinary output publication,
receiver observers validate that complete source geometry and advance the same
host receipt and prefill row progression without fabricating a second transform
graph. The neutral observer callback rejects by default; its MLX implementation
shares the existing source validator, quota worker and row state machine. Native
receipt transport, completion and loaded placement remain separate mandatory
producers before managed capture is admitted.

A source-prepared Host transfer authenticates its exact current Scope and selected
GPU stream, then submits the existing fixed one-stream child traversal. The
suspended enclosing model bank's stream limit is an upper bound: a TP model may
also retain CPU collective streams. Both Host promotion and demotion accept
that larger bound while retaining zero-capacity refusal and the same Graph loan,
completion owner, input checks and fixed child submission geometry.


CPU capture classification facts now describe the existing F32 finite, NaN and
signed-infinity operators and Bool-to-U32 conversion. They retain the native
comparison/logical/broadcast/cast sources and actual scalar seeds, with no
floating representation attached to Bool or U32 outputs. Summary chunk tracing
keeps exact static slice coordinates through the shared selection worker. These
facts do not admit a complete CPU Summary: its integer sum and remaining scalar
reduction/completion sources must also be qualified before that consumer opens.


The shared llguidance slicer can now freeze its actual regex ordering, ordered
containment tree and selected token masks into one exact source-derived byte
record. The record also retains every token byte, EOS alias in order and all
TokRxInfo fields, so a reconstruction checks the actual tokenizer without an
allocating vocabulary copy. No regex, DFA, tokenizer callback or compiler graph
is retained by that source. Its count/write passes share one encoder, including
recursive source frames and typed partial-destination custody. Ordinary source
reconstruction enters the same lazy child/mask subtraction/trie filtering worker
as ordinary regex recognition, preserving its operation order. The record is
not original grammar admission: paid slice/tree destinations, mutable lexer and
parser construction, callback tokenization and per-step scratch remain required.

The scheduled Host batch completion applies the same capacity distinction as
individual Host copies: the enclosing original bank may hold CPU/GPU streams,
while this source authenticates its selected GPU stream and submits one fixed
Synchronizer for already-scheduled roots. Zero stream capacity, lazy roots,
root-count drift and all source/scope mismatches continue to refuse.


Retained neural boundaries now use the actual CPU/GPU stream population. A
CPU-only boundary requires the exact retained CPU equation source and its
single-stream traversal. The shared nested Event worker accepts the already
authenticated CPU stream, settles the real Event and records while the resident
graph bank remains suspended, and returns that completed Event through ordinary
consumer ownership. GPU-only submission retains its asynchronous behavior.
Completion, callback, graph and wait storage use the existing CPU completion and
per-boundary inventories; no native failure or polling error releases authority.
The reverse CPU-target/GPU-assistant public regression validates this consumer.

The CPU capture reducer source includes complete rank-one U32 counts and F32
minimum, maximum, and sum, using the ordinary `Reduce`/`Squeeze` chain. Count and
maximum admit only complete contiguous inputs for the existing SIMD all-axis
worker; the F32 sum retains its existing cascade order. A singleton invokes only
the actual squeeze alias and retains its input storage. The source accounts for
the same task, weak aliases, plan and SIMD controls; it does not rewrite numerical
bodies or select an alternative reduction. Mask/count and reduction producers
remain separate from complete CPU summary admission, whose scalar, selection,
root and completion consumers must also be qualified.

Managed partition capture retains a paid shared run identity in the same funded
capture session and checkpoint. The first actual forward epoch is consumed before
receipt preparation; restore preserves it, while fork binds a fresh first epoch.
The existing ordinary run-name writer and receipt program are shared. Identity
metadata remains descriptive: native composition authenticates setup, source,
parameter overlay, placement and every reached transport role independently.

The native partition capture quote records the exact floating representation from
each reached logits hook beside that span's existing capture completion population.
Receiving ranks validate the published tensor while adding no local transform.
The issued text step selects those retained prefill/decode facts for receipt
construction; logical Float32 geometry alone never supplies source precision.


Constraint recipes now retain that compiler-produced slicer record in the same
versioned SharedControllerBytes allocation as their normalized tokenizer and
grammar inputs. Registration copies the whole historical source and preserves
its closed fixed layout; it retains no ordinary factory or tokenizer graph.
The original grammar vocabulary adapter charges the record-view controls before
use and compares every original trie token, EOS alias and metadata field with
that same record. A descriptor checks byte structure only; historical identity
continues to come from the exact registered recipe owner. No allocating ordinary
tokenizer callback or regex recognizer is called during this source handoff.
The paid slicer/lexer/parser and mutable grammar controller consumers remain
unfinished and do not gain admission from this immutable source join.
