shared concatenation worker under one exact Graph/Record/backing source. Single
input permutation paths retain their allocation-free input wrapper. Input and
count-source owners retire before their funding on success and failed prefixes.


Managed local logical variable exchange now enters the same ordinary route
worker with the retained complete peer-count source. Each reached route executes
its real I32 row-count exchange, validates the result against that immutable
matrix, prepares the exact receive prototype and runs the asymmetric payload pair.
Slices, optional axis permutations and final source-rank concatenation use the
existing paid numerical child role. Every native child consumes a new request
claim and retains the exact count owner; physical-world transport is never used
for a local-only itinerary. Duplicate, foreign or incomplete count sources still
refuse before this path is entered.


The original semantic-channel source accepts an explicit forbidden or prepared
grammar input loan. Both use the same literal/structural-row compiler and actual
source-pool checks. A grammar-backed channel owner retains only the originally
compiled trie and registered immutable validity/recipe/declaration aliases; it
retains no parser, canonical history or operation funding. The existing semantic
host validates these exact inputs against each current copied controller through
the neutral controller contract. This permits independent saved histories while
rejecting a foreign tokenizer, declaration or controller branch. The original
forbidden entrypoint remains an immediate consumer of this shared producer.
Tool-payload parsing is not supplied by this source handoff.

Resident routed capture quotation admits the retained architecture-declared
routed observation source through the existing five-source observer and native
carrier. Ordinary invocation and bounded prefill share this source selection;
the actual provider layouts and completion roots still determine the quote.
Partitioned routed capture requires its own contribution and transport recipe.


The existing four-rank accepted-variable native fixture includes an asymmetric
neighbor-pair case with nonzero signed payloads of one versus three rows. It
compares cold and actual completion census, checks mismatched/lazy prototype
refusal without evaluation or output mutation, and retains the received output
past scope/backing handles before verifying one final retirement. It uses the
same launcher, accepted constructors, paired root ordering and support owners;
the target now emits six VARIABLE_CASE records per rank. Native execution remains
a separately recorded validation step.

Prepared-media decoder capture accepts routed-unit selection through the same
explicit flattened causal declaration and sparse fragment mapping as text.
An ordinary dense declaration cannot certify routed token coordinates, and
encoder hooks remain outside this decoder-only preparation. Partition native
estimates expose exact value equality for checking each callback against its
retained source allowance.

The original active grammar's prepaid state cell also owns failed independent
parser copies. The cell is reserved and allocated before lexer/chart copying
begins, then retains either the copied parser or the exact owning copy failure.
An initial reservation refusal retains the immutable source without allocating
the cell. Controller, sampler and native error transports carry this small owner
rather than repeating the full lexer/chart failure inline; the underlying cause,
partial destination and funding remain alive until that owner retires. The same
source-derived copy census includes the cell and its complete failure variant.

Prepared-chat original startup now applies the same ordinary allocation-free
controller selector to the retained generation plan. Active selection constructs
the paid vocabulary, lexer, chart, token session, canonical history and shared
controller from the registered recipe/declaration and actual historical tokenizer.
The original semantic source accepts its exact immutable grammar inputs alongside
the existing forbidden source; it retains no parser or canonical history. The
same structural-token/literal compiler and committed semantic driver consume both.
Startup reserves its owning error cell before any nested constructor, preserving
partial prefixes and the original source without expanding native error frames.
Tool-payload parsing still requires its own actual prepared state/consumer
join; it is not represented as plain text.

Original automatic grammar controllers retain the fixed trigger prefix and an
independently paid packed mask beside the initial parser. The same borrowed
trigger worker selects whole-token or cross-token activation; the latter uses
the existing original special-aware tokenizer and the ordinary decoder's exact
borrowed round-trip comparison. Each activating candidate gets an independently
funded parser trial. Successful activation publishes that parser; pending output
and canonical committed IDs remain distinct. Complete copies include both the
pending prefix and any completed mask, with the same source-derived copy census.
The original startup selector now constructs Auto through this source chain.
Structured tool-payload parsing is still a separate unfinished semantic consumer.


The managed expert-parallel public integration uses the existing partitioned
text runner and the shared nonzero routed component fixture, with two expert
ranks, uneven prefill chunks and cached decode. Its serial, ordinary, managed
and controlled modes share request preparation and generation. The presence of
this focused case does not qualify a missing cold source: retained provider
selection, completed router-ID/count sources, shape-dependent local expert work
and every selected movement stage must all be supplied before original
admission can pass.

Observed routed cold equations now invoke the existing provider-aware unit
traversal under the exact prepared path loan, for resident and layerwise
parameters. The architecture's typed routed visitor supplies the resident
provider and semantic prefill/decode pass; the shared span driver still owns
readout, retained roots, completion, sampling and observer progression. Plain
feed-forward quotation cannot stand in for a routed callback. This serial entry
does not impose a parallel-architecture bound or grant distributed execution.

The sealed runtime partition-capture contract can lend a move-only projected
local hook to the existing funded observer. That loan owns the actual original
receipt and fragment destinations while the backend mutably borrows its existing
transform and completion workers. Returning the same loan restores its original
transport continuation; the shared observer advances canonical global prefill
progress only after the local callback and return succeed. Native callback errors
retain the partial host/source owner through the neutral backend-failure source,
with its concrete retention and adapter frames included in the source census.
Complete-producer rows keep their existing destination path. This seam alone
grants neither contiguous placement nor a local source-completion contract for
empty-overlap producers; the retained program and native cold source must supply
those independently before public admission.

CPU projected Preview keeps provider-proved positive element strides through
rectangular Slice and a native-planned one-dimensional reshape. The neutral
representation has a fixed four-axis, u32-stride metadata slot; larger or missing
facts remain unknown. Singleton-axis strides are canonical because no selected
element observes them. Static Slice publishes the selected strides from its
actual source and coordinates. The existing native fixed reshape planner still
decides alias versus General copy, including its own control/population facts;
an alias flatten preserves its actual linear step for the following Preview
Slice. No shape-only contiguity inference, forced copy, family rule or second
reshape implementation is introduced. These optional facts grant no backing or
source authority. Existing metadata producers price their enlarged values through
the actual Rust type sizes.


Explicit routed logical Sum and Gather use one assembly worker for ordinary
and cold/native adapters. Sum keeps the selected route-order left fold; Gather
uses the retained local source-rank permutation and the same native Stack plus
first-axis reshape. The worker consumes its input handles and admits exact
result-vector controls; route transport and request authority remain separate
retained sources. This shared assembly does not itself qualify model expert
parallel execution without the remaining complete invocation source.


The routed model collective source retains each actually reached Pair/Peer child
from its selected explicit route table, including original native group and
backing owners. Final Sum/Gather quotation runs the shared ordinary assembly
on completed per-route layouts. No-op route positions create no fictitious
transport; the result recipe and every reached child retain independent finite
Graph/Record/backing capacities under the same original source identity.


Original routed model collectives execute the retained route table through the
existing accepted Pair and Peer roles, then the same arithmetic/completion role
consumes every completed routed result. The final result aliases are prepaid;
its invocation retains the original input roots and exact cold recipe through
completion and failure. Each reached native step spends a fresh request claim,
while no-op route entries spend no transport authority.


Resident expert partitions publish the ordinary constructor's exact provider,
local parameter geometry and retained execution strategy through the same
prepared partition source slot as tensor/pipeline partitions. Repeated native
construction borrows the winning source; a checked quote cannot create another
provider table. Retention alone does not qualify cold expert routing: the
completed ID/count loan and finite dynamic expert region remain separate source
requirements, so the corresponding quotation gate stays closed until joined.


The EP dynamic-region population is derived from the retained architecture
owner/local-expert table and the current row/route geometry. It bounds dispatch,
local expert rows and return rows without inventing router IDs or granting byte
capacity. Actual execution binds the complete count matrix against that same
population before movement; original count storage retains the resulting row
cardinalities alongside its completed native count owner and funding. Rebinding
or missing completed custody is a typed refusal. The cold region/native graph
join remains required before the managed EP admission gate can open.

Resident traversal now has the same private selected-unit execution seam as
layerwise traversal. Its ordinary entry passes the existing observed/unobserved
unit call; typed routed entry passes the existing provider call. Both retain one
dependency/group/readout loop and its existing abort/completion behavior. The
selected executor's actual closure is included in forward metadata.

The original grammar forcing adapter retains its concrete parser/tokenizer failure
in one paid local slot next to the live forcing context. The shared canonical
selector transports only a private fixed marker, and its preflight frame retires
before traversal. Error publication still moves that exact cause, partial parser,
encoded tokens and funding into the existing owning failure; no failure-time
allocation, source substitution or grammar-policy change is introduced.
The active-state operation boundary likewise publishes each full worker failure
directly into its existing prepaid cell. Its outer operation and preflight
transports remain fixed; source validation, parser mutation and failure custody
continue through the same callbacks in the same order.

An empty selected overlap remains distinct from an absent producer and from an
empty physical source tensor. A fixed runtime receiver descriptor preserves the
actual receipt-local shape and canonical prefill chunk, even when that receipt
has no selected fragment. The shared observer validates those local axes and
the retained scalar before invoking its existing source-completion method. It
never manufactures a fragment, destination, or zero contribution for this path.
The sealed program still owns the per-epoch completion attempt, and the native
owner must independently qualify its actual stream and completion source.

Semantic tool identifiers, names and JSON argument fragments use the same neutral
immutable `SemanticText` owner as text and reasoning deltas. Ordinary parsers
still construct ordinary strings; prepared producers must pay for fresh retained
text before publication. Escaped tool events therefore retain the actual payer,
and snapshots share prepared immutable bytes while continuing to account for
ordinary string copies. Serialization remains plain strings; no mutable or
unfunded extraction is introduced at the core/facade boundary.

Dense native grouped equations preserve an exact F32 scalar witness only when
all actual floating input and parameter witnesses are F32. Integral routing
operands do not supply floating facts. This applies to the ordinary grouped
unit boundary as well as its finish; layout contiguity and allocation authority
remain separate. Routed capture reports a missing physical source witness with
its source index instead of collapsing that failure into invocation geometry.

The existing incremental JSON container and field boundary scanners now live in
`eredu-text` and immediately serve both ordinary facade consumers. They expose
fixed lexical cursors and the shared traversal with a concrete append callback;
prepared payload storage can reserve its actual destination before publishing
the next cursor. This extraction preserves Unicode whitespace, escaped strings,
scalar delimiter handling, container completion and original JSON spelling.
Complete JSON validation, duplicate-field policy, semantic publication and tool
schema validation remain with their existing owners.

Native communicator setup initializes its exact retained transport stream through
`PrefillRootsRuntime::prepare_for_stream`, the same ordinary scheduler/Event
producer used by model construction. CPU compute and CPU communication can use
different stream identities; ordinary collective evaluation on the compute stream
does not establish a worker for the communication stream. Group aliases share one
setup owner and its measured baseline. This prepares persistent native runtime
state before request admission; it supplies no Graph, Record, Buffer, source or
submission allowance. Original constructors still require the actual prepared
worker, scope and quota identities.

The dense native selector publishes the same exact F32 witness for selected
scores and final coefficients when every actual floating source is F32. This
includes supplied integral IDs and original/effective routing pairs; precision
controls remain the existing selected worker's controls. It supplies no witness
for a missing or reduced-precision source and no new allocation authority.

Projected CPU capture predicates retain source-derived positive element strides
through Summary and Histogram workers. The shared classification/comparison
lowerings require actual F32 storage and checked native iterator spans. Selection
uses its existing General worker and source-owned collapse/iterator storage when
a floating operand is strided. The native descriptor checks every readable input
span against its actual retained backing; larger contiguous backings remain
rejected because vector branches can inherit them as output. Boolean masks remain
non-floating typed values, with no fabricated floating representation.

The neutral resident expert provider owns one whole-input routed observation
invocation around its existing serial or tensor-parallel grouped worker. It uses
the shared invocation guard, so an enclosing provider scope remains the sole
owner and an unscoped cold observer receives begin/batches/finish in order.
Disabled observation still executes the existing worker directly; failures
finish before returning while retaining the first cause. Cold equation
construction includes the provider's fixed invocation controls in its metadata
reservation. No synthetic route tensor or family branch is introduced.

The ordinary fixed broadcast frontend reserves its known result count once.
An identity three-input broadcast therefore uses one initializer vector, one
result vector and one retained primitive-input vector, matching the existing
resident source's three requests per primitive. Geometric result-vector growth
is not hidden by unrelated graph nodes or a larger quota. Broadcasting, dtype
promotion, ordering and arithmetic remain the same for ordinary and original
execution.

A retained contiguous capture row owns paid copies of exact per-rank cold source
geometry and scalar facts before the first forward. Its closed preparation
consumes that source under the common program's actual epoch and original funding
run/reservation, then uses the existing receipt, allowance, fragment-host bank and
delivery constructors. Source order comes from the ordinary receipt writer. Local
hooks temporarily own the actual bank/receipt; each chunk/epoch can be lent once
and must return to its original continuation. Empty local overlap issues only the
actual local completion descriptor, while absent ranks acquire no tensor source.
Incomplete local coverage retains its real bank in the typed error. This row owner
does not itself perform protocol votes or open public admission; the shared sealed
program must coordinate it before forwarding hooks and before final delivery.


The routed partition cold driver records an explicit dynamic expert region at each
actual provider invocation. Its paid equation record retains the selected local
grouped specification, original expert owner table, source row/top-k geometry,
communication group and neural TP mode. It never reads Workspace routing IDs or
constructs a hypothetical peer-count matrix. The ordinary executable provider
enters the same source declaration through an additive communication callback,
whose default runs the existing dispatch/return body. Native region lowering must
supply finite child graph, completion and storage sources before the record can
have a complete bound; an absent producer remains incomplete admission. Pure EP
keeps the neural parallel context absent, independently of its control group.

The original grammar sampling loan exposes only the logical word prefix of the
actual paid TokTrie mask. The trie walker retains its extra sentinel bit and
complete allocation; at word-aligned vocabulary sizes that sentinel occupies an
additional backing word. Native sampling and capture still receive the strict
canonical vocabulary extent, while the unchanged parser owner retains all
backing words and funding through copy, failure and retirement.

The portable pipeline receiver allocator describes the same typed zero-fill
constructor as the native allocator. Activation placeholders retain the selected
F16/BF16/F32 wire precision; I32/U32 placeholders retain their logical type. Their
existing scalar, broadcast and Full sources supply actual CPU or Metal facts
before byte framing. Generic initialization does not establish those facts.

CPU saved-state copy quotation consumes the existing Contiguous source and typed
eager deep-copy constructor. Contiguous retains both alias and logical-copy
possibilities because a row-major descriptor can still name oversized backing.
The eager destination is independent and keeps its physical floating precision;
missing source representation stays unknown. The existing OriginalCopyPlan owns
the actual completion frontier, recovery aliases and separate copy account.

The shared text object cursor drives both the ordinary declarative tool parser
and runtime's paid JSON object owner. Each path retains its actual raw input;
field spans preserve exact argument spelling, keys are decoded by the existing
JSON parser, and duplicate keys remain rejected. Ordinary schema and semantic
validation remain in their existing facade workers. Runtime's original owner
prepares finite raw/field destinations, uses the existing paid serde event
parser for complete field and object syntax, and retains every produced key,
string and buffer on failure. Copies allocate new raw/field storage under their
new funding while immutable decoded strings keep their original payer. This
object mechanism does not authorize tool names, schemas or protocol envelopes;
those source and semantic consumers remain required before tool admission.

The routed dynamic-region handoff binds its received rows once to the completed
count owner. Physical and logical count consensus both retain that owner. Actual
received global/local expert pairs validate the retained constructor map before
local row counts and I32 indices enter funded destinations; a repeated or failed
binding cannot refund the attempt. The same count owner authenticates prepared
integer ingress for metadata exchange and local grouped evaluation. Empty ingress
uses an explicitly initialized unit seed and its zero-length slice, while original
metadata readout borrows the existing completed source instead of adding ordinary
Eval/readback. The region still requires its complete native child graph and
movement census before the original admission predicate may accept it.

Partition fragment Host preparation may precede the actual forward receipt.
The move-only prepared owner uses the same original table and per-fragment
holds as immediate construction, retaining separate destination identities.
Binding compares the shared admission, artifact/execution/overlay, selection,
phase/prediction, full global/local projections, world, combination and limits;
only the separately authenticated run/forward identity is supplied later. The
final native allowance remains mandatory, and a refused bind retains all holds.
No funding run is cloned, reconstructed or exposed through this Host owner.

JSON tool field interpretation now uses one text-layer worker for ordinary
owned values and original paid value certificates. Function-name priority,
argument-object validation, protocol ID Unicode-scalar length and required-field
ordering remain shared. The facade projects actual selected JSON framing and
field names into the existing original channel-source compiler. That compiler
copies every literal under the same paid decoder/controller source owner;
equal bytes from another source do not supply its identity. Other payload
shapes keep their distinct required producers, and neither these declarations
nor grammar acceptance substitutes for complete application-schema validation.

The retained contiguous capture row accepts that one prepared Host owner at its
actual first epoch through the same receipt/allowance/delivery constructor used
for immediate original funding. The prepared arm performs no new reservation or
host allocation. Both routes keep local hook loans move-only and compare the
same completed native source estimate before each projected transformation.

JSON call framing uses the same text-layer transitions for ordinary and original
consumers. The worker borrows exact copied protocol literals, compares combined
suffixes without an intermediate String, and reports consumption before and
after the completion callback separately. A failed callback therefore retains
the same pending closing bracket as the ordinary parser. The shared ordinary
consumer also records when a JSON-list function suffix has already been consumed,
so a split before the following separator does not require that suffix twice.
This fixes that streaming boundary while leaving semantic completion validation
with the caller's actual tool/schema owner.

CPU value completion/retention uses the same borrowed-value worker as Metal.
Its equation has no output tensor; the CPU recorder includes the exact root count,
fixed controls and one actual nested completion, without a new arithmetic birth.
Pipeline framing preserves proved row/last-axis facts: senders return their input,
while receivers decode dense bytes through the existing materialization/View/
reshape sequence. Arbitrary physical source strides are not copied across ranks.

### Grouped checkpoint parameter representation

Neutral grouped workspace construction resolves retained parameter representation
against the complete bank shape, including the leading group axis. The temporary
ungrouped projection description does not match a stored grouped tensor. The same
identity/geometry lookup used by ordinary parameters now runs after adding that
axis, preserving exact scalar and layout facts without inferring them from a
logical floating type or checkpoint format. Missing identities and changed bank
geometry retain unknown representation; scalar constructor accounting is unchanged.

The same scheduled partition receipt program can retain complete and contiguous
rows together. Contiguous rows use the shared Source vote and ordered receipt
transcript, lend their original hook owner through the existing observer, advance
the ordinary global prefill target, and enter the same final receipt delivery.
Empty shards validate their real local source; absent pipeline ranks acquire no
source. This does not qualify a native cold placement or open a public gate.

The scheduled constructor distinguishes complete producer descriptors from
contiguous slots. Each contiguous slot must consume its own retained source and
protected Host bank before preparation; absent attachment is a typed refusal.
Both row kinds retain the same loaded run identity and actual first forward epoch.

The prepared JSON call producer validates field roles during the same actual
field-completion callback as ordinary parsing. It publishes retained function
name, ID and argument fragments in the ordinary order, then performs final
object/required-field validation. The generated call-ID decimal writer is also
shared and has an exact fixed destination. A fallible completion loan receives
the exact name, original argument spelling and funding; the loan must own the
original full-schema producer and pay its actual parse/validation scratch.
Only its success permits ToolCallEnd. Failure retains the call prefix and the
loan's concrete error independently. The public adapter authenticates the
registered schema source before installing this callback; grammar acceptance
does not replace full-schema validation.

A dynamic expert region retains its exact local grouped equation as a separate
native child source. Ordinary grouped modules and the child quote use the same
`WorkspaceGroupedBank::trace_with_parameters` recorder. The completed count owner
selects actual received rows; actual native parameter/input descriptors are
projected again and their graph, record, kernel and backing requirements must fit
the retained row ceiling before child construction. The one-use region cursor
requires a successful completed child, not merely an attempted local callback.

That child owns a prepared validation/grouped-output collector. Its explicit
parent observer must match the active collector; its child observer must match
the current already-admitted native scope. The temporary loan restores the exact
parent collector and retains the child collector, unused destinations and failed
assertion arrays in Recovery. Ordinary collector entry remains non-nestable. The
shared nested-root completion handles both returned values and actual assertions.
This local numerical source alone is not a complete dynamic-region fact: native
movement/input and transport ceilings still have to close before EP admission.

### Retained F32 routing precision

The native normalized-selector workspace recipe accepts Preserve and Input
precision when every actual floating operand is retained as F32. Logical floating
storage is insufficient evidence; unknown or reduced-precision operands keep their
typed incomplete bound. Explicit F32 conversion retains its existing recipe.
The shared row-projection probe owns fixed controls for its non-BF16 and CPU
rejections. F32 preserved projection accounts for those controls without claiming
a BF16 kernel invocation or changing the selector's numerical worker.

Saved resume retains the selected CPU or Metal mechanism in both the sealed
isolated-copy context and future equations. Its native preparation captures the
actual execution stream: CPU repeats the existing decoder/key copy completion
for each operand, followed by one pending reshape/cast frontier. Pending rank is
kept separate from the largest state rank; no GPU kernel allowance substitutes
for a CPU copy. Saved admission closures preserve the concrete refusal site.

The expert-region local child uses a finite census beside the existing grouped
allocation equations. Zero and singleton are explicit cases. Nonchunked positive
row populations use their upper endpoint: projection and validation buffers are
rounded nonnegative row multiples, and sort buffers/kernel passes are monotone.
For the actual Gated threshold/chunk worker, the census additionally visits the
largest admitted row count in each chunk-remainder class and the last unchunked
row. Within one remainder class, extra whole chunks add retained allocations,
graph nodes, validation roots and kernels; final output/concatenation extents also
grow. This covers singleton/full tails and the threshold transition in at most
CHUNK + 3 traces, independent of the route population size. Each visited trace
retains the usual metadata charges and exact worker qualification. The empty
child follows the existing local provider's zeros-like, Linear output reshape and
optional TP bias alias. Actual completed rows still require the exact retained
source and fit every componentwise ceiling before child construction.

The partition prefill quote borrows `PartitionPrefillCaptureGeometry` from the
same admitted projection used by the real receipt consumer. The geometry has no
receipt identity, account or source precision. The native observer constructs
its local projection through the existing paid contiguous constructor, records
precision only from the observed tensor, and traces the existing raw, Summary
or Histogram worker. Additive nonlinear observations retain raw terms until the
shared F64-to-F32 assembly. A real local replica or empty spatial overlap retains
its existing completion frontier; an absent invocation supplies no scalar or
native source. Public projected delivery still requires the original Host owner,
actual distributed source vote and sealed receipt program before admission.


The full tool-completion validator remains the pinned `jsonschema` 0.52.0
engine, separate from the deliberately relaxed grammar embedding. The local
external fork now shares its recursive cache worker between ordinary and
private funded validation contexts. A funded context borrows the exact cold
hash source and pays each reached stack/table replacement before allocation,
using hashbrown's shared prospective request. Failed growth preserves the
existing scratch and first cause; no scalar refund creates renewed authority.
The public prepared-chat Auto callback now consumes this context through its
registered schema source and paid borrowed input. Each selected keyword and
immutable source still needs its own declaration; an unknown required workspace
returns its typed first refusal before that worker runs.

The schema context now also owns the reached `unevaluatedItems` Boolean mask
and `unevaluatedProperties` name-set allocations. The original and ordinary
property traversal uses one hash-table worker and preserves conditional,
combinator, and recursive marking order; source property names remain borrowed
for the closed input representation. The mask reserves its exact reached
array length before initialization. A refused set insertion preserves earlier
marks and the context's first cause. These collection producers do not qualify
pattern matching, arbitrary JSON adapters, formatted diagnostics, or the rest
of the full-schema completion path.

The shared expert-region callback lends an opaque movement-source loan to the
existing route driver. Native movement authenticates the private retained region
occurrence, original source account, selected stream and active parent observer;
an equal-shaped later region cannot reuse the loan. Its actual integer gather
and scatter destinations enter through the initialized request input producer,
including a paid empty slice. Shape directories and sequential accumulation wave
vectors use the same cumulative account. The ordinary and original paths keep
one movement implementation and one forward/reverse routing protocol. This
source/ingress join does not certify the still-incomplete dynamic movement and
transport numerical ceiling; that gate remains closed until those producers are
retained together with the local numerical child.

### Variable transport storage before routing

The selected Ring implementation exposes a descriptive envelope for global
sender and receiver row ceilings, using the same constructor, CPU evaluation,
packet-allocation counter, and completion census as actual variable exchange.
One packet is bounded by the lesser row ceiling; every original forwarding hop
and every complete peer-squared matrix owner remains counted. No count matrix,
tensor, native task, or execution authority is synthesized by the query.
Architecture/runtime callers include idle sentinels and reverse traffic in their
semantic ceilings. Execution still authenticates the actual completed matrix and
checks its componentwise capacity against the retained region allowance.

The completion input producer now builds a neutral immutable JSON tree through
the existing paid serde event parser. Its record and decoded-string buffers
are allocated under their original metadata owner before parsing. Object
lookup preserves decoded duplicate-key last-value semantics and lexicographic
member order; superseded subtrees remain physically owned and charged. Borrowed
node/child views cannot escape the tree, and syntax or allocation failure
retains its actual produced prefix. This runtime mechanism owns JSON storage,
not schema policy; the facade still owns the full-schema validation adapter and
tool completion decision.

The schema engine now performs intrinsic funding at its existing `Validate`
dispatch. Ordinary validation uses the same bodies as before; a funded
invocation enters a body only after its explicit frame producer succeeds.
Unqualified intrinsic implementations return a typed first cause before body
execution. Recursive references and compositional children pass through this
same dispatch, so one unsupported child cannot silently execute ordinary
scratch. The initial body set covers structural/object/array traversal, type
and size checks, combinators, required fields, conditional branches, and the
paid unevaluated masks/sets. Pattern-bearing property marking refuses at its
actual match call until its regex workspace is joined. This is an additive
execution qualification mechanism, not a second schema validator; regex,
format, uniqueness, numeric fallbacks, content and custom keyword sources remain
unfinished breadth. No public tool capability changes in this packet.

Contiguous capture now protects original Host destinations before the Source
vote while retaining only the actual local tensor precision. Its unbound
fragment allowance runs the same receipt cost worker from exact geometry and
F32 output estimates, and exposes no native loan or destination methods. The
existing distributed Source frame supplies common precision; binding consumes
the unbound owner without reserving or refunding global capture credits, then
constructs the ordinary typed fragment destinations. Rejected source votes keep
the original Host owner in the error. Local nonexporting replicas retain their
own physical source and completion descriptor, separate from exported receipt
rows; ranks without an invocation retain no local tensor witness.

Rank-two additive indexed updates now have a neutral workspace operation rather
than an elementwise surrogate. Its exact source describes target/update/index
geometry and target-dtype accumulation, including repeated destinations. The
shared expert movement worker records and executes the same gather, scalar
flatten/reshape, zero and ScatterAxis Sum equations. MLX quotes the actual
cast/broadcast/output source and native graph/kernel population; integer values
and their validation still belong to the retained movement ingress producer.

The original expert movement producer retains cold profiles for input/scalar
packing, returned-row permutation, zero destinations and additive row updates.
Each actual invocation completes its parent-owned local dependencies before
entering the already authenticated child-scope mechanism. Actual descriptors are
projected from those completed roots and checked against the retained row, dtype
and native graph/record/backing ceilings. The same ordinary movement equations
then run with a paid validation collector and exact nested output destination;
completion/failure retains the input roots, source, bank and metadata account.
The separate transport-envelope join remains necessary before complete dynamic
region admission.

The shared expert route driver supplies a finite movement itinerary from source
rows, routes per row, reduction order and the provider's separate-bias declaration.
The cold region retains that declaration; the actual driver authenticates it before
reverse traffic. Each original movement consumes an attempt before preparing its
indices, and only exact child completion marks it delivered. A successful region
requires every declared child once, with no outstanding attempt. Failed attempts
and failed final validation remain spent with their original source account.

Expert-region transport retains the shared architecture's named forward/inverse
payload itinerary. Each native variable transfer spends the next retained entry,
authenticates the actual completed count owner and selected physical communicator,
and compares actual matrix/shape/capacities with the native descriptive envelope.
Every sender and receiver row ceiling is global; an idle local bank never lowers
another member's bound. Zero-traffic sentinels are included explicitly. Failure
leaves the entry pending and spent, while a successful region requires all quoted
entries to have reached exact native completion. Native envelopes alone grant no
construction authority; the actual count matrix remains required by construction.

The four expert-route parent reshapes are now one neutral geometry/normalization
helper shared by actual preparation and the cold region recorder. Cold recording
also restores each returned tensor's original leading shape through the same
Tensor reshape contract. These parent operators therefore remain in the ordinary
model graph and are distinct from the retained local/movement/transport children;
recording an opaque region no longer hides their constructor population.

Original partition fragment Host preparation retains the initial admitted producer-record ceiling separately from the effective transport bound. The actual run/epoch envelope may tighten the effective bound through the existing receipt worker; Host compatibility still compares the original ceiling, source, geometry and original limits. The later receipt identity, source allowance and decoder continue using the tightened bound. This permits pre-epoch Host protection without inventing native precision or a cold transport.

Original contiguous prefill capture now retains backend-neutral projection/native estimates under the exact loaded architecture source during admission. The shared Host constructor protects each local/received fragment destination before the request funding run moves into execution. The actual operation moves these owners once into the existing partition program; only its Source vote binds the recorded local precision to peer fragment allowances. Cold Host contexts use the same loaded-label worker as the actual program and cannot bind the first forward epoch. An inactive schedule row has no fabricated producer, scalar or Host destination; active rows still require their exact source. Raw additive nonlinear terms keep the existing F64-to-F32 global assembly. Public projected-capture admission remains gated until the outer cold/observer and budget-policy consumers are complete.

The full-schema completion adapter borrows the runtime's paid serde event tree,
including exact primitive numbers, decoded strings, last-value duplicate keys,
and stable node identities. Its explicit representation contract qualifies only
allocation-free primitive access; diagnostic conversion and numeric spelling do
not inherit that qualification. The pinned validator's original entry uses the
same compiled body dispatch and preserves the first scratch refusal. Cold typed
validator construction and its retained source accounting are separate from this
entry. The facade binds that source to the actual controller recipe and pool
before installing the public completion callback. Parse failures and schema
mismatches retain the actual input prefix, compiled source, and metadata payer.

Original semantic channels retain an authenticated neutral full-schema callback
with the exact controller/source pool. The runtime consumes the same text-owned
JSON envelope and field workers as the ordinary parser. A call ends only after
the facade callback succeeds; framing consumption preserves the ordinary
before/after-callback order. Independent copies include the live object cursor,
raw spelling, fields and call index, while immutable text/source aliases retain
their actual original payers. Full-schema failures use the existing shared
portable error owner through speculative output, with allocation-free aliasing
and identity equality; they preserve the first concrete cause and actual input
prefix. Facade source accounting and authenticated callback installation are
joined in the public Auto tool path.

The whole-operation token-validation collector lends its existing finite grouped
observer slots through an authenticated lexical prefill role. The backend checks
the current parent before the retained bank accepts a child, binds only that
accepted child's observer, and restores the parent before normal native sealing
or unwind recovery. This handoff changes neither custody, counts nor submission
authority; grouped callbacks still require the exact current observer. Fixed
handoff controls are included for every declared prefill role.

The shared expert exchange driver borrows checkpoint-independent route metadata
directly into the transport's paid conversion worker. Sequential combination
obtains its order and destination directories from the retained movement account
and uses iterative in-place ordering with original-row tie breaks. Ordinary
combination borrows the packing plan's destination slice. These changes remove
unpriced copies and sort scratch while preserving architecture-owned ordering
and the actual transport/completion source.

The saved CPU pending-token trace consumes the same isolated integer source as
its separately admitted native copy. The cold CPU adapter prices unchanged-shape
integer reshape returns, singleton reshape aliases through the existing native
fixed-stride planner, and the closed packed I32-to-U32 text-matrix cast. It does
not infer a floating representation or general row layout for integer tensors.
The copy account continues to own native Graph, Record, completion and backing
resources; these tensor/host facts complete the shared resume report rather than
introducing another preparation worker.

A complete original expert region now reduces its retained local child, finite
movement children, exact forward/reverse native transfer envelopes and physical
count/vote producers into the shared model byte/birth census. Its actual parent
completion attempts and possible empty metadata slices contribute separately to
the existing Metal or CPU graph recorder. Those sources, their precise completed
count binding and funded host directories are required before facts become
complete. Logical count extraction/provider-wave and noncanonical reorder sources
remain distinct missing producers until their own retained envelopes are joined.

The pinned schema source exposes a separate cold retained-allocation census.
It visits actual boxes, vector/string capacities, Arc payload layouts, paths,
and recursive-reference cells, deduplicating shared live allocations by identity.
The facade's borrowed representation declares the exact key and schema-number
backing it constructs. No invocation reruns this allocating traversal. Absolute
URI storage, retained serde object metadata, compiled hash collections and
additional keyword source classes without inspectors remain explicit unfinished
source producers, distinct from per-invocation validator scratch qualification.
Their first typed source refusal is retained; schema spelling length supplies
neither a source-capacity estimate nor admission.

Projected partition capture applies the admitted limit policy through the same
scheduled Source and Coordination votes as complete-producer capture. Only typed
receipt or fragment-allowance limits can become a Skip; missing or foreign source
geometry remains an error. A skipped row advertises no scalar, lends no native
loan, and retains its original prepaid Host until delivery or an owning failure.
Preparation failure before binding also retains that Host. Earlier ledger
charges remain spent in either policy, including when the source vote rejects.

Managed partition capture now selects its initial-prefill fragment source through
one backend contract shared by model quotation and remote-output handling. The
retained architecture table must supply a contiguous Input, Unit or Readout hook,
and the source must have the implemented raw/Preview/Summary/Histogram program.
Real local callbacks validate native scalar, shape and completion; absent PP
ranks advance the existing logical fragment progression without using published
logits as an activation source. Initial-prefill-only selections remain inactive
when cached decode emits the same path. Projected decode and globally selected
vocabulary reducers still require separate retained native/delivery programs;
this source join does not advertise those unfinished paths.

The dynamic expert region retains its exact count itinerary before execution. Physical counts keep the selected native Gather source; logical counts retain the existing pair, routed-peer or packed-world recipes and any additional world census required by the selected variable plan. The completed count reader borrows these recipes from one spent region occurrence, and successful region completion requires that count owner to have finished. Wire geometry comes from the same encoder helper; no logical subgroup is substituted with a plain physical Gather. Provider-wave and variable-route qualification remain separate source requirements.

Funded capture sequencing refusals retain an allocation-free callback stage at
the shared observer boundary. This identifies preparation, coordination,
completion and value-hook failures without formatting a diagnostic or replacing
a native/policy cause. The concrete protocol enum remains part of the existing
error/control size census; no new error ownership or funding source is created.

The facade registers independently compiled immutable full tool-schema declarations
through the existing neutral controller-source storage worker. The retained
source records its actual graph/row/name capacities and exact recipe identity;
source inspection and compilation remain cold operations under exclusion. A
source class without a complete inspector retains a typed refusal after its
partial compiled graph is destroyed, rather than lending unaccounted storage.
The ordinary and original declarations use one tool-validation worker.

The original channel consumer authenticates this registered declaration against
the actual grammar recipe and pool, then invokes the pinned full-schema engine
on its paid borrowed argument tree. The channel reserves the callback's concrete
failure transport before entering it; escaped errors retain the actual argument
prefix, registered schema and payer. Completion emits ToolCallEnd only after
validation succeeds. Forbidden-trigger requests require no schema callback, and
all invocation drivers and copy/commit ordering remain shared. Keyword bodies
and immutable source classes without original producers still return their
first typed refusal; this join does not claim full validator breadth.

Expert provider votes retain the architecture-declared tensor, expert and optional pipeline-wave groups in their existing order. The neutral failure-agreement policy has an additive completed-source hook: only a backend's explicit retained request source can use it, while ordinary and custom policies retain the prepared-group default. Returned booleans require exact native completion; the hook cannot manufacture a completion, change the selected group, or choose a different provider schedule.

Original full-schema completion also qualifies the existing Boolean/null/string
const bodies and small string-enum body. They use the same ordinary borrowed
primitive access and comparison loops. Numeric equality, recursive comparisons,
large hash-backed enums and numeric bound helpers consume their corresponding
source/scratch producers described below; qualification remains specific to
the actual selected worker.

Large schema property maps and string-enum sets now use the pinned hashbrown
map/set with the same existing ahash seed/lookup policy in ordinary and original
paths. Cold source census consumes each completed table's actual allocation
request plus its retained names, strings and shared child graph. The change
keeps validation traversal and error ordering on the input/property workers;
it does not claim the unrelated pattern-index or evaluator tables.
The pinned table now exposes a safe lookup-control query for the actual
get/find/probe chain, including its selected control-group representation. The
query does not hash, compare, probe or allocate. These schema consumers name
their existing ahash/string-equivalence obligations separately and reserve the
combined body before the original map/set lookup. The prospective reservation
API and every ordinary lookup worker remain unchanged.

The pinned jsonschema-value 0.52.1 dependency supplies side-effect-free controls
for its actual primitive number comparison/equality helpers. These source
queries report no original population when that dependency's own compiled
arbitrary-precision feature selects allocating fallback work. The existing
full-schema min/max/exclusive-bound and numeric-const validators consume the
queries before calling their unchanged ordinary helpers, retaining wide integer
and signed-zero semantics. MultipleOf's separate fraction fallback and arbitrary precision remain unfinished producers.
The vendored dependency remains excluded from workspace membership; no foreign
VM feature is selected by eredu and no new unsafe code or exception is added.

Structural equality now has one borrowed worker used by the ordinary SerdeJson
adapter and original full-schema array/enum/const consumers. Each reached
recursive frame and numeric helper accepts the existing validation funding loan
before access/descent; rejected work retains its first actual cause. The worker
preserves mathematical number comparison, array position and the selected serde
object key iteration order. It performs no input-to-Value conversion or key
allocation. Other ordinary representation overrides remain unchanged. Compiled
object literal backing is supplied by the immutable declaration described below;
unrelated opaque serde-object source graphs still require their own inspector.

Original full-schema pattern validation qualifies the existing compiler-selected
prefix, exact, literal-alternation and ECMA whitespace workers. Their actual
stored strings/vector/location are included in the immutable source census,
and each borrowed body has its own finite invocation controls. Both ordinary
and original validation continue to execute the same unchanged pattern bodies
and compiler recognition. General regex sources and execution remain separately
unqualified; a literal-pattern qualification does not admit the fallback engine.

The selected non-arbitrary-precision integer multipleOf worker now exposes its
own finite comparison/modulo controls. The existing integer validator consumes
that source and retains its exact scalar/location declaration, preserving wide
signed/unsigned modulo and the ordinary large-divisor fallback. Fractional
multipleOf still needs its decimal-printer and BigFraction execution sources;
it is not covered by the integer worker's qualification.

Compiled object/array constants and non-string enum metadata use the same
immutable literal declaration in ordinary and original validation. Its scalars,
strings, Vec elements and Vec object members expose their completed capacities
to the existing schema source census; no hidden serde BTreeMap allocation is
retained in these declarations. Object key iteration order and exact numbers
are copied from the input without serialization or normalization.
A single borrowed equality worker handles serde values and those declarations.
The selected ordinary serde adapter and original context consume it directly;
custom ordinary Node implementations preserve their equals_value override via
the additive literal default. Ordinary error construction reconstructs the
same expected JSON metadata, outside original invocation. This closes nested
object constants/enums without granting unknown retained object graphs elsewhere,
and their source accounts remain held through actual input/validation failures.

Absolute schema URI storage uses the pinned fluent-uri 0.4.1 source's read-only
owned-string capacity query. The existing source census deduplicates its actual
Arc before charging the URI shell and complete retained string allocation,
including spare capacity. URI parsing, normalization and reference resolution
remain unchanged and occur under the existing cold construction owner. The
dependency is excluded from workspace membership; no new unsafe code or native
boundary is introduced, and the older 0.3.2 dependency is unaffected.

Noncanonical world variable exchange now retains source-derived input and output block-permutation envelopes as well as the native transfer envelope. The existing block worker is traced at its zero, singleton and maximum positive-block branches; arity and row ceilings derive from the selected membership and route population. Execution recompiles its actual completed counts through that same worker and must fit Graph, Record, backing, birth, control and kernel ceilings before entering the child role. This grants no completed count matrix or native construction authority. Local peer-route exchange remains separately source-qualified.

Local logical expert transport retains one source slot for each actual slice, count hop, asymmetric payload hop and final join in the existing selected route plan. Native pair envelopes use source-derived zero/singleton/maximum send and receive geometries; numerical stages reuse the shared block/join worker. Actual completed matrices and native peers remain mandatory, and each stage is spent and checked before its child constructor. Region success requires every retained stage to have been consumed, without creating another communication schedule or refunding failed attempts.

Inactive replicated expert-provider waves carry an explicit neutral wave/unit declaration with the architecture's ordered tensor, expert and pipeline vote groups. The same original expert occurrence directory retains their control-only native sources, without creating a local numerical bank or count matrix. Cold source facts and CPU/Metal recipe census include every selected vote's backing and births; actual source-bound completion spends the existing vote cursor, and the shared occurrence cannot finish until all votes complete. Ordinary execution still invokes the existing provider agreement body. Dynamic inactive expert dispatch/count waves remain a distinct source join.

Replicated expert-provider declarations retain the exact bank and invocation unit on both active ranks and inactive pipeline participants. The active provider records its same ordered vote source after local numerical work; inactive participants retain their wave ordinal. The ordinary provider agreement body and its original failure precedence are shared, with no inferred group and no numerical bank created for idle participants.

Dynamic inactive pipeline expert waves now retain each bank's selected per-unit route cardinality with the existing schedule. Their neutral declaration describes a zero local contribution and the active peers' row ceiling, with the exact payload sequence, wire scalar and provider groups. The common count, variable-transfer and provider source constructors serve both active and idle occurrences. The same parent typed-zero/empty-metadata Slice producers and their finite completions are included in native recipe census; idle inputs complete under their retained parent before being lent to a communication child. No cold count matrix or local numerical bank is synthesized. Source cursors preserve forward-transfer, provider-vote and reverse-transfer order, and success requires the entire occurrence to finish.

The selected local-peer path has a separate per-hop receive-prototype slot. Positive receives retain the existing initialized leaf; an actual zero count uses the shared completed empty block worker because initialized host leaves require positive dimensions. Its exact numerical envelope is included even when that branch is not taken, and the occurrence is spent without refund. Local-route parent inputs complete before entering the first transform or communication child.

The single-invocation projected capture source is shared by paid fragment Host
destinations and the native cold equation. Runtime retains the original global
admission and exact producer projection; the backend selects its existing raw,
Summary or Histogram worker. Additive nonlinear transforms remain raw F32 terms
until the existing global F64-to-F32 assembly. This source does not grant work or
open projected decode admission: per-step original Host protection and move-only
program/hook issuance must be joined before public decode support is reported.
Chunked initial prefill continues through its separate temporal projection.

An ordinary projected local callback now loans that same receipt and fragment
bank out of the transport owner. It validates the actual source and estimate,
spends the existing per-fragment native loan, invokes the standard typed backend
transform, and records the result in the original once-only slot. Errors retain
the detached bank and receipt; neither a partial native write nor a repeated
callback can release the original Host or refund its native attempt. Public
projected decode remains closed until per-frame protection and observer/program
issuance consume this callback.

The globally funded fragment allowance now carries its actual phase and
prediction into the once-only assembly charge. Initial-prefill consumers retain
their original coordinate check. A single-invocation target pairs the ordinary
frame's typed destination with that exact charge and account; the same receipt
exchange releases its value only after the final delivery vote. Recording the
result adds the remaining previously reserved record charge once and preserves
partition evidence. This does not yet issue per-frame native capture sources.

The same runtime contiguous program retains either actual chunked-prefill
geometry or an actual decode prediction. Decode uses one original Host fragment
slot, one source-voted local native attempt and the existing ordinary callback
and final delivery path. Nonexporting local replicas and empty-overlap sources
carry their own fixed physical shape/scalar through the same source completion
worker; absent ranks fabricate neither tensor nor scalar. The facade's public
projected decode guard still awaits native cold observation and per-frame Host
protection from the retained request before it can be opened.


Projected ordinary decode now uses the same retained partition receipt program
as initial prefill. Native admission prepares the actual per-rank geometry and
estimate for each selected future prediction, and protects a separate original
Host destination before request funding moves into execution. A prediction-keyed
move-only slot supplies that exact owner once; resumed preparation starts at the
retained next prediction and cannot restore a previously spent capture budget.
The cold observer uses the single-invocation source for local transforms and the
existing replica completion for actual empty or non-exporting local tensors.
Absent pipeline ranks reserve the global result without fabricating tensor or
scalar facts. The late Source vote binds precision before fragment issuance.
Raw, Preview, Summary and Histogram follow the same shared delivery and assembly
workers, preserving raw F64 accumulation followed by F32 conversion before global
nonlinear reduction. Explicit nested windows and projected vocabulary selection
retain their separate source requirements.

The typed routed-provider traversal preserves its retained execution geometry across uncaptured spans as well as spans carrying prepared observation paths. Its private source-selected callback is still the canonical architecture provider equation and uses the shared internal observer/unit worker. Public arbitrary unit callbacks keep invalidating prepared geometry and observation bindings; no stale binding is reset and no graph is reconstructed to recover from mutation.

Ordinary local variable exchange completes its count and payload pair in the same complementary physical-endpoint order retained by the counted pair source. This uses the selected logical exchange plan and the existing native completion, including asymmetric zero-row receives. Both pair roots settle before the ordinary route advances or assembles output; a send-first dependency on both peers no longer makes large payload progress depend on socket buffering. Explicit intermediate routes still require their retained participation wave and are not enabled by this ordering change.

The focused public expert-parallel fixture matrix reuses the same nonzero routed model and ordinary/managed/controlled generation runner. In addition to physical EP2, TP2×EP2 selects actual adjacent logical EP pairs in a four-rank Ring; PP2×EP2 crosses a decoder-unit boundary and executes the retained inactive expert waves; TP2×PP2×EP2 combines both in eight ranks. Each case keeps the existing independent serial oracle, uneven two-position prefill chunks, four committed outputs with cached decode, fresh communicator per mode and every-rank ID/text comparison. These cases are staged validation requirements until their native results are recorded, not claims of execution coverage.

The public saved expert fixture reuses the existing snapshot/restore/fork driver for both physical EP2 and combined TP2×PP2×EP2. Fresh process groups independently snapshot before the first commit and after one commit, compare original/restored/forked futures with the serial nonzero routed oracle, and retain the saved prefix throughout. The common lifecycle also exercises one-byte fork refusal alongside cancelled and one-byte restore refusal, checks unchanged live snapshot/branch/retained usage with nondecreasing cumulative copying, and verifies retirement without copy-budget refund. Saved execution still obtains a fresh occurrence directory from the retained manifest/world and exact parameter epoch through the shared resume quote; this adds validation coverage, not another saved-state engine. Native results remain pending.


### Planned resident expert invocation lifecycle

The selected gated and ReLU-squared resident providers now enter the existing
runtime routed-invocation scope even when no partition-coordinate map is needed.
Their actual grouped batches share one begin/finish lifetime, including compact
and tensor-parallel calls. Nested coordinate/provider adapters keep borrowing an
already-active invocation; they do not create another frame or refund capture
spending. The scope borrows the original request and introduces no native
tensor or host payload buffer. The public routed-capture comparison exercises
this selected-provider join.

The original full-schema property-name worker uses the same ordinary string-node
callback and child validator. Its selected facade representation declares the
actual allocation-free unit buffer and borrowed key node; the validation context
reserves those construction frames before each reached call. An adapter without
that declaration refuses before its buffer or string constructor runs. Legacy
dependencies, dependent-required and dependent-schema validators retain and
inspect their actual prepared-key vectors and child graphs, and execute their
unchanged borrowed lookup bodies under the same per-dispatch funding.

The paid serde event tree now follows the selected serde map order, reported by
the parser dependency itself: insertion order with preserve_order, lexical order
otherwise. Repeated keys keep the first position and last value while superseded
records retain their payer. This preserves the pinned JSONSchema engine's
preexisting member-zip equality under that configuration; the new Literal source
does not redefine ordinary object equality. Ordinary key-based JSON equality may
be desirable upstream, but changing it is separate from this ownership migration.

Retained expert movement refusal distinguishes input declaration, exact shape/dtype profile selection, native input projection and componentwise recipe ceiling. The typed diagnostic carries only fixed input geometry/dtype and named native counters; it is retained through the existing metadata error source and grants no construction authority. Source identity, input matching and every graph/record/backing/birth/control/kernel comparison remain strict.


Paid dense and contiguous receipt construction accepts explicitly shaped physical
invocations through the same original admission and ordinary receipt validator.
The context's invocation axes remain in the canonical identity and are checked
against the original invocation bounds before source geometry is projected.
Fragment Host inspection borrows those exact axes for its existing raw or typed
reducer destination, including raw additive terms. This geometry capability does
not select a native completion or grant nested execution: the ordinary native
callback equation and final ordinary-frame assembly remain closed to explicit
invocations until their nested root, window and owner consumers are supplied.
Terminal vocabulary retains its separate typed physical-readout requirement.


The projected explicit-invocation source composes a receipt's authenticated
spatial fragment with the existing logical row-window worker. The receipt keeps
its complete logical invocation identity; the borrowed source separately retains
the physical invocation shape and window. Raw/Preview and disjoint
Summary/Histogram use the same geometry and typed Host planners as complete
capture. Additive nonlinear selections still export raw terms for global F64 sum
and F32 conversion before reduction. The composed source rejects changed logical
extents, context coordinates, invalid windows and ambiguous row-axis partitioning.
Its fixed geometry frames are priced separately from ordinary invocation controls.
This geometry source alone does not authorize nested native completion, issue a
per-window destination, or publish a window as the complete receipt. Those owners
remain required at the retained invocation integration boundary.


Causal component prefill declarations come from the selected architecture
projection worker. The shared dense MLP supplies its actual unit and write hooks
(and their effective companions) under the enclosing block's causal input proof;
custom projection workers keep an empty default. Dynamic Qwen selection delegates
only its actual dense branch. DeepSeek-V3 publishes the same declarations for
its selected dense MLP or shared expert, retaining the latter's independent
additive TP write provenance. This admits existing per-row equations to the
shared prefill source binder without inferring equivalence from path spelling,
tensor dimensions, or the presence of an ordinary observation hook. Routed
carriers, attention internals, generated views and proposal/media invocations
retain their separately declared source semantics.

Original full-schema uniqueItems consumes the ordinary duplicate-detection
shortcuts, threshold, structural number comparison and recursive hashing. The
selected input is held as borrowed node handles; no input-to-Value conversion
occurs. Before the large-array path, the caller pays the pinned hash table's
complete prospective allocation. Read-only lookup and already-reserved insertion
controls are supplied by that same pinned table implementation. Original hashing
uses its retained initialized seed, and a refused recursive comparison/hash
stops before insertion. Existing primitive numeric hashing and selected object
member-order behavior remain unchanged, including their upstream edge semantics.


The original expert movement child publishes each completed parent input through
that parent's existing strict traversal-leaf validator before borrowing its native
descriptor into workspace projection. Nested completion waits for work and retires
records; the root can still retain the completed event, which the read-only
allocation inspector correctly treats as unknown until that exact publication.
The validator detaches only the matching completed event, with no new evaluation,
backing grant, or source substitution. Both parent publication and child leaf
validation controls are charged per input; movement profiles, actual allocation
identity checks, and Graph/Record/backing ceilings remain unchanged.


### Routed capture invocation custody (2026-09-17)

Routed prefill and cached decode use the same five-source completion,
publication, pinning and transfer worker. Prefill retains those sources in its
canonical chunk carrier; decode retains them in the existing funded Work
collectors, as ordinary scalar capture does. Decode does not require or recreate
a retired prefill segment. Original invocation publications retain their lexical
aliases through the transfer and attach accounting custody to source backing
owners. Work retains every input before settlement and survives partial failure.
Original collectors cannot grow beyond their admitted capacity; the additional
fixed publication and borrow controls are included in the routed control report.

Projected prefill destinations keep their independently priced Host custody. The
receipt-issued raw and typed reduction claims bind to the canonical scheduled
source segment by the exact retained admission and chunk, then validate both
Host owners against the same active native account under the accounting lock.
Ordinary claims still require their original scheduled owner identity. This
association adds no source completion, allocation credit, or receipt authority;
all completed origins remain pinned in the existing segment rollback worker.

Modern-draft format and string content annotations retain their actual shared
serde string declarations and use the unchanged constant-true assertion bodies;
original completion does not reinterpret them as format validation or content
decoding. Existing contains/minContains/maxContains workers now retain their
compiled child graphs and exact diagnostic locations in the same source census.
Custom validator callbacks, asserted format helpers, and undeclared evaluator
storage still require their own qualified source and refuse before execution.

### Validated managed controller and schema composition

The selected Forbidden, Active and Auto controllers now complete through the
same public ordinary, managed and controlled prepared-chat drivers. Public Auto
tool completion passed with an actual nonzero native model, registered schema
callback, once-only tool events, terminal output and escaped immutable payloads.
Existing component checks cover split/atomic activation, history/EOS and paid
independent copies. The atomic public Auto token finishes during the initial
commit, before a verification round; no synthetic round or completion is added.

The extended borrowed-schema source check passed after exercising scalar and
numeric rules, nested literal objects/arrays, URI/ref sources, selected literal
patterns, propertyNames/dependencies and uniqueItems across its actual hashing
threshold. It also checks late funding refusal and exact retained error custody.
The paid tree preserves the selected serde map order and duplicate-key position,
including the pinned ordinary engine's existing member-order equality behavior.

A concrete source or required workspace that lacks qualification returns a typed
unknown-bound refusal. Remaining built-in sources include general regex and
pattern-key machinery, fractional multipleOf, unevaluated evaluator graphs and
some contentSchema annotation backing. Custom callbacks and externally supplied
validation engines carry no inferred bound; they are extension contracts, not
unmigrated model families. The default facade compiler uses the ordinary engine
without custom callbacks or remote retrieval. The accompanying modern-draft string
annotation and contains source hooks await focused validation. See
[managed controller coverage](execution-control.md#managed-prepared-chat-controllers-and-tool-completion)
for the public and component scope.


Expert movement and local expert children configure their retained resident graph
with the cold owned-child recipe's finite nested-completion population before
running equations. The bank stays owned by that exact child through final root
and token-validation completion; only afterward may the parent graph resume.
Completed output descriptors are published under the child observer before a
following transport borrows them as leaves. The existing metadata source pays
the traversal configuration and each output validation; completion failure keeps
the child roots, collector and source custody in the admitted recovery owner.

The completed V3 routed partition constructor retains its exact local static
specification, unit specifications, parameter description and state geometry for
cold quotation. The retained family source shares the actual resident provider
and execution handoff. Its TP spans use the existing routed observation worker;
its PP spans use the same generic text partition executor as decoder families.
The constructor publishes this neutral source only after partition validation.
Cold quotation never reconstructs checkpoint selection or mutable provider state.


### Routed preliminary geometry and native scalar facts (2026-09-17)

Host-layerwise and disk preliminary capture estimates validate the shared five
source shapes, coordinates, and logical floating/integer classes without
manufacturing a native precision witness. The later native recorder still
requires each actual floating representation and validates the same shapes
before recording completions, publications and source custody. Both stages use
one shape validator; exact native dtype checks are unchanged. This separates
conservative portable metadata from selected native facts rather than promoting
a logical Float32 descriptor into a hardware scalar guarantee.


Independently addressable grouped providers share one neutral compact-chunk plan
between ordinary and tensor-parallel execution. The plan consumes the selected
physical member-byte maximum, access class, route cardinality and retained bulk
working-set target. It emits exact ordered token ranges and per-chunk member
ceilings without discovering IDs, acquiring cache storage or granting native
work. Both existing provider loops consume this plan; actual demand discovery,
member scratch limits and acquired-output completion remain separate obligations.
Managed addressable admission stays closed until those original sources join.


The native addressable bank exposes a counted, nonblocking source-only loan of
its existing shared pool. The loan traverses retained post-lowering member
metadata directly, preserves the logical bank restriction, and reports actual
effective member bytes and replacement-row origins. Parameter replacement cannot
race this immutable census. Loan failures retain the real pool plus metadata
custody; successful references cannot escape the lexical callback. This source
view neither acquires members nor supplies their materialization/completion
recipe, so it does not open managed independent-cache admission by itself.

Physical and world-backed variable exchanges publish their completed output
descriptor under the actual transport child observer before returning to the
model scope, matching the existing local-peer exchange handoff. The source funds
one strict leaf validation per collective result, including an idle sentinel.
The accepted completion, output and retained source remain together until that
publication succeeds; no parent traversal evaluates a foreign child Event.


### Original prepared media with capture

Managed prepared input accepts the same explicit immutable capture source and
borrowed delivery callback as managed token input. The facade passes that source
through the existing core preparation options and consuming session; it does not
encode the media again or introduce a generation loop. The backend authenticates
the completed media source, current session, media decoder geometry and retained
observation paths before quoting the actual selected traversal.
The media execution gateway consumes the same accepted capture binding after
validating its original request, prepared-media selection and current traversal
paths. Every media span revalidates that binding against the retained source's
request. Ordinary media capture keeps its own source contract; an unknown
transactional or traversal observer still refuses before source/state work.


The portable media equation worker composes its existing encoder-cut hook with
the prepared borrowed observation hook. It keeps the original media roots, compact
encoder outputs, decoder state and capture roots in each interval, observes the
complete requested logits before selecting the sampling row, and uses the same
span-aware observer and native capture recorder as token input. Native recipe
assembly carries the actual capture admission alongside the completed input
source into the shared quote/control seal. The resulting owner retains both
source identities, paid Host destinations and native completion resources.
Ordinary preinstalled media collectors remain invalid as original authority.

Pending original media restore lends its independently copied sampler and capture
checkpoint to this same observed media equation worker. Native preparation shares
the existing saved checkpoint observer/recorder with token and partitioned input;
