it retains the completed media source through recipe reduction and supplies the
same checkpoint, selection and witness to the established saved quote seal.
Capture usage and native retirement remain attached to their existing owners.

Addressable bank demand discovery can return its actual completed source and
metadata custody to the existing grouped driver. Ordinary indexed movement
keeps its existing discovery method through the default adapter. Checked
producers provide an owned demand destination; the driver borrows its ordered
entries and pays compact member/mapping directories from the same account.
The demand owner remains live through acquisition, binding, grouped execution
and bank completion, and joins any failing consumer's retained cause. This
source handoff alone does not enable an unqualified IndependentCache execution.


### Original media with paged decoder state

Media equation admission uses the same selected-state validator as token input.
It compares the actual projected layer variants and metadata context with the
retained state layout and selected paged components, including exact block size
and persistence policy. It does not manufacture a pager from source dimensions.
The native composite adapter supplies its existing complete mixed-state projection
with actual canonical manager pins and native/Host/Disk source witnesses.

The completed-media quote transfers those pins into the existing paged source
bank, retires temporary native projection aliases, and prepares the same span
catalogs and Host/Disk itinerary consumed by the shared quote seal and execution
roles. Original media alignment, encoder-once retention, capture and bounded
prefill remain in their existing driver. Saved state uses the established copied
paged projection and actual installed-manager source handoff. A mismatched layer,
context or page geometry still refuses before equation execution.

The native indexed-movement constructor retains the same scoped addressable
cache and the selected chunk policy. The architecture's shared provider sends
each canonical chunk ordinal and member domain to that mechanism. An explicit
original source binds the actual ID descriptor, parent observer, initialized
input runtime and cumulative metadata account; no owner is inferred from TLS.
Completed integer IDs are read through the existing signed-stride reader, and
their exact demand owner is required by remapping. The source pays the host
destinations and native immutable I32 copy using the existing owned-host-copy
producer. Remap attempts remain spent on refusal. This joins demand/remap
construction only; the checked IndependentCache gates still require the actual
acquisition, parameter binding and grouped completion sources.


The native indexed-row-add worker now uses the existing precompiled Metal
ScatterAxis sum for F32/F16/BF16, I32/U32 indices, both location widths, and the
four actual index/update contiguity combinations. The shared ordinary scatter
equation, copy source, atomic duplicate accumulation, request-owned pipeline
slots and original Graph/Record/backing budgets are unchanged. Bool remains an
overwrite-only source. This supplies the exact EP return worker already described
by the shared IndexedRowAdd cold recipe; it grants no JIT or foreign-role access.


The addressable native acquisition leaf accepts the original completed-ID source,
exact canonical member requests, and an explicit loan of the existing prepared
residency slots. It uses the same manager Device acquisition and original transfer
ordering; demand metadata alone supplies no cache grant. The returned ordinary
acquisition type retains that source through configured grouped-output completion
and transfer retirement. Canonical bank unit IDs use one shared finite decimal
writer with caller-funded destinations. Preparing the dynamic slot envelope,
installing the invocation, and qualifying compact parameter binding remain
required before enabling the full IndependentCache original path.

### Borrowed routed partition source

The architecture's retained rank table supplies routed invocation geometry,
expert/unit ownership, source peers and the canonical exporting decision.
Ordinary sparse capture and managed source quotation consume the same borrowed
query. Equal nonempty coordinate maps select the lowest-rank exporter while all
replica invocations remain actual sources; empty owners retain explicit receipt
acknowledgments. Idle pipeline ranks own no invocation. No geometry query creates
native rows, allocates a second ownership table or grants capture authority.

Sparse receipt coverage, exact native scalar/coordinate sources, completion and
the prepaid host/transport owner remain separate requirements. Their managed
composition must be present before a distributed routed capture is admitted.


Serial original captured quotation and saved captured quotation now borrow the
same retained layerwise parameter source as ordinary acquisition. The shared
architecture observation driver binds exact per-unit representations before
its native trace; static parameter descriptions remain source-derived. Host
and Disk sources therefore preserve routed projection scalar facts instead of
using resident placeholders without their streamed representation. The native
recorder validates the complete replaced-constructor census against that source
and adds its seed/Full graph costs once through the existing host-copy recipe.
Parameter epoch, source custody, funding, and transfer/completion checks still
govern execution; these descriptive loans confer no execution authority.


### Projected capture geometry at native transfer

The scheduled native tensor worker carries the claim's exact immutable geometry
into its Host transfer plan. This retains local partition axes, strided component
selection, physical invocation windows and additive raw-term semantics while
borrowing the same global admission. Reconstructing from the global selection
alone would erase those coordinates. The fixed geometry copy creates no source
pin, destination or execution authority; native source validation, claim identity,
original completion custody and the existing transfer worker remain in force.


Independent-cache compact parameter binding has a counted, borrowed-name row
destination. The same native binder now serves ordinary maps and prepaid rows:
it visits the actual fixed physical fields, validates every selected name,
shape and promoted/packed encoding before mutation, then moves each Array into
its existing field. No parameter-tree flattening, copied name set or temporary
binding map is required by the prepaid path. Its row owner retains metadata
funding and a failed/duplicate binding attempt remains spent. This is a binding
producer only: the independent-cache invocation must still supply its exact
acquisition, compact constructor and numerical completion sources.


The native Eval stream census preserves the dedicated router CPU stream and
the Ring communication CPU stream independently when both occur in one model
trace. Each mechanism's two-stream profile already includes the model GPU;
taking their maximum would merge distinct CPU sources. Their joint record and
traversal bound now includes both, while the existing router and communication
worker/primitive populations remain separately priced. The worker qualification
still requires exactly these source classes; no global arena allowance changes.


Expert variable-transfer readiness belongs to its retained transfer occurrence.
Physical numerical payloads cross from the already completed and published
movement/local child; metadata columns complete in the parent because their
exact prepared input may be an empty Slice. Local-peer and inactive-wave sources
retain their per-transfer parent completion. The cold source and execution use
the same payload predicate, so metadata input completions are distinct from the
returned-column read completions and no adapter adds an unquoted duplicate Eval.
Each required parent completion publishes its settled descriptor before the
communication child borrows it, with its one leaf-validation control charged to
the retained request. Matrix, group, occurrence and stream validation still
precede this handoff, and failed completion retains original failure custody.


Projected capture source presence and native scalar type remain descriptive facts
when a cumulative capture budget skips a reached logical hook. The cold observer
retains those actual facts before reservation, without retaining the source or
tracing a native transformation. Host binding can therefore preserve the source
identity through the ordinary coordinated skip, including restored and forked
sessions whose cumulative allowance remains exhausted. Missing hooks still have
no scalar witness, and skipped rows acquire no transformation population.


The original sparse partition receipt constructor consumes borrowed producer ranks
and validated expert/unit ownership from the architecture source. Portable core
coordinate maps provide an allocation-free copy into separately paid local-order
and inverse destinations; wire identity and lookup semantics remain unchanged.
The ordinary projection constructor and its prepaid source share the same
positive arithmetic-run worker, including permuted columns and empty overlap.
The runtime pays both owning projection populations because its existing sparse
declaration validator independently reconstructs the projection. Canonical paid
producer/ownership vectors feed the existing coverage, source-peer, schedule,
identity, receipt and ledger machinery without allocating tree nodes. Success and
failure retain the metadata account until their owned destinations retire. This
constructor alone does not admit native sparse collection, Host transformation,
transport or assembly; those retain their separate exact sources and budgets.


### Original sparse partition Host destinations

Partition RoutedUnits capture retains original token/slot/peer identities and
expert/unit placement separately from native receive-order rows. Its cold Host
plan uses the shared global fragment-coordinate worker, reserves selected sparse
row/scalar buffers and bounds chunk evidence by the actual ownership row bound.
Short source-bound writers reuse the serial fixed sparse destination; they cannot
substitute local receive indices for original coordinates. Dropped writers poison
the existing target. Whole-invocation sealing validates original ownership, unique
rows and complete actual native ranges, including a real zero-row EP owner.
The fragment's Host identity and native allowance remain separate; these producers
do not themselves establish all-rank transport, assembly or forward completion.


Independent-cache compact binding has one source-bearing acquired-row producer.
It authenticates the exact demand/acquisition owner, borrows the selected bank's
published parameter revision, and supplies lexical names to the shared paid
physical-field binder. Each selected lease contributes one leading group row;
an actual published replacement uses the same native axis-range worker before
concatenation. The fixed destination and every handle/coordinate producer are
charged to the original chunk. Parameter publication increments its revision
atomically with the existing all-pool replacement transaction, so an older
chunk cannot silently select a later replacement table. The acquired leases
remain alive through grouped completion; duplicate or failed binding attempts
stay spent. Invocation installation must still provide the selected compact
constructor and Slice/Concatenate native Graph/Record population before this
producer may run; the source-specific admission gate remains until that join.


Native named modules accept an immutable paid parameter table alongside their
ordinary map. Both lend names and ParameterSpec values through the same direct
physical-field verifier and parameter visitor, including exact uniqueness and
missing-slot checks. The paid constructor moves already-funded specs into one
fixed-capacity lexical directory; it creates no parameter tree or name set.
Clones retain the same immutable table, and its fields retire before metadata
funding. This is a constructor storage mechanism only: the selected module's
native scalar/placeholder graph and acquired parameter source remain separately
required before an IndependentCache invocation can be admitted.


The paid partition fragment allowance has separate tensor and routed source
contracts. A routed source retains the ordinary sparse request: exact global
fragment coordinates, source-token count, expert/unit ownership, native-row
bound and the selected collector estimate. It never substitutes a dense local
tensor shape. Both contracts feed the same ordinary receipt cost and descriptor
worker, retain per-fragment attempts, and spend the same global/local quotas.
The original source-vote allowance binds only the scalar after coordination;
it neither requotes nor refunds work. Sparse scalar support matches the neutral
ordinary collector contract, including F64 where the actual backend supplies it.
This source prerequisite alone does not open sparse Host, native or public
capture admission; the complete destination/transport/program joins remain
required.

The original partition fragment bank retains each sparse routed destination across
short native provider callbacks under its original fragment Host identity. It
spends the matching native allowance once, seals actual source-row coverage, and
keeps failed partial rows with their custody. Prefill validates the existing
logical routed schedule and accumulates each invocation’s known native extent,
requiring exact completion before accepting the next chunk; it does not create
dense row destinations or refill credits between chunks. Sparse wire delivery and global assembly remain separate
required consumers of these completed fragments.

Sparse partition prefill retains the ordinary canonical fragment’s batch-aware
token mapping. Each short writer distinguishes original prompt coordinates,
physical pre-exchange token IDs, and actual receive-row offsets. Exchanged origins
are checked against the current invocation’s token count before mapping them to
logical rows; batch gaps are not treated as a single token offset.


The managed partitioned routed collector decodes the same five completed native
source loans as serial capture. Borrowed receive-origin tags and the retained
unit map preserve original source peer/token/slot identities and global scalar
order; they create no extra native tensors. Cold and completed descriptor checks
share exact physical row, route-width, dtype and placement validation. Every route
is checked against owned experts before publication-peer filtering, and sparse
values are written directly into the paid fragment destination. Empty producers
retain their acknowledgment without inventing a source range. This native reader
alone does not grant admission; the funded fragment program, transport and cold
source construction must also be present.


The original sparse observer validates a borrowed provider layout separately from
its selected fragment. This neutral layout retains the bank equation, per-peer
invocation token extent and ownership; the ordinary partition session uses the
same invocation validator. Native adapters report actual received rows and dtype,
then bind five-source batches to a short paid Host writer. The four scheduled
backend methods grant no transport, quota, completion or fabricated tensor source.

Original sparse partition transport borrows all completed local fragments through
the canonical record serializer. Its original-account destination measures and
writes the same immutable records; an empty producer emits an empty fragment
sequence. The existing bounded receipt reader validates each fragment’s ordinal,
context, source precision, charge, global bank, row ownership and local shape
while filling its fixed sparse Host buffers. Canonical routed row headers precede
their values. Remote source ranges bind the sender’s completed receipt evidence;
they grant no native execution authority. Final sparse assembly and delivery
remain separately required before a captured frame can publish.


A routed partition callback lends the existing receipt/fragment bank out of its
transport continuation. Each fragment spends its retained native credit once;
provider batches then borrow the same sparse writer. Actual result dtype and
estimate are checked against that credit before the five-source copy. Prefill
windows remain distinct from received native rows. A continuation cannot accept
an unfinished invocation, and failures retain the actual partial Host owner.


The original scheduled partition collector binds its sparse writer to the same
five-source completion/publication/pinning worker used by serial routed capture.
Prefill uses the active carrier and segment account; decode uses the existing Work
owner. All native graphs are retained before the first fallible completion, and
publication/source leases survive a partial failure. Receipt-lifetime ownership
is borrowed separately from mutable target slices, so consuming the source-bound
writer cannot outlive or replace its admitted layout. The native adapter validates
actual invocation rows and every five-array batch before sparse copying; the
runtime still owns receipt votes, quotas, transport and delivery.


Independent-cache compact native construction now receives acquired parameter rows
through the same physical declaration worker as ordinary grouped construction.
The native worker owns encoding-specific shapes, while retained neutral specs own
parameter identities and companions. Its checked factory moves the actual paid
Slice/Concatenate outputs into direct physical fields and validates the same
shape/encoding rules used by ordinary strict binding. No placeholder scalar,
Full graph, reconstructed parameter map, tensor clone, or additional Eval is
created by this checked constructor. Block-FP8 is selected before field creation,
so its final fields do not require throwaway dense placeholders. Parameter and
spec copies use the closed neutral metadata clone census; immutable named tables
and the selected-linear wrapper retain their original funding through retirement.
The shared scoped bank consumes this path only from its exact original acquired
source; an original call cannot fall through to ordinary construction. Native
Slice/Concatenate, manager slots, numerical child completion and the outer
invocation remain separately required before complete IndependentCache admission.


The routed partition source retains exact borrowed architecture ownership in paid
coordinate copies and retains each native fragment request without scalar
inference. It constructs the ordinary sparse receipt, then joins the existing
unvoted allowance, Source agreement, Host binding and delivery continuation.
Nonexporting local replicas retain their own source ownership. Scheduled sparse
callback issuance and native capability facts remain separate requirements.


Cold distributed routed capture consumes the retained architecture ownership and
the actual provider invocation. Native receive rows stay separate from original
per-peer input tokens and whole-prompt coordinates. The cold observer validates
the same five source layouts as the completed reader, counts each actual positive
coordinate-run fragment, and prices five source completions per fragment; replicas
and empty overlaps use their actual replica completion path. Absent pipeline ranks
advance only shared logical policy. An idle EP invocation with zero native rows
advances an empty acknowledgment without fabricating a result dtype or tensor.
Capture quota skips preserve actual reached source facts while granting no native
transform. This quotation does not independently authorize a missing Host bank or
distributed delivery path.


The sparse Source frame carries actual provider presence separately from its
optional result scalar. Idle EP ranks retain their ownership and every projected
empty payload; their records do not acquire the common allowance's dtype. The
same rank-major frame validates all nonempty scalar witnesses and retains the
per-producer optional dtype table. Dense source voting is unchanged. An all-idle
frame without any result witness retains a typed missing-source refusal.


A sparse hook moves its retained local ownership out of the program and returns
it with the same receipt/Host continuation. Replica and empty-overlap sources
therefore authenticate and complete their actual five-descriptor batches even
without a destination fragment. Original and funded collectors share the checked
native offset/extent worker. Absent result precision permits only a real zero-row
invocation; it cannot authorize any nonempty routed result callback.

Original distributed routed capture completes through the same receipt exchange,
final delivery vote and scheduled frame insertion as dense capture. The sparse
assembler advances one cursor per paid fragment and reuses a paid unit-coverage
bitmap, calling the ordinary sparse scalar-copy worker. It checks coefficient
bits, overlap, all selected units and exact participating route count. The typed
assembled payload keeps peer-tagged rows; independently paid contribution owners
retain the original ownership maps and each fragment’s actual native ranges.
These are distinct from logical prompt-token windows. Partial assembly and failed
delivery retain original account custody and cannot refund or reissue a claim.

An idle exchanged producer still emits every projected sparse fragment, with
empty rows/ranges and `source_dtype: null` in both envelope and records. The common
voted precision funds its fixed Host storage only. Receiver validation requires
that absent result precision corresponds to zero actual native rows; input dtype
cannot replace a missing routed-result witness.

The addressable demand driver now lends the actual native acquisition source
lexically to the selected bank after completed-ID discovery and remapping.
Funded demand metadata cannot select an ordinary acquisition fallback. The MLX
source binds the existing registered operation access and its already checked-out
residency attempt before discovery, then obtains the same request-bound manager
slots through that owner. Source, bank, scope, ordinal and funding validation all
precede cache mutation. The neutral driver keeps its original demand owner over
acquisition, binding and terminal completion; compact route handles and semantic
spec clones use the same retained account. This installs neither a TLS owner
lookup nor a new cache/transfer engine. The enclosing cold invocation still must
supply its actual registered operation and native movement population.

Original distributed sparse Host admission retains the same loaded architecture
ownership table and counts its actual strided/permuted projection fragments with
the shared coordinate planner. Each prediction owns its prospective receipt and
original Host reservation; the bound source remains explicitly contiguous or
routed. Runtime issuance consumes the existing sparse source constructor with
the same global token/slot/unit slices and ordinary native estimate. The native
result dtype is optional for an actual idle producer and is never substituted
from the provider input. The outer shared program receives the exact total
fragment limit, including capacity for empty acknowledgments, rather than a
one-fragment-per-rank assumption.


The funded routed observer now borrows a finite original hook table from the
sealed partition program, executes the ordinary provider callbacks, and returns
all receipt/Host owners before delivery. Before/after points share routing and
schedule selection. Absent PP ranks advance only declared global prefill progress;
actual replicas still complete their real sources. Partition prefill progresses
in Assembling state without a serial sparse payload, and its final claim remains
unavailable until the shared all-rank assembly and delivery succeed.


Managed distributed routed selections bind through the original partition frame
and neutral prepared program. The backend supplies the retained architecture
source, exact paid Host owner and observed optional scalar; it selects the neutral
routed row rather than reinterpreting it as a dense tensor. Per-frame fragment
limits come from the actual prospective Host receipts, including multiple positive
runs in permuted unit maps. No family branch or independent capture driver is
introduced. Host construction, original source votes, sparse assembly and delivery
remain prerequisites of the same frame.


Addressable cache telemetry now owns a fixed vector of counters selected from
its actual immutable bank catalog at load time. All later ordinary and checked
updates address existing rows; an unknown bank returns a typed error rather than
growing a map. The acquired-row constructor records its real compact-bank bytes
and elapsed construction in the same table. Its retained vector capacity is
available to the exact bank-source census, independently of native tensor storage.

The managed pipeline boundary constructors for DeepSeek V3/V4, Nemotron-H and
Qwen conditional/VL use a shared architecture-owned metadata destination. Families
retain their exact role order, scalar declarations and dimensions; fixed values
and repeated capture/DeepStack values move through paid vectors without cloning
tensors. Cardinality is checked before decoding or allocating the outgoing role
vector. The existing runtime wire schema performs geometry validation and
transport binding. The enclosing quote or execution owner retains the metadata
account through dependent work; these declarations grant no native authority.

Saved text/media resume uses sequential source preparation, shared equation
tracing, and final quote composition. The preparation phase returns the exact
copied symbolic state, immutable media source, registered roots and copy proof;
its temporary projection and constructor frames retire before composite model
reconstruction. Final report/control sealing begins after that trace returns.
The same original metadata account prices the phase carriers, and the existing
resume source identity, capture checkpoint and native-copy admission remain
unchanged. These phases reduce simultaneous call-stack storage without changing
thread stack limits or introducing another media or saved-state engine.

The cold sliding-attention trace follows the named neutral operation's existing
source contract: window and absolute position generate the causal mask. The
general request's mask is not an operand of the default or native sliding worker.
Its prior construction remains independently recorded and priced; sinks remain
real operands. Native fused-first-chunk and offset query-tile sources therefore
consume the same descriptor as ordinary execution without extra source guards
or capacity allowances. Caller-specified mask semantics stay with ordinary
attention, as selected by the architecture's existing eligibility decision.


The addressable expert cache uses the ordinary canonical residency-window
collector after completed route IDs select the actual ordered member set.
Its checked window constructor consumes two finite source-bank attempts from
that same registered operation: closure scratch, then exact controller,
transfer, and named-catalog storage. The resulting attempt owns private scratch
and retains both construction receipts through acquisition, compact binding,
and completion. Equal-sized target-layer windows never authorize an expert
subset, and workspace metadata funding does not manufacture operation custody.
The retained Host source is authenticated against the addressable manager;
foreground-disk use still requires its own exact read-source plan and bank.


The same selected-demand window also consumes a retained foreground-disk
capacity and descriptor source. It builds the actual completed subset's read
plan in the counted metadata destination, prices its exact read-slot factory,
and then passes that plan and capacity into the existing window materializer.
Read attempts remain keyed to their canonical units, so warm omissions cannot
consume another expert's reads. The demand result supplies neither new physical
capacity nor source-construction credit.


Selected addressable residency access is a narrow loan of the exact installed
model role, shared by resident and layerwise execution. Registered text roles
retain their existing registry; resident speculative roles retain the installed
bank's weak projection and exact role identity. Authentication checks liveness
and the supplied role's observer before using separately accepted construction
or disk-read capacity. No layerwise unit bank, current-source reconstruction,
or additional execution authority is created for resident acquisition.

IndependentCache source-bank loading uses the existing original residency
initializer with an explicit absent target role. The bank retains its real
Cacheable/Disk assignments, foreground read descriptors, catalogs, prepared
materialization streams and paying manager owner. All actual bank IDs enter the
existing supplementary singleton acquisition protocol. No target model layout
or target ordinal is fabricated. Target Host/dense/controller initialization and
its matching census run only when that role is present; request-selected windows
and native grants remain separate consumers of the retained source.

The cold addressable-bank source projection now runs through the same total
architecture construction and typed visitors as native binding. It retains the
actual selected bank members, local expert ownership, physical partition layout,
and prediction pairing. Its result is descriptive only: native source-manager
admission occurs separately before ordinary native load ownership, and the
binder must authenticate the resulting source against its actual declarations.


Cold addressable-window admission bounds the selected canonical closure by both
the complete eligible source domain and the selected-count multiple of each
singleton source maximum. Recipe depth remains a maximum. This finite census
uses actual immutable binding, alias, recipe, and native-name populations and
does not enumerate possible demand subsets or token row counts. These scalar
ceilings describe storage; runtime construction still recomputes and validates
the exact completed member set before consuming its original source attempts.

Independent addressable caches now receive a move-only prepared source-manager
slot through replicated, composite, partitioned, and prediction binding visitors.
Preparation runs before ordinary native load exclusion. The ordinary cache
constructor authenticates exact source catalogs, recipes, unit assignments,
storage policy and streams before adopting it; it does not initialize a second
manager. Transformed source producers retain their existing separate admission
requirement and cannot be qualified by the direct-reader preparation.


#### Source-qualified sliding paged scans

Original blockwise paged execution uses the same `PagedScanPlan` visibility
predicate and cache discard eligibility as ordinary execution. Prepared scan rows
are the exact visible retained/publication IDs; each native attention block
carries the retained sliding width and prefix. The completed output remains an
original completion root before scan aliases and demand/source pins retire.

An expired page keeps its canonical backing while any source pin, demand lease,
imported ownership, or saved history protects it. A completed original scan may
install a fixed discard request on an exact retained/publication ID. The request
retains its paid control owner, does not retain a manager or executable, and is
consumed by the same removal worker immediately or at final canonical pin
release. Native records and their funding drop after the manager lock. This
quiescent accepted mutation preserves the installed manager generation; it does
not enter ordinary generation cancellation or invoke an unqualified I/O worker.
The original source and completed-work checks still precede every mutation.

An independently copied sliding pager preserves its window and prefix through
the existing copy worker and a distinct manager. Shared-history snapshots remain
subject to their separate retained-history contract.

The local sliding paged update uses the same neutral `PagedLocalUpdatePlan` and
`PagedVisiblePlan` as ordinary execution. Its private old-window source is
selected before append from the admitted pager's initial rows and earlier
publications; the canonical invocation coordinates remain separate from the
window being read. Fixed slice destinations, one active page lease, and partial
failure roots remain in the accepted append owner. The existing Host/Disk
itinerary performs each actual promotion, and completion precedes demand-lease
release and the final append. Completed local updates and blockwise scans issue
the same private exact-page retirement authority; neither reopens a source nor
changes the manager generation. Source pins defer physical retirement until
those same retained owners release it.
Public initial/saved paged-media validation remains pending the joined native
artifact.


The foreground expert-read envelope uses each actual eligible read row's source,
output, backing, and slot-factory counts. Component maxima times the selected
closure limit are capped by the full source totals. The resulting finite facts
can consume only a matching accepted source bank, binding the existing shared
retirement capacity to the original descriptor identity. Dynamic windows still
construct their exact per-unit cursors, and completed chunks permit physical
backing retirement without refunding cumulative constructor attempts.

The retained routed pipeline workspace quote uses the same selected pipeline unit
strategy as execution, including expert exchange and inactive cross-stage waves.
Workspace communication hooks record each retained active region or inactive wave
without executing the imperative route body. The cold movement witness rejects
entry before allocating route indices; it is not a second movement worker. Both
general decoder and retained family sources use this constructor, whose fixed
metadata controls are charged by the cold context. Sparse capture inside exchanged
regions remains a separate source join and is not certified by this quote change.


Paged KV admission treats a declared fixed-state companion as the same attention
mechanism. The complete hybrid projector still counts and authenticates each
actual companion through the shared fixed-role, dtype, geometry and backing
producer before any original program exists. This covers the optional prefix
embedding retained beside media decoder KV without a family-specific backend
branch or removal of fixed-state storage from the quote. Saved-copy and reset
continue to validate their own concrete fixed-state source and destination.

The neutral routed capture layout counts invocation rows from the original
batch/sequence prefix or the already flattened provider input. Cold MLX capture
projection and native validation share that checked rule; neither reshapes the
source to satisfy an observer. Original exchange tags, local unit ordering and
the retained maximum row bound remain independent validation requirements.

Independently addressable grouped execution has its own neutral whole-provider
source. It retains the actual bank/unit/owner-group, selected Gated/Linear/Relu2
kernel, local member mapping, compact chunk scalars and storage limits. It has no
expert-exchange, peer-count or movement-transfer fields. GroupedNeuralBackend's
outer hook encloses the existing ordinary provider body before the full spec copy,
four normalizations, per-chunk selections and result joins. WorkspaceBackend
records one distinct AddressableRegion with the four original input tensors;
native mechanisms must supply the complete source before admission can succeed.
A move-only lexical invocation loan passes to the existing indexed movement owner
through its owner/accessor guard. The provider's immutable plan is retained behind
one load-time Arc; no plan/spec is deep-copied to bypass its mutable bank borrow.
The actual native invocation funding pays the full spec copy and output/shape
directories; ordinary unfunded mechanisms retain their existing callbacks.


An indexed cache invocation retains the actual scoped bank revision, the shared
ordinary chunk plan and source-derived selected-window/read ceilings. Its two
accepted source banks remain separate from metadata funding. Installing that
explicit invocation in the existing movement consumer permits one ordered source
per declared chunk, only after the preceding chunk completes. Each child receives
two finite window-constructor attempts; read capacity preserves the original
physical descriptor and retirement account. Failed, skipped or duplicate chunks
do not restore counters, and failure ownership retains both the invocation and
any unfinished child. This mechanism grants no numerical graph or family role;
the selected model's complete retained equation source must supply those.


Prepared text equation inputs retain the selected native token producer's integer
element type through a neutral workspace fact. The shared span worker uses that
fact for ordinary configured and saved text, while explicitly borrowed external
or assistant inputs preserve their declared dtype. Pipeline allocators continue
to require the exact logical wire dtype; a token boundary never repairs a missing
source by inserting a cast. The MLX fact comes from its actual u32 host-token
worker and is independent of model family or CPU/Metal placement.

Original model control requests retain exact agreement leaves for every local
FailureAgreement group declared by their prepared communication manifest. A
reached provider vote selects its actual initialized group before the existing
cursor and native role bind it; a tensor subgroup is never substituted with the
session/world group. Both immutable I32 status inputs and the ordinary sum/scalar
completion worker remain shared. Cold capacity is the union of those real group
leaves, and event, funding, stream, occurrence and terminal-completion validation
remain mandatory. Source-only control owners keep their single original group.


Addressable model binding exposes a backend-only immutable bank source separately
from mutable movement. Cold numerical records can inspect that exact source and
retain a per-unit residency plan. The outer accepted role lends a move-only typed
factory through the neutral invocation loan. The actual movement consumes it,
revalidates bank, revision, chunk policy and selected stream, then prepares its
invocation from the existing accepted banks. Generic architecture owners never
need native downcasts or ambient source discovery.

Independently addressable native execution retains its outer normalization,
row slices and output joins separately from compact binding and grouped child
sources. Child result frontiers carry their producer's exact representation;
a logical float type alone supplies no native dtype or contiguity proof. The
parent projection is only one input to complete invocation admission.

Addressable parent row selection uses the same portable `narrow_axis` interval
and native Slice source as its cold quote. Concatenation borrows the tensor
slice directly through the existing shared adapter, with no extra pointer
directory or cloned handles. Checked parent adapters authenticate the installed
request source and debit its metadata account; graph and backing ownership stay
with the separately admitted parent numerical recipe.

Addressable invocation handoff carries the original borrowed operands and
retained region declaration to the existing indexed movement owner. The native
movement consumes its explicit factory/request binding and supplies the same
metadata funding to the shared architecture callback. A stream or tensor is
never used to discover a current model source.

Cold independently addressable binding layouts borrow the exact loaded scoped
bank and its immutable supplementary Host/foreground source. Member identity,
chunk policy and replacement revision are checked before a descriptor visitor
runs. A replacement contributes its actual native tensor and original member
row; an unloaded member contributes the existing prepared copy/read output row.
The visitor neither materializes parameters nor reconstructs family semantics.

Prepared fragment Host destinations compare canonical sparse producer ownership
as well as ordinary fragment geometry. They may bind a sparse receipt only when
rank, source-peer placement and local expert/unit coordinate maps all match.
Sparse destinations use the same source/epoch admission and cumulative allowance
checks as dense destinations.

The independently addressable model binding retains the actual movement's
per-scope source channel separately from the Send/Sync physical cache. A request
installs only weak typed provider and activation references in that channel. The
move-only lexical installation closes before releasing its metadata custody;
expired or overlapping installations refuse. The request provider enters its
admitted numerical scope and completes returned grouped outputs around the
shared callback. Neither native stream identity nor thread-local state selects
a request owner.

Completed native sessions retain each independently addressable movement's exact
source in the existing bank map. Portable typed providers expose only a borrow
of their generic movement; native binding supplies source projection and erasure.
Partition construction uses its existing generic retained-result slot for that
same source. Quote and request installation borrow the completed map; they never
recreate a movement channel from a physical bank, model name or native stream.
Physical cache telemetry and replacement publication continue through the source's
separate storage owner.

An independently addressable invocation consumes a move-only directory of exact
selected-window constructor children issued directly from the accepted model
source root. Each chunk receives its two-attempt child once; region children are
never split again. The shared metadata account pays the directory, and every
child is checked against the exact source account, bytes and attempt population
before native invocation. Early refusal cannot refund issued root slices.

The indexed request callback returns the ordinary grouped result so its admitted
native parent can complete the actual output roots. Its lexical adapter preserves
the architecture's typed failure across the native callback boundary; native
parent recovery must settle or retain resources before the adapter returns it.
The weak request channel grants no authority after installation expires.

Sequential independently addressable disk regions share one native foreground
read capacity prepared from the accepted exact descriptor source root. Its cold
series sums source controls and finite read/output attempts and retains the
maximum region backing population. Region factories authenticate the same
source/account/manager and use their own actual observer loans; read counters
stay in the shared root and are consumed by the unchanged read worker. No
region source bank is recursively split, and no scalar byte argument creates
read authority. The request callback census includes its concrete closure size.

Addressable factories retain the original typed movement source as well as its
physical bank. Installation authenticates the constructor-created request
channel, so sharing a physical cache cannot redirect an admitted factory to a
different movement binding. Source failures retain physical bank/error custody
without placing the thread-local request sidecar in Send/Sync public errors.

An addressable quote can clone its descriptive residency plan into a physical
invocation using the caller's paid metadata account. The clone preserves the
actual movement channel, source manager, parameter revision and chunk plan and
retains the original descriptive funding. It copies no accepted capacity or
native attempt state; the factory still consumes unique constructor partitions
and the authenticated shared reader capacity separately.

Native source-qualified numerical and communication operations share one
scope/quota/recovery worker. Callers supply exact retained source custody,
admitted backing and graph/record capacities, and their selected completion
deadline. The worker preserves unresolved native resources on failure or unwind;
a failed status query never supplies completion evidence. Communication group
selection and addressable bank selection remain in their respective callers.

The native role worker lends its actual parent/child scope relation to selected
residency. The enclosing registry authenticates the parent before entry; the
child keeps the same source, account and move-only construction banks. Child
authentication checks the still-live parent installation and the worker-created
child identity without registering a second model role or increasing its grant.

The original routed partition hook returns its unchanged receipt and Host owner
after each prefill chunk using receipt/source identity. Its accumulated provenance
remains pending until completed local and received fragments supply their actual
ranges; final delivery still requires every provenance row before the delivery
vote can release the assembled observation. Hook reunion grants no completion or
new receipt authority.


### Shared paged snapshot storage and enclosing state tables

The native saved-state copier borrows paged attention through an exact outer-owner
view and uses one canonical manager/page/tail worker for saved and resumed copies.
The view preserves layer ordinal, global layer, manager identity, live tail count,
and complete catalog coverage. Each actual outer layout row also supplies the
snapshot policy witness: KV and KV-plus-fixed attention must match the pager's
full or positive sliding window. The shared copy preserves the existing prefix,
offset and tails; it does not borrow the stricter empty-reset predicate. Retained
transaction history and key-only pagers still require their own qualified source.
The view constructs no temporary KV table and grants no copy authority. The
existing KV saved-copy path consumes this shared worker.

Outer state tables and fixed-role child tables retain their separate registered
sources, destination initializers, and publication receipts. Combining those
tables with paged attention uses the grouped saved/resume producer: the canonical
pager population is copied once, each actual fixed child is initialized under its
existing group admission, and the returned live state retains the same copied
manager. The source inventory includes both paged operands and every fixed value;
resume quotation shares the ordinary complete-layer projection and isolated-copy
workers. Physical Host/Disk custody, failure retention, and native completion stay
in the existing paged manager worker. Public saved-media validation remains pending
for this newly joined representation.

Partition routed capture records the actual provider-input readiness operation
for each admitted selected hook before its five-source batch observations. The
cold observer uses the shared prefill/decode reservation and progression policy,
retains that original input root, and adds its one native completion to the same
recorded span. Idle providers still authenticate this source; skipped selections
add no readiness work. Native nested-completion guards and source identity remain
unchanged.

The shared native role exposes its concrete metadata census from the same pure
graph, record, failure, housekeeping, observer, native-control and optional
pipeline layout inspections used by execution. Cold addressable source planning
adds the concrete callback/output/error frames separately. These queries create
no device, stream, quota or submission authority; runtime still reserves failure
custody before inspecting and constructs the same accepted native owners.


Independently addressable expert execution has a distinct neutral workspace region,
without expert-exchange or count semantics. Its native cold source borrows the
completed executable's actual bank sidecars and physical parameter rows. The
ordinary compact constructors authenticate parameter identities and ordering;
existing numerical reducers qualify normalization, selected-row copies, compact
concatenation, grouped arithmetic, and final joins. Exact full/tail row classes
and finite compact cardinalities bound the unchanged chunk plan in one native
role. Constructor and foreground-read sources remain separately authenticated
and paid. The enclosing model completes its four real operands once; existing
ID-read and chunk-output completions remain inside the addressable role.

Resident, parallel, media, and saved-state quotation retain the same explicit
bank source directory and occurrence records. Geometry alone cannot establish
this source, and cold numerical qualification alone does not grant execution:
request installation must bind the actual constructor/read grants and native
role wrapper before complete managed admission.

An addressable numerical occurrence completes its four original operands under
the model's admitted completion source before entering the common native role.
The region keeps those settled inputs, exact quote, selected-residency source,
constructor partitions and shared reader capacity through native recovery. Its
ordinary provider callback constructs all compact chunks within that one scope;
only completed final output roles return to the model.

The immutable native stream-copy worker exposes its compiled layout independently
of a source stream. Cold request accounting and actual capture use the same
control census. These fixed facts never create a stream-copy plan: realization
still requires capturing the exact existing stream and retaining its custody.

A retained Host source-construction program composes independently sourced
components before request admission. Its identity and complete component facts
are part of the accepted aggregate. One allocation-free authority transition
partitions that aggregate into the declared roots, preserving each exact peak
selection and finite child population. The paid directory is constructed only
after account validation. Ordinary split children remain terminal; composite
roots cannot debit or split as though they were an individual producer. Paged
state and addressable constructor/read sources therefore coexist without
replacing each other's selected source component.

Addressable source quotation includes the shared native role's actual graph,
record, failure, recovery, pipeline, collector, completion and immutable stream
wrapper controls. The runtime uses the same fixed layout helpers; constructor
partition directories and distinct reader peaks remain in the accepted source
program. The provider callback is borrowed from its already funded request
channel and cannot introduce a new numerical or source grant.

The shared native ownership worker preserves each caller's completion policy.
Communication supplies its selected deadline; local synchronous numerical
execution supplies no additional timeout. Neither case treats a polling error
or an elapsed deadline as proof that retained native work has completed.

Addressable request activation follows the retained row and operation order.
One lexical provider is installed per actual movement channel, and each reached
region consumes its next accepted source occurrence before fallible native work.
The provider never selects a source by shape or creates a replacement grant.
A successful model callback must consume its declared row; failures preserve the
original callback error and fence further use of that request.


Logical subgroup status agreement retains the ordinary connected-Ring member
chain as a shared operation plan. Its managed adapter authenticates every peer
against that original group and qualifies the actual native Send/Receive
workers; it never admits a logical subgroup as a native world Sum. Shared
I32 addition uses the existing CPU binary worker. Completed leaf boundaries
make subsequent constructor inputs explicit, with cumulative graph, record,
and backing capacities for every receive, addition, send, and final scalar
completion. All waits share the original chain deadline and retain existing
quarantine and failure custody. The one-member plan is a completed alias.

Addressable source programs preserve target-parameter and paged-state sources as
separate original components. Before the first native role, the target component
can return to the original operation destination bank by an account-checked move.
Its exact finite partitions and cumulative source spending survive; an empty
destination wrapper is recreated only with zero vector capacity and the existing
accepted custody. Refusal leaves the actual source with its caller, and a restored
component cannot be extracted again through the prefill handoff.

### Original sparse intervention lowering

Runtime sparse intervention lowering uses one coordinate-selection and payload-gather
worker for ordinary and original sources. Duplicate detection sorts separate paid
row keys; selected indices retain native row order, global component coordinates,
compact-mask semantics and exact half-float payload bits. Original chunk owners
bind the actual immutable intervention declaration, phase, prediction, optional
logical window and actual native row extent before receiving scalar coordinates.
Every row, scratch, index and gathered payload allocation uses retained cumulative
metadata funding; both the source and funding remain with successful recipes and
failed construction. This recipe supplies no native authentication, ledger claim,
completion or execution authority. The original sparse admission gate remains
until the funded observer consumes that recipe. The native companion reuses the
existing five completed source loans and scalar route decoder, verifies the exact
chunk destination, and poisons partial rows on any source failure; it creates no
extra native coordinate arrays or ordinary readback vectors.


The retained resident recipe prepares the addressable request source program
before ordinary or saved native quotation can become complete. Target parameters,
paged state, and indexed constructors/readers keep separate exact descriptors;
compound host-destination facts replace only the authenticated previous source
amount. Target plus paged composition also uses this program when no indexed
region is present, without inventing an indexed constructor component.

Request controls include the shared provider's actual activation population and
the separate graph/record arenas of each retained region occurrence. Region
numerical host controls and mutable backing remain in their existing equation
populations and are not added again. The recipe retains the move-only source plan
and immutable facts separately. First-prefill extraction consumes that plan once;
prefill/decode selectors return the same filtered physical report index used by
its source rows. This descriptive preparation creates no grant or native owner.
Actual member and child-output source comparisons include scalar representation
as well as logical shape and dtype.

Original sparse callback progression retains a move-only cursor in the existing
paid capture claim. One full-invocation ledger charge covers every actual provider
chunk; a short batch loan cannot be retried after abandonment. Ordinary and
original callbacks use the same range and affected-count worker. The final frame
accepts an unmatched result only with a complete zero-effect sparse receipt.
These provisional receipts do not settle native roots. The funded callback now
uses the existing routed observer and action order, with the native indexed
selection/update source still required before sparse admission is enabled.
Prepared distributed edits, canonical multi-invocation prefill aggregation, and
general managed plain intervention preparation remain separate source joins.


Addressable invocation entry uses a neutral borrowed callback with a fixed abort
marker. The architecture retains its original typed error and pending ordinary
body, and restores that error after native completion or recovery returns. Its
actual callback, pending body, and error-slot layouts travel with the retained
region as descriptive host controls, never as submission or allocation authority.
The native adapter borrows that callback through a concrete owner and function
pointer, so factory, invocation-guard, and request-channel storage use the same
compiled layout workers during cold quotation and execution. The source-only
channel closure layout query contains no callback loan and never executes.

The existing original invocation guard still owns installation, completion,
failed-source retention, and teardown. Its preparation and entry controls are
separate actual calls and both remain priced. A callback error does not invent
completion, release failed native roots, select a bank, or restart the ordinary
provider loop.


### Sparse element selection and overwrite source

The neutral workspace distinguishes producer-validated sparse element selection
and overwrite from the general checked Gather and additive ScatterAxis contracts.
Both consume rank-one native I32 indices whose distinct in-range values remain the
responsibility of the retained row-lowering source. The descriptor supplies no
readback, index authority, or native grant. Exact update shape and physical dtype
prevent widening or broadcasting a virtual expert tensor.

Ordinary and prepared activation adapters share the native one-index Gather and
general Scatter overwrite bodies. The same rank-one argument worker avoids an
identical temporary singleton shape vector; its complete source copy and sparse
writes retain their existing semantics. Metal facts price the actual result,
argument transforms, graph frames and precompiled selector owner. Index ingress,
paid host lowering, completion and callback custody remain separate required
joins. The CPU general Scatter task and iterator storage still require their own
source qualification; this Metal source does not stand in for that worker.

The completed sparse row recipe now owns its exact signed-index conversion under
the original metadata account. Its actual-row trace, population and execution all
call the same activation kernel and portable action worker. Success returns that
same row owner for receipt completion; a failure retains it and the partial index
destination while numerical prefixes remain in the caller's original recovery
roots. No-match recipes execute no native index or action work. This actual-row
producer does not substitute for the prospective selected-length envelope or
authenticate the enclosing callback; those remain necessary admission joins.


A grouped observation source envelope describes maximum provider/selected rows,
unit columns, and one exact mechanism callback schedule. It is distinct from
source-checked row arithmetic and from an actual native batch. Expert exchange
can retain an empty-provider branch with no unit callback, while an ordinary
grouped worker may explicitly deliver an empty batch. Schedule branches remain
separate when selected by row count. Refinement validates only cardinality;
completion, original route/origin identity, dtype and source ownership still
come from the actual native source loans. Sparse capture and intervention may
use the envelope for finite destination sizing without manufacturing routes.


An expert local-child source can retain a supplied sparse observer population
while tracing the ordinary grouped Units/Finish equations. It uses the actual
selected native callback schedule; each observed batch retains its five source
aliases, and an idle provider contributes no fabricated unit batch. The existing
shared capture-frontier worker extends that same child's traversal, nested
completion, Graph and Record sources. Per-invocation input completion stays
separate from per-batch original/effective capture. This source constructor does
not by itself enable an outer observer or create a receipt, vote or grant.

The CPU general Scatter source now names the ordinary queued overwrite task and
uses the same generic iterator loop with inline storage for its single index.
Its exact retained geometry supplies separate rank-one and rank-two weak owners,
the real index vector, complete destination copy and both queued jobs. A borrowed
primitive-state view avoids allocating an axis vector during source inspection.
The existing CPU element-select/overwrite fact consumer uses these original
sources; its F32/I32 profile does not grant authority from index geometry alone.
Native source qualification must be rebuilt for this changed loop and source.


The ordinary cumulative capture host schedule can retain an exact
OriginalInterventionSource. Its existing per-prediction intervention constructor
prices every outcome and diagnostic, including inactive operations and requests
with no tensor captures. The source must belong to the same pool as the consumed
capture custody. Explicit speculative/model invocation masks keep their existing
separate admission path; the ordinary source cannot replace that authority.
Native intervention quotation, source reads and completion remain backend
obligations before any public preparation gate can admit those operations.

Cold expert observation has a separate prospective callback. The architecture
passes its retained local equation and original route geometry; the shared
workspace recorder queries the selected Units output representation from exact
parameter layouts. The callback returns source-loan retention counts, not a
concrete batch, exchanged origin tags or submission authority. Unsupported
observers retain their typed refusal. Native local-child sources must qualify
every applicable row branch before using those counts.

Scheduled intervention claims and their existing preview/summary evidence
authenticate the actual active text funding scope against the original host
account. Explicit model invocation claims keep their separate occurrence
custody. This comparison grants no source access, native allocation or
completion and does not convert one kind of authority to another.


The retained native activation recipe now distinguishes an explicit model
occurrence from an ordinary scheduled text phase. Both consume the same
PreparedModelInterventions row resolver, cold trace, native execution and receipt
worker. A borrowed custody discriminator authenticates either the original model
account or the actual WorkingMemoryFundingScope through the matching neutral
claim method; it never converts either owner into the other. Scheduled preparation
retains no fabricated invocation or window. Source/evidence availability and
sparse numerical producer gates remain separate from this custody handoff.

Capture inside an accepted numerical child borrows that child's stored observer
through the existing token collector. The lookup requires the original retained
model/prefill parent and verifies both the accepted ancestry and current scope;
an unrelated current scope supplies no authority. Input readiness remains on
the parent role. Child failure/unwind restores the suspended collector while
retaining its numerical aliases and parent custody through recovery. Ordinary
boundary-leaf projections keep their original exact-parent check.

Ordinary funded intervention checkpoints retain the exact paid source alias
beside the capture plan and cumulative lineage. Fresh continuation host plans
price all remaining outcome rows at their original absolute coordinates.
Restore/fork reject a missing or substituted intervention source before installing
the destination bank. Same-run restore keeps current cumulative spending; forks
inherit the saved usage through the existing independent continuation ledger.


Scheduled text interventions retain one paid source-bound static row for each
actual logical prediction, including continuation coordinates. The ordinary
capture observer owns the single cumulative ledger and lends it to the same
model-row begin/trace/finish workers; the row owner never resets or duplicates
spending. Native consumers borrow a sealed row and authenticate its original
source and actual scheduled funding scope. Scheduled static logits use the same
activation-hook and action workers, while explicit model admission keeps its
Activation-stage contract. Sequence demand and exact traced axes remain binding;
this handoff does not turn a prompt sequence slice into a last-position slice
or supply the still-separate physical windows for chunked dense prefill edits.

Text preparation carries an optional neutral immutable intervention source
through the same ordinary and controlled preparation owner as capture.
Backend defaults reject either unaccounted source. A native adapter must validate
and retain the exact source, price its edits and outcome/evidence storage, and
install the shared collector before exposing a machine. The initial contract
alone does not enable native intervention admission.

Text intervention source preparation reuses the loaded declaration validator,
the original pool's closed immutable-plan compiler and the existing static
logical-budget preflight. Only then is the paid source attached to the cumulative
capture host schedule. This source preparation is separate from the complete
native equation quotation and collector installation; it cannot enable either.

The ordinary workspace capture observer can borrow a source-bound intervention
schedule alongside its existing capture plan. Logical begin, edit trace and end
use the same cumulative ledger and native operation recorder; prefill fragments
finish the logical row only after the final chunk. Explicit model-invocation
interventions keep their existing owner. This observer hook alone does not install
a native request or grant distributed replica transformations.

The ordinary text recipe can now borrow the exact original intervention source
and a caller-owned row destination through the existing resident and partitioned
capture quotation. Each budget candidate discards the previous candidate's
native row descriptions and traces the same shared observer under its actual
metadata account. The accepted capture quotation retains those descriptions
before its original control guard. This wiring alone does not enable the public
request gate: native scheduled row borrowing, prefill slice progress, and saved
continuation integration must all be connected before that gate is opened.

Addressable sparse observation retains a distinct borrowed source view containing
the original member map and compact chunk policy. A metadata-only backend hook
borrows that observer before the unchanged provider callback; native execution
continues through its existing bank acquisition and grouped kernels. Physical
Units layouts come from the retained bank rows, while preliminary portable
geometry carries no scalar witness. The source descriptor contains per-callback
retention only; actual callbacks still supply selected IDs, token offsets and
full original route identity. Invocation and partition adapters preserve the
observer loan and its first typed failure.


Sparse intervention quotation distinguishes a descriptive selected-index extent
from actual signed indices. Count and cold equation workers consume that extent;
the native worker rejects it and only accepts the actual paid lowering. The
scalar envelope and actual sparse owner share one gather/action/overwrite graph
worker and the ordinary lowerer's numerical action classification. This
structural envelope must still be bound to the original declaration, callback
coordinates and all applicable native count branches before admission. It is
not a completed-row proof; replacement/additive payload sources and exchanged
origin envelopes remain distinct producer joins.

The original explicit-invocation sparse intervention callback retains the actual
serial provider layout and each consecutive source range, reserves its lowering
and error storage before quote sealing, and uses the shared five-loan scalar
reader and operation cursor. A source-proved full row/unit Zero or Scale selection
has an exact native index count; completion rechecks that count before the shared
selection/update graph executes. Arbitrary token/component selection, masks,
gathered replacement payloads, and exchanged origins require their own applicable
numerical source and continue to refuse before native work. A maximum-sized Host
destination alone is not authority for a different count-shaped native graph.

Ordinary managed token text now forwards both immutable plans through the existing
sequence admission. Active logits edits select sequence demand before candidate
quotation. The actual original intervention source is compiled and attached to
the cumulative host bank; accepted cold rows pass by closed owner into native
work, whose scheduled callbacks revalidate source, coordinate and native funding.
The facade's intervention entry composes the same controlled session and capture
delivery. This stage still requires behavioral verification and physical chunk
progress; media/legacy joins remain explicit unknown-bound refusals until their
cold row source is connected, rather than silently dropping the supplied edits.

Authenticated ordinary media quotation now borrows the same intervention source
and cold-row destination as original token text. The media recipe retains that
exact source identity and compares it again when composing the admitted
candidate; the prepared input and media geometry are unchanged. Both facade
entries use the existing controlled session and capture delivery. This closes
source routing only: physical chunk progression and media behavioral validation
remain required before claiming complete intervention parity.

Expert route IDs and movement indices use the same prepaid initialized-source
publisher as sampling leaves. The retained architecture itinerary supplies each
integer-source occurrence and its maximum actual row geometry; the cold request
adds those source constructors before admission. Runtime construction publishes
and attaches the original immutable birth before numerical or capture aliases
escape. Empty routes still use their actual one-row source seed plus the separately
quoted empty Slice. Canonical immutable-alias publication remains existing-only;
neither mutable native backing nor a byte/identity pair can impersonate the source.

### Saved intervention destination declaration validation

MLX's existing saved capture admission authenticates a retained original
intervention source against both the destination working-memory domain and the
actual loaded architecture declaration before quoting continuation rows. Cold
quotation and accepted reconstruction use the same check. The source plan and
cumulative lineage stay retained; validation does not copy or re-admit the edit
schedule and grants no native authority. Architecture-owned declaration checks
continue to decide target geometry and current session compatibility.

Realtime ingress now has one borrowed validation/source loan shared by ordinary
and counted materializers. The canonical frame coordinator invokes the selected
materializer's source admission before copying forcing/schedule policy or payload
history. Exact matrix views retain the original frame and contract, including
absent optional inputs and selectively forced token validation. This source seam
does not itself advertise complete managed realtime execution: native temporal,
depth, transport, saved-state and PCM producers must retain their accepted owners
and complete quotes through the existing frame coordinator and scheduler.

Prepared native input publication is a backend mechanism shared by sampling,
expert metadata and realtime ingress. The worker consumes an actual initialized
input plan, accepted source bank and exact source custody; it retains canonical
allocation attachment and failure ownership. Caller-specific transport controls
are counted by each adapter and included in the same actual construction census.
The shared worker never creates a bank or infers authority from an active scope.

Ordinary original interventions use one logical prediction claim across bounded
prefill chunks. Runtime supplies a canonical window from the original request
and retains one move-only operation cursor; each fragment spends against the
existing cumulative ledger, and abandoned work cannot reissue the claim. Cold
preparation retains separately paid physical rows beneath the same declaration;
native callbacks select by the exact window and authenticate the unchanged
scheduled account. Logical-to-physical slices and replacement payloads use the
same window/partition workers as explicit invocations. Final outcomes publish
only after every required chunk hook completes. Hidden activation edits do not
request extra vocabulary positions; row-bearing logits edits retain Sequence
readout. Row evidence aggregation, changing Context-axis source geometry and
cached-origin intervention admission require their own qualified producers.
Saved state remains restricted to existing drained logical boundaries; no new
snapshot boundary between physical chunks is introduced.

The native realtime input source borrows the exact validated frame and prepared
input runtime. Its one-to-three actual matrix recipes supply finite constructor
facts to the enclosing frame quote. After admission, a move-only materializer
authenticates the exact bank/account, consumes each selected matrix once in
canonical order, and publishes through the shared initialized-input worker.
Policy copies are charged before materialization. No input view, equal scalar
capacity or standalone metadata funding can create native source authority.
The accepted frame source bank remains a dependency of the full realtime quote;
this adapter does not convert an incomplete frame into a supported managed path.

### Addressable enclosing-input completion source

Addressable bank execution completes its four actual enclosing-model operands
through the same fixed-root native completion worker used by cache and transfer
frontiers. That worker and its cold control census both accept the exact
four-root form. The already admitted parent program supplies its nested
completion count and root capacity; no child source can grant extra parent
completions, and unresolved work remains owned by existing native recovery.

An architecture-declared final publication has one intervention member: the existing exporting publication owner. Other output-stage ranks still own and observe real local logits replicas, but the shared driver never calls their edit hook. Internal Unit/Readout/Input replicas retain their ordinary intervention membership. Both the operation projection and its region census consume this same architecture decision, so distributed member votes cannot wait for replica edit callbacks that do not exist.

### Observed expert region boundary across pipeline execution

The neutral communication region boundary now carries the actual routed observer
as a single mutable loan. Workspace realization records its prospective grouped
observation source in the same region trace used for pipeline expert execution.
Native realization forwards that loan into the existing route body, where actual
received rows, coordinates, transformations and completion produce evidence.
This joins the already existing resident cold observer with the same pipeline
mechanism; a symbolic source never replaces a physical callback or receipt.

Realtime frame admission uses the same atomic pool comparison, pending account
publication and final ticket retirement as other original operations. A distinct
frame origin retains exact scheduler incarnation/history/frontier/batch and the
actual executable identity. Complete frame source domains are required before
acceptance; one move-only native claim and one source-bank claim cannot refill
or replay after refusal. Metadata aliases retain only the frame's account, never
its model, bank or submission permission. They participate in the existing
canonical initialized-source registration and host metadata retirement protocols.
This primitive does not supply a missing temporal/depth/state/transport quote.

Ordinary and funded partition interventions share one fixed outcome-frame source and validator. It authenticates the retained operation digest, epoch, ordered world ranks and actual invocation membership before accepting any result. Dense outcomes cannot carry sparse counts, inactive ranks cannot report edits, and a member rejection remains a rejection. This borrowed wire descriptor grants no source, budget or outcome authority; its enclosing move-only operation continues to own those contracts and all native completion resources.

Compact intervention masks now use one core index-projection worker for ordinary and original construction. It validates the entire admitted global index set using caller-owned finite scratch, preserves original failure order, and fills exact local identities without a tree or growing destination. Runtime supplies actual metadata funding before scratch/output allocation and retains that account with the localized action. Empty keep and delete sets retain their different original mask semantics; projection does not grant native edit or outcome authority.

### Saved ordinary intervention row sources

Saved text and prepared-media continuation quote the existing intervention worker
from the checkpoint's absolute prediction coordinate and the actual remaining
output interval. The first native prefill after a committed snapshot retains its
logical Decode coordinate; a snapshot taken before execution retains the original
logical prefill and canonical chunk windows. Public checkpoints remain drained
logical boundaries, so no partial physical-prefill snapshot protocol is added.

The saved cold quote keeps every attempted row with its original declaration and
preparation account, then moves the completed rows into the existing accepted
capture owner. Native callbacks authenticate that same source, coordinate and new
scheduled funding scope. The checkpoint's cumulative ledger remains authoritative;
restoration neither readmits the declaration nor refunds capture/intervention
spending. Saved readout demand uses the existing admitted operation schedule, and
an absent or substituted row source refuses before execution. Distributed outcome
transport and source-qualified intervention classes retain their separate checks.

Original distributed intervention preparation retains a move-only projection of the immutable admitted operation. It uses the existing coordinate projection constructor and shared payload/index workers, reserves each physical metadata destination before construction, and keeps the source/account through errors. Ordinary and original projections share their exact geometry digest and additive-term policy. Equal tensor extents cannot replace the original component map. This source owner supplies local slice/action loans only; accepted claims, native completion and member/world outcome authority remain with the existing transaction driver.

The retained Moshi realtime source and native realization share the same
