`execute_layerwise_moshi_realtime_with_observation` traversal. The metadata
provider supplies actual selected parameter and state projections to the
ordinary temporal/depth decision boundary, including sampling, causal
observations, output demand and forced-tail omission. This shared entry does
not qualify missing projections or create native admission authority.

Realtime frame-native activation consumes its own accepted frame claim into the
shared native-role worker. The actual prepared allocator creates a buffer owner
carrying that frame's account; graph, record, failure and recovery owners retain
the same account. Cold wrapper accounting uses the same allocator/role layout
queries and concrete callback shape as activation. A root frame cannot infer an
original parent scope, and completion still requires the shared worker's positive
terminal observation before any native owner is released.

The runtime capture bank exposes whether its admitted schedule owns frame constructors.
Both shared transaction entry and backend progression checks consume that fact, so
intervention-only predictions retain the same paid frames and outcome delivery as
tensor captures. Empty tensor selections alone do not bypass constructor accounting.

A Moshi realtime executable retains one immutable architecture source containing
its normalized configuration, selected local geometry and execution identity.
The native and Workspace models share that exact source; cold preparation does
not reopen artifacts or regenerate parallel geometry. `execute_moshi_workspace_frame`
binds supplied retained static and unit parameter projections, then executes the
shared temporal/depth traversal with the actual projected cache and sampler
state. It adds no synthetic input or empty-state source and issues no admission.

The shared native activation-edit worker settles each retained emitted prefix under
its original scope. A later full replacement can disconnect a prefix from the final
output graph, so final-output completion alone cannot certify its storage. The same
static and sparse population counters include every one-root completion and its
control storage; failures retain the graph before settlement through the existing
recovery owner. Ordinary edit execution keeps its ordinary completion policy.

The funded partition intervention source retains the original admitted operation,
its architecture member projections, and the ordered canonical invocation/window
transcript. The transcript includes both pre-window coordinate identity and the
actual native program's ordered post-window geometry/payload identity; equal byte
counts alone cannot authenticate an edit. Runtime reserves the complete logical
allowance once on every rank before common coordination, then lends only a
move-only local child allowance after the existing member preflight vote. The
backend still authenticates the original frame claim, native scope, actual tensor,
and retained program independently. Component/window preparation, dependency
completion and edit credits remain distinct and are consumed once.

A local loan must return to its exact original owner before the existing second
member vote. Missing, dropped or failed loans remain rejected at the shared
18-word world outcome boundary. The original bounded transport worker retains
completion/cancellation custody; polling errors do not establish completion.
These source/allowance primitives do not activate remote intervention outcomes:
the funded observer, evidence delivery and original frame receipt must be joined
before the remote source path is admitted.


The original distributed dense-intervention source retains the architecture's
borrowed invocation member (including publication filtering and additive offset
ownership), then constructs the existing paid component projection. For bounded
prefill, each actual local update is intersected with the canonical token window
using the shared contiguous-slice and payload workers. The native owner retains
that ordered physical update list, exact scalar/shape, original declaration and
preparation account; its agreement digest hashes the retained updates and payloads.
The ordinary component projection and original source consume the same member
selector and projection-charge worker. Neither coordinate description grants work.

The local native worker borrows the original intervention claim and scheduled
scope, consumes the runtime's move-only member allowance once, and uses the
existing static activation worker plus retained input/output completion. It does
not finish the global claim or publish an outcome. Member votes, canonical-window
progress, provisional local charges and the final world receipt remain runtime
policy. The cold per-operation table retains the exact architecture member set for
each canonical window. Peer entries describe geometry and ordinary worker costs;
only an actual local hook can bind an entry to executable native work. Final-logit
receivers retain the existing publication-owner source and never apply the edit.

The same scheduled text owner supplies those sealed entries to the original
partition frame. Construction of copied invocation/member transcripts reserves
its exact destinations against that frame's finite request metadata account.
The funded program owns both member votes and the final world receipt, while the
native callback borrows the original claim and matches the actual rank, window,
source, shape and scheduled scope before spending its local allowance. No separate
prefill ledger, synthetic peer tensor or native authority is introduced. Active
before/after evidence still requires its original companion delivery source;
remote publication metadata cannot replace that owner. Split-prefill sparse
RoutedUnits capture aggregation is a separate required collector join.


The realtime frame coordinator also accepts an exact borrowed execution view.
Ordinary scheduler branches still enter the same coordinator and publish the
same schedule, payload, sampler and completion effects. Cold adapters can borrow
the original schedule and sampler sources while projecting numerical state;
they do not clone a second native transaction branch or create publication
authority. Completion evidence from a failed submitted frame remains in the
unpublished branch before that branch is discarded.

Realtime native source projection borrows the selected architecture source and
actual idle resident units, or the existing source-bearing Host/Disk parameter
policy. Identity population explicitly declares an unchanged prepared lease;
unknown custom population remains unqualified. The prepared metadata model is
constructed before the frame trace, then the shared temporal/depth traversal
executes within the enclosing ingress/history/sampling trace. No native gate is
opened by these loans: the complete schedule/history host clone source, native
operation slots, source banks and completion roots still require their accepted
frame account. Partitioned realtime retains its distinct traversal/source gate.

The original partition capture program also owns dense intervention invocation
rows. Their original operation source, ordered windows, actual member maps and
post-window program identities join the existing pre-forward coordination digest.
The shared funded activation observer uses the same frame/prefill claims and
backend edit callback between the existing two member votes. It never charges
the parent ledger again inside the callback or creates a parallel inference loop.

Only a successful authenticated world receipt produces the private intervention
outcome loan. Working memory compares that loan with the original frame source,
coordinate, spent claim and exact provisional local charge before reconciling the
global reservation. Absent pipeline ranks have no local cursor or numerical
owner; their still-available original outcome claims are consumed only at that
world boundary. Missing local windows and dropped loans cannot become Applied.
Evidence-bearing partition rows remain closed until their original Before/After
companion destinations and delivery owners are attached; a source-only remote
publication never substitutes for either evidence value.

Resident request ownership is independent of internal neural submission count.
An actual retained addressable invocation requires the resident request and
selected-stream registry even when the graph declares zero neural boundaries.
The same resident owner and empty, finite submission bank serve that case;
cold control accounting includes their concrete layouts before installation.
Text and speculative callers derive this requirement from their retained native
recipe. They never synthesize an extra tensor submission or use an ordinary
fallback to acquire an independent cache member.


Realtime pre-branch admission uses the core scheduler's shared bounded
preparation worker. An explicit callback receives the actual queued frame and
canonical state before constructing its branch; default preparation still
calls the ordinary semantic transaction. A typed optional preparation payload
travels in that same scheduler branch through submission, cancellation and
failure, without a side table or dynamically inferred owner. Installation is
once-only even after the payload is consumed. Canonical and released state
carry only its type, so restoring state cannot clone a frame's admission or
compiled native plan. Host source funding remains the existing core-owned
HostMetadataFunding, with no native dependency in scheduler policy.

The original capture member vote borrows the already retained FailureAgreement
group and both immutable status leaves from the request's control source. It
consumes the same monotone control cursor, then uses the existing original
control invocation, native role/recovery and completed scalar resolver. The
portable Hook transport permits that exact bounded vote to complete inside its
retained role; ordinary adapters keep the existing submit/wait/resolve default.
No synthetic native completion is introduced, and a polling error still retains
the submitted source/budget through the established native recovery owner.

Both adapters use the same member-only logical source equation and exact
selected FailureAgreement requirement. Absent pipeline ranks do not enter hook
communication. A source that requires a world participation wave cannot be
substituted for that member-only callback; the cold source must qualify the
actual selected group before the invocation is admitted.

Realtime schedule occupancy, delayed payload history and frame insertion rows
share one neutral ordered contiguous slot table in eredu-core. Coordinates,
overwrite semantics and pruning remain in the existing core/runtime workers.
The storage exposes concrete destination layouts and paid, fallible clone
and prepared-insertion operations; no estimate depends on opaque tree nodes.
Payload child allocation and whole-frame admission remain separate obligations.
The ordinary table migration alone does not qualify managed realtime: the
scheduler must bind its actual frame account before cloning and use the paid
destinations throughout execution.

The original intervention source copy retains each actual before/after geometry
admission in a shared capture owner, constructed only after the same count/copy
comparison and with its concrete owner and host-token storage priced per real
companion. This moves the copied DTO without copying its buffers or readmitting
it. Partition evidence receipt and Host writers may alias that exact source;
the original preparation custody remains until the final alias retires. The
companion retains zero logical budgets and grants no operation, side, window,
native transform, world outcome or delivery authority.


An accepted realtime native frame now has a distinct lexical operation-bank
claim under its own native root. The frame worker constructs that claim only
after consuming OriginalRealtimeNative; its once-only flag is spent before
preparation, including failed preparation. The selected resident slot retains
the actual stream, original observer and same frame account. Its finite bank
uses the existing PreparedNeuralSubmission producer, consumer wait source and
completion retirement, without constructing text geometry or a speculative
role. Cold fitting extends the same complete numerical recipe with the actual
graph boundary/fanout population and measured native WaitRecord extents.

The realtime operation owner is removed lexically before the frame root seals.
Issued completions retain their own native resources and account aliases, so
owner retirement and a polling failure cannot refund live work. This mechanism
is not complete public frame admission by itself: pre-branch host history,
initialized inputs, sampling, model state, final publication and readback must
all consume the same admitted frame source before the public gate opens.

Original internal speculative activation revalidation consumes the actual sparse
model worker's operation/dtype facts in addition to ordinary discovery facts. It
shares the retained declaration and phase comparison with static activations;
the capture-only/static entries retain their stricter profiles. The current
sparse producer declares F32 Zero/Scale without evidence and validates exact
full-selection counts, five actual source loans, serial provider ranges, native
scope and original funding before execution. Other selected-count branches still
require their own numerical source. Continuation preflight uses the same ordinary
sparse estimator over virtual geometry, never a dense expert-axis allocation.

An original intervention evidence target can lend its already allocated child
frame to the same scheduled partition receipt/Host worker. Its private claim row
owns exactly the two original side slots and a spent frame slot; ordinary runs
continue borrowing their existing finite rows. No new frame, payload backing or
admission is created. Returning the move-only target checks the original source,
operation, coordinate and scheduled custody. Dropped/failed loans leave an
explicit incomplete slot, preserve spent sides and cannot turn an empty evidence
list into successful delivery. Serial and partition issuance cannot share a side.

Realtime frame preparation borrows the selected executable's actual resident
operation slot and stream plan through a move-only erased source. The complete
frame numerical trace qualifies that source before admission; only the accepted
frame's private operation claim can install it. Type erasure retains the concrete
slot and charges both descriptive owners through the existing metadata context.
Bounded and partitioned policies keep their source-specific refusals until their
own operation and materialization itineraries are joined.

Realtime payload history now maps the actual coordinate/envelope table through
an explicit payload-source visitor, preserving contract, domain, owner and history
generation. Its host account pays schedule/contract copies and fixed destination
storage before callbacks, and remains after all history metadata. Managed history
copies, insertion staging, overwrite destinations and ordered-read vectors use
fallible accounted constructors in the ordinary shared interpreter/coordinator.
Model-state and tensor copies remain caller-supplied sources; schedule/sampler/RNG
branch funding and complete native frame qualification are still required.

The realtime frame quote runs the existing complete coordinator over the retained
Moshi workspace model and exact projected cache, history, schedule, samplers and
random state. Its ingress descriptors come from the actual borrowed prepared-input
plans before the numerical span starts; their initialized storage is charged to
the distinct source-construction bank. Frame interpretation uses the same neutral
tensor adapter in native and metadata execution. The closing census retains all
inputs, decision/diagnostic outputs, delayed history, cache, architecture forward
context and advanced random key. The private synchronous metadata completion
marker grants no native completion or scheduler publication.

Distributed intervention evidence retains one existing partition capture program
per real original companion. Attachment is atomic with the operation sources and
requires the exact original shared geometry, transport, coordinate and loaded
causal declarations. Preparation, source votes, receiver progression, assembly
and delivery use the existing workers and the enclosing nonrefundable ledger.
The move-only companion target is returned on either success or failure, with
the first failure preserved. No companion can contain another intervention
program. Native evidence qualification and actual Before/After callbacks remain
required before the corresponding public admission gate may open.

Realtime pre-branch payload contracts are derived by the runtime from the actual
canonical session incarnation, history generation, frontier and submitted batch.
The normalized schedule's concrete delay-vector clone has one core-owned paid
constructor shared with history copies. A backend consumes this contract and
does not reconstruct first-frame identity or batch policy. Native operation-plan
erasure requires its real metadata account before creating the erased owner.

Realtime cold preparation now projects the canonical native cache, exact delayed
payload envelopes and current random key through retained typed source visits.
The source-funded history mapper preserves coordinates, domains, contracts and
owner generations while each native descriptor retains its original allocation
witness. The selected model operation slot is qualified by the resulting complete
coordinator trace; its descriptive recipe and original state/payload witnesses
remain together until the enclosing accepted frame consumes them. Resident state
projection uses the existing fallible, funded descriptor handoff rather than the
legacy unchecked clone path.

Addressable acquisition retains its actual member pins while first settling the
input transfer's native owner and then completing its grouped output. Transfer
retirement precedes another enclosing nested graph traversal; it cannot leave
a suspended transfer owner in place when output completion needs that graph.
Neither polling failure nor transfer completion alone releases the acquisition.

Original intervention evidence borrows the paid immutable component map and
the existing native projected-capture equations. Session-private trace entry
points validate an actual workspace tensor through those same raw/reducer
workers and report their existing completion/root populations. They do not
choose exporting ranks, manufacture a tensor from prospective geometry, or
issue native/Host authority. Architecture source selection and original
Before/After callback custody remain separate required inputs.

Speculative raw capture envelopes retain one completed physical invocation, with
its exact prefill span and cumulative spending (`SpeculativeActivationCapture`);
only statistics and Preview have a separate logical reduction delivery. Sparse
raw records now use the same declared physical-window row intersection in both
ordinary and original collectors. Each window selects its globally anchored
rows into physical token coordinates, retains the complete real provider ranges,
and pays the existing record/fragment metadata plus sparse payload charge. The
original native path keeps its fixed paid target and five actual source loans.
No requested logical aggregate is replaced by several uncharged captures, and
no dense expert-axis allocation or alternate generation driver is introduced.

Realtime host outputs retain their original host metadata source after all token
and diagnostic vectors. Successful prepublication observation may therefore drop
its native observer without refunding live host output storage. The ordinary
constructor and value equality are preserved; source-bearing deep clones reserve
the exact token, shape and diagnostic destinations through the same cumulative
account before allocation. Source attachment retains custody and grants no new
native completion or allocation authority.

Realtime schedule transitions use one coordinate worker for ordinary and admitted execution. The admitted entry constructs the exact copied configuration, occupied-coordinate directory and transition-vector destinations under the retained host account before their allocations; insertion capacity follows that worker’s concrete insertion loops, including warmup and forced rows. Capacity refusal leaves the canonical schedule unchanged. Runtime history and generation owners retain this account through the state and its transition records.

Realtime generation and fair-scheduler branches accept explicit model, sampler and RNG copy sources under the admitted host account. They reserve their concrete wrappers and sampler destination before copying, perform fallible host construction before model branching, and retain the account after branch payloads through completion, publication or discard. The scheduler and its states share immutable selected model identities; per-frame branching no longer deep-copies the selected realization. Native copy qualification remains in the backend callbacks.

The architecture's borrowed dense capture source now exposes actual immutable
component maps as well as the existing range-only view. Both use the same
ordinary assembly validation and canonical exporter decision, including empty
acknowledgments, replicas and absent pipeline ranks. The contiguous API delegates
to that worker and retains its explicit range check. Native intervention evidence
consumes this producer decision separately from the set of ranks that execute
an edit; a borrowed coordinate map grants no tensor or transport authority.

Original realtime host observation now uses an exact output-row plan from the
complete coordinator trace and the frame role's actual retained observer. It
validates shape, physical scalar type and completed scope membership before
reading native storage, without evaluation, polling or a second native cast.
Half-precision diagnostics convert from their typed completed host slices into
the same F32 public values. Every destination vector is funded before allocation;
cloned observer handles share one permanent attempt latch, and both returned
outputs and retained failures keep the original frame account. Numerical source
capacity and host destination allocations remain separately counted.

The native distributed intervention evidence source retains the original copied
Before/After companion, the ordinary canonical exporter decision and every actual
component projection fragment. Peer descriptors have no scalar or execution
authority; only tracing the real local before/after values binds their separate
scalar witnesses. Raw, Preview and Summary work uses the existing partition
equations, and replica/empty-overlap completion uses the ordinary source worker.
The exact operation claim and scope remain required at the native callback;
preparing this source alone does not enable evidence admission or replace the
original companion receipt, Host owner, ledger or world delivery.

The original sparse scalar source now admits strided token selections over the
complete virtual expert/component axis. The portable lowering worker supplies
one exact scalar count for each real provider range using the same logical
selection ordinals as ordinary row lowering. A backend still proves complete
serial route coverage and compares every completed lowered index count with that
source before executing the existing selection/update graph. A zero-selection
chunk validates and retains all five source loans and finishes its original
receipt without manufacturing an index tensor or numerical edit. Per-expert
component subsets retain their typed unknown-count refusal until an actual count
source is joined; they never use a maximum as completed route data.

Realtime frame admission can retain an explicit native preparation phase for the
selected state's actual copy program. Preparation and equation execution receive
distinct move-only claims from the same frame account; their physical, graph and
record capacities remain separately charged, and all host controls consume one
cumulative counter. The native adapter completes preparation before returning a
scheduler item. State restoration, failed preparation and custody aliases cannot
reissue or refund either claim. Append-only state that only shares immutable
arrays does not invent a numerical copy phase.

The shared sequential decision driver can retain an admitted host account for result, diagnostic and forced-tail destinations. Sampler implementations provide exact host-copy and next-mutation sources, while sampling backends qualify random-state copies. Ordinary and admitted construction converge before decision ordering, forcing, sampling and commitment; host refusal precedes the actual sampler callback. Realtime composition uses the existing GenerationSampler history copy/growth worker for those sources.

Realtime frame interpretation and coordination allocate insertion tables, temporal/directive vectors, sampled/resolved outputs, sampler copies and diagnostic destinations through the same exact host-destination constructor. The original ordered callbacks still produce values into those destinations. Source-aware sampler and random-copy hooks join the existing decision driver; host admission failure is typed and occurs before the corresponding producer or sample runs.

Original distributed intervention validation retains the loaded partition's
existing immutable layout/support owner. Architecture validation authenticates
the resolved artifact and session, selected topology and execution identity,
then compares the original intervention fields against the same mechanism and
phase support used by ordinary discovery. The serial validator remains separate;
no loaded support DTO is cloned or reconstructed during request quotation, and
this source loan grants no local edit, transport or outcome authority.

Original dense fragment sources can retain exact component maps as well as
contiguous ranges. Both use the same paid receipt constructor, ordinary
overlap/coverage validator, source vote, original Host bank and delivery.
Coordinate maps and all positive-run fragments are copied through their actual
counted producers; permutations never become enclosing spans, and empty
exporters remain explicit acknowledgments. Terminal prefill uses a distinct
one-invocation coordinate instead of invented chunk geometry.

Realtime random-state branching uses the ordinary immutable-key semantics:
advancement replaces the key, and a branch shares its existing native descriptor.
The native funded clone consumes the measured prepared-handle constructor and
uses the existing generation/history owner to retain the host account after all
cloned fields. Native failures independently retain that account
and their original cause. The workspace sampling adapter records the same tensor
clone under its actual trace source instead of inventing a random-data copy.

The realtime native preparation consumer reuses `OriginalCopyLayoutBuilder` and
the same contiguous/eager isolated-copy leaf as saved state. Its finite source
clones and copy calls are consumed before work, partial roots stay in the shared
native recovery owner, and the configured construction bank closes on either
result. A successful return establishes native completion before the scheduler
can prepare another item; it does not carry a TLS scope between requests.

Addressable source handoffs validate that the original traversal context and its configured resident bank remain available after route remapping, parameter acquisition and grouped computation. These read-only checks consume no completion attempt and retain the same source on failure; a stage-specific cause distinguishes source handoff failure from output submission or retirement.

State branch host construction can use the existing prepared-host slot metadata
producer directly with `HostMetadataFunding`. It moves the already-paid boxed
extent and retains its funding through both slot metadata and escaped identity.
`InferenceRetention` exposes a source-derived paid clone of its actual request
and lease directories, preserving the initialized revision and every existing
charge without issuing submission authority or refunding observation/copy work.

Ordinary intervention admission now retains the same `CaptureTextOrigin` as its
coupled capture source. The shared request resolver adds cached positions only
to Context axes; prediction schedules, new-prompt Sequence rows and logical
prefill slices remain request-relative. Nonzero origin participates in both
session and peer intent identity, survives paid immutable copies and the existing
shared evidence companions, and is compared before ordinary installation or
original Host frame planning. Zero-origin and independent-invocation identities
keep their existing format. Canonical prefill windows compare the actual cache
position to origin plus input offset and retain the actual growing Context
extent. This source binding does not implement multi-axis Context projection or
open the separately guarded opaque prepared-control intervention API.

Realtime KV transaction preparation borrows the actual native state and uses
its ordinary checkpoint branch: append-only arrays receive paid immutable
handles, while capacity-backed slots invoke the existing isolated-copy worker.
The copied host slot table, rollback directory and inference-retention handles
use exact paid constructors. A numerical preparation retains every source array
and its actual stream through the common native recovery before returning the
transaction. Paged state requires its own manager/history checkpoint source;
the dense constructor does not claim that source or bypass its ownership.

Once realtime state carries paid host storage, ordinary transaction/decision constructors cannot silently clone it. They return a typed source-required refusal before copying; the source-aware scheduler preparation and shared frame coordinator supply the actual copy sources. This is an internal admission boundary, not a declaration that saved or parallel realtime execution is architecturally unsupported.

Original intervention companion frames reuse the same prefill target/header
initializer and finite slot census as their parent capture frame. The retained
causal selection authenticates the parent's actual inference schedule before
initialization. Later epochs reuse progressed slots; each child completes its
canonical chunk and final targets through the existing coverage and delivery
workers. A failed or abandoned companion retains its original frame custody.

Partition intervention evidence retains the actual operation cadence: row-axis prefill companions use the original canonical target progression, while terminal-prefill and decode companions use the same single-invocation receipt. The distinction comes from the retained observation axes and never substitutes a fabricated prefill window.

Distributed intervention evidence validates each actual Before/After native array against its retained local source, original operation claim, scalar and window. The runtime lends the existing companion frame to the same projected Host hook or replica completion worker, returns that frame on failure, and includes both evidence callbacks inside the original two-member-vote transaction. Native or evidence failures remain the primary cause even if the closing peer vote also fails; all-rank outcome and delivery authority remain with the original parent receipt.

Realtime context and completion resources share the same native backend owner.
Automatic realtime loading uses the ordinary execution factory's prepared stream
construction, after neutral selection. The managed owner retains execution and
source streams and borrows its admitted allocator from that exact pool; cloning
the context's resource reference creates no native stream handle. Completion
retirement retains the backend even after the public context is dropped.
The explicit low-level stream constructor remains an ordinary source and cannot
supply prepared execution authority. This ownership handoff alone does not
certify model, state, or frame memory; their original source admission is separate.

The original ordinary intervention source projects canonical prefill query rows
and each declared Context axis together. The retained request origin determines
the full admitted Context, while the actual chunk determines its reached prefix.
Both use the shared contiguous slice worker and the existing paid payload
projection, so strided payload coordinates stay relative to the original selected
tensor. Native execution still binds the actual source shape, scalar type,
original claim and scheduled funding. This does not change independent invocation
geometry, enable opaque prepared-control instrumentation, or supply distributed
evidence authority.

Original realtime frame completion uses the same coordinator and nested-root
worker as other original operations. The actual updated RNG key joins the final
frontier after coordinator state publication, alongside frame/state/history and
token-assertion roots. A lexical guard retains token assertions on every exit
and closes construction before native recovery. The public completion selects
ordinary or original ownership without changing scheduler commitment policy;
original host observation uses its exact observer and needs no cloned stream.

Original distributed intervention hook preparation retains an alias to the authenticated setup's immutable global group descriptors. Every rank can therefore validate a remote pipeline stage's declared member agreement through the same selector as ordinary capture. Native execution still selects an exact local manifest operation, requires actual membership, and consumes the existing original agreement role; a remote descriptor supplies no native handle, completion, or allowance. The existing transport control census includes the retained alias through its concrete owner size, and its source allocation remains owned by the same communicator table.

The selected native RelativeAttention and JointGroupSelection workers now retain
their F32 output scalar fact when all four actual input sources prove F32. This
keeps relative-attention hidden values and both joint coefficient slices usable
by the existing routed Units reader. Integral IDs retain their distinct dtype;
missing or reduced-precision source evidence is not replaced by logical Float32.
No storage layout, bound, source identity or execution grant comes from this fact.

Realtime original execution lends the actual selected model through an accepted-frame model lease. The ordinary and original entry points call one unchanged decision body; the original entry validates its exact model/account/native scope and opens no ordinary recovery scope. The outer native role retains a paid slot before the mutable borrow, and the slot pins the real execution payload after that borrow ends on success, failure or unwind. Pending work therefore cannot release selected parameter/module ownership when the scheduler discards its unpublished branch.

Partition intervention rows retain the original evidence companion's exact component projection for every declared member. Only the actual local cold callback binds Before/After floating representation; peer descriptors remain source-only. Canonical prefill evidence uses the existing ordinary cursor after the original companion receipt has taken ownership of its frame, while an unbound serial prefill row keeps its existing explicit refusal. Source qualification alone cannot issue a native writer or complete a capture.

A prepared realtime frame now carries its unique accepted issuer, source-derived native capacities, initialized-input bank, actual retained source witnesses and selected model lease. Its native worker invokes the same frame coordinator, temporal/depth equation and sampling driver, installs the paid operation bank, completes the complete final frontier including the updated random key, then creates the existing prepublication transition. Input policy shape is retained descriptively; actual token construction borrows and validates the scheduler's original input. The callback shape used for cold native controls is the exact callback constructor used during execution. Model/source registration and the complete portable branch/history census remain prerequisites of creating this accepted preparation.

Original distributed intervention evidence retains a private source loan from
its authenticated parent capture admission alongside each companion receipt.
The companion remains its original zero-budget geometry source; only the parent
ledger reserves logical work. Receipt charge validation borrows the parent limits
through this retained source, and the ordinary receipt digest includes the parent
admission plus intervention intent and operation. Paid aliases and digest controls
are prepared before the same fragment allowance/vote/delivery worker; no scalar
limit override, new capture admission, or native permission is introduced.

Realtime branch admission queries the same concrete host shell and directory calculations used by funded Session, Generation, PayloadHistory and coordinate-table constructors. The census is parameterized by the actual native payload and callback/error types; it sums copied schedule and envelope contracts while leaving model, sampler, random and tensor-copy sources separate. These descriptive queries allocate nothing and grant no destination or native work.

Addressable numerical roles include their selected parameter-transfer sources in
the same native arena. The immutable manager closure supplies the finite copy,
aggregate-completion, retry and consumer-wait populations. Their shared source
layout and Graph/Record reducers are the same mechanisms used by ordinary
layerwise execution. Completed parameter frontiers extend the equation traversal;
copy backing, descriptors and kernels remain separate producers. Native nested
completion admission includes both numerical and transfer occurrences, and no
capacity is borrowed from an enclosing model role.

Original prefill intervention Host preparation validates and prices an actual
shared evidence companion through the same source-profile validator. This
source-only step permits no edit callback: the runtime cursor still requires
the exact prepared partition companion frame before lending an operation.

Distributed intervention evidence protects its original companion Host destinations
with the request before native execution. The backend borrows architecture-owned
component maps and canonical exporters, derives the ordinary coordinate receipt,
and retains exact per-fragment estimates. Local edit membership separately controls
whether an actual scalar/shape witness exists; remote publication replicas never
supply a synthetic tensor. The same protected Host rows feed the existing runtime
before/after capture program and its original parent ledger, source votes, transport,
assembly, and global operation outcome. Canonical prefill evidence retains the
loaded causal path declaration; terminal-prefill and decode use one real invocation.
Saved continuation uses the same source and unspent prediction interval.

Partition evidence receiver progress runs during the original early coordination,
without completing producer hooks. The shared capture observer completes each
companion chunk only after the actual model callback and intervention cursor
validation return; the last chunk seals local companion targets before ordinary
receipt delivery. Both phases borrow and restore the same original frame, so
missing Before/After callbacks still fail and no receiver gains a new source,
claim, budget, or independent inference driver.

The original realtime scheduler branch consumes an exact borrowed canonical-state source. Its paid Session/Generation/Payload constructors share retained history values through prepared native handle clones, copy each sampler's actual history, and preserve the same immutable RNG key. The existing cache checkpoint policy decides whether a native state-copy phase is needed; that separate claim comes from the same accepted frame account and completes before scheduler preparation returns. The callback census instantiates the same concrete clone callbacks used at runtime, and every refusal retains its original funding and failure source.


Realtime loaded-model publication reuses the text loading settlement and retained-storage publication workers. The private constructor holds temporary ordinary loading exclusion and detached failure recovery, settles actual module/helper roots, then inventories the same modules, residency-manager buffers and original/transformed checkpoint sources plus the actual idle group buffer. Complete coverage publishes independent charges on each native/source backing; the loading exclusion is never attached to an array or host token and does not become managed authority. A closed fixed HostSlotTable retains the source publication, manager and stable execution identity, and its actual inline storage receives its own registration. Completions retain this same resources owner and backend pool. The architecture-validated realtime ingress contract is retained once and borrowed by frame preparation.

This preserves the text registration scope: general preexisting Rust model/configuration bookkeeping, including the retained immutable ingress declaration, remains excluded. Fixed slot size is not a census of nested heaps, and this is not total process-memory accounting. New managed frame preparation, state/history branches and copies, operation controls, completion and retained output still require their complete source-derived funding and lifetime census. Loaded publication alone supplies none of those future execution grants.

Realtime retained cold-frame source custody retires after the ingress contract and forcing-shape descriptors it funded. The shared original host observer uses a closed Rc owner: its shared allocation is destroyed before the final account-bearing payload, including a dropped unobserved result. These retention orders are independent of success or failure and do not change any capacities.

Addressable compact execution now retires the exact completed original transfer's lease collection at the existing per-chunk output-completion boundary. Transfer completion and dependent output completion both precede this unlocked retirement; unresolved and shared owners keep their existing deferred custody. A following compact chunk can therefore evict the previous member under the same bounded cache capacity, without a global retirement sweep or relaxed residency budget. Acquisition reserves the existing exact retirement helper's controls before native work.


Original model-role RoutedUnits capture uses the same five evaluated source loans and scalar decoder as scheduled sparse capture. The funded frame lends its existing sparse writer under the exact model-occurrence custody, while the accepted equation retains and completes all five native graphs. This model loan does not convert authority into a scheduled account or add a source registration. Cold source accounting uses this actual worker's five roots/completions and controls. Every write rechecks the original model account; partial failure leaves the paid sparse payload poisoned in the original frame. Existing invocation/window attribution, selected-row coverage, logical spending and final receipt validation remain shared with ordinary and controlled capture.


Realtime original admission now enters through the existing scheduler's typed
preparation callback. Its application supplies the shared-domain capacity and
optional frame limit explicitly. The backend authenticates the completed loaded
source in the same backend domain, quotes the ordinary coordinator plus temporal
and depth equations against borrowed canonical state, and admits execution,
initialized ingress, output observation, Host branch storage and any actual native
state-copy phase together. The native preparation copy completes before the
scheduler prepares another item. A move-only frame source remains on the returned
branch and is consumed once by submission; cancellation and refusal do not recreate
it. The context's bounded convenience method calls the same fair scheduler and
uses a lexical borrowed model cell solely to sequence its immutable preparation
and mutable execution callbacks. New public preparation/submission errors retain
their original source behind BackendFailure. No physical-memory observation or
advisory native limit supplies allocation authority.


Realtime scheduler, coordinator and sampling tensor aliases share the backend's
source-funded MlxTensor clone worker. The worker pays the actual final native
handle and clone/error controls, then retains the original immutable descriptor
without evaluation, backing copy or new allocation authority. Shared portable
coordinator/sampling hooks pass the explicit Host source; their native adapters
use the same worker as state-history branching, with no dependency on composition
from backend sampling. The containing history/driver keeps that Host account after
its aliases retire.

The realtime coordinator now retains a source-only Host population from the
actual cold executor transition and original schedule, history, and samplers.
The shared schedule, history mapping, vector, and sequential-decision workers
expose the same checked allocation equations used during execution. Native
specialization supplies concrete tensor, error, completion, and coordinator
headers; a Workspace tensor width is never a native storage witness. Exact
placement keys determine history replacement cardinality without another
schedule execution. A permitted forced-tail skip retains both the bounded
skip directories and the possible executed branch. Sampler copies, one-step
sample growth, and the actual random-owner alias are distinct populations.

Coordinator, interpreter, and decision descriptor copies use explicit original
Host clone hooks. Their default is a typed refusal, while MLX uses the existing
prepared immutable-array clone worker shared with scheduler branches. The
retained transition bounds each real alias operation; numerical data and the
initial scheduler branch remain separate sources. Copy failure preserves its
original source and funding, and follows the existing unpublished frame and
completion retirement path. This source grants no model, state, or submission
authority and introduces no alternate realtime execution driver.


Selected realtime Host-layerwise and foreground-disk construction now prepares
the original residency manager before acquiring ordinary model-construction
ownership. The source comes from the retained neutral realtime materialization
tasks and exact execution-unit order, using the same binding projection and
manager constructor as the existing generic policy. Native construction consumes
that move-only manager only after validating the actual store, declarations,
residency plan and streams; it creates no duplicate ordinary manager. Loaded
source publication retains the resulting original manager. This load-time source
is independent of per-frame operation/read/copy admission, which must still be
qualified before managed bounded execution can run. Transformed and partitioned
source producers remain separately required; no empty source stands in for them.


Cold layerwise realtime construction records the actual logical unit acquisitions
made by the shared traversal. A prepared source enables one paid ordinal directory;
its ordinary policy hook observes the already validated acquire before building
that unit. Source order and the retained layout stay authoritative, including
separate logical ordinals sharing checkpoint parameters. The existing native
constructor census consumes this borrowed selection when present, so a forced
depth tail cannot be priced as though its skipped units were constructed. Ordinary
whole-forward source users retain their existing full-layout census. The directory
is descriptive metadata and grants no source, materialization or native authority.

Independent speculative and shared target equation inspection now admit the exact retained addressable-bank source through the existing region recorder. An addressable provider does not claim ordinary resident-unit equations; its separately qualified bank, child numerical, constructor and transfer sources supply those operations. Providers with neither the ordinary-equation fact nor an actual selected addressable source still reject before execution. The independent lane's model identity, control origin, invocation geometry and state source checks are unchanged.

Realtime TP workspace construction borrows the same fully-local partition
predicate and original parallel context used by its ordinary runtime. Its
resident or bounded frame binds the retained local model/parameter sources and
uses the existing parallel layered traversal; it does not substitute replicated
equations for sharded parameters. This descriptive construction alone grants
no collective source or original frame admission. Those require the actual
retained communicator inventory and each quoted native occurrence.

Realtime PP and combined TP/PP were already unimplemented before this original
memory migration: the tracked Moshi selection rejects a pipeline size other
than one, and its ordinary executor installs no boundary transport, output
publisher, or commit agreement. The existing typed selection refusal remains.
This is a pre-existing implementation gap, not an inherent model limitation;
this migration targets the already implemented replicated and pure-TP paths.


Realtime bounded numerical quotation borrows the selected layerwise parameter
and copy source. The same source-derived unloaded-slot declaration and native
Host copy reducer now serve ordinary resident records, addressable children and
realtime frame recipes. The recorded acquisition ordinals qualify scalar
placeholders; actual manager windows retain warm/missing transfer attempts.
Replaced constructors add only their real scalar backing and unevaluated graph
descriptors. The shared copy reducer supplies copy/aggregate/wait completion and
worker populations; no text-forward geometry or extra execution engine is used.

Initial realtime TP construction retains its actual distributed session and
communicator inventory. The selected partition borrows group/route handle
aliases directly into the same ordinary traversal; it does not reconstruct an
entire communicator map or recreate native groups. Loaded storage publication
includes the retained setup buffers. Later original frame qualification must
authenticate that same inventory, authority, and selected tensor-group identity
through the existing original communication owner. Retaining the initial setup
creates no per-frame collective allowance or completion evidence.


Realtime Host-layerwise and foreground operation sources carry their actual
selected policy slot, manager, windows and an owned cold parameter inventory.
The common operation-plan constructor accepts explicit populations; realtime
uses one frame's selected graph/units rather than fabricating text geometry.
The existing accepted bank installer serves speculative and realtime claims,
with distinct account tags and the same exact source-ticket validation. Native
transfer completions retain realtime custody independently of the lexical slot
owner. Foreground source tickets retain their original accepted source bank;
account aliases and descriptive populations cannot create another ticket.


Original realtime full-attention paged branches now reuse the existing sequential append-only checkpoint policy. Inspection borrows the exact manager catalog and tail source; preparation pays the canonical block-ID list and immutable native tail aliases from the same frame Host account. The existing Concat policy still selects any separately admitted numerical copy phase. A source-bound rollback marker retains its original funding through commit or discard, and changed catalog frontiers refuse before a branch is returned.

Discard reuses the manager's lease-checked record-removal worker, validates the actual completed branch frontier, restores the original optional tail accounting, and retires appended native/source records outside the catalog mutex. It neither reopens shards nor resets frame, copy, transport or observation spending. Empty and sealed-only canonical tails retain their exact absence rather than acquiring a synthetic tail owner. This joins append-only full-attention paging; the existing sliding transaction guard remains because an advancing sliding cache can discard canonical history that this checkpoint cannot restore.

The existing pure tensor-parallel realtime source retains the original initialized
communication owner, including registered buffer pins. Its frame report prepares
finite collective occurrences through the same parallel source worker used by
text, then the ordinary owned-child numerical reducer consumes those exact
occurrences alongside any local layerwise constructor source. These descriptive
objects do not enter a native role or authorize a frame; admission still requires
explicit installation of the retained invocation and its completion custody.

Realtime tensor-parallel cold binding dispatches by the actual local resident or
layerwise policy type. It binds the retained architecture's local static/unit
sources, projects rank and size from the installed native group, and invokes the
same portable frame coordinator with a descriptive parallel context. The
existing fully-local traversal predicate rejects unimplemented realtime pipeline
transport; no backend family traversal or substitute model is introduced.


The realtime composition now selects the actual resident or bounded operation
source through a generic native policy trait. Its cold frame visitor qualifies
the borrowed layerwise source with the shared numerical reducer, and the same
frame account admits ingress plus foreground parameter reads as independent
components of one original source program. Admission partitions that exact
program once. Native frame activation consumes the selected read component in
the existing operation bank; ingress receives its original component unchanged.
The component directory, unused roots, model lease and source funding remain in
the frame completion owner. No parallel or paging qualification is inferred by
this local source handoff.

An original realtime TP frame lends the source-bound parallel context explicitly
through the existing architecture and fully-local traversal driver. The neutral
runtime does not discover native owners or replace its retained setup context.
The common native invocation binder counts its borrowed callback, binding and
closure controls from the same helpers used at execution. Its owner stays in the
existing frame Recovery; callback failure is preserved and context return alone
is never completion or permission to release collective source custody.

A compiled pure-TP realtime frame now owns its exact per-frame parallel invocation
beside actual state/payload projections. Cold preparation consumes the retained
communicator table and the full coordinator report; the shared numerical reducer
prices its native collective occurrences. The accepted frame's existing Recovery
retains that same invocation through native completion or quarantine. Only the
actual role lends its bound group to the selected local runtime, after checking
native-handle and retained-source identity against the installed setup. Resident
and bounded policies share typed operation-source selection; a missing bounded
load-time source remains a typed refusal and is not reconstructed during execution.


Ordinary text equation observation uses its actual recorded token-input ordinal
even when the retained provider executes an addressable expert bank. Independent
prefill/proposal quotation therefore consumes the ordinary opening/closing state
union through the same callback as uninterrupted text. Explicit media and
external/embedded capture callbacks retain their separate source contracts;
addressable residency cannot reclassify token input as a prepared media source.

The selective MLX unit populator preserves its prepared lease source when it has no parameter replacements. Independently owned parameter exclusions are shared by exact binding construction and original lease population; they do not introduce a new value producer. Host-layerwise and disk-streamed workspace admission therefore consume that same filtered unit source alongside the separately qualified addressable bank. Replacement values remain a distinct source and do not inherit this declaration.

Realtime Host/Disk manager preparation applies the architecture-retained pure-TP
local layout through the same selected-task binding and placement worker used by
the final native binder. Both produce identical ordered execution-unit recipes;
the prepared manager validates those exact declarations and source/execution
streams when adopted. This preparation precedes the ordinary native load owner
and introduces no target tensors, inferred local shapes, or new residency policy.
Unsupported transformed source producers retain their existing typed boundary.

The focused managed realtime TP fixture uses the existing nonzero tiny checkpoint,
four canonical forced/unforced cached frames, and the shared ordinary/managed
scheduler helpers. The existing Ring harness launches two actual rank processes;
each compares original-funded TP output and progression with ordinary TP and a
serial numerical baseline and requires native collective submissions. Both ranks
use one local Metal device. This is not validation on separate accelerators or
hosts, and it does not claim ordinary realtime PP/combined implementation.


### Original reads of transformed immutable checkpoint storage

The neutral encoded reader also retains exact immutable `MemoryWeightStore`
tensors. The existing range projection, borrowed destination worker and detached
read owner handle these bytes directly. Their source and span metadata appear in
the same constructor/clone/read census; no payload staging, file identity or file
read telemetry is invented. Detachment retains the actual memory owner, and
matching requires that owner identity as well as the selected ranges. This
retention does not register or promote ordinary storage into original custody.

The native bounded-quantization overlay forwards encoded reads to the actual
selected transformed or passthrough store. Original addressable manager
preparation therefore consumes the transformed backing through its existing
read/materialization pipeline and preserves the selected manager identity check.
A batch spanning distinct overlay sources retains the existing typed absence;
separate per-binding reads can share one destination worker invocation. Existing
source registration remains responsible for the actual retained payload, while
new read metadata and scratch retain their own original source funding.


### Managed realtime token frames and external codecs

The existing realtime request boundary is `eredu_core::RealtimeInputFrame`:
encoded audio tokens, optional forced audio/text tokens, and observation policy.
`MlxRealtimeExecutionContext::prepare_realtime_frame` admits the selected model,
actual input materialization, frame equations, state transition, sampling,
completion and output observation within that boundary. Its working-memory
account does not grant coverage to unrelated native work performed by callers.

`eredu_codec::AudioTokenizer` and `Mimi::encode_step`/`decode_step` are separate
low-level codec interfaces. Codec configuration, checkpoint admission, parameter
binding and streaming equations remain in `eredu-codec`; a generic native backend
supplies tensor/materialization mechanisms. These interfaces have no managed
request, application-capacity or realtime-session parameter. The
`personaplex_full_path_bench` example composes ordinary codec calls and the
ordinary token-frame scheduler, including a host token bridge. Its PCM timing is
an ordinary application benchmark, not managed-memory validation. A future
joint PCM session would need an explicit codec-state and completion contract;
the current token-frame API does not promise one.

This boundary does not exclude model-integrated media processing. Encoders,
prepared media inputs and residuals selected by an inference request remain in
that request's complete source quotation and accepted ownership, including their
materialization, state, transfer and completion costs.


Independent autoregressive equation quotation retains the invocation's explicit
`ExpertPass` through the shared routed and composite equation visitor. A finite
storage report may encode one proposal, verification or replay as a `Prefill`
span while the existing native driver executes it as `Decode`; that report shape
does not select expert-bank acquisition policy. Addressable source declarations
therefore use the actual invocation pass for single-versus-bulk access and chunk
planning, while ordinary prompt/decode quotations keep their canonical span
policy. The accepted source still requires exact declaration equality at use.

Moshi's temporal and depth transformer configurations provide the checked
companions of the shared decoder construction contract. They reuse the ordinary
alias, normalization, quantization and rotary policies; validation shares one
predicate worker with caller-funded diagnostics. The ordinary shared module
constructor owns the resulting parameter and specification destinations, and
native parameter binding remains a separate exact-source step.

Checked Moshi unit construction uses the shared module metadata destinations for
its depth parameter names, encoding companions and block directory. Copies of
normalized per-slice and local TP transformer configurations preserve the actual
names, scalar policy and ordered attention schedule while paying each concrete
string, schedule and replacement destination before allocation. Parameter source
binding and native invocation authority remain with their existing owners.


### Plain bounded parameter representation source

Plain original text quotation now lends its retained layerwise copy/read source
alongside the static model source. Before constructing any workspace tensor, the
native adapter copies the exact prepared parameter names, shapes, logical dtypes
and physical representations into the context's descriptive table. The neutral
extension shares initial installation's duplicate-conflict rule, refuses after
construction or span start, and uses the same paid metadata allocation worker.
Absent or contradictory physical evidence remains unknown.

This source handoff preserves the existing resident-shaped equation trace,
selective expert-parameter exclusions, and independent native constructor/copy
accounting. It does not import ordinary native owners, infer F32 from logical
shapes, or grant execution. The enclosing request retains and revalidates the
same prepared layerwise identity. Observed and parallel quotation continue to
bind those source rows at their existing checked unit acquisitions.

Unobserved serial saved-text preparation installs those same static and prepared
unit rows on its fresh context before copied-state spans begin. A move-only
prepared source then passes into the existing resume recipe and quote owner;
the quote does not reconstruct a second layerwise source or extend a started
context. The saved source, parameter epoch, native copy population, fresh request
admission and cumulative copy budgets keep their existing validation. This also
preserves the resumed token's actual cache position and selected readout demand.


The native Host-transfer constructor exposes its canonical array/copy output
layout as a fixed descriptive fact. Retained immutable Host snapshots and the
foreground source's exact encoded-read destinations carry that fact into the
same workspace parameter rows used by ordinary layerwise and independently
addressable execution. Floating dtype and canonical copy contiguity therefore
survive compact parameter construction, including affine scales and biases.
Logical shape alone remains insufficient: generic disk/custom recipe rows keep
unknown contiguity unless their own actual producer supplies a layout. The fact
creates no array, completion, source grant or budget, and existing source/alias
identity checks still select the physical owner. This changes neither native
copy execution nor its paid population.

Per-frame Moshi depth execution borrows the selected model's validated depth
template instead of reconstructing an owned per-slice configuration. The shared
depth worker reads its block count; slice-specific names and parameter identities
remain in the already-bound modules. Ordinary and checked construction still
produce their exact owned per-slice configurations, sharing the same index
validator with execution. No string or schedule clone is introduced by the
ordinary, controlled, or parallel frame's depth dispatch.

The shared native embedding source includes the actual `ZeroSentinel` lookup
prefix and tail: token-domain equality/or validation, selected-row lookup,
and equality/expanded-mask/zero/select output construction. Its constructor,
edge, eager-scalar, and backing-population facts preserve the ordinary single
validation boundary and the selected dense or packed-row worker. Sentinel
support does not infer a model family or replace invalid-token rejection.

The CPU dense embedding source follows the same sentinel domain assertion and
masked-row output as the native operator. It queries every actual cast,
broadcast, equality, logical-or, gather, Full, and Select source; in particular,
the output-zero scalar is I32 before its cast to the table's physical dtype.
Strict and sentinel lookups retain one validation completion, while serial and
vocabulary-parallel paths retain their distinct eager-scalar populations. The
focused CPU source check covers scalar and rank-two IDs, F32/F16/BF16 tables,
two negative sentinel values, and rejection of a nonnegative sentinel.

Evidence companion geometry uses the admitted intervention intent for its
descriptive identity. Every rank retains its distinct loaded-session
intervention admission and exact shared geometry owner; equal descriptions
create no source, callback, quota or native authority. This lets the existing
coordination and receipt protocols compare the same before/after evidence
declaration across ranks. Source storage, operation ordinal, side, window,
run/epoch and budget checks remain mandatory, and changed intervention semantics
still produce a different identity. Count and copy use the same paid string
producer; the geometry-only plan keeps zero independent budgets.


Original full-pager realtime branches prepare the checked rollback collector's
actual current-row and bounded historical telemetry storage from the retained
manager and participating local paged layer identities. The shared cache table
and telemetry constructors accept the same Host funding directly, without a
second workspace or inference driver. This metadata preparation does not grant
block/tail growth or native append work. It authenticates the unchanged manager
source before moving existing collector values; replaced storage retires after
the manager lock is released. The canonical collector keeps the new account
through discard until replacement or final manager retirement, while rollback
continues to validate original pages, completed append-only additions and exact
tail restoration through its existing checked worker.

Native concatenation retains the exact input representation for its singleton
alias. For two or more inputs, the existing native copy worker establishes
canonical row-contiguous output after actual scalar promotion, including empty
outputs. This producer fact survives the compact addressable parameter join;
unknown scalar sources remain unknown and singleton strided views retain their
original strides. The native layout regression compares these branches on
nonzero and empty F32/F16/BF16 inputs without changing admission or copy custody.

The first paid realtime state clone may also initialize the canonical state's
lazy revision identity through the shared retention worker. That immutable
revision and its escaped aliases retain the original metadata account after
reporting tables are replaced. Reporting replacement retires its predecessor
storage; it cannot refund a cumulative account that still owns this revision.
The full-pager transaction fixture checks both lifetimes independently and
requires final zero usage when the last corresponding owner is destroyed.

The packed grouped native source validates dense, affine, and MXFP4 parameter
roles through one borrowed census. Affine group16 retains all three selected
packed banks before its four-input QMM; larger groups retain the explicit-index
six-input GatherQMM, including native floating promotion. The existing dense
replacement branch remains a componentwise alternative for graph and backing
capacity. Native C and Rust adapter controls distinguish these actual workers;
no format name supplies missing parameter, invocation, or physical dtype facts.
Whole, Units, Finish, chunking and TP bias correction use the same grouped
lowering and retain the existing callback and completion ownership.


### Sampled and forced token validation source

The native equation recipe now prices the same finite token-domain validator
used by embedding and sequential decisions. It preserves integer normalization,
lower/upper comparisons and the deferred Boolean assertion, including that
assertion's independent completion root. Empty inputs retain the existing cast
branch without inventing an assertion. Invalid cardinalities and output geometry
remain rejected before quotation.

The CPU source reuses embedding's actual validation prefix and existing native
cast, comparison, Boolean and reduction producers; integer inputs acquire no
floating representation. Native Eval still authenticates the concrete operands.
Neither source changes the validator, bypasses an invalid-token failure, chooses
a family policy or grants work independently of the original scope.

Realtime frame completion now certifies every actual retained input, state,
history, output and updated random-key descriptor after the existing nested
completion settles, before publishing the frame. The shared original-observer
validator detaches only matching completed events; pending, foreign and failed
sources still refuse without new evaluation or admission. The exact cold
frontier count prepays these validations, and its original root allocation is
restored on failure. Later cold projection continues to require certified native
backing instead of inferring readiness from an enclosing completion alone.

### Shared capture collector capacity includes original evidence companions

The native prefill carrier prepares one fixed collector for both ordinary
capture rows and the Before/After geometry companions retained by the original
intervention source. Cold quotation and actual bootstrap use the same checked
population helper: root/publication slots sum across simultaneously retained
outputs, while reusable source-inspection controls use their peak. The exact
original source travels through the neutral bootstrap; capacity creates neither
a source registration nor capture quota. Every companion still needs its
original claim, shared segment, native scope and completed publication. Collector
capacity remains fixed after preparation and retires with the existing chunk
ticket. This closes the former parent-only collector estimate for partitioned
Summary evidence; no family or transport branch is introduced.

The canonical prefill capture bootstrap borrows the admitted bank's original
intervention source and retains it in the same source-segment stamp. Dense
partition evidence and reductions match their exact original companion admission
identities against that retained owner, alongside the existing parent identity;
newly rebuilt equal plans are rejected. Chunk, phase, account, native scope,
projection, and original claim validation still apply independently. Source pins
and the original source owner follow the same settled-segment retirement path.
Companion geometry carries no new logical quota: the parent ledger remains the
only evidence budget, and actual Host/source/native grants remain separate.

Affine projection output descriptions now follow the existing native physical
worker: packed QMM promotes the actual input, scale and affine-bias scalar types;
a floating weight replacement uses the actual input and replacement weight,
without its retained packed companions. An ordinary output bias participates
only in the final addition. Exact parameter roles and geometry remain checked,
and missing floating source facts remain unknown. This scalar-only producer
preserves representation through ordinary routed inputs and completed grouped
children; it grants no strides, storage or completion and does not weaken the
addressable parent source check.

Managed realtime serial execution now lends its actual frame metadata funding
through the same selected serial body used by ordinary execution. The concrete
adapter retains a failed layered model's typed source under that funding instead
of allocating an ordinary error string inside the accepted frame. Its existing
model-lease census includes the source wrapper and constructor controls; the
outer frame retains the same model, budget and failure custody. The change does
not alter the selected equation, residency acquisition or native acceptance.

The concrete realtime execution error adapter also lends the original native
policy cause through `Error::source`, while retaining the full portable layered
error for context. This preserves Host acquisition and completion causes before
the existing scheduler formats a submission failure. The portable policy
contract keeps its existing Display-only bound; no backend error requirement is
introduced there. The accepted model-lease and parallel wrapper census use this
exact retained source type, and the model and budget custody remain unchanged.

### Affine router scalar facts use actual selected operands

The shared router workspace projection preserves F32 only for a validated affine
selector whose participating native floating inputs and parameters carry exact
F32 facts. Packed geometry, companion roles, optional biases/scales, supplied
indices and original/effective output geometry remain checked. A floating weight
replacement follows the existing worker's early dense branch and ignores unused
packed companions. This scalar witness grants no layout, storage, completion or
native operation population; the selected native source qualifies those
separately. Thus load-time affine transformation can retain routing coefficients
without inferring precision from the model family or logical Float32 geometry.

The original communication preparation producer accepts the actual finite word
slice emitted by a neutral coordinator. Its initialized U32 source retains the
exact word count, and the same native world-Gather source validates the checked
count times the actual participant count before allocating its destination.
Text readiness keeps its existing fixed-width protocol validation at the caller;
managed realtime scheduler protocols can use their own exact records through
the same independently admitted input, native scope and completion owners.
This changes no wire policy and creates no model invocation or reusable quota.

Affine top-k selectors reuse the ordinary projection source after validating the
actual F32 hidden value, participating companions, parameter roles and output
geometry. The shared borrowed projection description retains the scalar fact
through flattening and follows the native floating-weight replacement before
consulting packed companions. Its matrix or packed byte source and native
primitive population remain the existing producers; selector normalization,
selection and scoring continue through the same routing worker. Flatten/cast
boundaries and any rejected BF16 probe have explicit controls. No logical dtype
stands in for missing physical evidence, and existing unsupported routing
policies retain their typed refusal.

Managed realtime scheduler consensus binds the actual loaded communication owner
and registered buffers before branching. Every reached word exchange uses the
shared original initialized U32 input, source-qualified CPU world Gather and
exact bounded completion, each compared against the same pool and caller's
explicit capacity. Protocol lengths and agreement remain neutral scheduler
policy. The original Host word destination is borrowed through validation; no
ordinary tensor constructor, unaccounted Vec extraction or new frame authority
is used. Setup metadata and the first typed transport failure remain retained
through outstanding completions and returned scheduler diagnostics.

Realtime distributed source admission uses the existing core fair preparation,
schedule comparison, submission agreement and completion/publication driver.
The source-aware entry supplies the actual canonical-state preparation callback;
all ranks agree its outcome before model dispatch. A refusal restores queued
work, discards unpublished branches through the original state owner and fences
further turns while retaining canonical state and the first local cause.
The backend adapter supplies the same measured prepare/submit callbacks used by
local frames and the existing selected world transport. It neither duplicates
scheduler policy nor treats scheduler consensus as a model equation source.

Realtime bounded policies use the same neural submission population producer as
ordinary bounded execution: shared graph boundaries plus the concrete policy's
final-output submission. Resident policy finish adds no submission. This
mechanism distinction is explicit before quotation and propagates through the
accepted bank, native boundary recipe and control census. The final bounded
submission consumes its own prepared slot; no slot reuse, observer bypass or
ordinary fallback is introduced.

Managed realtime consensus and scheduler diagnostics now use the same retained
protocol Host account before constructing exact UTF-8 destinations. A checked
count/write pair rejects formatting drift; funding refusal returns the existing
inline metadata error and stores a static fence reason. The prepaid native and
model first-cause owners remain authoritative through agreement and cleanup.
Unpublished-branch cleanup rotates the existing prepared directory and retains
its first failure without allocating a temporary error list or replacement queue.
Ordinary scheduler formatting and the shared disposition worker remain in place.

The managed distributed frame adapter also lends every original prepublication
completion or host-observation error to its explicitly prepaid first-cause slot
before the shared consensus worker can discard a failed output. The callback
moves the exact composite error, including any cached observation source alias,
into one counted neutral error owner. That owner retains Host funding through
return to the caller. Poll failure still triggers the existing rank agreement
and quarantine/retirement rules; retaining a diagnostic proves no completion.


### Transformed checkpoint source publication

The shared bounded-quantization source lends both its retained original branch
and its transformed in-memory payloads to the existing borrowed inventory
visitor. Hidden source owners remain included; incomplete branches stay unknown.
A managed request may retain a load-time ordinary source only while its exact
physical key and capacity have a live, fully charged ordinary registration in
that same pool. This is an existing-source alias, not original constructor
custody. Both preflight and the canonical publication transaction reject missing,
foreign, changed-capacity or differently funded rows; publication cannot create
such a source row or move its charge into the native equation budget. The original
GGUF constructor path keeps its independent same-pool custody checks. Source
owners, registration aliases and the fixed collector/control census survive the
same completion and saved-state lifetimes as other retained input sources.


### Inactive adapter feature configuration

The portable facade keeps Metal, CUDA and NCCL forwarding flags inert when the
MLX adapter is not selected. Its incompatible Metal/CUDA diagnostic therefore
requires the `mlx` feature as well as both options. Selecting the adapter still
rejects that incompatible native configuration, and the concrete backend retains
its own feature guard. Host image/audio features remain independently usable.


Original host thread startup can read the exact accepted ceiling of a live
source account before that account enters native funding. The shared runtime
keeps the source's role-specific publication validation, execution-identity
check and capacity lookup under one pool lock; its general ledger getters
remain restricted to funded accounts. Foreign, retired or quarantined sources
do not supply a ceiling. Startup still commits a separate host-only account
under the original ceiling, with the existing joined-thread retirement and
unresolved-thread quarantine rules. No source construction or native allowance
is recreated by the lookup. This also covers the existing realtime Disk path
with background Host prefetch through its original realtime source custody.


Original background Host prefetch now retains the completed cold layerwise
acquisition itinerary when a selected invocation omits execution units. The
native coordinator consumes window payloads tagged with their original logical
ordinals and completes only after every declared visit was consumed. Each visit
still uses its original Host lookahead, canonical source and device promotion;
the itinerary cannot widen those sources or authorize another attempt. Ordinary
whole-layout invocations keep their full ordered itinerary. An empty declared
visit starts no thread. Successful nonempty completion still requires drained
native leases, actual worker idleness and join before advancing the forward;
failure closes the same source owner without resetting spending. Realtime binds
this generic mechanism from the actual workspace acquisition trace, including
forced depth tails, without a family-specific residency policy.
